name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.esiste_ortogonale_nello_span
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set f : W →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := (innerSL ℝ d).toLinearMap.comp W.subtype with hf
  have hrange : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range f) ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range f) ≤ Module.finrank ℝ ℝ :=
      Submodule.finrank_le _
    simpa using h1
  have hrk := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker f
  have hker : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker f) := by omega
  have hne : LinearMap.ker f ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hker
    simp [finrank_bot] at hker
  obtain ⟨w, hwker, hwne⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
  refine ⟨(w : E n), w.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    apply hwne
    exact Subtype.ext h
  · have h1 : f w = 0 := hwker
    have h2 : ⟪d, (w : E n)⟫ = 0 := h1
    rw [real_inner_comm] at h2
    exact h2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.secondo_spigolo
statement:
theorem secondo_spigolo (Q : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) = 2)
    {v : E n} (hv : v ∈ Q.vertices)
    {e₁ : Set (E n)} (he₁ : Q.IsFace e₁) (hde₁ : faceDim e₁ = 1)
    (hve₁ : v ∈ e₁) :
    ∃ e₂ : Set (E n), Q.IsFace e₂ ∧ faceDim e₂ = 1 ∧ v ∈ e₂ ∧ e₂ ≠ e₁
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (vertex_isFace Q hv).1 (Set.singleton_nonempty v)
  have hvT : v ∈ Q.toSet := by
    have : v ∈ ({v} : Set (E n)) := rfl
    rw [hl] at this
    exact this.1
  have hlmax : ∀ y ∈ Q.toSet, l y ≤ l v := by
    have : v ∈ ({v} : Set (E n)) := rfl
    rw [hl] at this
    exact this.2
  have hlchar : ∀ q ∈ Q.toSet, l q = l v → q = v := by
    intro q hq hlq
    have : q ∈ ({v} : Set (E n)) := by
      rw [hl]
      exact ⟨hq, fun y hy => le_trans (hlmax y hy) (le_of_eq hlq.symm)⟩
    exact this
  
  obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁e, hu₁v⟩ := faccia_ha_secondo_punto hde₁ (v := v)
  have hu₁T : u₁ ∈ Q.toSet := face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hu₁e
  
  have hu₁lt : l u₁ < l v := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hlmax u₁ hu₁T) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hlchar u₁ hu₁T h) hu₁v
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwW, hwne, hwd⟩ := esiste_ortogonale_nello_span
    (le_of_eq hdim.symm) (u₁ - v)
  
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀V, hu₀ne⟩ := exists_vertex_inner_ne Q hvT hwW hwne
  
  
  have costruzione : ∀ w' : E n, ⟪w', u₁ - v⟫ = 0 →
      (∃ u ∈ Q.vertices, ⟪w', v⟫ < ⟪w', u⟫) →
      ∃ e₂ : Set (E n), Q.IsFace e₂ ∧ faceDim e₂ = 1 ∧ v ∈ e₂ ∧ e₂ ≠ e₁ := by
    intro w' hw'd hup
    obtain ⟨ux, huxV, huxgt⟩ := hup
    
    set S : Finset (E n) := Q.vertices.filter (fun u => ⟪w', v⟫ < ⟪w', u⟫)
      with hS
    have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨ux, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huxV, huxgt⟩⟩
    
    set r : E n → ℝ := fun u => (l v - l u) / (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫) with hr
    obtain ⟨us, husS, husmin⟩ := S.exists_min_image r hSne
    have husV : us ∈ Q.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp husS).1
    have husgt : ⟪w', v⟫ < ⟪w', us⟫ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp husS).2
    have husne : us ≠ v := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at husgt
      exact lt_irrefl _ husgt
    have husT : us ∈ Q.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ husV
    have huslt : l us < l v := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hlmax us husT) with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd (hlchar us husT h) husne
    set t : ℝ := r us with ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := by
      rw [ht, hr]
      apply div_pos
      · linarith
      · linarith
    
    set ψ : E n →L[ℝ] ℝ := l + t • innerSL ℝ w' with hψ
    have hψval : ∀ y : E n, ψ y = l y + t * ⟪w', y⟫ := by
      intro y
      rw [hψ]
      simp
    
    have hvert : ∀ u ∈ Q.vertices, ψ u ≤ ψ v := by
      intro u huV
      rw [hψval, hψval]
      by_cases hside : ⟪w', v⟫ < ⟪w', u⟫
      · 
        have huS : u ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huV, hside⟩
        have hrle : t ≤ r u := husmin u huS
        have hgap : (0:ℝ) < ⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫ := by linarith
        have h1 : t * (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫) ≤ r u * (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrle (le_of_lt hgap)
        have h2 : r u * (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫) = l v - l u := by
          rw [hr]
          field_simp
        nlinarith
      · 
        push_neg at hside
        have h1 : l u ≤ l v := hlmax u (subset_convexHull ℝ _ huV)
        have h2 : t * ⟪w', u⟫ ≤ t * ⟪w', v⟫ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hside (le_of_lt htpos)
        linarith
    
    have hbody : ∀ y ∈ Q.toSet, ψ y ≤ ψ v := by
      intro y hy
      have hconv : Convex ℝ {z : E n | ψ z ≤ ψ v} := by
        apply convex_halfSpace_le
        exact ψ.toLinearMap.isLinear
      have hsub : (Q.vertices : Set (E n)) ⊆ {z : E n | ψ z ≤ ψ v} := by
        intro u hu
        exact hvert u (Finset.mem_coe.mp hu)
      have := convexHull_min hsub hconv
      exact this hy
    
    set F : Set (E n) := {x ∈ Q.toSet | ∀ y ∈ Q.toSet, ψ y ≤ ψ x} with hF
    have hvF : v ∈ F := ⟨hvT, hbody⟩
    have hFface : Q.IsFace F := by
      refine ⟨fun _ => ⟨ψ, rfl⟩, ⟨v, hvF⟩⟩
    
    have htie : ψ us = ψ v := by
      rw [hψval, hψval]
      have hgap : (0:ℝ) < ⟪w', us⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫ := by linarith
      have h2 : t * (⟪w', us⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫) = l v - l us := by
        show (l v - l us) / (⟪w', us⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫) * (⟪w', us⟫ - ⟪w', v⟫) =
          l v - l us
        exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hgap)
      nlinarith [h2]
    have husF : us ∈ F := by
      refine ⟨husT, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      rw [htie]
      exact hbody y hy
    
    have hu₁F : u₁ ∉ F := by
      intro hmem
      have h1 : ψ u₁ = ψ v :=
        le_antisymm (hbody u₁ hu₁T) (hmem.2 v hvT)
      rw [hψval, hψval] at h1
      have h2 : ⟪w', u₁⟫ = ⟪w', v⟫ := by
        have h3 : ⟪w', u₁ - v⟫ = 0 := hw'd
        rw [inner_sub_right] at h3
        linarith
      have h4 : l u₁ = l v := by
        rw [h2] at h1
        linarith
      exact hu₁v (hlchar u₁ hu₁T h4)
    
    have hFne : F ≠ Q.toSet := by
      intro h
      exact hu₁F (h ▸ hu₁T)
    have hFne₁ : F ≠ e₁ := by
      intro h
      exact hu₁F (h ▸ hu₁e)
    
    have hd1 : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F) :=
      finrank_pos_di_due hvF husF husne
    have hd2 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F) < 2 := by
      have hss : F ⊂ Q.toSet :=
        ⟨fun x hx => hx.1, fun hsup => hFne
          (Set.Subset.antisymm (fun x hx => hx.1) hsup)⟩
      have h1 := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset Q hFface (toSet_isFace Q) hss
      have h2 : faceDim Q.toSet = 2 := hdim
      have h3 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F) <
          Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) := h1
      omega
    refine ⟨F, hFface, ?_, hvF, hFne₁⟩
    show Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F) = 1
    omega
  
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hu₀ne with hlt | hgt
  · 
    apply costruzione (-w)
    · rw [inner_neg_left, hwd, neg_zero]
    · refine ⟨u₀, hu₀V, ?_⟩
      rw [inner_neg_left, inner_neg_left]
      linarith
  · 
    exact costruzione w hwd ⟨u₀, hu₀V, hgt⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.flag_vertex_coordinates
statement:
private theorem flag_vertex_coordinates :
    (∀ j : Fin 4, e1_600 j = ![(1 : ℝ), 0, 0, 0] j) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 4, c1_600 j =
      ![aureo / 2, (1 : ℝ) / 2, (aureo - 1) / 2, 0] j) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 4, c2_600 j =
      ![aureo / 2, (1 : ℝ) / 2, -(aureo - 1) / 2, 0] j) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 4, c3_600 j =
      ![aureo / 2, (aureo - 1) / 2, 0, (1 : ℝ) / 2] j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    fin_cases j <;> norm_num [e1_600, vertA_apply]
  · intro j
    fin_cases j
    · simpa [c1_600, segniC1, segnoC, baseC] using
        (vertC_at (1 : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) segniC1 (0 : Fin 4))
    · simpa [c1_600, segniC1, segnoC, baseC] using
        (vertC_at (1 : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) segniC1 (1 : Fin 4))
    · simpa [c1_600, segniC1, segnoC, baseC] using
        (vertC_at (1 : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) segniC1 (2 : Fin 4))
    · simpa [c1_600, segniC1, segnoC, baseC] using
        (vertC_at (1 : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) segniC1 (3 : Fin 4))
  · intro j
    fin_cases j
    · simpa [c2_600, segniC2, segnoC, baseC] using
        (vertC_at (1 : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) segniC2 (0 : Fin 4))
    · simpa [c2_600, segniC2, segnoC, baseC] using
        (vertC_at (1 : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) segniC2 (1 : Fin 4))
    · convert (vertC_at (1 : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) segniC2
        (2 : Fin 4)) using 1 <;>
        simp [c2_600, segniC2, segnoC, baseC] <;> ring
    · simpa [c2_600, segniC2, segnoC, baseC] using
        (vertC_at (1 : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) segniC2 (3 : Fin 4))
  · intro j
    fin_cases j
    · simpa [c3_600, sigma3_600, segniC1, segnoC, baseC,
        Equiv.swap_apply_def] using
        (vertC_at sigma3_600 segniC1 (0 : Fin 4))
    · simpa [c3_600, sigma3_600, segniC1, segnoC, baseC,
        Equiv.swap_apply_def] using
        (vertC_at sigma3_600 segniC1 (2 : Fin 4))
    · simpa [c3_600, sigma3_600, segniC1, segnoC, baseC,
        Equiv.swap_apply_def] using
        (vertC_at sigma3_600 segniC1 (3 : Fin 4))
    · simpa [c3_600, sigma3_600, segniC1, segnoC, baseC,
        Equiv.swap_apply_def] using
        (vertC_at sigma3_600 segniC1 (1 : Fin 4))

  · exact ⟨(1, segniC1), rfl⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_flag_values
statement:
private theorem l3_flag_values :
    l3_600 e1_600 = 1 + 3 * aureo / 2 ∧
      l3_600 c1_600 = 1 + 3 * aureo / 2 ∧
      l3_600 c2_600 = 1 + 3 * aureo / 2 ∧
      l3_600 c3_600 = 1 + 3 * aureo / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [l3_600_apply, l3_600_apply, l3_600_apply, l3_600_apply]
  rw [flag_vertex_coordinates.1 0, flag_vertex_coordinates.1 1,
    flag_vertex_coordinates.1 3, flag_vertex_coordinates.2.1 0,
    flag_vertex_coordinates.2.1 1, flag_vertex_coordinates.2.1 3,
    flag_vertex_coordinates.2.2.1 0, flag_vertex_coordinates.2.2.1 1,
    flag_vertex_coordinates.2.2.1 3,
    flag_vertex_coordinates.2.2.2 0, flag_vertex_coordinates.2.2.2 1,
    flag_vertex_coordinates.2.2.2 3]
  simp
  constructor <;> nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_vertA_le
statement:
private theorem l3_vertA_le (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) :
    l3_600 (vertA i b) ≤ 1 + 3 * aureo / 2
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> cases b <;>
    norm_num [l3_600_apply, vertA_apply, Fin.ext_iff] <;>
    nlinarith [aureo_sq, aureo_bounds.1, aureo_bounds.2]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_vertB_lt
statement:
private theorem l3_vertB_lt (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    l3_600 (vertB s) < 1 + 3 * aureo / 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [l3_600_apply, vertB_apply]
  cases h0 : s 0 <;> cases h1 : s 1 <;> cases h3 : s 3 <;>
    norm_num <;>
    nlinarith [aureo_sq, aureo_bounds.1, aureo_bounds.2]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertC_coord_le_base
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertC_apply]
  have hb := baseC_nonneg ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)
  have hs_all (k : Fin 4) : segnoC s k ≤ 1 := by
    fin_cases k <;>
      simp [segnoC] <;> split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hs := hs_all ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)
  nlinarith

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_vertC_le
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := vertC_coord_le_base σ s (0 : Fin 4)
  have h1 := vertC_coord_le_base σ s (1 : Fin 4)
  have h3 := vertC_coord_le_base σ s (3 : Fin 4)
  have hk0 := Equiv.apply_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (0 : Fin 4)
  have hk1 := Equiv.apply_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (1 : Fin 4)
  have hk3 := Equiv.apply_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (3 : Fin 4)
  generalize he0 : (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm 0 = k0 at h0 hk0
  generalize he1 : (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm 1 = k1 at h1 hk1
  generalize he3 : (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm 3 = k3 at h3 hk3
  rw [l3_600_apply]
  fin_cases σ
  all_goals fin_cases k0
  all_goals norm_num [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def,
    Fin.ext_iff] at hk0
  all_goals fin_cases k1
  all_goals norm_num [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def,
    Fin.ext_iff] at hk1
  all_goals fin_cases k3
  all_goals norm_num [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def,
    Fin.ext_iff] at hk3
  all_goals norm_num [baseC] at h0 h1 h3 ⊢
  all_goals nlinarith [aureo_sq, aureo_bounds.1, aureo_bounds.2]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_vertA_eq
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> cases b <;>
    norm_num [l3_600_apply, vertA_apply, Fin.ext_iff] at h <;>
    try nlinarith [aureo_sq, aureo_bounds.1, aureo_bounds.2]
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_vertC_eq
statement:
private theorem l3_vertC_eq (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (s : Fin 3 → Bool)
    (h : l3_600 (vertC σ s) = 1 + 3 * aureo / 2) :
    vertC σ s = c1_600 ∨ vertC σ s = c2_600 ∨ vertC σ s = c3_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [l3_600_apply, vertC_apply, vertC_apply, vertC_apply] at h
  have hk0 := Equiv.apply_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (0 : Fin 4)
  have hk1 := Equiv.apply_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (1 : Fin 4)
  have hk2 := Equiv.apply_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (2 : Fin 4)
  have hk3 := Equiv.apply_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (3 : Fin 4)
  generalize he0 : (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm 0 = k0 at h hk0
  generalize he1 : (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm 1 = k1 at h hk1
  generalize he2 : (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm 2 = k2 at hk2
  generalize he3 : (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm 3 = k3 at h hk3
  fin_cases σ
  all_goals fin_cases k0
  all_goals norm_num [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def,
    Fin.ext_iff] at hk0
  all_goals fin_cases k1
  all_goals norm_num [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def,
    Fin.ext_iff] at hk1
  all_goals fin_cases k2
  all_goals norm_num [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def,
    Fin.ext_iff] at hk2
  all_goals fin_cases k3
  all_goals norm_num [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def,
    Fin.ext_iff] at hk3
  all_goals
    cases hs0 : s 0 <;> cases hs1 : s 1 <;> cases hs2 : s 2 <;>
      norm_num [segnoC, baseC, hs0, hs1, hs2] at h
  all_goals try nlinarith [aureo_sq, aureo_bounds.1, aureo_bounds.2]
  all_goals
    first
    | left
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;>
        simp [vertC_apply, he0, he1, he2, he3, hs0, hs1, hs2,
          segnoC, baseC, c1_600, c2_600, c3_600, segniC1, segniC2,
          sigma3_600, ← Equiv.Perm.inv_def, mul_inv_rev, Equiv.swap_inv,
          Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def, Fin.ext_iff]
      done
    | right; left
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;>
        simp [vertC_apply, he0, he1, he2, he3, hs0, hs1, hs2,
          segnoC, baseC, c1_600, c2_600, c3_600, segniC1, segniC2,
          sigma3_600, ← Equiv.Perm.inv_def, mul_inv_rev, Equiv.swap_inv,
          Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def, Fin.ext_iff]
      done
    | right; right
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;>
        simp [vertC_apply, he0, he1, he2, he3, hs0, hs1, hs2,
          segnoC, baseC, c1_600, c2_600, c3_600, segniC1, segniC2,
          sigma3_600, ← Equiv.Perm.inv_def, mul_inv_rev, Equiv.swap_inv,
          Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def, Fin.ext_iff]
      done

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_vertices_le
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hv' : v ∈ seicentoVertici := by exact_mod_cast hv
  simp only [seicentoVertici, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hv'
  rcases hv' with (⟨p, hp⟩ | ⟨s, hs⟩) | ⟨p, hp⟩
  · rw [← hp]
    exact l3_vertA_le p.1 p.2
  · rw [← hs]
    exact (l3_vertB_lt s).le
  · rw [← hp]
    exact l3_vertC_le p.1 p.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.argmax_l3_600
statement:
private theorem argmax_l3_600 :
    {x ∈ (seicento.vertices : Set E4) |
      l3_600 x = 1 + 3 * aureo / 2} =
      (generatoriF3_600 : Set E4)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hl⟩
    have hx' : x ∈ seicentoVertici := by exact_mod_cast hx
    simp only [seicentoVertici, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
      Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx'
    rcases hx' with (⟨p, hp⟩ | ⟨s, hs⟩) | ⟨p, hp⟩
    · rw [← hp] at hl ⊢
      rw [l3_vertA_eq p.1 p.2 hl]
      simp [generatoriF3_600]
    · rw [← hs] at hl
      have := l3_vertB_lt s
      linarith
    · rw [← hp] at hl ⊢
      rcases l3_vertC_eq p.1 p.2 hl with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;>
        simp [generatoriF3_600]
  · intro hx
    have hc : x = e1_600 ∨ x = c1_600 ∨ x = c2_600 ∨ x = c3_600 := by
      simpa [generatoriF3_600] using hx
    rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast flag_vertices_mem.1, l3_flag_values.1⟩
    · exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast flag_vertices_mem.2.1, l3_flag_values.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast flag_vertices_mem.2.2.1,
        l3_flag_values.2.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast flag_vertices_mem.2.2.2,
        l3_flag_values.2.2.2⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isExposed_argmax_600
statement:
private theorem isExposed_argmax_600 (s : Finset E4) (l : E4 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (c : ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (harg : {x ∈ (seicento.vertices : Set E4) | l x = c} = (s : Set E4))
    (hle : ∀ x ∈ seicento.toSet, l x ≤ c) :
    IsExposed ℝ seicento.toSet (convexHull ℝ (s : Set E4))
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  have hsV : (s : Set E4) ⊆ (seicento.vertices : Set E4) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← harg] at hx
    exact hx.1
  have hsP : (s : Set E4) ⊆ seicento.toSet := by
    intro x hx
    exact subset_convexHull ℝ _ (hsV hx)
  have hsub : convexHull ℝ (s : Set E4) ⊆ seicento.toSet :=
    convexHull_min hsP (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have heq : ∀ x ∈ (s : Set E4), l x = c := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← harg] at hx
    exact hx.2
  have hge : ∀ x ∈ convexHull ℝ (s : Set E4), c ≤ l x := by
    intro x hx
    exact convexHull_min (fun y hy => by change c ≤ l y; rw [heq y hy])
      (convex_halfSpace_ge (LinearMap.isLinear l.toLinearMap) c) hx
  refine ⟨l, Set.ext ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hlx : l x = c := le_antisymm (hle x (hsub hx)) (hge x hx)
    exact ⟨hsub hx, fun y hy => by rw [hlx]; exact hle y hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxP, hxmax⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
    have haS : a ∈ (s : Set E4) := by exact_mod_cast ha
    have haP : a ∈ seicento.toSet := hsP haS
    have hlx : l x = c := by
      apply le_antisymm (hle x hxP)
      simpa [heq a haS] using hxmax a haP
    have hxarg := faccia_argmax seicento.vertices l hxP hxmax
    have hset : {z ∈ (seicento.vertices : Set E4) | l z = l x} =
        (s : Set E4) := by simpa [hlx] using harg
    rwa [hset] at hxarg

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F3_600_isFace

    (1 + 3 * aureo / 2) (by simp [generatoriF3_600])
    argmax_l3_600 l3_toSet_le

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.argmax_l2_generators
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hne : 3 * aureo / 2 ≠ 1 + aureo := by
    intro h
    linarith [aureo_bounds.2]
  simp only [generatoriF3_600, generatoriF2_600, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
    Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hl⟩
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
    · rw [small_functional_values.2.2.2.2.2] at hl
      exact (hne hl).elim
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, small_functional_values.2.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), small_functional_values.2.2.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)),
        small_functional_values.2.2.2.2.1⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isExposed_hull_argmax
statement:
private theorem isExposed_hull_argmax (t s : Finset E4)
    (l : E4 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (harg : {x ∈ (t : Set E4) | l x = c} = (s : Set E4))
    (hleV : ∀ x ∈ (t : Set E4), l x ≤ c) :
    IsExposed ℝ (convexHull ℝ (t : Set E4))
      (convexHull ℝ (s : Set E4))
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  have hsT : (s : Set E4) ⊆ (t : Set E4) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← harg] at hx
    exact hx.1
  have hsP : (s : Set E4) ⊆ convexHull ℝ (t : Set E4) :=
    fun x hx => subset_convexHull ℝ _ (hsT hx)
  have hsub : convexHull ℝ (s : Set E4) ⊆ convexHull ℝ (t : Set E4) :=
    convexHull_min hsP (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have hle : ∀ x ∈ convexHull ℝ (t : Set E4), l x ≤ c := by
    intro x hx
    exact convexHull_min hleV
      (convex_halfSpace_le (LinearMap.isLinear l.toLinearMap) c) hx
  have heq : ∀ x ∈ (s : Set E4), l x = c := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← harg] at hx
    exact hx.2
  have hge : ∀ x ∈ convexHull ℝ (s : Set E4), c ≤ l x := by
    intro x hx
    exact convexHull_min (fun y hy => by change c ≤ l y; rw [heq y hy])
      (convex_halfSpace_ge (LinearMap.isLinear l.toLinearMap) c) hx
  refine ⟨l, Set.ext ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hlx : l x = c := le_antisymm (hle x (hsub hx)) (hge x hx)
    exact ⟨hsub hx, fun y hy => by rw [hlx]; exact hle y hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxP, hxmax⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
    have haS : a ∈ (s : Set E4) := by exact_mod_cast ha
    have haP : a ∈ convexHull ℝ (t : Set E4) := hsP haS
    have hlx : l x = c := by
      apply le_antisymm (hle x hxP)
      simpa [heq a haS] using hxmax a haP
    have hxarg := faccia_argmax t l hxP hxmax
    have hset : {z ∈ (t : Set E4) | l z = l x} = (s : Set E4) := by
      simpa [hlx] using harg
    rwa [hset] at hxarg

        · rw [small_functional_values.2.2.2.1]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.p3_600_affineIndependent
statement: private theorem p3_600_affineIndependent : AffineIndependent ℝ p3_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_eq_of_fintype_affineCombination_eq]
  intro a b ha hb hab
  funext i
  have hc (j : Fin 4) := congrArg (fun x : E4 => x j) hab
  rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ (by simpa using ha),
    Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ (by simpa using hb)] at hc
  have h0 := hc 0
  have h1 := hc 1
  have h2 := hc 2
  have h3 := hc 3
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at ha hb
  norm_num [p3_600_zero, p3_600_one, p3_600_two, p3_600_three,
    Fin.sum_univ_four] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  have e3 : a 3 = b 3 := by linarith
  have e1 : a 1 = b 1 := by
    nlinarith [aureo_sub_one_pos]
  have e2 : a 2 = b 2 := by
    nlinarith [aureo_sub_one_pos]
  have e0 : a 0 = b 0 := by linarith
  fin_cases i
  · exact e0
  · exact e1
  · exact e2
  · exact e3

proof:

  have hgen : (generatoriF1_600 : Set E4) = {e1_600, c1_600} := by
    ext x
    simp [generatoriF1_600]
  rw [F1_600, hgen, convexHull_pair]
  unfold faceDim
  rw [vectorSpan_segment]
  apply finrank_span_singleton
  exact vsub_ne_zero.mpr e1_ne_c1_600.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faceDim_F2_600
statement: theorem faceDim_F2_600 : faceDim F2_600 = 2
proof:
:= by

    direction_affineSpan, ← range_p2_600]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F0_ssubset_F1_600
statement: theorem F0_ssubset_F1_600 : F0_600 ⊂ F1_600
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
  constructor
  · apply convexHull_mono
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : x = e1_600 := by simpa [generatoriF0_600] using hx
    subst x
    simp [generatoriF1_600]
  · intro h
    have hd := faceDim_F0_600
    rw [h, faceDim_F1_600] at hd
    omega

      simpa [generatoriF1_600] using hx
    rcases hc with rfl | rfl <;> simp [generatoriF2_600]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoLinear_apply_coord_600
statement:
@[simp] private theorem segnoLinear_apply_coord_600 (d : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ))
    (x : E d) (i : Fin d) :
    segnoLinear d σ ε x (σ i) = (ε i : ℝ) * x i
proof:
:= by
  simp [segnoLinear]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.signedBool_spec
proof:
:= by
  have hu := u.property
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hu
  rcases hu with hu | hu <;> cases b <;>
    simp [signedBool, hu] <;> norm_num at *

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.signedEven_vertA
statement:
private theorem signedEven_vertA (τ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) :
    segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε (vertA i b) =
      vertA ((τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) i) (signedBool (ε i) b)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  let k := (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j
  have hj : (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k = j :=
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).apply_symm_apply j
  rw [← hj, segnoPerm_apply, segnoLinear_apply_coord_600]
  simp only [vertA_apply]
  change (ε k : ℝ) *
      (if k = i then (if b then 1 else -1) else 0) =
    if (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k = (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) i then
      (if signedBool (ε i) b then 1 else -1) else 0
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · have hτki : (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k =
        (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) i := congrArg _ hki
    rw [if_pos hki, if_pos hτki, hki]
    exact signedBool_spec (ε i) b |>.symm
  · have hτki : (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k ≠
        (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) i :=
      ((τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).injective.ne hki)
    simp [hki, hτki]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.signedEven_vertB
statement:
private theorem signedEven_vertB (τ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε (vertB s) =
      vertB (fun j => signedBool (ε ((τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j))
        (s ((τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)))
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  let k := (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j
  have hj : (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k = j :=
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).apply_symm_apply j
  rw [← hj, segnoPerm_apply, segnoLinear_apply_coord_600]
  simp only [vertB_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  calc
    (ε k : ℝ) * (if s k then 1 / 2 else -(1 / 2)) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((ε k : ℝ) * (if s k then 1 else -1)) := by
          cases hsk : s k <;> simp [hsk] <;> ring
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (if signedBool (ε k) (s k) then 1 else -1) := by
          rw [← signedBool_spec]
    _ = if signedBool (ε k) (s k) then 1 / 2 else -(1 / 2) := by
          cases signedBool (ε k) (s k) <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.signedEven_vertC
statement:
private theorem signedEven_vertC (τ σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (s : Fin 3 → Bool) :
    segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε (vertC σ s) =
      vertC (τ * σ) (signedC ε σ s)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  let k := ((τ * σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) :
    Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j
  have hj : (((τ * σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) :
      Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k) = j :=
    ((τ * σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) :
      Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).apply_symm_apply j
  rw [← hj]
  change segnoLinear 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε (vertC σ s)
      ((τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k)) = _
  rw [segnoLinear_apply_coord_600, vertC_at, vertC_at]
  clear hj
  clear_value k
  clear j
  fin_cases k
  · simpa [signedC, segnoC] using
      congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z * baseC (0 : Fin 4))
        (signedBool_spec (ε ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) 0)) (s 0)).symm
  · simpa [signedC, segnoC] using
      congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z * baseC (1 : Fin 4))
        (signedBool_spec (ε ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) 1)) (s 1)).symm
  · simpa [signedC, segnoC] using
      congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z * baseC (2 : Fin 4))
        (signedBool_spec (ε ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) 2)) (s 2)).symm
  · simp [baseC]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.signedEven_mem_seicentoVertici
statement:
private theorem signedEven_mem_seicentoVertici
    (τ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) {v : E4}
    (hv : v ∈ seicentoVertici) :
    segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε v ∈ seicentoVertici
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [seicentoVertici, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hv ⊢
  rcases hv with (⟨p, rfl⟩ | ⟨s, rfl⟩) | ⟨p, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨((τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) p.1,
      signedBool (ε p.1) p.2), (signedEven_vertA τ ε p.1 p.2).symm⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(fun j =>
      signedBool (ε ((τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j))
        (s ((τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j))),
      (signedEven_vertB τ ε s).symm⟩)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨(τ * p.1, signedC ε p.1 p.2),
      (signedEven_vertC τ p.1 ε p.2).symm⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.signedEven_image_seicentoVertici
statement:
private theorem signedEven_image_seicentoVertici
    (τ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) :
    (segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε : E4 → E4) ''
      (seicentoVertici : Set E4) = (seicentoVertici : Set E4)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Finset.image
      (segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε : E4 → E4)
      seicentoVertici = seicentoVertici := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hv
      exact signedEven_mem_seicentoVertici τ ε hu
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _
        (segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε).injective]
  rw [← Finset.coe_image, hfin]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.signedEven_isSymmetry_seicento
statement:
theorem signedEven_isSymmetry_seicento (τ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) :
    seicento.isSymmetry (segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry, ConvexPolytope.toSet]
  calc
    (segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε : E4 → E4) ''
        convexHull ℝ ((seicento.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4) =
      convexHull ℝ ((segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε : E4 → E4) ''
        ((seicento.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4)) := by
          exact (segnoPerm 4 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ε).toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.image_convexHull _
    _ = convexHull ℝ ((seicento.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4) := by
      rw [show ((seicento.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4) =
          (seicentoVertici : Set E4) by rfl,
        signedEven_image_seicentoVertici]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.signedRefl_apply
statement:
private theorem signedRefl_apply
    (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (x : E4) (i : Fin 4) :
    segnoPerm 4 (Equiv.refl (Fin 4)) ε x i = (ε i : ℝ) * x i
proof:
:= by
  simpa using segnoLinear_apply_coord_600 4 (Equiv.refl (Fin 4)) ε x i

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r1_600_isSymmetry
statement: theorem r1_600_isSymmetry : seicento.isSymmetry r1_600
proof:
:= by
  exact signedEven_isSymmetry_seicento 1 segnoTerza_600

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r3_600_isSymmetry
statement: theorem r3_600_isSymmetry : seicento.isSymmetry r3_600
proof:
:= by
  exact signedEven_isSymmetry_seicento 1 segnoQuarta_600

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r1_600_vertices
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> ext k <;> fin_cases k <;>
    rw [show r1_600 _ _ = (segnoTerza_600 _ : ℝ) * _ by
      exact signedRefl_apply segnoTerza_600 _ _] <;>
    simp [segnoTerza_600] <;> ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r3_600_vertices
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> ext k <;> fin_cases k <;>

      exact signedRefl_apply segnoQuarta_600 _ _] <;>

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.image_convexHull_isom600
statement:
private theorem image_convexHull_isom600 (g : Isom 4) (s : Set E4) :
    (g : E4 → E4) '' convexHull ℝ s = convexHull ℝ ((g : E4 → E4) '' s)
proof:
:=
  g.toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.image_convexHull s

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r1_image_F0_600
statement: private theorem r1_image_F0_600 : (r1_600 : E4 → E4) '' F0_600 = F0_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [F0_600, image_convexHull_isom600]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [generatoriF0_600, r1_600_vertices.1]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r1_image_F2_600
statement: private theorem r1_image_F2_600 : (r1_600 : E4 → E4) '' F2_600 = F2_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [F2_600, image_convexHull_isom600]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [generatoriF2_600, r1_600_vertices.1, r1_600_vertices.2.1,
    r1_600_vertices.2.2.1] <;> tauto

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r1_image_F3_600
statement: private theorem r1_image_F3_600 : (r1_600 : E4 → E4) '' F3_600 = F3_600
proof:
:= by

  ext x

statement: private theorem r3_image_F0_600 : (r3_600 : E4 → E4) '' F0_600 = F0_600

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r3_image_F1_600

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r3_image_F2_600

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l1_eq_on_F1_600
statement:
private theorem l1_eq_on_F1_600 {x : E4} (hx : x ∈ F1_600) :
    l1_600 x = 1 + aureo / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [F1_600] at hx
  exact le_antisymm
    (convexHull_min (fun y hy => by
        change l1_600 y ≤ 1 + aureo / 2
        have hc : y = e1_600 ∨ y = c1_600 := by
          simpa [generatoriF1_600] using hy
        rcases hc with rfl | rfl
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.1.1]
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.1.2.1])
      (convex_halfSpace_le (LinearMap.isLinear l1_600.toLinearMap)
        (1 + aureo / 2)) hx)
    (convexHull_min (fun y hy => by
        change 1 + aureo / 2 ≤ l1_600 y
        have hc : y = e1_600 ∨ y = c1_600 := by
          simpa [generatoriF1_600] using hy
        rcases hc with rfl | rfl
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.1.1]
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.1.2.1])
      (convex_halfSpace_ge (LinearMap.isLinear l1_600.toLinearMap)
        (1 + aureo / 2)) hx)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r1_moves_F1_600
statement: private theorem r1_moves_F1_600 : (r1_600 : E4 → E4) '' F1_600 ≠ F1_600
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc : c2_600 ∈ (r1_600 : E4 → E4) '' F1_600 :=
    ⟨c1_600, subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by simp [generatoriF1_600]),
      r1_600_vertices.2.1⟩
  rw [h] at hc
  have hv := l1_eq_on_F1_600 hc
  rw [small_functional_values.2.1.2.2.1] at hv
  linarith [aureo_bounds.2]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_r3_c3_600
statement:
private theorem l3_r3_c3_600 :
    l3_600 (r3_600 c3_600) = 1 / 2 + 3 * aureo / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [l3_600_apply]
  have hcoord (i : Fin 4) :
      r3_600 c3_600 i = (segnoQuarta_600 i : ℝ) * c3_600 i :=
    signedRefl_apply segnoQuarta_600 c3_600 i
  rw [hcoord 0, hcoord 1, hcoord 3]
  rw [c3_600_coord0, c3_600_coord1, c3_600_coord3]
  norm_num [segnoQuarta_600, Fin.ext_iff]
  nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_eq_on_F3_600
statement:
private theorem l3_eq_on_F3_600 {x : E4} (hx : x ∈ F3_600) :
    l3_600 x = 1 + 3 * aureo / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [F3_600] at hx
  exact le_antisymm
    (convexHull_min (fun y hy => by
        change l3_600 y ≤ 1 + 3 * aureo / 2
        have hc : y = e1_600 ∨ y = c1_600 ∨ y = c2_600 ∨ y = c3_600 := by
          simpa [generatoriF3_600] using hy
        rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · rw [l3_flag_values.1]
        · rw [l3_flag_values.2.1]
        · rw [l3_flag_values.2.2.1]
        · rw [l3_flag_values.2.2.2])
      (convex_halfSpace_le (LinearMap.isLinear l3_600.toLinearMap)
        (1 + 3 * aureo / 2)) hx)
    (convexHull_min (fun y hy => by
        change 1 + 3 * aureo / 2 ≤ l3_600 y
        have hc : y = e1_600 ∨ y = c1_600 ∨ y = c2_600 ∨ y = c3_600 := by
          simpa [generatoriF3_600] using hy
        rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · rw [l3_flag_values.1]
        · rw [l3_flag_values.2.1]
        · rw [l3_flag_values.2.2.1]
        · rw [l3_flag_values.2.2.2])
      (convex_halfSpace_ge (LinearMap.isLinear l3_600.toLinearMap)
        (1 + 3 * aureo / 2)) hx)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r3_moves_F3_600
statement: private theorem r3_moves_F3_600 : (r3_600 : E4 → E4) '' F3_600 ≠ F3_600
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc : r3_600 c3_600 ∈ (r3_600 : E4 → E4) '' F3_600 :=
    ⟨c3_600, subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by simp [generatoriF3_600]), rfl⟩
  rw [h] at hc
  have hv := l3_eq_on_F3_600 hc
  rw [l3_r3_c3_600] at hv
  norm_num at hv

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r1_600_flagAdjacent
statement:
theorem r1_600_flagAdjacent :
    FlagAdjacentAt seicento seicentoFlag
      (mapFlag seicento r1_600_isSymmetry seicentoFlag) 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact r1_image_F0_600
    · exact (hj rfl).elim
    · exact r1_image_F2_600
    · exact r1_image_F3_600
  · exact r1_moves_F1_600

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r3_600_flagAdjacent
statement:
theorem r3_600_flagAdjacent :
    FlagAdjacentAt seicento seicentoFlag
      (mapFlag seicento r3_600_isSymmetry seicentoFlag) 3
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact r3_image_F0_600
    · exact r3_image_F1_600
    · exact r3_image_F2_600
    · exact (hj rfl).elim
  · exact r3_moves_F3_600

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha0_parallel
statement:
private theorem alpha0_parallel :
    e1_600 - c1_600 = (aureo - 1) • alpha0_600
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [alpha0_600, Fin.ext_iff] <;>
    nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_alpha0_600
statement: private theorem norm_sq_alpha0_600 : ‖alpha0_600‖ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_four]
  norm_num [alpha0_600, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hφ : 0 ≤ aureo := by linarith [aureo_bounds.1]
  have hφm : 0 ≤ aureo - 1 := by linarith [aureo_bounds.1]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hφm, abs_of_nonneg hφ]
  nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_alpha0_600
statement: private theorem norm_alpha0_600 : ‖alpha0_600‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [norm_sq_alpha0_600, norm_nonneg alpha0_600]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_600_formula
statement:
private theorem r0_600_formula (x : E4) :
    r0_600 x = x - (2 * ⟪alpha0_600, x⟫ : ℝ) • alpha0_600
proof:
:= by
  change ((ℝ ∙ alpha0_600)ᗮ).reflection x = _
  rw [Submodule.reflection_orthogonal_apply,
    Submodule.reflection_singleton_apply, norm_alpha0_600]
  norm_num
  module

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha0_inner_flag
statement:
private theorem alpha0_inner_flag :
    ⟪alpha0_600, e1_600⟫ = (aureo - 1) / 2 ∧
    ⟪alpha0_600, c1_600⟫ = -(aureo - 1) / 2 ∧
    ⟪alpha0_600, c2_600⟫ = 0 ∧
    ⟪alpha0_600, c3_600⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_mem_seicentoVertici
statement:
private theorem r0_mem_seicentoVertici {v : E4} (hv : v ∈ seicentoVertici) :
    r0_600 v ∈ seicentoVertici
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [seicentoVertici, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hv
  rcases hv with (⟨p, hp⟩ | ⟨s, hs⟩) | ⟨p, hp⟩
  · rw [← hp]
    exact r0_vertA_mem p.1 p.2
  · rw [← hs]
    exact r0_vertB_mem s
  · rw [← hp]
    exact r0_vertC_mem p.1 p.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_image_seicentoVertici
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Finset.image (r0_600 : E4 → E4) seicentoVertici =
      seicentoVertici := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hv
      exact r0_mem_seicentoVertici hu
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ r0_600.injective]
  rw [← Finset.coe_image, hfin]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_600_isSymmetry
statement: theorem r0_600_isSymmetry : seicento.isSymmetry r0_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry, ConvexPolytope.toSet]
  calc
    (r0_600 : E4 → E4) ''
        convexHull ℝ ((seicento.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4) =
      convexHull ℝ ((r0_600 : E4 → E4) ''
        ((seicento.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4)) := by
          exact r0_600.toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.image_convexHull _
    _ = convexHull ℝ ((seicento.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4) := by
      rw [show ((seicento.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4) =
          (seicentoVertici : Set E4) by rfl, r0_image_seicentoVertici]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_image_F1_600
statement: private theorem r0_image_F1_600 : (r0_600 : E4 → E4) '' F1_600 = F1_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [F1_600, image_convexHull_isom600]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [generatoriF1_600, r0_600_vertices.1, r0_600_vertices.2.1] <;> tauto

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_image_F2_600
statement: private theorem r0_image_F2_600 : (r0_600 : E4 → E4) '' F2_600 = F2_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [F2_600, image_convexHull_isom600]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [generatoriF2_600, r0_600_vertices.1, r0_600_vertices.2.1,
    r0_600_vertices.2.2.1] <;> tauto

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_image_F3_600
statement: private theorem r0_image_F3_600 : (r0_600 : E4 → E4) '' F3_600 = F3_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [F3_600, image_convexHull_isom600]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [generatoriF3_600, r0_600_vertices.1, r0_600_vertices.2.1,
    r0_600_vertices.2.2.1, r0_600_vertices.2.2.2] <;> tauto

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_moves_F0_600
statement: private theorem r0_moves_F0_600 : (r0_600 : E4 → E4) '' F0_600 ≠ F0_600
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc : c1_600 ∈ (r0_600 : E4 → E4) '' F0_600 :=
    ⟨e1_600, subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by simp [generatoriF0_600]),
      r0_600_vertices.1⟩
  rw [h, F0_600, generatoriF0_600] at hc
  have heq : c1_600 = e1_600 := by simpa using hc
  exact e1_ne_c1_600 heq.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r0_600_flagAdjacent
statement:
theorem r0_600_flagAdjacent :
    FlagAdjacentAt seicento seicentoFlag
      (mapFlag seicento r0_600_isSymmetry seicentoFlag) 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro j hj
    fin_cases j
    · exact (hj rfl).elim
    · exact r0_image_F1_600
    · exact r0_image_F2_600
    · exact r0_image_F3_600
  · exact r0_moves_F0_600

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha2_coordinates
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · simpa [alpha2_600, g2Linear_600, tau5_600, twoSwapAlt,
      segnoUno_600, alpha0_600, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def, Fin.ext_iff] using
      (segnoLinear_apply_coord_600 4 (tau5_600 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4))
        segnoUno_600 alpha0_600 (3 : Fin 4))
  · simpa [alpha2_600, g2Linear_600, tau5_600, twoSwapAlt,
      segnoUno_600, alpha0_600, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def, Fin.ext_iff] using
      (segnoLinear_apply_coord_600 4 (tau5_600 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4))
        segnoUno_600 alpha0_600 (0 : Fin 4))
  · simpa [alpha2_600, g2Linear_600, tau5_600, twoSwapAlt,
      segnoUno_600, alpha0_600, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def, Fin.ext_iff] using
      (segnoLinear_apply_coord_600 4 (tau5_600 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4))
        segnoUno_600 alpha0_600 (2 : Fin 4))
  · simpa [alpha2_600, g2Linear_600, tau5_600, twoSwapAlt,
      segnoUno_600, alpha0_600, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_def, Fin.ext_iff] using
      (segnoLinear_apply_coord_600 4 (tau5_600 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4))
        segnoUno_600 alpha0_600 (1 : Fin 4))

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha2_coord0
statement: @[simp] private theorem alpha2_coord0 : alpha2_600 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [alpha2_coordinates 0]
  change (0 : ℝ) = 0
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha2_coord1
statement:
@[simp] private theorem alpha2_coord1 :
    alpha2_600 1 = (aureo - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [alpha2_coordinates 1]
  change (aureo - 1) / 2 = (aureo - 1) / 2
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha2_coord2
statement: @[simp] private theorem alpha2_coord2 : alpha2_600 2 = -(1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [alpha2_coordinates 2]
  change -(1 / 2 : ℝ) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ)
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha2_coord3
statement: @[simp] private theorem alpha2_coord3 : alpha2_600 3 = -aureo / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [alpha2_coordinates 3]
  change -aureo / 2 = -aureo / 2
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha2_parallel
statement:
private theorem alpha2_parallel :
    c2_600 - c3_600 = (aureo - 1) • alpha2_600
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [alpha2_coordinates, Fin.ext_iff] <;>
    nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_alpha2_600
statement: private theorem norm_alpha2_600 : ‖alpha2_600‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [alpha2_600, g2Linear_600.norm_map, norm_alpha0_600]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r2_600_formula
statement:
private theorem r2_600_formula (x : E4) :
    r2_600 x = x - (2 * ⟪alpha2_600, x⟫ : ℝ) • alpha2_600
proof:
:= by
  change ((ℝ ∙ alpha2_600)ᗮ).reflection x = _
  rw [Submodule.reflection_orthogonal_apply,
    Submodule.reflection_singleton_apply, norm_alpha2_600]
  norm_num
  module

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.alpha2_inner_flag
statement:
private theorem alpha2_inner_flag :
    ⟪alpha2_600, e1_600⟫ = 0 ∧
    ⟪alpha2_600, c1_600⟫ = 0 ∧
    ⟪alpha2_600, c2_600⟫ = (aureo - 1) / 2 ∧
    ⟪alpha2_600, c3_600⟫ = -(aureo - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial,
      Fin.sum_univ_four] <;>
    simp <;>
    nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.span_map_g2_600
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_span]
  simp [alpha2_600]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.wall_map_g2_600
statement:
private theorem wall_map_g2_600 :
    ((ℝ ∙ alpha0_600)ᗮ).map
      (g2Linear_600.toLinearEquiv : E4 →ₗ[ℝ] E4) =
      (ℝ ∙ alpha2_600)ᗮ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_orthogonal_equiv, span_map_g2_600]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.r2_conjugate
statement:
private theorem r2_conjugate :

    l2_600 x = 1 + aureo
proof:

  exact le_antisymm
    (convexHull_min (fun y hy => by
        change l2_600 y ≤ 1 + aureo
        have hc : y = e1_600 ∨ y = c1_600 ∨ y = c2_600 := by
          simpa [generatoriF2_600] using hy
        rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.2.1]
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.2.2.1]
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.2.2.2.1])
      (convex_halfSpace_le (LinearMap.isLinear l2_600.toLinearMap)
        (1 + aureo)) hx)
    (convexHull_min (fun y hy => by
        change 1 + aureo ≤ l2_600 y
        have hc : y = e1_600 ∨ y = c1_600 ∨ y = c2_600 := by
          simpa [generatoriF2_600] using hy
        rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.2.1]
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.2.2.1]
        · rw [small_functional_values.2.2.2.2.1])

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.perno
statement:
theorem perno (P : ConvexPolytope n) {f : Set (E n)} (hf : P.IsFace f)
    (hproper : ∃ v ∈ P.vertices, v ∉ f) :
    ∃ f' : Set (E n), P.IsFace f' ∧ f ⊂ f'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hf.1 hf.2
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀f⟩ := hf.2
  obtain ⟨u, huV, huf⟩ := hproper
  have hp₀T : p₀ ∈ P.toSet := by
    rw [hl] at hp₀f
    exact hp₀f.1
  have huT : u ∈ P.toSet :=
    subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast huV)

  
  set M : ℝ := l p₀ with hM
  have hlf : ∀ z ∈ f, l z = M := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hl] at hz hp₀f
    exact le_antisymm (hp₀f.2 z hz.1) (hz.2 p₀ hp₀f.1)
  have hlmax : ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, l y ≤ M := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hl] at hp₀f
    exact hp₀f.2 y hy
  have hl_strict : ∀ v ∈ P.vertices, v ∉ f → l v < M := by
    intro v hvV hvf
    have hvT : v ∈ P.toSet :=
      subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hvV)
    have hvle := hlmax v hvT
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hvle with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      apply hvf
      rw [hl]
      exact ⟨hvT, fun y hy => h ▸ hlmax y hy⟩
  have hlu : l u < M := hl_strict u huV huf

  
  
  have huaff : u ∉ affineSpan ℝ f := by
    intro hu
    let A : AffineSubspace ℝ (E n) :=
      AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (LinearMap.ker l.toLinearMap)
    have hfA : f ⊆ (A : Set (E n)) := by
      intro z hz
      change z - p₀ ∈ LinearMap.ker l.toLinearMap
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      simp [hlf z hz, hM]
    have hspan : affineSpan ℝ f ≤ A := (affineSpan_le).2 hfA
    have huA := hspan hu
    rw [AffineSubspace.mem_mk', LinearMap.mem_ker] at huA
    have hzero : l u - l p₀ = 0 := by simpa using huA
    rw [← hM] at hzero
    linarith

  
  set S : Submodule ℝ (E n) := vectorSpan ℝ f with hS
  set d : E n := u - p₀ with hd
  set w : E n := d - S.starProjection d with hw
  have hdS : d ∉ S := by
    intro hdmem
    apply huaff
    have hpaff : p₀ ∈ affineSpan ℝ f := mem_affineSpan ℝ hp₀f
    have := vadd_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_vectorSpan hpaff hdmem
    simpa [d] using this
  have hwne : w ≠ 0 := by
    intro hwzero
    have hzero : d - S.starProjection d = 0 := by simpa [w] using hwzero
    have hproj : S.starProjection d = d := (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero).symm
    exact hdS (Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.mp hproj)

  set l₂ : E n →L[ℝ] ℝ := innerSL ℝ w with hl₂
  have hl₂const : ∀ z ∈ f, l₂ z = l₂ p₀ := by
    intro z hz
    have hzS : z - p₀ ∈ S := by
      rw [hS]
      simpa using vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hz hp₀f
    have ho := Submodule.starProjection_inner_eq_zero d (z - p₀) hzS
    change inner ℝ w z = inner ℝ w p₀
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← inner_sub_right]
    simpa [w] using ho
  have horth : inner ℝ w (S.starProjection d) = 0 := by
    have hpS : S.starProjection d ∈ S := S.starProjection_apply_mem d
    change inner ℝ (d - S.starProjection d) (S.starProjection d) = 0
    exact Submodule.starProjection_inner_eq_zero d (S.starProjection d) hpS
  have hwd : inner ℝ w d = inner ℝ w w := by
    calc
      inner ℝ w d = inner ℝ w (w + S.starProjection d) := by
        congr 2
        simp [w]
      _ = inner ℝ w w + inner ℝ w (S.starProjection d) :=
        inner_add_right _ _ _
      _ = inner ℝ w w := by rw [horth, add_zero]
  have hl₂gap : l₂ u - l₂ p₀ = ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    change inner ℝ w u - inner ℝ w p₀ = ‖w‖ ^ 2
    rw [← inner_sub_right]
    change inner ℝ w d = ‖w‖ ^ 2
    rw [hwd, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hl₂up : l₂ p₀ < l₂ u := by
    have hn : 0 < ‖w‖ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hwne)
    linarith

  
  set Vup : Finset (E n) :=
    P.vertices.filter (fun v => l₂ p₀ < l₂ v) with hVup
  have huUp : u ∈ Vup := by simp [hVup, huV, hl₂up]
  have hVupne : Vup.Nonempty := ⟨u, huUp⟩
  set ratio : E n → ℝ :=
    fun v => (M - l v) / (l₂ v - l₂ p₀) with hratio
  have hratio_pos : ∀ v ∈ Vup, 0 < ratio v := by
    intro v hvUp
    have hv := Finset.mem_filter.mp hvUp
    have hvnf : v ∉ f := by
      intro hvf
      have := hl₂const v hvf
      linarith
    have hnum : 0 < M - l v := by
      have := hl_strict v hv.1 hvnf
      linarith
    have hden : 0 < l₂ v - l₂ p₀ := by linarith
    rw [hratio]
    exact div_pos hnum hden
  set R : Finset ℝ := Vup.image ratio with hR
  have hRne : R.Nonempty := hVupne.image ratio
  set t : ℝ := R.min' hRne with ht
  have htpos : 0 < t := by
    have htmem : t ∈ R := by
      rw [ht]
      exact Finset.min'_mem R hRne
    obtain ⟨v, hvUp, hvt⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (by simpa [hR] using htmem)
    rw [← hvt]
    exact hratio_pos v hvUp

  
  set L : E n →L[ℝ] ℝ := l + t • l₂ with hL
  have hLapp : ∀ x, L x = l x + t * l₂ x := by
    intro x
    simp [hL, smul_eq_mul]
  have hvert : ∀ v ∈ (P.vertices : Set (E n)),
      L v ≤ M + t * l₂ p₀ := by
    intro v hvS
    have hvV : v ∈ P.vertices := by exact_mod_cast hvS
    have hvT : v ∈ P.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ hvS
    by_cases hvup : l₂ p₀ < l₂ v
    · have hvUp : v ∈ Vup := by simp [hVup, hvV, hvup]
      have hratioR : ratio v ∈ R := by
        rw [hR]
        exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem ratio hvUp
      have htle : t ≤ ratio v := by
        rw [ht]
        exact Finset.min'_le R (ratio v) hratioR
      have hden : 0 < l₂ v - l₂ p₀ := by linarith
      have hmul : t * (l₂ v - l₂ p₀) ≤ M - l v := by
        calc
          t * (l₂ v - l₂ p₀) ≤ ratio v * (l₂ v - l₂ p₀) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htle (le_of_lt hden)
          _ = M - l v := by
            rw [hratio]
            field_simp
      rw [hLapp]
      linarith
    · have hlv := hlmax v hvT
      have hl₂v : l₂ v ≤ l₂ p₀ := le_of_not_gt hvup
      rw [hLapp]
      nlinarith
  have hLbound : ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, L y ≤ M + t * l₂ p₀ :=
    le_su_toSet P L hvert

  
  have htmem : t ∈ R := by
    rw [ht]
    exact Finset.min'_mem R hRne
  obtain ⟨vcrit, hvcritUp, hvcritEq⟩ :=
    Finset.mem_image.mp (by simpa [hR] using htmem)
  have hvcritV : vcrit ∈ P.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvcritUp).1
  have hvcritGrow : l₂ p₀ < l₂ vcrit := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvcritUp).2
  have hvcrit_notf : vcrit ∉ f := by
    intro hvcf
    have := hl₂const vcrit hvcf
    linarith
  have hvcritL : L vcrit = M + t * l₂ p₀ := by
    have hden : l₂ vcrit - l₂ p₀ ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have heq : t * (l₂ vcrit - l₂ p₀) = M - l vcrit := by
      rw [← hvcritEq, hratio]
      field_simp
    rw [hLapp]
    linarith

  set f' : Set (E n) :=
    {x ∈ P.toSet | ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, L y ≤ L x} with hf'def
  have hsub : f ⊆ f' := by
    intro x hxf
    have hxT : x ∈ P.toSet := by
      rw [hl] at hxf
      exact hxf.1
    have hLx : L x = M + t * l₂ p₀ := by
      rw [hLapp, hlf x hxf, hl₂const x hxf]
    refine ⟨hxT, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact (hLbound y hy).trans_eq hLx.symm
  have hvcritT : vcrit ∈ P.toSet :=
    subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hvcritV)
  have hvcritf' : vcrit ∈ f' := by
    refine ⟨hvcritT, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact (hLbound y hy).trans_eq hvcritL.symm
  have hf'ne : f'.Nonempty := ⟨p₀, hsub hp₀f⟩
  have hf'face : P.IsFace f' := by
    refine ⟨?_, hf'ne⟩
    intro _
    refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
    rfl

  refine ⟨f', hf'face, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne]
  refine ⟨hsub, ?_⟩
  intro hff'
  apply hvcrit_notf
  rw [hff']
  exact hvcritf'

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonic_classification

    platonicCount 2 = ⊤ ∧ platonicCount 3 = 5 ∧ platonicCount 4 = 6 ∧
      ∀ d, 5 ≤ d → platonicCount d = 3
proof:
:=

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.esiste_unitario_ortogonale
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : Module.finrank ℝ (Wᗮ : Submodule ℝ (E n)) = 1 := by
    have hsum := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal (K := W) (𝕜 := ℝ)
    have hn : Module.finrank ℝ (E n) = n := by simp
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := finrank_eq_one_iff'.mp hrank
  obtain ⟨hvne, hspan⟩ := hv
  have hvnorm : ‖(v : E n)‖ ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using fun hc => hvne (Subtype.ext (by simpa using hc))
  refine ⟨‖(v : E n)‖⁻¹ • (v : E n), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_smul]
    simp [abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)), hvnorm]
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ v.2
  · apply le_antisymm
    · intro w hw
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan ⟨w, hw⟩
      refine Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨c * ‖(v : E n)‖, ?_⟩
      have hcv : c • (v : E n) = w := congrArg Subtype.val hc
      rw [mul_smul, smul_inv_smul₀ hvnorm]
      exact hcv
    · rw [Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ v.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.esiste_normale
statement:
theorem esiste_normale (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ α p : E n, ‖α‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ x : E n, simpleReflection P hreg F i x = x ↔
        ⟪α, x - p⟫ = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hdim, hfix⟩ := simpleReflection_fix_eq_hyperplane P hreg F i
  
  obtain ⟨q, _, hqfix⟩ := centroidi_fissi_indipendenti P hreg F i
  have hp : q i ∈ H := (hfix (q i)).mp (hqfix i)
  obtain ⟨α, hαnorm, _, hspan⟩ := esiste_unitario_ortogonale hdim
  refine ⟨α, q i, hαnorm, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [hfix x]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hmem : x - q i ∈ H.direction := by
      have := AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hx hp
      simpa [vsub_eq_sub] using this
    have hα : α ∈ H.directionᗮ := by
      rw [hspan]
      exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self α
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    exact hα (x - q i) hmem
  · intro hx
    have hmem : x - q i ∈ H.direction := by
      have hbot : (H.directionᗮ)ᗮ = H.direction :=
        Submodule.orthogonal_orthogonal _
      rw [← hbot, hspan]
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hw
      rw [← hc, real_inner_smul_left, hx, mul_zero]
    have hx' : x = (x - q i) +ᵥ q i := by
      simp [vadd_eq_add]
    rw [hx']
    exact AffineSubspace.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hmem hp

theorem normale_formula (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ∀ x, simpleReflection P hreg F i x =
      x - (2 * ⟪normale P hreg F i, x - puntoBase P hreg F i⟫ : ℝ) •
        normale P hreg F i
proof:
:=
  (simpleReflection_formula P hreg F i).choose_spec.choose_spec.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_diag_canonica
statement:

proof:

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_lontane_canonica
statement:
theorem gram_lontane_canonica (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n} (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ)) :
    ⟪normale P hreg F i, normale P hreg F j⟫ = 0
proof:
:=
  normali_lontani_ortogonali P hreg F hij
    (normale_norm P hreg F i) (normale_formula P hreg F i)
    (normale_norm P hreg F j) (normale_formula P hreg F j)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_adiacente_canonica
statement:
theorem gram_adiacente_canonica (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    |⟪normale P hreg F i,
        normale P hreg F ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩⟫| =
      Real.cos (Real.pi /
        (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  rotazione_elementare_incondizionata P hreg F i hi hn
    (normale_norm P hreg F i)
    (normale_norm P hreg F ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩)
    (normale_formula P hreg F i)
    (normale_formula P hreg F ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segno_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem segno_eq_one_or_neg_one (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :

proof:

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segno_ne_zero

    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) : segno P hreg F i ≠ 0

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segno_abs

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segno_succ
statement:
theorem segno_succ (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < n) :
    segno P hreg F ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ =
      if ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk⟩,
          normale P hreg F ⟨k + 1, hk⟩⟫ ≤ 0 then 1 else -1
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.normaleOrientato_norm
statement:
theorem normaleOrientato_norm (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ‖normaleOrientato P hreg F i‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [normaleOrientato, norm_smul, normale_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    segno_abs]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.normaleOrientato_formula
statement:
theorem normaleOrientato_formula (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ∀ x, simpleReflection P hreg F i x =
      x - (2 * ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i,
        x - puntoBase P hreg F i⟫ : ℝ) • normaleOrientato P hreg F i
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rcases segno_eq_one_or_neg_one P hreg F i with hs | hs
  · simpa [normaleOrientato, hs] using normale_formula P hreg F i x
  · rw [normale_formula P hreg F i x]
    simp [normaleOrientato, hs, inner_neg_left]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_diag_orientata
statement:
theorem gram_diag_orientata (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normaleOrientato P hreg F i⟫ = 1
proof:
:=
  gram_diagonale (normaleOrientato_norm P hreg F i)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_lontane_orientata
statement:
theorem gram_lontane_orientata (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ)) :
    ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normaleOrientato P hreg F j⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases segno_eq_one_or_neg_one P hreg F i with hi | hi <;>
  rcases segno_eq_one_or_neg_one P hreg F j with hj | hj <;>
  simp [normaleOrientato, hi, hj, gram_lontane_canonica P hreg F hij]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_adiacente_orientata
statement:
theorem gram_adiacente_orientata (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i,
        normaleOrientato P hreg F ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩⟫ =
      -Real.cos (Real.pi /
        (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let j : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
  let a : ℝ := ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normale P hreg F j⟫
  have habs : |a| = Real.cos (Real.pi /
      (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j : ℝ)) := by
    rw [show a = segno P hreg F i *
        ⟪normale P hreg F i, normale P hreg F j⟫ by
      simp [a, normaleOrientato, real_inner_smul_left],
      abs_mul, segno_abs, one_mul]
    exact gram_adiacente_canonica P hreg F i hi hn
  have horient :
      ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normaleOrientato P hreg F j⟫ =
        -|a| := by
    change ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i,
      segno P hreg F j • normale P hreg F j⟫ = -|a|
    rw [real_inner_smul_right]
    change segno P hreg F j * a = -|a|
    rw [show segno P hreg F j =
        if a ≤ 0 then 1 else -1 by
      simpa only [j, a] using segno_succ P hreg F (i : ℕ) hi]
    split_ifs with ha
    · simp [abs_of_nonpos ha]
    · have ha' : 0 < a := lt_of_not_ge ha
      simp [abs_of_pos ha']
  rw [horient, habs]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.inner_normale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero_of_fixed
statement:
theorem inner_normale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero_of_fixed
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag)
    (i : Fin n) (x : E n)
    (hx : simpleReflection P hreg F i x = x) :
    ⟪normale P hreg F i, x - puntoBase P hreg F i⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hform := normale_formula P hreg F i x
  rw [hx] at hform
  have hsmul :
      (2 * ⟪normale P hreg F i, x - puntoBase P hreg F i⟫ : ℝ) •
        normale P hreg F i = 0 := sub_eq_self.mp hform.symm
  have hnzero : normale P hreg F i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hnorm := normale_norm P hreg F i
    rw [hz, norm_zero] at hnorm
    norm_num at hnorm
  have hscalar := (smul_eq_zero.mp hsmul).resolve_right hnzero
  linarith

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.normali_canonici_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem normali_canonici_linearIndependent (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (normale P hreg F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : Fin (n + 1) → E n := centroidiBandieraCorpo P F
  let v : Fin n → E n := fun k => q k.castSucc - q (Fin.last n)
  have hqAI : AffineIndependent ℝ q := by
    simpa only [q] using centroidiBandieraCorpo_affineIndependent P hreg.1 F
  have hvsub : LinearIndependent ℝ
      (fun z : {z : Fin (n + 1) // z ≠ Fin.last n} =>
        q z - q (Fin.last n)) := by
    simpa only [vsub_eq_sub] using
      (affineIndependent_iff_linearIndependent_vsub ℝ q (Fin.last n)).mp hqAI
  let e : Fin n → {z : Fin (n + 1) // z ≠ Fin.last n} :=
    fun k => ⟨k.castSucc, ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last k)⟩
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro a b hab
    exact Fin.castSucc_injective n (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
  have hvLI : LinearIndependent ℝ v := by
    change LinearIndependent ℝ
      ((fun z : {z : Fin (n + 1) // z ≠ Fin.last n} =>
        q z - q (Fin.last n)) ∘ e)
    exact hvsub.comp e he
  have htopfix : ∀ i : Fin n,
      simpleReflection P hreg F i (q (Fin.last n)) = q (Fin.last n) := by
    intro i
    simpa only [q, centroidiBandieraCorpo_last] using
      centroide_di_faccia_fissato P
        (simpleReflection_isSymmetry P hreg F i) (toSet_isFace P)
        (simpleReflection_isSymmetry P hreg F i)
  have hfacefix : ∀ (i k : Fin n), k ≠ i →
      simpleReflection P hreg F i (q k.castSucc) = q k.castSucc := by
    intro i k hki
    simpa only [q, centroidiBandieraCorpo_castSucc] using
      centroide_di_faccia_fissato P
        (simpleReflection_isSymmetry P hreg F i) (F.isFace k)
        (simpleReflection_fissa_facce P hreg F i hki)
  have horth : ∀ (i k : Fin n), k ≠ i →
      ⟪normale P hreg F i, v k⟫ = 0 := by
    intro i k hki
    have hk0 := inner_normale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero_of_fixed P hreg F i
      (q k.castSucc) (hfacefix i k hki)
    have ht0 := inner_normale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero_of_fixed P hreg F i
      (q (Fin.last n)) (htopfix i)
    change ⟪normale P hreg F i, q k.castSucc - q (Fin.last n)⟫ = 0
    rw [show q k.castSucc - q (Fin.last n) =
        (q k.castSucc - puntoBase P hreg F i) -
          (q (Fin.last n) - puntoBase P hreg F i) by abel,
      inner_sub_right, hk0, ht0, sub_zero]
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
  have hvspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = ⊤ :=
    hvLI.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank (by simp [E])
  have hdiag : ∀ i : Fin n, ⟪normale P hreg F i, v i⟫ ≠ 0 := by
    intro i hii
    have hall : ∀ k : Fin n, ⟪normale P hreg F i, v k⟫ = 0 := by
      intro k
      by_cases hki : k = i
      · simpa [hki] using hii
      · exact horth i k hki
    have hmem : normale P hreg F i ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) := by
      rw [hvspan]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hmem
    have hself :
        ⟪normale P hreg F i, normale P hreg F i⟫ = 0 := by
      calc
        ⟪normale P hreg F i, normale P hreg F i⟫ =
            ⟪normale P hreg F i, ∑ k, c k • v k⟫ := by rw [hc]
        _ = ∑ k, ⟪normale P hreg F i, c k • v k⟫ := by rw [inner_sum]
        _ = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro k _
          rw [real_inner_smul_right, hall k, mul_zero]
    have hz : normale P hreg F i = 0 := inner_self_eq_zero.mp hself
    have hnorm := normale_norm P hreg F i
    rw [hz, norm_zero] at hnorm
    norm_num at hnorm
  exact linearIndependent_of_biorthogonal (normale P hreg F) v hdiag horth

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.normali_orientati_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem normali_orientati_linearIndependent (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (normaleOrientato P hreg F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg i
  have hind := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp
    (normali_canonici_linearIndependent P hreg F hn)
  have hsum : ∑ k, (g k * segno P hreg F k) • normale P hreg F k = 0 := by
    simpa only [normaleOrientato, smul_smul] using hg
  have hi := hind (fun k => g k * segno P hreg F k) hsum i
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hi).resolve_right (segno_ne_zero P hreg F i)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_canonica
statement:
theorem gram_canonica (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    (∀ i : Fin n,
      ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normaleOrientato P hreg F i⟫ = 1) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin n, (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ) →
      ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normaleOrientato P hreg F j⟫ = 0) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin n) (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n),
      ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i,
        normaleOrientato P hreg F ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩⟫ =
        -Real.cos (Real.pi /
          (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨gram_diag_orientata P hreg F,
    fun _ _ hij => gram_lontane_orientata P hreg F hij,
    fun i hi => gram_adiacente_orientata P hreg F i hi hn⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_canonica_definita_positiva
statement:
theorem gram_canonica_definita_positiva (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ j, ∑ i, g i *
      ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normaleOrientato P hreg F j⟫ = 0) :
    ∀ i, g i = 0
proof:
:=
  gram_definita_positiva (normaleOrientato P hreg F)
    (normali_orientati_linearIndependent P hreg F (by omega)) g hzero

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertOrto_not_eq_neg
statement:
theorem vertOrto_not_eq_neg {d : ℕ} (i : Fin d) (b : Bool) :
    vertOrto (i, !b) = -vertOrto (i, b)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  by_cases h : k = i <;> cases b <;> simp [vertOrto_apply, h]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesse_face_no_antipodi
statement:
theorem ortoplesse_face_no_antipodi (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    {f : Set (E d)} (hf : (ortoplesse d hd).IsFace f) (hproper : faceDim f < d)
    {i : Fin d} {b c : Bool}
    (hb : vertOrto (i, b) ∈ (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f))
    (hc : vertOrto (i, c) ∈ (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f)) :
    b = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hbc
  let P := ortoplesse d hd
  have hbF : vertOrto (i, b) ∈ f := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
  have hcF : vertOrto (i, c) ∈ f := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).2
  obtain ⟨l, hmem, hchar⟩ := espositore_di_faccia P hf
  have hbdata := hmem (vertOrto (i, b)) hbF
  have hcdata := hmem (vertOrto (i, c)) hcF
  have hsame : l (vertOrto (i, b)) = l (vertOrto (i, c)) :=
    le_antisymm (hcdata.2 _ hbdata.1) (hbdata.2 _ hcdata.1)
  have hopp : vertOrto (i, c) = -vertOrto (i, b) := by
    have hcnot : c = !b := by cases b <;> cases c <;> simp_all
    rw [hcnot, vertOrto_not_eq_neg]
  have hneg : l (vertOrto (i, c)) = -l (vertOrto (i, b)) := by
    rw [hopp, map_neg]
  have hbzero : l (vertOrto (i, b)) = 0 := by linarith
  have hall : ∀ v ∈ P.vertices, v ∈ f := by
    intro v hv
    have hv' : v ∈ verticiOrto d := hv
    rw [mem_verticiOrto] at hv'
    obtain ⟨⟨j, s⟩, rfl⟩ := hv'
    have hvP : vertOrto (j, s) ∈ P.toSet :=
      subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by
        exact_mod_cast (mem_verticiOrto.mpr ⟨(j, s), rfl⟩))
    have hopV : vertOrto (j, !s) ∈ P.vertices := by
      exact mem_verticiOrto.mpr ⟨(j, !s), rfl⟩
    have hopP : vertOrto (j, !s) ∈ P.toSet :=
      subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hopV)
    have hvle : l (vertOrto (j, s)) ≤ 0 := by
      simpa [hbzero] using hbdata.2 (vertOrto (j, s)) hvP
    have hople : l (vertOrto (j, !s)) ≤ 0 := by
      simpa [hbzero] using hbdata.2 (vertOrto (j, !s)) hopP
    have hopval : l (vertOrto (j, !s)) = -l (vertOrto (j, s)) := by
      rw [vertOrto_not_eq_neg, map_neg]
    have hvzero : l (vertOrto (j, s)) = 0 := by linarith
    apply hchar (vertOrto (j, s)) hvP
    intro z hz
    calc
      l z ≤ l (vertOrto (i, b)) := hbdata.2 z hz
      _ = l (vertOrto (j, s)) := by rw [hbzero, hvzero]
  have hfP : f ⊆ P.toSet := fun y hy => (hmem y hy).1
  have hPf : P.toSet ⊆ f := by
    apply convexHull_min
    · intro v hv
      exact hall v (by exact_mod_cast hv)
    · exact hf.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have heq : f = P.toSet := Set.Subset.antisymm hfP hPf
  have hdim : faceDim f = d := by
    rw [heq]
    exact ortoplesse_isFullDim d hd
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesse_face_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem ortoplesse_face_affineIndependent (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    {f : Set (E d)} (hf : (ortoplesse d hd).IsFace f) (hproper : faceDim f < d) :
    AffineIndependent ℝ
      ((↑) : {x // x ∈
        (((ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f) : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d))} →
        E d)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Finset (E d) := (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f)
  apply LinearIndependent.affineIndependent
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hsum x
  have hxvert : (x : E d) ∈ verticiOrto d := (Finset.mem_filter.mp x.property).1
  rw [mem_verticiOrto] at hxvert
  obtain ⟨⟨i, b⟩, hxeq⟩ := hxvert
  have hyzero : ∀ y : {x // x ∈ (S : Set (E d))}, y ≠ x → (y : E d) i = 0 := by
    intro y hyx
    have hyvert : (y : E d) ∈ verticiOrto d := (Finset.mem_filter.mp y.property).1
    rw [mem_verticiOrto] at hyvert
    obtain ⟨⟨j, c⟩, hyeq⟩ := hyvert
    rw [← hyeq]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      have hxbmem : vertOrto (i, b) ∈
          (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f) := by
        rw [hxeq]
        exact x.property
      have hycmem : vertOrto (i, c) ∈
          (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f) := by
        rw [hyeq]
        exact y.property
      have hbc : b = c := ortoplesse_face_no_antipodi d hd hf hproper
        (i := i) (b := b) (c := c) hxbmem hycmem
      exfalso
      apply hyx
      apply Subtype.ext
      calc
        (y : E d) = vertOrto (i, c) := hyeq.symm
        _ = vertOrto (i, b) := by rw [hbc]
        _ = (x : E d) := hxeq
    · simp [vertOrto_apply, hij]
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : E d => z i) hsum
  have hsum' : ∑ y, g y * (y : E d) i = 0 := by
    simpa [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hcoord
  have hsingle : (∑ y, g y * (y : E d) i) = g x * (x : E d) i := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single x
    · intro y _ hyx
      rw [hyzero y hyx, mul_zero]
    · simp
  rw [hsingle] at hsum'
  have hxnonzero : (x : E d) i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hxeq]
    rw [vertOrto_self (i, b)]
    cases b <;> norm_num
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hsum').resolve_right hxnonzero

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesse_face_card
statement:
theorem ortoplesse_face_card (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    {f : Set (E d)} (hf : (ortoplesse d hd).IsFace f) (hproper : faceDim f < d) :
    ((ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f)).card = faceDim f + 1
proof:
:= by
  let S : Finset (E d) := (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f)
  have hFS : f = convexHull ℝ (S : Set (E d)) := face_eq_hull_vertices _ hf
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
    have hne := hf.2
    rw [hFS, h] at hne
    simp at hne
  have hSind : AffineIndependent ℝ
      ((↑) : {x // x ∈ (S : Set (E d))} → E d) := by
    simpa only [S] using ortoplesse_face_affineIndependent d hd hf hproper
  letI : Nonempty {x // x ∈ (S : Set (E d))} :=
    ⟨⟨hSne.choose, hSne.choose_spec⟩⟩
  have hdim := hSind.finrank_vectorSpan_add_one
  have hrange : Set.range ((↑) : {x // x ∈ (S : Set (E d))} → E d) =
      (S : Set (E d)) := Subtype.range_coe_subtype
  rw [hrange] at hdim
  have hdim' : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (S : Set (E d))) = faceDim f := by
    symm
    unfold faceDim
    rw [hFS, ← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull, direction_affineSpan]
  rw [hdim'] at hdim
  change S.card = faceDim f + 1
  simpa using hdim.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.finPredSame_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem finPredSame_val {d : ℕ} (k : Fin d) (hk : k.val ≠ 0) :
    (finPredSame k hk).val = k.val - 1
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagVertices_card
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagVertices_card (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    (ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F k).card = k.val + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hproper : faceDim (F.face k) < d := by
    rw [F.dim_eq]
    exact k.isLt
  simpa [ortoplesseFlagVertices, F.dim_eq] using
    ortoplesse_face_card d hd (F.isFace k) hproper

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagVertices_mono
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagVertices_mono (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) {i j : Fin d} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F i ⊆ ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F j
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [ortoplesseFlagVertices, Finset.mem_filter] at hv ⊢
  refine ⟨hv.1, ?_⟩
  rcases hij.eq_or_lt with rfl | hij
  · exact hv.2
  · exact (F.strict_mono i j hij).1 hv.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagStep_nonempty
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagStep_nonempty (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    (ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F k \ ortoplesseFlagPrev d hd F k).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k.val = 0
  · have hc := ortoplesseFlagVertices_card d hd F k
    simpa [ortoplesseFlagPrev, hk] using
      (Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega : 0 < (ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F k).card))
  · let p : Fin d := finPredSame k hk
    have hpk : p < k := by
      apply Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr
      simp
      omega
    have hsub : ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F p ⊆
        ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F k :=
      ortoplesseFlagVertices_mono d hd F hpk.le
    have hcp := ortoplesseFlagVertices_card d hd F p
    have hck := ortoplesseFlagVertices_card d hd F k
    have hcdiff :
        (ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F k \
          ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F p).card = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hsub, hcp, hck]
      simp [p]
      omega
    have hne : (ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F k \
        ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F p).Nonempty :=
      Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
    simpa [ortoplesseFlagPrev, hk, p] using hne

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagNew_mem
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagNew_mem (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F k ∈ ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F k
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp
    (ortoplesseFlagStep_nonempty d hd F k).choose_spec).1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagNew_not_prev
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagNew_not_prev (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F k ∉ ortoplesseFlagPrev d hd F k
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp
    (ortoplesseFlagStep_nonempty d hd F k).choose_spec).2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagNew_injective
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagNew_injective (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) :
    Function.Injective (ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hijlt | hjilt
  · have hj0 : j.val ≠ 0 := by omega
    let p : Fin d := finPredSame j hj0
    have hip : i ≤ p := by
      apply Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr
      omega
    have himem : ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F i ∈
        ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F p :=
      ortoplesseFlagVertices_mono d hd F hip
        (ortoplesseFlagNew_mem d hd F i)
    have hjnot : ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F j ∉
        ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F p := by
      simpa [ortoplesseFlagPrev, hj0, p] using
        ortoplesseFlagNew_not_prev d hd F j
    exact hjnot (hij ▸ himem)
  · have hi0 : i.val ≠ 0 := by omega
    let p : Fin d := finPredSame i hi0
    have hjp : j ≤ p := by
      apply Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr
      omega
    have hjmem : ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F j ∈
        ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F p :=
      ortoplesseFlagVertices_mono d hd F hjp
        (ortoplesseFlagNew_mem d hd F j)
    have hinot : ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F i ∉
        ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F p := by
      simpa [ortoplesseFlagPrev, hi0, p] using
        ortoplesseFlagNew_not_prev d hd F i
    exact hinot (hij.symm ▸ hjmem)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagVertices_eq_image_Iic
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagVertices_eq_image_Iic (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    ortoplesseFlagVertices d hd F k =
      (Finset.Iic k).image (ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le ?_ ?_)
  · intro v hv
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hv
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact ortoplesseFlagVertices_mono d hd F (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hj)
      (ortoplesseFlagNew_mem d hd F j)
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (ortoplesseFlagNew_injective d hd F),
      ortoplesseFlagVertices_card d hd F k]
    simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagCode_spec
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagCode_spec (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    vertOrto (ortoplesseFlagCode d hd F k) = ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F k
proof:
:=
  (mem_verticiOrto.mp
    (show ortoplesseFlagNew d hd F k ∈ verticiOrto d from
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp (ortoplesseFlagNew_mem d hd F k)).1)).choose_spec

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesseFlagCode_fst_injective
statement:
theorem ortoplesseFlagCode_fst_injective (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (ortoplesse d hd).Flag) :
    Function.Injective (fun k => (ortoplesseFlagCode d hd F k).1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  let k : Fin d := max i j
  have himem : vertOrto (ortoplesseFlagCode d hd F i) ∈
      (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ F.face k) := by
    rw [ortoplesseFlagCode_spec]
    have hmono := ortoplesseFlagVertices_mono d hd F (show i ≤ k from le_max_left _ _)
    exact hmono (ortoplesseFlagNew_mem d hd F i)
  have hjmem : vertOrto (ortoplesseFlagCode d hd F j) ∈
      (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ F.face k) := by
    rw [ortoplesseFlagCode_spec]
    have hmono := ortoplesseFlagVertices_mono d hd F (show j ≤ k from le_max_right _ _)
    exact hmono (ortoplesseFlagNew_mem d hd F j)
  have hproper : faceDim (F.face k) < d := by
    rw [F.dim_eq]
    exact k.isLt
  have hbool : (ortoplesseFlagCode d hd F i).2 =
      (ortoplesseFlagCode d hd F j).2 :=
