name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.p2_24_affineIndependent
statement: private theorem p2_24_affineIndependent : AffineIndependent ℝ p2_24
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_eq_of_fintype_affineCombination_eq]
  intro a b ha hb hab
  funext i
  have hc (j : Fin 4) := congrArg (fun x : E4 => x j) hab
  rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ (by simpa using ha),
    Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ (by simpa using hb)] at hc
  have h0 := hc 0
  have h1 := hc 1
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at ha hb
  norm_num [v0_24, v1_24, v2_24, vertVentiquattro,
    segnoVentiquattro, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.ext_iff] at h0 h1
  have e0 : a 0 = b 0 := by linarith
  have e1 : a 1 = b 1 := by linarith
  have e2 : a 2 = b 2 := by linarith
  fin_cases i
  · exact e0
  · exact e1
  · exact e2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.p3_24_affineIndependent
statement: private theorem p3_24_affineIndependent : AffineIndependent ℝ p3_24
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_eq_of_fintype_affineCombination_eq]
  intro a b ha hb hab
  funext i
  have hc (j : Fin 4) := congrArg (fun x : E4 => x j) hab
  rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ (by simpa using ha),
    Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ (by simpa using hb)] at hc
  have h0 := hc 0
  have h1 := hc 1
  have h2 := hc 2
  have h3 := hc 3
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at ha hb
  norm_num [v0_24, v1_24, v2_24, v3_24, vertVentiquattro,
    segnoVentiquattro, Fin.sum_univ_four, Fin.ext_iff] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  have e0 : a 0 = b 0 := by linarith
  have e1 : a 1 = b 1 := by linarith
  have e2 : a 2 = b 2 := by linarith
  have e3 : a 3 = b 3 := by linarith
  fin_cases i
  · exact e0
  · exact e1
  · exact e2
  · exact e3

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.range_p2_24
statement:
private theorem range_p2_24 :
    Set.range p2_24 = (generatoriF2_24 : Set E4)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i <;> simp [p2_24, generatoriF2_24]
  · intro hx
    have : x = v0_24 ∨ x = v1_24 ∨ x = v2_24 := by
      simpa [generatoriF2_24] using hx
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faceDim_F0_24
statement: theorem faceDim_F0_24 : faceDim F0_24 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [F0_24, generatoriF0_24]
  simpa using faceDim_singleton v0_24

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.v0_ne_v1_24
statement: private theorem v0_ne_v1_24 : v0_24 ≠ v1_24
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : E4 => x (1 : Fin 4)) h
  norm_num [v0_24, v1_24, vertVentiquattro, segnoVentiquattro,
    Fin.ext_iff] at hc

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faceDim_F1_24
statement: theorem faceDim_F1_24 : faceDim F1_24 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : (generatoriF1_24 : Set E4) = {v0_24, v1_24} := by
    ext x
    simp [generatoriF1_24]
  rw [F1_24, hgen, convexHull_pair]
  unfold faceDim
  rw [vectorSpan_segment]
  apply finrank_span_singleton
  exact vsub_ne_zero.mpr v0_ne_v1_24.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faceDim_F2_24
statement: theorem faceDim_F2_24 : faceDim F2_24 = 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceDim
  rw [F2_24, ← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull,
    direction_affineSpan, ← range_p2_24]
  exact p2_24_affineIndependent.finrank_vectorSpan (by simp)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.l3_eq_on_F3_24
statement: private theorem l3_eq_on_F3_24 {x : E4} (hx : x ∈ F3_24) : l3_24 x = 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (li_toSet_le.2.2.2 x (F3_24_isFace.1.subset hx))
  rw [F3_24] at hx
  exact convexHull_min (fun y hy => by
      change (2 : ℝ) ≤ l3_24 y
      have hy' : y ∈ (generatoriF3_24 : Set E4) := hy
      rw [← argmax_l3_24] at hy'
      rw [hy'.2])
    (convex_halfSpace_ge (LinearMap.isLinear l3_24.toLinearMap) 2) hx

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.span_F3_le_ker_l3
statement:
private theorem span_F3_le_ker_l3 :
    vectorSpan ℝ F3_24 ≤ LinearMap.ker l3_24.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.span ℝ (F3_24 -ᵥ F3_24) ≤ _
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro d ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  change l3_24 (x - y) = 0
  rw [map_sub, l3_eq_on_F3_24 hx, l3_eq_on_F3_24 hy, sub_self]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.finrank_ker_l3_24
statement:
private theorem finrank_ker_l3_24 :
    Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker l3_24.toLinearMap) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective l3_24.toLinearMap := by
    intro t
    refine ⟨t • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 4) 1, ?_⟩
    norm_num [l3_24, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hr := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker l3_24.toLinearMap
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj, finrank_top] at hr
  have hE : Module.finrank ℝ E4 = 4 := by simp [E4, finrank_euclideanSpace]
  have hR : Module.finrank ℝ ℝ = 1 := Module.finrank_self ℝ
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faceDim_F3_24
statement: theorem faceDim_F3_24 : faceDim F3_24 = 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceDim
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F3_24) ≤
          Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker l3_24.toLinearMap) :=
        Submodule.finrank_mono span_F3_le_ker_l3
      _ = 3 := finrank_ker_l3_24
  · have hsub : vectorSpan ℝ (Set.range p3_24) ≤ vectorSpan ℝ F3_24 := by
      apply vectorSpan_mono ℝ
      rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
      apply subset_convexHull ℝ _
      fin_cases i <;> simp [p3_24, generatoriF3_24]
    calc
      3 = Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (Set.range p3_24)) :=
        (p3_24_affineIndependent.finrank_vectorSpan (by simp)).symm
      _ ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F3_24) :=
        Submodule.finrank_mono hsub

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F0_ssubset_F1_24
statement: theorem F0_ssubset_F1_24 : F0_24 ⊂ F1_24
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
  constructor
  · apply convexHull_mono
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : x = v0_24 := by simpa [generatoriF0_24] using hx
    subst x
    simp [generatoriF1_24]
  · intro h
    have := faceDim_F0_24
    rw [h, faceDim_F1_24] at this
    omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F1_ssubset_F2_24
statement: theorem F1_ssubset_F2_24 : F1_24 ⊂ F2_24
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
  constructor
  · apply convexHull_mono
    intro x hx
    have hx01 : x = v0_24 ∨ x = v1_24 := by
      simpa [generatoriF1_24] using hx
    rcases hx01 with rfl | rfl <;> simp [generatoriF2_24]
  · intro h
    have := faceDim_F1_24
    rw [h, faceDim_F2_24] at this
    omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F2_ssubset_F3_24
statement: theorem F2_ssubset_F3_24 : F2_24 ⊂ F3_24
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
  constructor
  · apply convexHull_mono
    intro x hx
    have hx012 : x = v0_24 ∨ x = v1_24 ∨ x = v2_24 := by
      simpa [generatoriF2_24] using hx
    rcases hx012 with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [generatoriF3_24]
  · intro h
    have := faceDim_F2_24
    rw [h, faceDim_F3_24] at this
    omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPerm_vertVentiquattro_24
statement:
private theorem segnoPerm_vertVentiquattro_24
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ))
    (c : CodiceVentiquattro) :
    ∃ d : CodiceVentiquattro,
      segnoPerm 4 σ ε (vertVentiquattro c) = vertVentiquattro d
proof:
:= by
  let i := indicePrimoVentiquattro c
  let j := indiceSecondoVentiquattro c
  let si := segnoBoolDaReale (ε i) (segnoPrimoVentiquattro c)
  let sj := segnoBoolDaReale (ε j) (segnoSecondoVentiquattro c)
  have hij : i ≠ j := indicePrimo_ne_indiceSecondo c
  by_cases hlt : σ i < σ j
  · refine ⟨codiceVentiquattro (σ i) (σ j) hlt si sj, ?_⟩
    simp only [segnoPerm_apply, vertVentiquattro, map_add, segnoLinear_single,
      indicePrimo_codiceVentiquattro, indiceSecondo_codiceVentiquattro,
      segnoPrimo_codiceVentiquattro, segnoSecondo_codiceVentiquattro]
    rw [segnoBoolDaReale_spec, segnoBoolDaReale_spec]
  · have hne : σ i ≠ σ j := fun h => hij (σ.injective h)
    have hgt : σ j < σ i := by omega
    refine ⟨codiceVentiquattro (σ j) (σ i) hgt sj si, ?_⟩
    simp only [segnoPerm_apply, vertVentiquattro, map_add, segnoLinear_single,
      indicePrimo_codiceVentiquattro, indiceSecondo_codiceVentiquattro,
      segnoPrimo_codiceVentiquattro, segnoSecondo_codiceVentiquattro]
    rw [segnoBoolDaReale_spec, segnoBoolDaReale_spec, add_comm]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPerm_mem_verticiVentiquattro_24
statement:
private theorem segnoPerm_mem_verticiVentiquattro_24
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ))
    {v : E4} (hv : v ∈ verticiVentiquattro) :
    segnoPerm 4 σ ε v ∈ verticiVentiquattro
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_verticiVentiquattro] at hv
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := segnoPerm_vertVentiquattro_24 σ ε c
  exact mem_verticiVentiquattro.mpr ⟨d, hd.symm⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPerm_image_verticiVentiquattro_24
statement:
private theorem segnoPerm_image_verticiVentiquattro_24
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) :
    (segnoPerm 4 σ ε : E4 → E4) '' (verticiVentiquattro : Set E4) =
      (verticiVentiquattro : Set E4)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin :
      Finset.image (segnoPerm 4 σ ε : E4 → E4) verticiVentiquattro =
        verticiVentiquattro := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hv
      exact segnoPerm_mem_verticiVentiquattro_24 σ ε hu
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (segnoPerm 4 σ ε).injective]
  rw [← Finset.coe_image, hfin]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPerm_isSymmetry_ventiquattro
statement:
theorem segnoPerm_isSymmetry_ventiquattro
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (ε : Fin 4 → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) :
    ventiquattro.isSymmetry (segnoPerm 4 σ ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry, ConvexPolytope.toSet]
  calc
    (segnoPerm 4 σ ε : E4 → E4) ''
        convexHull ℝ ((ventiquattro.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4) =
      convexHull ℝ ((segnoPerm 4 σ ε : E4 → E4) ''
        ((ventiquattro.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4)) := by
          exact (segnoPerm 4 σ ε).toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.image_convexHull _
    _ = convexHull ℝ ((ventiquattro.vertices : Finset E4) : Set E4) := by

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.facet_exists
statement:
theorem facet_exists (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hd : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet)) :
    ∃ f : Set (E n), P.IsFace f ∧
      faceDim f = Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set d : ℕ := Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) with hdd
  suffices H : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ f : Set (E n), P.IsFace f →
      d - 1 - faceDim f ≤ k → faceDim f ≤ d - 1 →
      ∃ g : Set (E n), P.IsFace g ∧ faceDim g = d - 1 by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := P.vertices_nonempty
    have h0 : P.IsFace ({v} : Set (E n)) := vertex_isFace P hv
    have hdim0 : faceDim ({v} : Set (E n)) = 0 := by
      show Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ ({v} : Set (E n))) = 0
      rw [vectorSpan_singleton]
      simp
    exact H (d - 1) {v} h0 (by omega) (by omega)
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro f hf hk hle
    exact ⟨f, hf, by omega⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro f hf hk hle
    by_cases heq : faceDim f = d - 1
    · exact ⟨f, hf, heq⟩
    · have hgap : faceDim f + 2 ≤ d := by omega
      obtain ⟨f', hf', hsub, hne⟩ := interpolazione P hf hgap
      have hlt : faceDim f < faceDim f' := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hf hf' hsub
      have hlt2 : faceDim f' < d := by
        have hss : f' ⊂ P.toSet := ⟨face_subset_toSet P hf', hne ∘ (fun h =>
          Set.Subset.antisymm (face_subset_toSet P hf') h)⟩
        have := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hf' (toSet_isFace P) hss
        exact this
      exact ih f' hf' (by omega) (by omega)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.chain_exists
statement:
theorem chain_exists (P : ConvexPolytope n) :
    ∀ d : ℕ, Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) = d →
    ∃ c : ℕ → Set (E n),
      (∀ k, k < d → P.IsFace (c k) ∧ faceDim (c k) = k) ∧
      (∀ j k, j < k → k < d → c j ⊂ c k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro d
  induction d generalizing P with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    exact ⟨fun _ => ∅, fun k hk => absurd hk (by omega),
      fun j k hjk hk => absurd hk (by omega)⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hdim
    
    have hd1 : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) := by omega
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfdim⟩ := facet_exists P hd1
    rw [hdim] at hfdim
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hfdim
    
    have hsubdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (facePolytope P hf).toSet) = m := by
      rw [facePolytope_toSet P hf]
      exact hfdim
    obtain ⟨c', hc'1, hc'2⟩ := ih (facePolytope P hf) hsubdim
    refine ⟨fun k => if k = m then f else c' k, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      by_cases hkm : k = m
      · subst hkm
        simp only [if_pos rfl]
        exact ⟨hf, hfdim⟩
      · have hklt : k < m := by omega
        simp only [if_neg hkm]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc'1 k hklt
        exact ⟨isFace_of_facePolytope P hf h1, h2⟩
    · intro j k hjk hk
      by_cases hkm : k = m
      · subst hkm
        have hjm : j ≠ k := by omega
        have hjlt : j < k := hjk
        simp only [if_pos rfl, if_neg hjm]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc'1 j hjlt
        constructor
        · have hsub1 : c' j ⊆ (facePolytope P hf).toSet :=
            face_subset_toSet (facePolytope P hf) h1
          rwa [facePolytope_toSet P hf] at hsub1
        · intro hcontra
          have hsub1 : c' j ⊆ (facePolytope P hf).toSet :=
            face_subset_toSet (facePolytope P hf) h1
          rw [facePolytope_toSet P hf] at hsub1
          have hfeq : c' j = f := Set.Subset.antisymm hsub1 hcontra
          have := h2
          rw [hfeq] at this
          omega
      · have hklt : k < m := by omega
        have hjm : j ≠ m := by omega
        simp only [if_neg hkm, if_neg hjm]
        exact hc'2 j k hjk hklt

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.flag_exists
statement:
theorem flag_exists (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim) :
    Nonempty (P.Flag)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) = n := hfull
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := chain_exists P n hdim
  refine ⟨⟨fun k => c k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro k
    exact (hc1 k k.isLt).1
  · intro k
    exact (hc1 k k.isLt).2
  · intro i j hij
    exact hc2 i j hij j.isLt

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_forma_positiva
statement:
theorem gram_forma_positiva {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (α : ι → E n)
    (hind : LinearIndependent ℝ α) (g : ι → ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    0 < ∑ i, ∑ j, g i * g j * ⟪α i, α j⟫
proof:
:= by
  
  have hform : (∑ i, ∑ j, g i * g j * ⟪α i, α j⟫)
      = ⟪∑ i, g i • α i, ∑ j, g j • α j⟫ := by
    rw [sum_inner]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro i _
    rw [inner_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro j _
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  rw [hform, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hne : (∑ i, g i • α i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hg
    funext i
    exact (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hind) g h i
  positivity

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_canonica_forma_positiva
statement:
theorem gram_canonica_forma_positiva (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    0 < ∑ i, ∑ j, g i * g j *
      ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normaleOrientato P hreg F j⟫
proof:
:=
  gram_forma_positiva (normaleOrientato P hreg F)
    (normali_orientati_linearIndependent P hreg F (by omega)) g hg

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.facet_above_proper_face
statement:
theorem facet_above_proper_face (Q : ConvexPolytope n)
    {e : Set (E n)} (he : Q.IsFace e) (heTop : e ⊂ Q.toSet) :
    ∃ D : Set (E n), Q.IsFace D ∧ e ⊆ D ∧ D ⊂ Q.toSet ∧
      faceDim D + 1 = faceDim Q.toSet
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Set (Set (E n)) :=
    {D | Q.IsFace D ∧ e ⊆ D ∧ D ≠ Q.toSet}
  have hSfinite : S.Finite := by
    apply (facce_finite Q).subset
    intro D hD
    exact hD.1
  have heS : e ∈ S := ⟨he, Subset.rfl, heTop.ne⟩
  obtain ⟨D, heD, hDmax⟩ := hSfinite.exists_le_maximal heS
  have hDS : D ∈ S := hDmax.1
  have hDTop : D ⊂ Q.toSet :=
    (face_subset_toSet Q hDS.1).ssubset_of_ne hDS.2.2
  have hdimlt := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset Q hDS.1 (toSet_isFace Q) hDTop
  have hfacet : faceDim D + 1 = faceDim Q.toSet := by
    by_contra hne
    have hgap : faceDim D + 2 ≤
        Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) := by
      change faceDim D + 2 ≤ faceDim Q.toSet
      omega
    obtain ⟨D', hD', hDD', hD'ne⟩ := interpolazione Q hDS.1 hgap
    have hD'S : D' ∈ S :=
      ⟨hD', hDS.2.1.trans hDD'.1, hD'ne⟩
    have hD'D : D' ⊆ D := hDmax.2 hD'S hDD'.1
    exact hDD'.ne (Set.Subset.antisymm hDD'.1 hD'D)
  exact ⟨D, hDS.1, heD, hDTop, hfacet⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ridgeConnectedAboveOne_of_vertexStarAboveThree
statement:
theorem ridgeConnectedAboveOne_of_vertexStarAboveThree
    (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hstar : VertexStarRidgeConnectedAboveThree P) :
    RidgeConnectedAboveOne P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro B hB hdB A A' hA hA' hAB hA'B hdA hdA'
  by_cases hdhi : faceDim B ≤ 3
  · exact ridgeConnected_in_faceDim_le_three P B hB hdB hdhi
      A A' hA hA' hAB hA'B hdA hdA'
  · have hdBfour : 4 ≤ faceDim B := by omega
    let Q : ConvexPolytope n := facePolytope P hB
    have hQT : Q.toSet = B := facePolytope_toSet P hB
    have hQdim : faceDim Q.toSet = faceDim B := by rw [hQT]
    have hAQ : Q.IsFace A := facePolytope_isFace_of P hB hA hAB.1
    have hA'Q : Q.IsFace A' := facePolytope_isFace_of P hB hA' hA'B.1
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (facePolytope Q hAQ).vertices_nonempty
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := (facePolytope Q hA'Q).vertices_nonempty
    have hxQ : x ∈ Q.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1
    have hxA : x ∈ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    have hx'Q : x' ∈ Q.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx').1
    have hx'A' : x' ∈ A' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx').2
    have hverts : Relation.ReflTransGen (GeneralVertexStep Q) x x' :=
      balinski_light_general Q hxQ hx'Q
    change Relation.ReflTransGen (RidgeStepIn P B) A A'
    have transfer : ∀ {q : E n},
        Relation.ReflTransGen (GeneralVertexStep Q) x q →
        ∃ X : Set (E n),
          Relation.ReflTransGen (RidgeStepIn P B) A X ∧
          P.IsFace X ∧ X ⊂ B ∧
          faceDim X + 1 = faceDim B ∧
          q ∈ Q.vertices ∧ q ∈ X := by
      intro q hpath
      induction hpath with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨A, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, hA, hAB, hdA, hxQ, hxA⟩
      | @tail p q hprev hstep ih =>
          obtain ⟨X, hAX, hXP, hXB, hdX, hpQ, hpX⟩ := ih
          obtain ⟨hqQ, _hpq, e, he, hde, hpe, hqe⟩ := hstep
          have heTop : e ⊂ Q.toSet := by
            refine (face_subset_toSet Q he).ssubset_of_ne ?_
            intro heq
            have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
            rw [hde, hQdim] at hdim
            omega
          obtain ⟨D, hDQ, heD, hDTop, hdD⟩ :=
            facet_above_proper_face Q he heTop
          have hDP : P.IsFace D := isFace_of_facePolytope P hB hDQ
          have hDB : D ⊂ B := by simpa only [hQT] using hDTop
          have hdDB : faceDim D + 1 = faceDim B := by
            rw [← hQdim]
            exact hdD
          have hpD : p ∈ D := heD hpe
          have hqD : q ∈ D := heD hqe
          have hXD := hstar B hB hdBfour p hpQ X D hXP hDP
            hXB hDB hdX hdDB hpX hpD
          exact ⟨D, hAX.trans hXD, hDP, hDB, hdDB, hqQ, hqD⟩
    obtain ⟨X, hAX, hXP, hXB, hdX, hx'Q', hx'X⟩ := transfer hverts
    exact hAX.trans
      (hstar B hB hdBfour x' hx'Q' X A' hXP hA' hXB hA'B
        hdX hdA' hx'X hx'A')

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coniugioScala_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coniugioScala_apply (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ρ : Isom n)
    (x : E n) : coniugioScala a ha ρ x = a • ρ (a⁻¹ • x)
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coniugioScala_smul
statement:
theorem coniugioScala_smul (a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ρ : Isom n) (x : E n) :
    coniugioScala a ha ρ (a • x) = a • ρ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coniugioScala_apply]
  congr 1
  rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.similar_symm
statement:
theorem similar_symm {P Q : ConvexPolytope n} (h : Similar P Q) :
    Similar Q P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, φ, hQ⟩ := h
  have hane : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ha
  refine ⟨a⁻¹, inv_pos.mpr ha, coniugioScala a hane φ.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [hQ]
  rw [Set.image_image, Set.image_image, Set.image_image]
  have hid : ∀ x : E n,
      a⁻¹ • (coniugioScala a hane φ.symm) (a • φ x) = x := by
    intro x
    rw [coniugioScala_smul]
    rw [φ.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hane, one_smul]
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, hx, hid x⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    rw [← hxy]
    show a⁻¹ • (coniugioScala a hane φ.symm) (a • φ y) ∈ P.toSet
    rw [hid y]
    exact hy

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.similar_trans
statement:
theorem similar_trans {P Q R : ConvexPolytope n}
    (h1 : Similar P Q) (h2 : Similar Q R) : Similar P R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, φ, hQ⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨b, hb, ψ, hR⟩ := h2
  have hane : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ha
  have haine : a⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hane
  
  set ψhat : Isom n := coniugioScala a⁻¹ haine ψ with hψhat
  have hassorbe : ∀ z : E n, ψ (a • z) = a • ψhat z := by
    intro z
    rw [hψhat, coniugioScala_apply]
    rw [inv_inv]
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hane, one_smul]
  refine ⟨b * a, mul_pos hb ha, φ.trans ψhat, ?_⟩
  rw [hR, hQ]
  rw [Set.image_image, Set.image_image, Set.image_image, Set.image_image]
  have hid : ∀ x : E n,
      b • ψ (a • φ x) = (b * a) • (φ.trans ψhat) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hassorbe (φ x)]
    rw [smul_smul]
    rfl
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    show (b * a) • (φ.trans ψhat) y = x
    rw [← hxy]
    exact (hid y).symm
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    show b • ψ (a • φ y) = x
    rw [← hxy]
    exact hid y

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.classeSim_mem_quoziente
proof:
:=
  ⟨P, rfl⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.classeSim_ne_of_card_ne
statement:
theorem classeSim_ne_of_card_ne {d : ℕ} {P Q : regularPolytopes d}
    (h : (P : ConvexPolytope d).vertices.card ≠
      (Q : ConvexPolytope d).vertices.card) :
    classeSim d P ≠ classeSim d Q
proof:
:= by
  intro hcon
  apply h
  have hQ : Q ∈ classeSim d Q := similar_refl (Q : ConvexPolytope d)
  rw [← hcon] at hQ
  exact (vertices_card_of_similar hQ).symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_eq_top
statement:
theorem platonicCount_eq_top (d : ℕ) (F : ℕ → regularPolytopes d)
    (hcard : Function.Injective
      (fun n => (F n : ConvexPolytope d).vertices.card)) :
    platonicCount d = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun n => classeSim d (F n)) := by
    intro m n hmn
    by_contra hne
    exact classeSim_ne_of_card_ne (fun hc => hne (hcard hc)) hmn
  have hsub : Set.range (fun n => classeSim d (F n)) ⊆
      {S : Set (regularPolytopes d) |
        ∃ P', S = {Q : regularPolytopes d | regularSimilar d P' Q}} := by
    rintro S ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact classeSim_mem_quoziente d (F n)
  have hinf : (Set.range (fun n => classeSim d (F n))).Infinite :=
    Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinj
  have hinf' : {S : Set (regularPolytopes d) |
      ∃ P', S = {Q : regularPolytopes d | regularSimilar d P' Q}}.Infinite :=
    hinf.mono hsub
  show Set.encard _ = ⊤
  exact hinf'.encard_eq

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.interna_tre
statement:
theorem interna_tre (m : ℕ → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (hL : 4 ≤ L)
    (hwin : FinestraPattern m L) (i : ℕ) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i) (hiL : i + 1 < L) :
    m i = 3
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i + 3 ≤ L
  · have hw := hwin (i - 1) (by omega)
    have he : i - 1 + 1 = i := by omega
    rcases hw with ⟨_, h1, _, _⟩ | ⟨_, h1, _, _⟩ | ⟨_, h1, _, _⟩ <;>
      (rw [he] at h1; exact h1)
  · have hw := hwin (L - 4) (by omega)
    have he : L - 4 + 2 = i := by omega
    rcases hw with ⟨_, _, h2, _⟩ | ⟨_, _, h2, _⟩ | ⟨_, _, h2, _⟩ <;>
      (rw [he] at h2; exact h2)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.propagazione
statement:
theorem propagazione (m : ℕ → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (hL : 4 ≤ L)
    (hwin : FinestraPattern m L) :
    allThree m L ∨ leftFour m L ∨ rightFour m L ∨ doubleFour m L
proof:
:= by
  have hint : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i + 1 < L → m i = 3 := interna_tre m L hL hwin
  have h0 : m 0 = 3 ∨ m 0 = 4 := by
    rcases hwin 0 (by omega) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact Or.inl h
  have hLm1 : m (L - 1) = 3 ∨ m (L - 1) = 4 := by
    have he : L - 4 + 3 = L - 1 := by omega
    rcases hwin (L - 4) (by omega) with ⟨_, _, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, h⟩ <;>
      rw [he] at h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
  
  have hcover : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i < L - 1 → m i = 3 := by
    intro i hi1 hi; exact hint i hi1 (by omega)
  rcases h0 with h0 | h0 <;> rcases hLm1 with hL1 | hL1
  · 
    refine Or.inl ?_
    intro i hi
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i 1 with h | h
    · have : i = 0 := by omega
      rw [this]; exact h0
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i (L - 1) with h' | h'
      · exact hcover i h h'
      · have : i = L - 1 := by omega
        rw [this]; exact hL1
  · 
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨?_, hL1⟩))
    intro i hi
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i 1 with h | h
    · have : i = 0 := by omega
      rw [this]; exact h0
    · exact hcover i h hi
  · 
    refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h0, ?_⟩)
    intro i hi1 hi
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i (L - 1) with h' | h'
    · exact hcover i hi1 h'
    · have : i = L - 1 := by omega
      rw [this]; exact hL1
  · 
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h0, hcover, hL1⟩))

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.schlafli_ge_tre_all
statement:
theorem schlafli_ge_tre_all (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (i : Fin n) (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) :
    3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F i
proof:
:= by
  rw [schlafli_apply P hreg F i hi, schlafliDi, rangoSucc]
  exact coxeterMatrix_adiacente_ge_tre_ovunque P hreg F i hi hn

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.schlafliFun_eq
statement:
theorem schlafliFun_eq (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < n) :
    schlafliFun P hreg F i = schlafli P hreg F ⟨i, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [schlafliFun, dif_pos hi]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.finestraPattern_schlafli
statement:
theorem finestraPattern_schlafli (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    FinestraPattern (schlafliFun P hreg F) (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  have hs5 : s + 5 ≤ n := by omega
  have e0 : schlafliFun P hreg F s = schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafliFun_eq P hreg F s (by omega)
  have e1 : schlafliFun P hreg F (s + 1) = schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafliFun_eq P hreg F (s + 1) (by omega)
  have e2 : schlafliFun P hreg F (s + 2) = schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafliFun_eq P hreg F (s + 2) (by omega)
  have e3 : schlafliFun P hreg F (s + 3) = schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 3, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafliFun_eq P hreg F (s + 3) (by omega)
  rw [e0, e1, e2, e3]
  exact finestra_quadrupla P hreg F hn s hs5
    (schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨s, by omega⟩ (show s + 1 < n by omega))
    (schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ (show s + 1 + 1 < n by omega))
    (schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ (show s + 2 + 1 < n by omega))
    (schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨s + 3, by omega⟩ (show s + 3 + 1 < n by omega))

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.schlafli_high_dim_exclusive
statement:
theorem schlafli_high_dim_exclusive {d : ℕ} (P : ConvexPolytope d)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    allThree (schlafliFun P hreg F) (d - 1) ∨ leftFour (schlafliFun P hreg F) (d - 1) ∨
      rightFour (schlafliFun P hreg F) (d - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 3 ≤ d := by omega
  rcases propagazione (schlafliFun P hreg F) (d - 1) (by omega)
      (finestraPattern_schlafli P hreg F hn) with h3 | h4L | h4R | h44
  · exact Or.inl h3
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h4L)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h4R)
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨h0, hmid, hL1⟩ := h44
    have link : ∀ j, j + 1 < d →
        (coxeterCoeff P hreg F j) ^ 2 = Real.cos (π / (schlafliFun P hreg F j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
      intro j hj
      rw [coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F j (by omega) hj, schlafliFun_eq P hreg F j hj]
    have hc0 : (coxeterCoeff P hreg F 0) ^ 2 = 1 / 2 := by
      rw [link 0 (by omega), h0, show ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 4 by norm_num, cos_pi_div_four_sq]
    have hcL : (coxeterCoeff P hreg F ((d - 1) - 1)) ^ 2 = 1 / 2 := by
      rw [link ((d - 1) - 1) (by omega), hL1, show ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 4 by norm_num,
        cos_pi_div_four_sq]
    have hci : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ (d - 1) - 2 →
        (coxeterCoeff P hreg F i) ^ 2 = 1 / 4 := by
      intro i hi1 hi2
      rw [link i (by omega), hmid i hi1 (by omega), show ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 3 by norm_num,
        cos_pi_div_three_sq]
    have hmin : 0 < minoreGram (coxeterCoeff P hreg F) ((d - 1) + 1) := by
      rw [show (d - 1) + 1 = d from by omega]
      exact canonicalGram_positive_minori P hreg F hn d (le_refl d)
    exact doppio_quattro_impossibile (coxeterCoeff P hreg F) (d - 1) (by omega) hc0 hci hcL hmin

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faccia_intermedia_e_una_delle_due
statement:
theorem faccia_intermedia_e_una_delle_due (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n)
    (hi2 : (i : ℕ) + 2 < n)
    (hcomm : adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F i)
        ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ =
      adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩) i)
    {C : Set (E n)} (hC : P.IsFace C) (hdC : faceDim C = (i : ℕ))
    (hsotto : ∀ k : Fin n, (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → F.face k ⊂ C)
    (hsopra : C ⊂ F.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 2, hi2⟩) :
    C = F.face i ∨ C = (adjacentFlag P hfull F i).face i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hGout, hGi⟩ :=
    bandiera_del_residuo_generale P hfull F i hi hi2 hC hdC hsotto hsopra
  have hgal := residuo_rango_tre_connesso P hfull F G i hi
    (fun k hk hk2 => (hGout k hk hk2).symm)
  have h := facce_del_residuo_chiuso P hfull F i hi hcomm hgal
  rw [hGi] at h
  exact h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coxeterMatrix_adiacente_ge_tre
statement:
theorem coxeterMatrix_adiacente_ge_tre (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n)
    (hi2 : (i : ℕ) + 2 < n) (hipos : 0 < (i : ℕ)) :
    3 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set ip : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ with hip
  have hne : i ≠ ip := by
    intro he
    have : (i : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := congrArg Fin.val he
    omega
  have hge2 : 2 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip :=
    coxeterMatrix_off_diag_ge P hreg F hne
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip) 3 with hlt | hge
  · exfalso
    have h2 : coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip = 2 := by omega
    
    have hcomm := mosse_commutano_di_ordine_due P hreg F hne h2
    
    obtain ⟨im, him⟩ : ∃ im : ℕ, (i : ℕ) = im + 1 := ⟨(i : ℕ) - 1, by omega⟩
    have himn : im < n := by omega
    let A : Fin n := ⟨im, himn⟩
    let B : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 2, hi2⟩
    have hAval : (A : ℕ) = im := rfl
    have hBval : (B : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 2 := rfl
    have hAB : F.face A ⊂ F.face B := by
      refine F.strict_mono A B ?_
      rw [Fin.lt_def, hAval, hBval]
      omega
    have hrank : faceDim (F.face B) = faceDim (F.face A) + 3 := by
      rw [F.dim_eq, F.dim_eq, hAval, hBval]
      omega
    obtain ⟨C₁, C₂, C₃, hC₁, hC₂, hC₃, h12, h13, h23⟩ :=
      tre_intermedie_di_rango_tre P (F.isFace A) (F.isFace B) hAB hrank
    
    have hdim : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, faceDim C = faceDim (F.face A) + 1 →
        faceDim C = (i : ℕ) := by
      intro C hC
      rw [hC, F.dim_eq, hAval]
      omega
    have hsotto : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, F.face A ⊂ C →
        ∀ k : Fin n, (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → F.face k ⊂ C := by
      intro C hAC k hk
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (k : ℕ) im with hklt | hkge
      · refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ hAC.le
        refine F.strict_mono k A ?_
        rw [Fin.lt_def, hAval]
        exact hklt
      · have hkA : k = A := by
          apply Fin.ext
          show (k : ℕ) = im
          omega
        rw [hkA]
        exact hAC
    have hone : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, P.IsFace C → F.face A ⊂ C →
        C ⊂ F.face B → faceDim C = faceDim (F.face A) + 1 →
        C = F.face i ∨ C = (adjacentFlag P hreg.1 F i).face i := by
      intro C hCface hAC hCB hCdim
      exact faccia_intermedia_e_una_delle_due P hreg.1 F i hi hi2 hcomm
        hCface (hdim hCdim) (hsotto hAC) hCB
    have r₁ := hone hC₁.1 hC₁.2.1 hC₁.2.2.1 hC₁.2.2.2
    have r₂ := hone hC₂.1 hC₂.2.1 hC₂.2.2.1 hC₂.2.2.2
    have r₃ := hone hC₃.1 hC₃.2.1 hC₃.2.2.1 hC₃.2.2.2
    
    rcases r₁ with e₁ | e₁ <;> rcases r₂ with e₂ | e₂ <;>
      rcases r₃ with e₃ | e₃
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h13 (e₁.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h23 (e₂.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h23 (e₂.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h13 (e₁.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
  · exact hge

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.le_platonicCount
statement:
theorem le_platonicCount (d k : ℕ) (F : Fin k → regularPolytopes d)
    (hdist : ∀ i j : Fin k, i ≠ j → ¬ regularSimilar d (F i) (F j)) :
    (k : ℕ∞) ≤ platonicCount d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => classeSim d (F i)) := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    apply hdist i j hne
    have hij' : classeSim d (F i) = classeSim d (F j) := hij
    have hmem : F j ∈ classeSim d (F j) :=
      similar_refl (F j : ConvexPolytope d)
    show F j ∈ classeSim d (F i)
    rw [hij']
    exact hmem
  have hsub : Set.range (fun i => classeSim d (F i)) ⊆
      {S : Set (regularPolytopes d) |
        ∃ P', S = {Q : regularPolytopes d | regularSimilar d P' Q}} := by
    rintro S ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact classeSim_mem_quoziente d (F i)
  have hcard : (Set.range (fun i => classeSim d (F i))).encard = k := by
    rw [← Set.image_univ, hinj.encard_image, Set.encard_univ]
    simp
  calc (k : ℕ∞) = (Set.range (fun i => classeSim d (F i))).encard :=
        hcard.symm
    _ ≤ _ := Set.encard_le_encard hsub

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.le_platonicCount_di_invariante
statement:
theorem le_platonicCount_di_invariante (d k : ℕ)
    (F : Fin k → regularPolytopes d) {α : Type*}
    (inv : regularPolytopes d → α)
    (hinv : ∀ P Q : regularPolytopes d, regularSimilar d P Q →
      inv P = inv Q)
    (hsep : Function.Injective (fun i => inv (F i))) :
    (k : ℕ∞) ≤ platonicCount d
proof:
:= by
  refine le_platonicCount d k F ?_
  intro i j hij hsim
  exact hij (hsep (hinv (F i) (F j) hsim))

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.sep_of_mem_erase
statement:
theorem sep_of_mem_erase {w : E n} (hw : w ∈ Q.vertices.erase v) :
    D.l w < D.c
proof:
:=
  D.hsep w (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw) (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hw)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.numpos
statement: theorem numpos : 0 < D.l v - D.c
proof: := by linarith [D.hvc]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.denpos
statement: theorem denpos {w : E n} (hwc : D.l w < D.c) : 0 < D.l v - D.l w
proof:
:= by
  linarith [D.hvc]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.tau_pos
statement:
theorem tau_pos {w : E n} (hwc : D.l w < D.c) :
    0 < (D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l w)
proof:
:=
  div_pos D.numpos (D.denpos hwc)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.tau_lt_one
statement:
theorem tau_lt_one {w : E n} (hwc : D.l w < D.c) :
    (D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l w) < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_lt_one (D.denpos hwc)]
  linarith

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.attra_sub
statement:
theorem attra_sub (w : E n) :
    D.attra w - v = ((D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l w)) • (w - v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [attra, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.attra_level
statement:
theorem attra_level {w : E n} (hwc : D.l w < D.c) :
    D.l (D.attra w) = D.c
proof:
:= by
  have hden : D.l v - D.l w ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (D.denpos hwc)
  rw [attra]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
  have hcancel : (D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l w) * (D.l v - D.l w)
      = D.l v - D.c := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden
  nlinarith [hcancel]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.attra_mem_segment
statement:
theorem attra_mem_segment {w : E n} (hwc : D.l w < D.c) :
    D.attra w ∈ segment ℝ v w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1 - (D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l w),
    (D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l w),
    by linarith [D.tau_lt_one hwc], le_of_lt (D.tau_pos hwc), by ring, ?_⟩
  rw [attra]
  match_scalars <;> ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.attra_ne
statement: theorem attra_ne {w : E n} (hwc : D.l w < D.c) : D.attra w ≠ v
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := D.attra_level hwc
  rw [h] at this
  linarith [D.hvc]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.attra_mem_toSet
statement:
theorem attra_mem_toSet {w : E n} (hwV : w ∈ Q.vertices)
    (hwc : D.l w < D.c) : D.attra w ∈ Q.toSet
proof:
:= by
  have hvT : v ∈ Q.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast D.hv)
  have hwT : w ∈ Q.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hwV)
  exact (convex_convexHull ℝ _).segment_subset hvT hwT
    (D.attra_mem_segment hwc)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.gen_nonempty
statement: theorem gen_nonempty : D.gen.Nonempty
proof: := D.hW.image D.attra

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.mem_gen_of_mem_erase
statement:
theorem mem_gen_of_mem_erase {w : E n} (hw : w ∈ Q.vertices.erase v) :
    D.attra w ∈ D.gen
proof: := Finset.mem_image_of_mem D.attra hw

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.fetta_eq_hull
statement:
theorem fetta_eq_hull :
    Q.toSet ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c} = convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set W : Finset (E n) := Q.vertices.erase v with hWdef
  have hvins : Q.vertices = insert v W := (Finset.insert_erase D.hv).symm
  have hvnotW : v ∉ W := Finset.notMem_erase v Q.vertices
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨hxT, hxc⟩
    have hxc' : D.l x = D.c := hxc
    have hxT' : x ∈ convexHull ℝ ((Q.vertices : Finset (E n)) : Set (E n)) :=
      hxT
    rw [Finset.convexHull_eq] at hxT'
    obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha1, hax⟩ := hxT'
    have hxrep : x = ∑ u ∈ Q.vertices, a u • u := by
      rw [← hax, Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ ha1]
      rfl
    
    have hlev : ∑ u ∈ Q.vertices, a u * D.l u = D.c := by
      have hmap := congrArg D.l hxrep
      rw [map_sum] at hmap
      simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hmap
      exact hmap.symm.trans hxc'
    
    have ha1' : a v + ∑ w ∈ W, a w = 1 := by
      rw [hvins, Finset.sum_insert hvnotW] at ha1
      exact ha1
    have hlev' : a v * D.l v + ∑ w ∈ W, a w * D.l w = D.c := by
      rw [hvins, Finset.sum_insert hvnotW] at hlev
      exact hlev
    have hxrep' : x = a v • v + ∑ w ∈ W, a w • w := by
      rw [hvins, Finset.sum_insert hvnotW] at hxrep
      exact hxrep
    
    set μ : E n → ℝ := fun w => a w * (D.l v - D.l w) / (D.l v - D.c)
      with hμdef
    have hμ0 : ∀ w ∈ W, 0 ≤ μ w := by
      intro w hw
      exact div_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (ha0 w (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw))
          (le_of_lt (D.denpos (D.sep_of_mem_erase hw))))
        (le_of_lt D.numpos)
    have hnum : ∑ w ∈ W, a w * (D.l v - D.l w) = D.l v - D.c := by
      have hexp : ∀ w ∈ W, a w * (D.l v - D.l w)
          = a w * D.l v - a w * D.l w := fun w _ => mul_sub _ _ _
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hexp, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        ← Finset.sum_mul]
      have h1 : ∑ w ∈ W, a w = 1 - a v := by linarith
      have h2 : ∑ w ∈ W, a w * D.l w = D.c - a v * D.l v := by linarith
      rw [h1, h2]
      ring
    have hμ1 : ∑ w ∈ W, μ w = 1 := by
      have hstep : ∑ w ∈ W, μ w
          = (∑ w ∈ W, a w * (D.l v - D.l w)) / (D.l v - D.c) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
      rw [hstep, hnum, div_self (ne_of_gt D.numpos)]
    
    have hterm : ∀ w ∈ W, μ w • D.attra w = μ w • v + a w • (w - v) := by
      intro w hw
      have hden : D.l v - D.l w ≠ 0 :=
        ne_of_gt (D.denpos (D.sep_of_mem_erase hw))
      have hd : D.l v - D.c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt D.numpos
      have hcoef : μ w * ((D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l w)) = a w := by
        rw [hμdef]
        field_simp
      rw [attra, smul_add, smul_smul, hcoef]
    have hx2 : x = ∑ w ∈ W, μ w • D.attra w := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        ← Finset.sum_smul, hμ1, one_smul]
      have hsub : ∀ w ∈ W, a w • (w - v) = a w • w - a w • v :=
        fun w _ => smul_sub _ _ _
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        ← Finset.sum_smul]
      have h1 : ∑ w ∈ W, a w = 1 - a v := by linarith
      rw [h1, hxrep']
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
      abel
    have hmem := Finset.centerMass_mem_convexHull W (w := μ) hμ0
      (by rw [hμ1]; norm_num)
      (z := D.attra)
      (fun w hw => Finset.mem_coe.mpr (D.mem_gen_of_mem_erase hw))
    rw [Finset.centerMass_eq_of_sum_1 _ _ hμ1] at hmem
    rw [hx2]
    exact hmem
  · apply convexHull_min
    · intro y hy
      have hy' : y ∈ D.gen := hy
      simp only [gen, Finset.mem_image] at hy'
      obtain ⟨w, hw', rfl⟩ := hy'
      refine ⟨D.attra_mem_toSet (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw')
        (D.sep_of_mem_erase hw'), ?_⟩
      exact D.attra_level (D.sep_of_mem_erase hw')
    · exact (convex_convexHull ℝ _).inter
        (convex_hyperplane (LinearMap.isLinear D.l.toLinearMap) D.c)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.hull_ext
statement:
theorem hull_ext :
    convexHull ℝ ((convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))).extremePoints ℝ)
      = convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : IsCompact (convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))) :=
    D.gen.finite_toSet.isCompact_convexHull ℝ
  have hconv : Convex ℝ (convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))) :=
    convex_convexHull ℝ _
  have hKM := closure_convexHull_extremePoints hcomp hconv
  have hfin : ((convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))).extremePoints ℝ).Finite :=
    D.gen.finite_toSet.subset extremePoints_convexHull_subset
  calc convexHull ℝ ((convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))).extremePoints ℝ)
      = closure (convexHull ℝ
          ((convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))).extremePoints ℝ)) :=
        (hfin.isClosed_convexHull ℝ).closure_eq.symm
    _ = convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n)) := hKM

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.ext_finite
statement:
theorem ext_finite :
    ((convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))).extremePoints ℝ).Finite
proof:
:=
  D.gen.finite_toSet.subset extremePoints_convexHull_subset

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.ext_nonempty
statement:
theorem ext_nonempty :
    ((convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))).extremePoints ℝ).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hempty
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hempty
  have h0 := D.hull_ext
  rw [hempty, convexHull_empty] at h0
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := D.gen_nonempty
  have hymem : y ∈ convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n)) :=
    subset_convexHull ℝ _ (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hy)
  rw [← h0] at hymem
  exact hymem

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.politopo_toSet
statement:
theorem politopo_toSet :
    D.politopo.toSet = Q.toSet ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c}
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : D.politopo.toSet = convexHull ℝ
      ((convexHull ℝ (D.gen : Set (E n))).extremePoints ℝ) := by
    show convexHull ℝ ((D.ext_finite.toFinset : Finset (E n)) : Set (E n)) = _
    rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]
  rw [h1, D.hull_ext, ← D.fetta_eq_hull]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.esiste_vertice_altro
statement:
theorem esiste_vertice_altro {F : Set (E n)} (hF : Q.IsFace F) (hvF : v ∈ F)
    (hdF : 1 ≤ faceDim F) : ∃ w ∈ Q.vertices.erase v, w ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hfe := face_eq_hull_vertices Q hF
  have hsub : ((Q.vertices.filter (· ∈ F) : Finset (E n)) : Set (E n))
      ⊆ ({v} : Set (E n)) := by
    intro u hu
    have hu' : u ∈ Q.vertices.filter (· ∈ F) := by exact_mod_cast hu
    have huV : u ∈ Q.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu').1
    have huF : u ∈ F := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu').2
    by_contra huv
    have huv' : u ≠ v := by simpa using huv
    exact hcon u (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨huv', huV⟩) huF
  have hFsub : F ⊆ ({v} : Set (E n)) := by
    rw [hfe]
    exact convexHull_min hsub (convex_singleton v)
  have hFeq : F = ({v} : Set (E n)) :=
    Set.Subset.antisymm hFsub (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hvF)
  rw [hFeq, faceDim_singleton] at hdF
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.faccia_fetta
statement:
theorem faccia_fetta {F : Set (E n)} (hF : Q.IsFace F) (hvF : v ∈ F)
    (hdF : 1 ≤ faceDim F) :
    D.politopo.IsFace (F ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀W, hw₀F⟩ := esiste_vertice_altro hF hvF hdF
  have hw₀c := D.sep_of_mem_erase hw₀W
  have hattra₀F : D.attra w₀ ∈ F :=
    (hF.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)).segment_subset hvF hw₀F
      (D.attra_mem_segment hw₀c)
  have hne : (F ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c}).Nonempty :=
    ⟨D.attra w₀, hattra₀F, D.attra_level hw₀c⟩
  refine ⟨?_, hne⟩
  intro _
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hF.1 hF.2
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  rw [D.politopo_toSet]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxF, hxc⟩
    have hx' := hxF
    rw [hf] at hx'
    exact ⟨⟨hx'.1, hxc⟩, fun y hy => hx'.2 y hy.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hxT, hxc⟩, hxmax⟩
    have hatt' := hattra₀F
    rw [hf] at hatt'
    have h1 : f (D.attra w₀) ≤ f x :=
      hxmax _ ⟨hatt'.1, D.attra_level hw₀c⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hxc⟩
    rw [hf]
    exact ⟨hxT, fun y hy => le_trans (hatt'.2 y hy) h1⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.fetta_mono
statement:
theorem fetta_mono {F₁ F₂ : Set (E n)} (hF₁ : Q.IsFace F₁) (hvF₁ : v ∈ F₁)
    (hF₂ : Q.IsFace F₂) (hvF₂ : v ∈ F₂)
    (hsub : F₁ ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c} ⊆ F₂ ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c}) :
    F₁ ⊆ F₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ := hF₂.1 hF₂.2
  have hv₂ := hvF₂
  rw [hf₂] at hv₂
  have hfe := face_eq_hull_vertices Q hF₁
  rw [hfe]
  apply convexHull_min ?_ (hF₂.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _))
  intro u hu
  have hu' : u ∈ Q.vertices.filter (· ∈ F₁) := by exact_mod_cast hu
  have huV : u ∈ Q.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu').1
  have huF₁ : u ∈ F₁ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu').2
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · subst huv
    exact hvF₂
  · have huW : u ∈ Q.vertices.erase v := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨huv, huV⟩
    have huc : D.l u < D.c := D.sep_of_mem_erase huW
    have hattra₁ : D.attra u ∈ F₁ :=
      (hF₁.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)).segment_subset hvF₁ huF₁
        (D.attra_mem_segment huc)
    have hattra₂ : D.attra u ∈ F₂ :=
      (hsub ⟨hattra₁, D.attra_level huc⟩).1
    have hatt := hattra₂
    rw [hf₂] at hatt
    have heq : f₂ (D.attra u) = f₂ v :=
      le_antisymm (hv₂.2 _ hatt.1) (hatt.2 v hv₂.1)
    have hexp : f₂ (D.attra u)
        = f₂ v + ((D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l u)) * (f₂ u - f₂ v) := by
      rw [attra]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
    have hzero : ((D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l u)) * (f₂ u - f₂ v) = 0 := by
      linarith [hexp, heq]
    have hf₂u : f₂ u = f₂ v := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with h | h
      · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt (D.tau_pos huc))
      · linarith
    rw [hf₂]
    have huT : u ∈ Q.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast huV)
    exact ⟨huT, fun y hy => (hv₂.2 y hy).trans_eq hf₂u.symm⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.faccia_dalla_fetta
statement:
theorem faccia_dalla_fetta {G : Set (E n)} (hG : D.politopo.IsFace G) :
    ∃ F : Set (E n), Q.IsFace F ∧ v ∈ F ∧ 1 ≤ faceDim F ∧
      F ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c} = G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hG.1 hG.2
  rw [D.politopo_toSet] at hg
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hG.2
  have hx₀' := hx₀
  rw [hg] at hx₀'
  set M : ℝ := g x₀ with hM
  set t : ℝ := (M - g v) / (D.l v - D.c) with ht
  set f : E n →L[ℝ] ℝ := g + t • D.l with hfdef
  have hfapp : ∀ x, f x = g x + t * D.l x := by
    intro x
    simp [hfdef]
  have hvT : v ∈ Q.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast D.hv)
  
  have hkey : ∀ w ∈ Q.vertices.erase v,
      f v - f w = ((D.l v - D.l w) / (D.l v - D.c)) * (M - g (D.attra w)) := by
    intro w hw
    have hwc := D.sep_of_mem_erase hw
    have hden : D.l v - D.l w ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (D.denpos hwc)
    have hd : D.l v - D.c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt D.numpos
    have hgatt : g (D.attra w)
        = g v + ((D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l w)) * (g w - g v) := by
      rw [attra]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hfapp, hfapp, hgatt, ht]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hfvert : ∀ u ∈ (Q.vertices : Set (E n)), f u ≤ f v := by
    intro u huS
    have huV : u ∈ Q.vertices := by exact_mod_cast huS
    by_cases huv : u = v
    · subst huv
      exact le_refl _
    · have huW : u ∈ Q.vertices.erase v := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨huv, huV⟩
      have hwc := D.sep_of_mem_erase huW
      have hattmem : D.attra u ∈ Q.toSet ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c} :=
        ⟨D.attra_mem_toSet (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase huW) hwc,
          D.attra_level hwc⟩
      have hle : g (D.attra u) ≤ M := hx₀'.2 _ hattmem
      have hfrac : 0 ≤ (D.l v - D.l u) / (D.l v - D.c) :=
        le_of_lt (div_pos (D.denpos hwc) D.numpos)
      have hk := hkey u huW
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hfrac (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ M - g (D.attra u))]
  have hfmax : ∀ y ∈ Q.toSet, f y ≤ f v := le_su_toSet Q f hfvert
  set Fs : Set (E n) := {x ∈ Q.toSet | ∀ y ∈ Q.toSet, f y ≤ f x} with hFs
  have hvF : v ∈ Fs := ⟨hvT, hfmax⟩
  have hFface : Q.IsFace Fs := ⟨fun _ => ⟨f, rfl⟩, ⟨v, hvF⟩⟩
  
  have ht' : t * D.l v - t * D.c = M - g v := by
    rw [← mul_sub]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt D.numpos)
  have hfv : f v = M + t * D.c := by
    have := hfapp v
    linarith
  
  have hslice : Fs ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c} = G := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hxT, hxmax⟩, hxc⟩
      rw [hg]
      refine ⟨⟨hxT, hxc⟩, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      have h1 := hxmax y hy.1
      rw [hfapp, hfapp] at h1
      have hyc : D.l y = D.c := hy.2
      have hxc' : D.l x = D.c := hxc
      rw [hyc, hxc'] at h1
      linarith
    · intro hxG
      have hx' := hxG
      rw [hg] at hx'
      have hgx : g x = M :=
        le_antisymm (hx₀'.2 x hx'.1) (hx'.2 x₀ hx₀'.1)
      have hxc : D.l x = D.c := hx'.1.2
      have hfx : f x = M + t * D.c := by
        rw [hfapp, hgx, hxc]
      refine ⟨⟨hx'.1.1, ?_⟩, hxc⟩
      intro y hy
      calc f y ≤ f v := hfmax y hy
        _ = f x := by rw [hfv, hfx]
    
  have hx₀F : x₀ ∈ Fs := by
    have hx₀G : x₀ ∈ G := hx₀
    rw [← hslice] at hx₀G
    exact hx₀G.1
  have hx₀v : x₀ ≠ v := by
    intro h
    have hc := hx₀'.1.2
    rw [h] at hc
    have : D.l v = D.c := hc
    linarith [D.hvc]
  have hdim : 1 ≤ faceDim Fs := by
    have hmem : x₀ - v ∈ vectorSpan ℝ Fs := vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hx₀F hvF
    have hne0 : x₀ - v ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hx₀v
    have hle : Submodule.span ℝ {x₀ - v} ≤ vectorSpan ℝ Fs := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem
    have h2 := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
    rw [finrank_span_singleton hne0] at h2
    exact h2
  exact ⟨Fs, hFface, hvF, hdim, hslice⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.DatiFetta.fetta_faceDim
statement:
theorem fetta_faceDim {F : Set (E n)} (hF : Q.IsFace F) (hvF : v ∈ F)
    (hdF : 1 ≤ faceDim F) :
    faceDim (F ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c}) + 1 = faceDim F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀W, hw₀F⟩ := esiste_vertice_altro hF hvF hdF
  have hw₀c := D.sep_of_mem_erase hw₀W
  have hFconv : Convex ℝ F := hF.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have hatt₀F : D.attra w₀ ∈ F :=
    hFconv.segment_subset hvF hw₀F (D.attra_mem_segment hw₀c)
  have hatt₀H : D.l (D.attra w₀) = D.c := D.attra_level hw₀c
  set U : Submodule ℝ (E n) := vectorSpan ℝ F with hU
  set U' : Submodule ℝ (E n) :=
    vectorSpan ℝ (F ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c}) with hU'
  set L : Submodule ℝ (E n) := Submodule.span ℝ {D.attra w₀ - v} with hL
  set K : Submodule ℝ (E n) := LinearMap.ker D.l.toLinearMap with hK
  
  have h1 : U' ≤ U := vectorSpan_mono ℝ Set.inter_subset_left
  have h2 : L ≤ U := by
    rw [hL, Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hatt₀F hvF
  
  have h4 : U' ≤ K := by
    rw [hU']
    have hbase : D.attra w₀ ∈ F ∩ {x | D.l x = D.c} := ⟨hatt₀F, hatt₀H⟩
    rw [vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right ℝ hbase, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro z ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hxc : D.l x = D.c := hx.2
    rw [hK, SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    show D.l (x - D.attra w₀) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hxc, hatt₀H, sub_self]
  
  have h5 : L ⊓ K = ⊥ := by
    rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
    rintro x ⟨hxL, hxK⟩
    rw [hL] at hxL
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hxL
    have hxK' : D.l.toLinearMap (a • (D.attra w₀ - v)) = 0 := hxK
    have hval : D.l.toLinearMap (a • (D.attra w₀ - v))
        = a * (D.c - D.l v) := by
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      show a * D.l (D.attra w₀ - v) = _
      rw [map_sub, hatt₀H]
    rw [hval] at hxK'
    have hane : D.c - D.l v ≠ 0 := by linarith [D.hvc]
    have ha : a = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hxK' with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h hane
    rw [ha, zero_smul]
  
  have h3 : U ≤ U' ⊔ L := by
    have hfe := face_eq_hull_vertices Q hF
    have hUv : U = vectorSpan ℝ
        ((Q.vertices.filter (· ∈ F) : Finset (E n)) : Set (E n)) := by
      rw [hU]
      conv_lhs => rw [hfe]
      rw [← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull,
        direction_affineSpan]
    have hvmem : v ∈
        ((Q.vertices.filter (· ∈ F) : Finset (E n)) : Set (E n)) := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨D.hv, hvF⟩
    rw [hUv, vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right ℝ hvmem, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro z ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hu' : u ∈ Q.vertices.filter (· ∈ F) := by exact_mod_cast hu
    have huV : u ∈ Q.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu').1
    have huF : u ∈ F := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu').2
    show u - v ∈ (U' ⊔ L : Submodule ℝ (E n))
    by_cases huv : u = v
    · subst huv
      simp
    · have huW : u ∈ Q.vertices.erase v := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨huv, huV⟩
      have huc := D.sep_of_mem_erase huW
      have hattuF : D.attra u ∈ F :=
        hFconv.segment_subset hvF huF (D.attra_mem_segment huc)
      have hd1 : D.attra u - D.attra w₀ ∈ U' := by
        rw [hU']
        exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ ⟨hattuF, D.attra_level huc⟩
          ⟨hatt₀F, hatt₀H⟩
      have hd2 : D.attra w₀ - v ∈ L := by
        rw [hL]
        exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
      have hsum : D.attra u - v ∈ (U' ⊔ L : Submodule ℝ (E n)) := by
        have hsplit : D.attra u - v
            = (D.attra u - D.attra w₀) + (D.attra w₀ - v) := by abel
        rw [hsplit]
        exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left hd1)
          (Submodule.mem_sup_right hd2)
      have hscal : u - v
          = ((D.l v - D.l u) / (D.l v - D.c)) • (D.attra u - v) := by
        rw [D.attra_sub u, smul_smul]
        have hden : D.l v - D.l u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (D.denpos huc)
        have hd : D.l v - D.c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt D.numpos
        rw [show (D.l v - D.l u) / (D.l v - D.c)
            * ((D.l v - D.c) / (D.l v - D.l u)) = 1 by field_simp, one_smul]
      rw [hscal]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hsum
  
  have hsup : U' ⊔ L = U := le_antisymm (sup_le h1 h2) h3
  have hinf : U' ⊓ L = ⊥ := by
    rw [← le_bot_iff, ← h5]
    exact le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans h4)
  have hrk := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq U' L
  rw [hsup, hinf] at hrk
  have hL1 : Module.finrank ℝ L = 1 := by
    rw [hL]
    apply finrank_span_singleton
    intro h0
    have hattv : D.attra w₀ = v := by
      have := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
      exact this
    rw [hattv] at hatt₀H
    linarith [D.hvc]
  have hbot : Module.finrank ℝ (⊥ : Submodule ℝ (E n)) = 0 := finrank_bot ℝ _
  show Module.finrank ℝ U' + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ U
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertOrto_apply
statement:
theorem vertOrto_apply {d : ℕ} (p : Fin d × Bool) (k : Fin d) :
    vertOrto p k = if k = p.1 then (if p.2 then (1 : ℝ) else (-1 : ℝ))
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold vertOrto
  rw [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertOrto_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertOrto_self {d : ℕ} (p : Fin d × Bool) :
    vertOrto p p.1 = if p.2 then (1 : ℝ) else (-1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertOrto_apply]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertOrto_injective
statement:
theorem vertOrto_injective {d : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (vertOrto (d := d))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i, s⟩ ⟨j, t⟩ hpq
  have hval := congrArg (fun x : E d => x i) hpq
  simp only [vertOrto_apply] at hval
  have hidx : i = j := by
    by_contra hne
    rcases s <;> simp [hne] at hval
  subst j
  have hbool : s = t := by
    cases s <;> cases t
    · rfl
    · norm_num at hval
    · norm_num at hval
    · rfl
  subst t
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.mem_verticiOrto
statement:
theorem mem_verticiOrto {d : ℕ} {x : E d} :
    x ∈ verticiOrto d ↔ ∃ p : Fin d × Bool, vertOrto p = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [verticiOrto]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.card_verticiOrto
statement: theorem card_verticiOrto (d : ℕ) : (verticiOrto d).card = 2 * d
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticiOrto, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertOrto_injective]
  simp [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.verticiOrto_nonempty
statement:
theorem verticiOrto_nonempty {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (verticiOrto d).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨vertOrto (⟨0, hd⟩, true), ?_⟩
  exact mem_verticiOrto.mpr ⟨(⟨0, hd⟩, true), rfl⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_vertOrto
statement: theorem norm_vertOrto {d : ℕ} (p : Fin d × Bool) : ‖vertOrto p‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertOrto]
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  split <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.cosferico_extremePoints
statement:
theorem cosferico_extremePoints {A : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup A]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [Nontrivial A]
    (x : A) (r : ℝ) (V : Set A) (hV : V ⊆ sphere x r) :
    (convexHull ℝ V).extremePoints ℝ = V
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm extremePoints_convexHull_subset ?_
  have hball : convexHull ℝ V ⊆ closedBall x r :=
    convexHull_min (hV.trans sphere_subset_closedBall) (convex_closedBall x r)
  intro v hv
  have hsfera : v ∈ (closedBall x r).extremePoints ℝ := by
    rw [StrictConvexSpace.extremePoints_closedBall_eq_sphere]
    exact hV hv
  exact inter_extremePoints_subset_extremePoints_of_subset hball
    ⟨subset_convexHull ℝ V hv, hsfera⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.verticiOrto_eq_extremePoints
statement:
theorem verticiOrto_eq_extremePoints (d : ℕ) :
    ((verticiOrto d : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)) =
      Set.extremePoints ℝ
        (convexHull ℝ ((verticiOrto d : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · subst d
    simp [verticiOrto]
  · have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd
    let i : Fin d := ⟨0, hdpos⟩
    have hne : (0 : E d) ≠ vertOrto (i, true) := by
      intro h
      have hi := congrArg (fun x : E d => x i) h
      simp [vertOrto_apply] at hi
    haveI : Nontrivial (E d) := ⟨⟨0, vertOrto (i, true), hne⟩⟩
    symm
    apply cosferico_extremePoints 0 1
    intro v hv
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    have hv' : v ∈ verticiOrto d := by exact_mod_cast hv
    rw [mem_verticiOrto] at hv'
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hv'
    exact norm_vertOrto p

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.card_ortoplesse
statement:
theorem card_ortoplesse (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    (ortoplesse d hd).vertices.card = 2 * d
proof:
:= by
  exact card_verticiOrto d

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ortoplesse_isFullDim
statement:
theorem ortoplesse_isFullDim (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    (ortoplesse d hd).IsFullDim
proof:
:= by
  let W : Submodule ℝ (E d) := vectorSpan ℝ (ortoplesse d hd).toSet
  have hbasis : ∀ i : Fin d, (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin d) ℝ) i ∈ W := by
    intro i
    have hpV : vertOrto (i, true) ∈ verticiOrto d :=
      mem_verticiOrto.mpr ⟨(i, true), rfl⟩
    have hnV : vertOrto (i, false) ∈ verticiOrto d :=
      mem_verticiOrto.mpr ⟨(i, false), rfl⟩
    have hp : vertOrto (i, true) ∈ (ortoplesse d hd).toSet := by
      exact subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hpV)
    have hn : vertOrto (i, false) ∈ (ortoplesse d hd).toSet := by
      exact subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hnV)
    have hdiff : vertOrto (i, true) - vertOrto (i, false) ∈ W :=
      vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hp hn
    change EuclideanSpace.single i 1 - EuclideanSpace.single i (-1) ∈ W at hdiff
    rw [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    have htwice : (2 : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ W := by
      simpa only [PiLp.single_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul] using hdiff
    exact (W.smul_mem_iff (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).mp htwice
  have hW : W = ⊤ := by
    apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff').2
    intro x
    rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin d) ℝ).sum_repr x]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem W fun i _ => W.smul_mem _ (hbasis i)
  rw [ConvexPolytope.IsFullDim, ConvexPolytope.dim]
  change Module.finrank ℝ W = d
  rw [hW, finrank_top, finrank_euclideanSpace]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isometriaSegno_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem isometriaSegno_apply (s : ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (x : ℝ) :
    isometriaSegno s x = (s : ℝ) * x
proof:
:= by
  unfold isometriaSegno
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]
    simp
  · have hs : (s : ℝ) = -1 := by
      have hm := s.property
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hm
      rcases hm with hm | hm
      · exact hm
      · exact (h hm).elim
    rw [hs]
    simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoLinear_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem segnoLinear_single (d : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d))
    (ε : Fin d → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (i : Fin d) (a : ℝ) :
    segnoLinear d σ ε (EuclideanSpace.single i a) =
      EuclideanSpace.single (σ i) ((ε i : ℝ) * a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [segnoLinear]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPerm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem segnoPerm_apply (d : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d))
    (ε : Fin d → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) (x : E d) :
    segnoPerm d σ ε x = segnoLinear d σ ε x
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPerm_mem_verticiOrto
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_verticiOrto] at hv
  obtain ⟨⟨i, b⟩, rfl⟩ := hv
  have hs := (ε i).property
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hs
  rcases hs with hs | hs <;> cases b
  · apply mem_verticiOrto.mpr
    refine ⟨(σ i, true), ?_⟩
    simp [vertOrto, hs]
  · apply mem_verticiOrto.mpr
    refine ⟨(σ i, false), ?_⟩
    simp [vertOrto, hs]
  · apply mem_verticiOrto.mpr
    refine ⟨(σ i, false), ?_⟩
    simp [vertOrto, hs]
  · apply mem_verticiOrto.mpr
    refine ⟨(σ i, true), ?_⟩
    simp [vertOrto, hs]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPerm_image_verticiOrto
statement:
theorem segnoPerm_image_verticiOrto (d : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d))
    (ε : Fin d → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) :
    (segnoPerm d σ ε : E d → E d) '' (verticiOrto d : Set (E d)) =
      (verticiOrto d : Set (E d))
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Finset.image (segnoPerm d σ ε : E d → E d) (verticiOrto d) =
      verticiOrto d := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hv
      exact segnoPerm_mem_verticiOrto d σ ε hu
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (segnoPerm d σ ε).injective]
  rw [← Finset.coe_image, hfin]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPerm_isSymmetry
statement:
theorem segnoPerm_isSymmetry (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) (ε : Fin d → ({-1, 1} : Set ℝ)) :
    (ortoplesse d hd).isSymmetry (segnoPerm d σ ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry, ConvexPolytope.toSet]
  calc
    (segnoPerm d σ ε : E d → E d) ''
        convexHull ℝ ((ortoplesse d hd).vertices : Set (E d)) =
      convexHull ℝ ((segnoPerm d σ ε : E d → E d) ''
        ((ortoplesse d hd).vertices : Set (E d))) := by
          exact (segnoPerm d σ ε).toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.image_convexHull _
    _ = convexHull ℝ ((ortoplesse d hd).vertices : Set (E d)) := by
      rw [show ((ortoplesse d hd).vertices : Set (E d)) =
          (verticiOrto d : Set (E d)) by rfl,
        segnoPerm_image_verticiOrto]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertA_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertA_apply (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertA i b j = if j = i then (if b then (1 : ℝ) else -1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertA]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertB_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertB_apply (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertB s j = if s j then (1 / 2 : ℝ) else -(1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertB]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoC_abs
statement:
theorem segnoC_abs (s : Fin 3 → Bool) (k : Fin 4) :
    |segnoC s k| = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k <;> simp [segnoC] <;> split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoC_sq
statement:
theorem segnoC_sq (s : Fin 3 → Bool) (k : Fin 4) :
    segnoC s k ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k <;> simp [segnoC] <;> split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.baseC_nonneg
statement: theorem baseC_nonneg (k : Fin 4) : 0 ≤ baseC k
proof:
:= by
  have hv := aureo_valori_ordinati
  fin_cases k
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ aureo / 2
    linarith [hv.1, hv.2.1, hv.2.2.1]
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2
    norm_num
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (aureo - 1) / 2
    linarith [hv.1]
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0
    exact le_rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.baseC_injective
statement: theorem baseC_injective : Function.Injective baseC
proof:
:= by
  have hv := aureo_valori_ordinati
  intro k k' h
  fin_cases k <;> fin_cases k' <;> first
    | rfl
    | (exfalso; simp [baseC] at h; done)
    | (exfalso; simp [baseC] at h; nlinarith [hv.1, hv.2.1, hv.2.2.1])

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertC_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertC_apply (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (s : Fin 3 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertC σ s j = segnoC s ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
      baseC ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertC]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertC_at
statement:
theorem vertC_at (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) (s : Fin 3 → Bool)
    (k : Fin 4) :
    vertC σ s ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k) = segnoC s k * baseC k
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertC_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_vertA
statement: theorem norm_vertA (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) : ‖vertA i b‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ‖vertA i b‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    simp only [vertA_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · cases b <;> norm_num
    · intro j _ hj
      simp [hj]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖vertA i b‖ := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith [hsq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_vertB
statement: theorem norm_vertB (s : Fin 4 → Bool) : ‖vertB s‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ‖vertB s‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    simp only [vertB_apply]
    have hterm : ∀ j : Fin 4,
        ‖if s j then (1 / 2 : ℝ) else -(1 / 2)‖ ^ 2 = 1 / 4 := by
      intro j
      cases hs : s j <;> simp <;> norm_num
    simp_rw [hterm]
    norm_num
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖vertB s‖ := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith [hsq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_vertC
statement:
theorem norm_vertC (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) (s : Fin 3 → Bool) :
    ‖vertC σ s‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ‖vertC σ s‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    simp only [vertC_apply]
    have hre : ∑ j : Fin 4,
        ‖segnoC s ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
          baseC ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)‖ ^ 2
        = ∑ k : Fin 4, ‖segnoC s k * baseC k‖ ^ 2 :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm _ _ (fun j => rfl)
    rw [hre]
    have hterm : ∀ k : Fin 4,
        ‖segnoC s k * baseC k‖ ^ 2 = baseC k ^ 2 := by
      intro k
      rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        sq_abs, sq_abs, segnoC_sq, one_mul]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
    have h0 : baseC 0 = aureo / 2 := rfl
    have h1 : baseC 1 = 1 / 2 := rfl
    have h2 : baseC 2 = (aureo - 1) / 2 := rfl
    have h3 : baseC 3 = 0 := rfl
    rw [h0, h1, h2, h3]
    nlinarith [aureo_norm_sq]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖vertC σ s‖ := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith [hsq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.baseC_lt_one
statement: theorem baseC_lt_one (k : Fin 4) : baseC k < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hv := aureo_valori_ordinati
  fin_cases k
  · show aureo / 2 < 1
    linarith [hv.2.2.2]
  · show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1
    norm_num
  · show (aureo - 1) / 2 < 1
    linarith [hv.2.1, hv.2.2.1, hv.2.2.2]
  · show (0 : ℝ) < 1
    norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.baseC_pos_tre
statement: theorem baseC_pos_tre (m : Fin 3) : 0 < baseC ⟨(m : ℕ), by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hv := aureo_valori_ordinati
  fin_cases m
  · show (0 : ℝ) < aureo / 2
    linarith [hv.1, hv.2.1, hv.2.2.1]
  · show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2
    norm_num
  · show (0 : ℝ) < (aureo - 1) / 2
    linarith [hv.1]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertA_injective
statement:
theorem vertA_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Fin 4 × Bool => vertA p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i, b⟩ ⟨i', b'⟩ h
  simp only at h
  have hii : i = i' := by
    by_contra hne
    have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E 4 => v i) h
    simp only [vertA_apply, if_pos rfl, if_neg hne] at h1
    cases b <;> norm_num at h1
  subst hii
  have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E 4 => v i) h
  simp only [vertA_apply, if_pos rfl] at h2
  cases b <;> cases b' <;> first
    | rfl
    | (exfalso; norm_num at h2)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertB_injective
statement: theorem vertB_injective : Function.Injective vertB
proof:
:= by
  intro s s' h
  funext j
  have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E 4 => v j) h
  simp only [vertB_apply] at h1
  cases hs : s j <;> cases hs' : s' j <;>
    rw [hs, hs'] at h1 <;> first
      | rfl
      | (exfalso; norm_num at h1)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertC_injective
statement:
theorem vertC_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p :
      alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 3 → Bool) => vertC p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨σ, s⟩ ⟨σ', s'⟩ h
  simp only at h
  
  have hσσ : ∀ k : Fin 4, (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k =
      (σ' : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k := by
    intro k
    have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E 4 => v ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k)) h
    simp only [vertC_at, vertC_apply] at h1
    
    have habs := congrArg abs h1
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, segnoC_abs, segnoC_abs, one_mul, one_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (baseC_nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg (baseC_nonneg _)]
      at habs
    have hk := baseC_injective habs
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at hk
    have h2 := congrArg (σ' : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) hk
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  have hσ : σ = σ' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Equiv.ext hσσ
  subst hσ
  
  have hs : s = s' := by
    funext m
    have hk := congrArg (fun v : E 4 =>
      v ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) ⟨(m : ℕ), by omega⟩)) h
    simp only [vertC_at] at hk
    have hbne : baseC ⟨(m : ℕ), by omega⟩ ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt (baseC_pos_tre m)
    have hsg : segnoC s ⟨(m : ℕ), by omega⟩ =
        segnoC s' ⟨(m : ℕ), by omega⟩ :=
      mul_right_cancel₀ hbne hk
    fin_cases m
    · show s 0 = s' 0
      have h0 : (if s 0 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
          = (if s' 0 then 1 else -1) := hsg
      cases hs1 : s 0 <;> cases hs2 : s' 0 <;>
        first
          | rfl
          | (exfalso; rw [hs1, hs2] at h0; norm_num at h0)
    · show s 1 = s' 1
      have h0 : (if s 1 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
          = (if s' 1 then 1 else -1) := hsg
      cases hs1 : s 1 <;> cases hs2 : s' 1 <;>
        first
          | rfl
          | (exfalso; rw [hs1, hs2] at h0; norm_num at h0)
    · show s 2 = s' 2
      have h0 : (if s 2 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
          = (if s' 2 then 1 else -1) := hsg
      cases hs1 : s 2 <;> cases hs2 : s' 2 <;>
        first
          | rfl
          | (exfalso; rw [hs1, hs2] at h0; norm_num at h0)
  rw [hs]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertA_ne_vertB
statement:
theorem vertA_ne_vertB (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    vertA i b ≠ vertB s
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_ne i
  have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E 4 => v j) h
  simp only [vertA_apply, vertB_apply, if_neg hj] at h1
  cases hs : s j <;> rw [hs] at h1 <;> norm_num at h1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertA_ne_vertC
statement:
theorem vertA_ne_vertC (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool)
    (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) (s : Fin 3 → Bool) :
    vertA i b ≠ vertC σ s
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E 4 => v i) h
  simp only [vertA_apply, vertC_apply, if_pos rfl] at h1
  have habs := congrArg abs h1
  rw [abs_mul, segnoC_abs, one_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (baseC_nonneg _)] at habs
  have hlt := baseC_lt_one ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm i)
  cases b <;> norm_num at habs <;> linarith [hlt]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertB_ne_vertC
statement:
theorem vertB_ne_vertC (s : Fin 4 → Bool)
    (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) (t : Fin 3 → Bool) :
    vertB s ≠ vertC σ t
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E 4 =>
    v ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) 3)) h
  rw [vertC_at] at h1
  have hb3 : baseC 3 = 0 := rfl
  rw [hb3, mul_zero] at h1
  simp only [vertB_apply] at h1
  cases hs : s ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) 3) <;> rw [hs] at h1 <;>
    norm_num at h1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_mem_seicentoVertici
statement:
theorem norm_mem_seicentoVertici {v : E 4}
    (hv : v ∈ seicentoVertici) : ‖v‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [seicentoVertici, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hv
  rcases hv with (⟨p, hp⟩ | ⟨s, hs⟩) | ⟨p, hp⟩
  · rw [← hp]
    exact norm_vertA p.1 p.2
  · rw [← hs]
    exact norm_vertB s
  · rw [← hp]
    exact norm_vertC p.1 p.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.seicentoVertici_nonempty
statement: theorem seicentoVertici_nonempty : seicentoVertici.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨vertB (fun _ => true), ?_⟩
  simp only [seicentoVertici, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨fun _ => true, rfl⟩)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.card_seicentoVertici
statement: theorem card_seicentoVertici : seicentoVertici.card = 120
proof:
:= by
  rw [seicentoVertici]
  have hdisjAB : Disjoint
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × Bool)).image
        (fun p => vertA p.1 p.2))
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 → Bool)).image vertB) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    rintro x hxA hxB
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hxA hxB
    obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hxA
    obtain ⟨s, _, hs⟩ := hxB
    exact vertA_ne_vertB p.1 p.2 s hs.symm
  have hdisjABC : Disjoint
      (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × Bool)).image
          (fun p => vertA p.1 p.2)) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 → Bool)).image vertB))
      ((Finset.univ :
          Finset (alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 3 → Bool))).image
        (fun p => vertC p.1 p.2)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    rintro x hxAB hxC
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hxC
    obtain ⟨q, _, hq⟩ := hxC
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hxAB
    rcases hxAB with hxA | hxB
    · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hxA
      obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hxA
      exact vertA_ne_vertC p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
    · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hxB
      obtain ⟨s, _, rfl⟩ := hxB
      exact vertB_ne_vertC s q.1 q.2 hq.symm
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjABC,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjAB,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertA_injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertB_injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertC_injective]
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool, card_alternatingGroup]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.seicentoVertici_eq_extremePoints
statement:
theorem seicentoVertici_eq_extremePoints :
    ((seicentoVertici : Finset (E 4)) : Set (E 4)) =
      Set.extremePoints ℝ
        (convexHull ℝ ((seicentoVertici : Finset (E 4)) : Set (E 4)))
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (0 : E 4) ≠ vertB (fun _ => true) := by
    intro h
    have h0 := congrArg (fun x : E 4 => x (0 : Fin 4)) h
    simp only [vertB_apply] at h0
    norm_num at h0
  haveI : Nontrivial (E 4) := ⟨⟨0, vertB (fun _ => true), hne⟩⟩
  symm
  apply cosferico_extremePoints 0 1
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
  have hv' : v ∈ seicentoVertici := by exact_mod_cast hv
  exact norm_mem_seicentoVertici hv'

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.card_seicento_vertices
statement: theorem card_seicento_vertices : seicento.vertices.card = 120
proof:
:=
  card_seicentoVertici

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertA_mem_seicento_toSet
statement:
theorem vertA_mem_seicento_toSet (i : Fin 4) (b : Bool) :
    vertA i b ∈ seicento.toSet
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_convexHull ℝ _
  have hmem : vertA i b ∈ seicentoVertici := by
    simp only [seicentoVertici, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
      Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨(i, b), rfl⟩)
  exact_mod_cast hmem

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.seicento_isFullDim
statement: theorem seicento_isFullDim : seicento.IsFullDim
proof:
:= by
  let W : Submodule ℝ (E 4) := vectorSpan ℝ seicento.toSet
  have hbasis : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 4) ℝ) i ∈ W := by
    intro i
    have hdiff : vertA i true - vertA i false ∈ W :=
      vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ (vertA_mem_seicento_toSet i true)
        (vertA_mem_seicento_toSet i false)
    have hcalc : vertA i true - vertA i false
        = (2 : ℝ) • (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 4) ℝ) i := by
      ext j
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, vertA_apply, vertA_apply,
        EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · rw [if_pos hji, if_pos hji, if_pos hji]
        show (1 : ℝ) - (-1) = 2 * 1
        norm_num
      · rw [if_neg hji, if_neg hji, if_neg hji]
        show (0 : ℝ) - 0 = 2 * 0
        norm_num
    rw [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply] at *
    exact (W.smul_mem_iff (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).mp (hcalc ▸ hdiff)
  have hW : W = ⊤ := by
    rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
    intro x
    rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 4) ℝ).sum_repr x]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem W fun i _ => W.smul_mem _ (hbasis i)
  rw [ConvexPolytope.IsFullDim, ConvexPolytope.dim]
  change Module.finrank ℝ W = 4
  rw [hW, finrank_top, finrank_euclideanSpace]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.facePolytope_toSet
statement:
theorem facePolytope_toSet (P : ConvexPolytope n) {f : Set (E n)}
    (hf : P.IsFace f) : (facePolytope P hf).toSet = f
proof:
:=
  (face_eq_hull_vertices P hf).symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isFace_of_facePolytope
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsExposed ℝ f g := by
    rw [← facePolytope_toSet P hf]
    exact hg.1
  exact isFace_of_isExposed_isFace P hf h1 hg.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.facePolytope_isFace_of
proof:
:= by
