  refine ⟨?_, hg.2⟩
  have hfT : f ⊆ P.toSet := by
    obtain ⟨lf, hlf⟩ := hf.1 hf.2
    rw [hlf]
    exact fun z hz => hz.1
  intro hne
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hg.1 hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hne
  have hx₀g : x₀ ∈ g := hx₀
  refine ⟨l, ?_⟩
  rw [facePolytope_toSet P hf]
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxg := hx
    rw [hl] at hxg
    refine ⟨hsub hx, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact hxg.2 y (hfT hy)
  · rintro ⟨hxf, hxmax⟩
    rw [hl]
    have hx₀f : x₀ ∈ f := hsub hx₀g
    have hx₀m := hxmax x₀ hx₀f
    rw [hl] at hx₀g
    refine ⟨hfT hxf, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    calc l y ≤ l x₀ := hx₀g.2 y hy
      _ ≤ l x := hx₀m

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.relazioni_trasportate_da_gram_dim
statement:
theorem relazioni_trasportate_da_gram_dim {u w : Fin ι → E n}
    (hgram : ∀ i j, ⟪u i, u j⟫ = ⟪w i, w j⟫)
    (a : Fin ι → ℝ) (h : ∑ i, a i • u i = 0) :
    ∑ i, a i • w i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinter : ⟪∑ i, a i • w i, ∑ j, a j • w j⟫ = ⟪∑ i, a i • u i, ∑ j, a j • u j⟫ := by
    simp_rw [sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, ← hgram]
  have hnorm : ‖∑ i, a i • w i‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hinter, h]; simp
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hnorm)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.inner_somme_da_gram_dim
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, ← hgram]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.span_trasportato_da_gram_dim
statement:
theorem span_trasportato_da_gram_dim {u w : Fin ι → E n}
    (hspanU : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range u) = ⊤)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, ⟪u i, u j⟫ = ⟪w i, w j⟫) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let lu : (Fin ι → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] E n := Fintype.linearCombination ℝ u
  let lw : (Fin ι → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] E n := Fintype.linearCombination ℝ w
  have hker : LinearMap.ker lu = LinearMap.ker lw := by
    ext a
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    constructor
    · intro ha
      apply relazioni_trasportate_da_gram_dim hgram a
      simpa only [lu, Fintype.linearCombination_apply] using ha
    · intro ha
      apply relazioni_trasportate_da_gram_dim (fun i j => (hgram i j).symm) a
      simpa only [lw, Fintype.linearCombination_apply] using ha
  have hru := lu.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hrw := lw.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hrange : Module.finrank ℝ lu.range = Module.finrank ℝ lw.range := by
    rw [hker] at hru; omega
  have htopU : LinearMap.range lu = ⊤ := by
    simpa only [lu, Fintype.range_linearCombination] using hspanU
  have hfinW : Module.finrank ℝ lw.range = Module.finrank ℝ (E n) := by
    rw [← hrange, htopU]; simp
  have htopW : LinearMap.range lw = ⊤ := Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq hfinW
  simpa only [lw, Fintype.range_linearCombination] using htopW

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isometria_da_gram_dim
statement:
theorem isometria_da_gram_dim {u w : Fin ι → E n}
    (hspanU : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range u) = ⊤)
    (hspanW : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w) = ⊤)
    (hgram : ∀ i j, ⟪u i, u j⟫ = ⟪w i, w j⟫) :
    ∃ L : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n, ∀ i, L (u i) = w i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let lu : (Fin ι → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] E n := Fintype.linearCombination ℝ u
  let lw : (Fin ι → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] E n := Fintype.linearCombination ℝ w
  have hker : LinearMap.ker lu = LinearMap.ker lw := by
    ext a
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    constructor
    · intro ha
      apply relazioni_trasportate_da_gram_dim hgram a
      simpa only [lu, Fintype.linearCombination_apply] using ha
    · intro ha
      apply relazioni_trasportate_da_gram_dim (fun i j => (hgram i j).symm) a
      simpa only [lw, Fintype.linearCombination_apply] using ha
  have hsurjU : Function.Surjective lu :=
    (span_range_eq_top_iff_surjective_fintypeLinearCombination ℝ u).mp hspanU
  have hsurjW : Function.Surjective lw :=
    (span_range_eq_top_iff_surjective_fintypeLinearCombination ℝ w).mp hspanW
  let eu := LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective lu hsurjU
  let ew := LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective lw hsurjW
  let eqker := Submodule.quotEquivOfEq (LinearMap.ker lu) (LinearMap.ker lw) hker
  let e : E n ≃ₗ[ℝ] E n := eu.symm.trans (eqker.trans ew)
  have he_total : ∀ a : Fin ι → ℝ, e (lu a) = lw a := by
    intro a; simp [e, eu, ew, eqker]
  have he_inner : ∀ x y : E n, ⟪e x, e y⟫ = ⟪x, y⟫ := by
    intro x y
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hsurjU x
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hsurjU y
    rw [he_total, he_total]
    exact inner_somme_da_gram_dim hgram a b
  let L : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n := e.isometryOfInner he_inner
  refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
  intro i
  let a : Fin ι → ℝ := Pi.single i 1
  have hua : lu a = u i := by simp [lu, a, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  have hwa : lw a = w i := by simp [lw, a, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  change e (u i) = w i
  rw [← hua, he_total, hwa]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ConvexPolytope.asFinite_toSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem asFinite_toSet {n : ℕ} (P : ConvexPolytope n) :
    P.asFinite.toSet = P.toSet
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ConvexPolytope.asFinite_isFacet_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem asFinite_isFacet_iff (P : ConvexPolytope 3) (A : Set (E 3)) :
    P.asFinite.IsFacet A ↔ P.IsFace A ∧ faceDim A = 2
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ConvexPolytope.iteratedFacet_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem iteratedFacet_zero {P : ConvexPolytope 3} (σ : Isom 3)
    (F : P.Flag) : iteratedFacet σ F 0 = F.face 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [iteratedFacet]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ConvexPolytope.image_iteratedFacet
statement:
theorem image_iteratedFacet {P : ConvexPolytope 3} (σ : Isom 3) (F : P.Flag)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (σ : E 3 → E 3) '' iteratedFacet σ F k = iteratedFacet σ F (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedFacet, iteratedFacet, Set.image_image]
  congr 1
  funext x
  exact (Function.iterate_succ_apply' (σ : E 3 → E 3) k x).symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ConvexPolytope.finRotate_ne_self
statement:
theorem finRotate_ne_self {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (i : Fin q) :
    finRotate q i ≠ i
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
      by_cases hi : i = Fin.last n
      · subst i
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [finRotate_last, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_last] at hv
        omega
      · intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        rw [coe_finRotate_of_ne_last hi] at hv
        omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ConvexPolytope.facetOrbit_ruota
statement:
theorem facetOrbit_ruota {P : ConvexPolytope 3} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (σ : Isom 3) (F : P.Flag) (hperiod : iteratedFacet σ F q = F.face 2)
    (i : Fin q) :
    (σ : E 3 → E 3) '' facetOrbit σ F i =
      facetOrbit σ F (finRotate q i)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
      by_cases hi : i = Fin.last n
      · subst i
        rw [facetOrbit, facetOrbit, finRotate_last, Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero]
        rw [image_iteratedFacet]
        simpa using hperiod
      · rw [facetOrbit, facetOrbit, image_iteratedFacet]
        congr 1
        exact (coe_finRotate_of_ne_last hi).symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ConvexPolytope.fan_vertice_condizionale
statement:
theorem fan_vertice_condizionale (P : ConvexPolytope 3) (h : P.IsRegular)
    {v : E 3} {q : ℕ} (hq : 3 ≤ q)
    (F G L R : P.Flag)
    (hF0 : F.face 0 = {v}) (hG0 : G.face 0 = {v})
    (hL0 : L.face 0 = {v})
    (hLF : L.face 2 = F.face 2) (hRG : R.face 2 = G.face 2)
    (hLR : L.face 1 = R.face 1)
    (horbit : ∀ σ : Isom 3, P.isSymmetry σ →
      (∀ k : Fin 3, (σ : E 3 → E 3) '' F.face k = G.face k) →
      FanOrbitCertificate P v q F σ)
    (hedge_two : EdgeInAtMostTwoFacets P v) :
    Nonempty (P.asFinite.CyclicVertexData v q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσP, hσflag⟩ := h.2 F G
  have C : FanOrbitCertificate P v q F σ := horbit σ hσP hσflag

  have hσv : σ v = v := by
    have hv : σ v ∈ (σ : E 3 → E 3) '' F.face 0 := by
      exact ⟨v, by simp [hF0], rfl⟩
    rw [hσflag 0, hG0] at hv
    simpa using hv

  have hvF : v ∈ F.face 2 := by
    apply (F.strict_mono 0 2 (by decide)).1
    simp [hF0]

  have hmem : ∀ i : Fin q, v ∈ facetOrbit σ F i := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨v, hvF, ?_⟩
    exact (show Function.IsFixedPt (σ : E 3 → E 3) v from hσv).iterate i.val

  have hruota : ∀ i : Fin q,
      (σ : E 3 → E 3) '' facetOrbit σ F i =
        facetOrbit σ F (finRotate q i) :=
    facetOrbit_ruota (by omega) σ F C.period

  have hbase : ∃ x : E 3,
      x ≠ v ∧ x ∈ F.face 2 ∩ G.face 2 := by
    have hss : L.face 0 ⊂ L.face 1 := L.strict_mono 0 1 (by decide)
    obtain ⟨x, hxL1, hxL0⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset hss
    have hxne : x ≠ v := by
      intro hxv
      apply hxL0
      simp [hL0, hxv]
    have hxF : x ∈ F.face 2 := by
      rw [← hLF]
      exact (L.strict_mono 1 2 (by decide)).1 hxL1
    have hxR1 : x ∈ R.face 1 := by
      rw [← hLR]
      exact hxL1
    have hxG : x ∈ G.face 2 := by
      rw [← hRG]
      exact (R.strict_mono 1 2 (by decide)).1 hxR1
    exact ⟨x, hxne, hxF, hxG⟩
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀v, hx₀F, hx₀G⟩ := hbase

  refine ⟨{
    faccetta := facetOrbit σ F
    isFacet := ?_
    mem_v := hmem
    distinte := C.injective
    complete := ?_
    σ := σ
    fissa_v := hσv
    preserva := ?_
    ruota := hruota
    spigolo := ?_
    spigolo_due := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro i
    exact (asFinite_isFacet_iff P _).2 (C.isFacet i)
  · intro A hA hvA
    exact C.complete A hA.1 hA.2 hvA
  · simpa [ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry] using hσP
  · intro i
    let xᵢ : E 3 := ((σ : E 3 → E 3)^[i.val]) x₀
    have hxᵢ_this : xᵢ ∈ facetOrbit σ F i := by
      exact ⟨x₀, hx₀F, rfl⟩
    have hx₀image : x₀ ∈ (σ : E 3 → E 3) '' F.face 2 := by
      rw [hσflag 2]
      exact hx₀G
    obtain ⟨y, hyF, hσy⟩ := hx₀image
    have hxᵢ_image : xᵢ ∈ (σ : E 3 → E 3) '' facetOrbit σ F i := by
      refine ⟨((σ : E 3 → E 3)^[i.val]) y, ⟨y, hyF, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      dsimp [xᵢ]
      rw [← hσy]
      exact (Function.iterate_succ_apply' (σ : E 3 → E 3) i.val y).symm.trans
        (Function.iterate_succ_apply (σ : E 3 → E 3) i.val y)
    have hxᵢ_next : xᵢ ∈ facetOrbit σ F (finRotate q i) := by
      rw [← hruota i]
      exact hxᵢ_image
    have hxᵢv : xᵢ ≠ v := by
      intro heq
      apply hx₀v
      apply (σ.injective.iterate i.val)
      rw [(show Function.IsFixedPt (σ : E 3 → E 3) v from hσv).iterate i.val]
      exact heq
    exact ⟨xᵢ, hxᵢv, hxᵢ_this, hxᵢ_next⟩
  · intro i j x hxedge hxv hxj
    have hne : facetOrbit σ F i ≠ facetOrbit σ F (finRotate q i) := by
      intro heq
      have := C.injective heq
      exact (finRotate_ne_self (by omega) i) this.symm
    rcases hedge_two (C.isFacet i).1 (C.isFacet i).2
        (C.isFacet (finRotate q i)).1 (C.isFacet (finRotate q i)).2
        (C.isFacet j).1 (C.isFacet j).2 hne (hmem i)
        (hmem (finRotate q i)) (hmem j) hxedge hxv hxj with hj | hj
    · exact Or.inl (C.injective hj)
    · exact Or.inr (C.injective hj)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.schlafli_eq_of_fun_agree
statement:
theorem schlafli_eq_of_fun_agree (P₁ P₂ : ConvexPolytope d)
    (hreg₁ : P₁.IsRegular) (hreg₂ : P₂.IsRegular)
    (F₁ : P₁.Flag) (F₂ : P₂.Flag)
    (hagree : ∀ k, k + 1 < d →
      schlafliFun P₁ hreg₁ F₁ k = schlafliFun P₂ hreg₂ F₂ k) :
    schlafli P₁ hreg₁ F₁ = schlafli P₂ hreg₂ F₂
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < d
  · have h := hagree (i : ℕ) hi
    rw [schlafliFun_eq P₁ hreg₁ F₁ (i : ℕ) hi,
      schlafliFun_eq P₂ hreg₂ F₂ (i : ℕ) hi] at h
    have hfin : (⟨(i : ℕ), by omega⟩ : Fin d) = i := Fin.ext rfl
    rwa [hfin] at h
  · simp only [schlafli, dif_neg hi]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.agree_of_allThree
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rw [h₁ k (by omega), h₂ k (by omega)]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.agree_of_leftFour
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hkpos
  · rw [h₁.1, h₂.1]
  · rw [h₁.2 k hkpos (by omega), h₂.2 k hkpos (by omega)]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.agree_of_rightFour
statement:
theorem agree_of_rightFour {m₁ m₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (hd : 5 ≤ d)
    (h₁ : rightFour m₁ (d - 1)) (h₂ : rightFour m₂ (d - 1)) :
    ∀ k, k + 1 < d → m₁ k = m₂ k
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (d - 2) with hlt | hge
  · rw [h₁.1 k (by omega), h₂.1 k (by omega)]
  · have hkeq : k = d - 1 - 1 := by omega
    rw [hkeq, h₁.2, h₂.2]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.exists_flag
statement:
theorem exists_flag (P : ConvexPolytope d) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (hd : 0 < d) : Nonempty P.Flag
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := P.vertices_nonempty
  obtain ⟨F, _⟩ := bandiera_al_vertice_generica P hreg.1 hd hv
  exact ⟨F⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_high
statement: theorem platonicCount_high (d : ℕ) (hd : 5 ≤ d) : platonicCount d = 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (three_le_platonicCount d hd)
  
  have hflag : ∀ P : regularPolytopes d,
      Nonempty (P : ConvexPolytope d).Flag :=
    fun P => exists_flag (P : ConvexPolytope d) P.2 (by omega)
  set fl : ∀ P : regularPolytopes d, (P : ConvexPolytope d).Flag :=
    fun P => (hflag P).some with hfl
  
  set idx : regularPolytopes d → ℕ := fun P =>
    if allThree (schlafliFun (P : ConvexPolytope d) P.2 (fl P)) (d - 1)
      then 0
    else if leftFour (schlafliFun (P : ConvexPolytope d) P.2 (fl P)) (d - 1)
      then 1
    else 2 with hidx
  have hidx_lt : ∀ P, idx P < 3 := by
    intro P
    simp only [hidx]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  
  have hagree : ∀ P₁ P₂ : regularPolytopes d, idx P₁ = idx P₂ →
      ∀ k, k + 1 < d →
        schlafliFun (P₁ : ConvexPolytope d) P₁.2 (fl P₁) k =
          schlafliFun (P₂ : ConvexPolytope d) P₂.2 (fl P₂) k := by
    intro P₁ P₂ hip
    have hex₁ := schlafli_high_dim_exclusive (P₁ : ConvexPolytope d)
      P₁.2 (fl P₁) hd
    have hex₂ := schlafli_high_dim_exclusive (P₂ : ConvexPolytope d)
      P₂.2 (fl P₂) hd
    simp only [hidx] at hip
    by_cases hA₁ : allThree
        (schlafliFun (P₁ : ConvexPolytope d) P₁.2 (fl P₁)) (d - 1) <;>
      by_cases hA₂ : allThree
        (schlafliFun (P₂ : ConvexPolytope d) P₂.2 (fl P₂)) (d - 1)
    · exact agree_of_allThree hA₁ hA₂
    · rw [if_pos hA₁, if_neg hA₂] at hip
      split_ifs at hip <;> omega
    · rw [if_neg hA₁, if_pos hA₂] at hip
      split_ifs at hip <;> omega
    · rw [if_neg hA₁, if_neg hA₂] at hip
      by_cases hL₁ : leftFour
          (schlafliFun (P₁ : ConvexPolytope d) P₁.2 (fl P₁)) (d - 1) <;>
        by_cases hL₂ : leftFour
          (schlafliFun (P₂ : ConvexPolytope d) P₂.2 (fl P₂)) (d - 1)
      · exact agree_of_leftFour hL₁ hL₂
      · rw [if_pos hL₁, if_neg hL₂] at hip
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hL₁, if_pos hL₂] at hip
        omega
      · have hR₁ : rightFour
            (schlafliFun (P₁ : ConvexPolytope d) P₁.2 (fl P₁)) (d - 1) := by
          rcases hex₁ with h | h | h
          · exact absurd h hA₁
          · exact absurd h hL₁
          · exact h
        have hR₂ : rightFour
            (schlafliFun (P₂ : ConvexPolytope d) P₂.2 (fl P₂)) (d - 1) := by
          rcases hex₂ with h | h | h
          · exact absurd h hA₂
          · exact absurd h hL₂
          · exact h
        exact agree_of_rightFour hd hR₁ hR₂
  
  have hinj : ∀ P₁ P₂ : regularPolytopes d, idx P₁ = idx P₂ →
      classe d P₁ = classe d P₂ := by
    intro P₁ P₂ hip
    apply classe_eq_of_similar_gen
    show Similar (P₁ : ConvexPolytope d) (P₂ : ConvexPolytope d)
    exact similar_of_schlafli_eq (by omega) _ _ P₁.2 P₂.2 (fl P₁) (fl P₂)
      (schlafli_eq_of_fun_agree _ _ P₁.2 P₂.2 (fl P₁) (fl P₂)
        (hagree P₁ P₂ hip))
  
  set g : Fin 3 → Set (regularPolytopes d) := fun i =>
    if h : ∃ P : regularPolytopes d, idx P = (i : ℕ)
      then classe d h.choose else ∅ with hg
  have hsub : {S : Set (regularPolytopes d) |
      ∃ P, S = {Q : regularPolytopes d | regularSimilar d P Q}} ⊆
      Set.range g := by
    rintro S ⟨P, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨idx P, hidx_lt P⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [hg]
    have hex : ∃ P' : regularPolytopes d,
        idx P' = ((⟨idx P, hidx_lt P⟩ : Fin 3) : ℕ) := ⟨P, rfl⟩
    rw [dif_pos hex]
    have hPP' : idx hex.choose = idx P := hex.choose_spec
    exact hinj hex.choose P hPP'
  calc Set.encard {S : Set (regularPolytopes d) |
        ∃ P, S = {Q : regularPolytopes d | regularSimilar d P Q}}
      ≤ Set.encard (Set.range g) := Set.encard_le_encard hsub
    _ = Set.encard (g '' Set.univ) := by rw [Set.image_univ]
    _ ≤ Set.encard (Set.univ : Set (Fin 3)) := Set.encard_image_le _ _
    _ = 3 := by simp [Set.encard_univ]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_high_all

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.facet_exists_at_vertex
statement:
theorem facet_exists_at_vertex (P : ConvexPolytope n) {d : ℕ}
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) = d + 1)
    {v : E n} (hv : v ∈ P.vertices) :
    ∃ f : Set (E n), P.IsFace f ∧ faceDim f = d ∧ v ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices H : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ f : Set (E n), P.IsFace f → v ∈ f →
      d - faceDim f ≤ k → faceDim f ≤ d →
      ∃ g : Set (E n), P.IsFace g ∧ faceDim g = d ∧ v ∈ g by
    have hvface : P.IsFace ({v} : Set (E n)) := vertex_isFace P hv
    have hd0 : faceDim ({v} : Set (E n)) = 0 := faceDim_singleton v
    exact H d {v} hvface (Set.mem_singleton v)
      (by rw [hd0]; omega) (by rw [hd0]; omega)
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro f hf hvf hk _hle
      exact ⟨f, hf, by omega, hvf⟩
  | succ m ih =>
      intro f hf hvf hk hle
      by_cases heq : faceDim f = d
      · exact ⟨f, hf, heq, hvf⟩
      · have hgap : faceDim f + 2 ≤
            Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) := by
          rw [hdim]
          omega
        obtain ⟨f', hf', hff', hf'ne⟩ := interpolazione P hf hgap
        have hvf' : v ∈ f' := hff'.1 hvf
        have hlt : faceDim f < faceDim f' :=
          faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hf hf' hff'
        have hf'top : f' ⊂ P.toSet := by
          refine ⟨face_subset_toSet P hf', ?_⟩
          intro htop
          exact hf'ne (Set.Subset.antisymm (face_subset_toSet P hf') htop)
        have hltTop : faceDim f' <
            Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) :=
          faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hf' (toSet_isFace P) hf'top
        apply ih f' hf' hvf'
        · omega
        · rw [hdim] at hltTop
          omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.chain_exists_at_vertex
statement:
theorem chain_exists_at_vertex (P : ConvexPolytope n) :
    ∀ d : ℕ, Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) = d →
    ∀ v : E n, v ∈ P.vertices →
    ∃ c : ℕ → Set (E n),
      c 0 = {v} ∧
      (∀ k, k < d → P.IsFace (c k) ∧ faceDim (c k) = k) ∧
      (∀ j k, j < k → k < d → c j ⊂ c k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro d
  induction d generalizing P with
  | zero =>
      intro _ v _hv
      exact ⟨fun _ => {v}, rfl,
        fun k hk => absurd hk (by omega),
        fun j k hjk hk => absurd hk (by omega)⟩
  | succ m ih =>
      intro hdim v hv
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfdim, hvf⟩ :=
        facet_exists_at_vertex P hdim hv
      let Q : ConvexPolytope n := facePolytope P hf
      have hQdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) = m := by
        dsimp only [Q]
        rw [facePolytope_toSet P hf]
        exact hfdim
      have hvQ : v ∈ Q.vertices := by
        change v ∈ P.vertices.filter (· ∈ f)
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, hvf⟩
      obtain ⟨c', hc'0, hc'1, hc'2⟩ := ih Q hQdim v hvQ
      have hfzero : m = 0 → f = ({v} : Set (E n)) := by
        intro hm
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := faccia_dim0_singoletto hf.2 (by simpa [hm] using hfdim)
        have hvx : v = x := by
          rw [hx] at hvf
          exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hvf
        simpa [hvx] using hx
      refine ⟨fun k => if k = m then f else c' k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change (if 0 = m then f else c' 0) = {v}
        by_cases hm : m = 0
        · rw [if_pos hm.symm, hfzero hm]
        · rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hm), hc'0]
      · intro k hk
        change P.IsFace (if k = m then f else c' k) ∧
          faceDim (if k = m then f else c' k) = k
        by_cases hkm : k = m
        · rw [if_pos hkm]
          exact ⟨hf, hfdim.trans hkm.symm⟩
        · have hklt : k < m := by omega
          rw [if_neg hkm]
          obtain ⟨hkface, hkdim⟩ := hc'1 k hklt
          exact ⟨isFace_of_facePolytope P hf hkface, hkdim⟩
      · intro j k hjk hk
        change (if j = m then f else c' j) ⊂
          (if k = m then f else c' k)
        by_cases hkm : k = m
        · have hjm : j ≠ m := by omega
          rw [if_pos hkm, if_neg hjm]
          obtain ⟨hjface, hjdim⟩ := hc'1 j (by omega)
          have hjsub : c' j ⊆ f := by
            have := face_subset_toSet Q hjface
            simpa only [Q, facePolytope_toSet P hf] using this
          refine hjsub.ssubset_of_ne ?_
          intro heq
          have := congrArg faceDim heq
          rw [hjdim, hfdim] at this
          omega
        · have hklt : k < m := by omega
          have hjm : j ≠ m := by omega
          simp only [if_neg hkm, if_neg hjm]
          exact hc'2 j k hjk hklt

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.bandiera_al_vertice_generica
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) = n := hfull
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc1, hc2⟩ := chain_exists_at_vertex P n hdim v hv
  refine ⟨⟨fun k => c k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    exact (hc1 k k.isLt).1
  · intro k
    exact (hc1 k k.isLt).2
  · intro i j hij
    exact hc2 i j hij j.isLt
  · exact hc0

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertex_mem_simpleVertexOrbit_of_gallery
statement:
theorem vertex_mem_simpleVertexOrbit_of_gallery
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (hn : 0 < n)
    (F G : P.Flag) {v u : E n}
    (hF0 : F.face ⟨0, hn⟩ = {v})
    (hG0 : G.face ⟨0, hn⟩ = {u})
    (hgal : GalleryConnected P F G) :
    u ∈ simpleVertexOrbit P hreg F v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwFG⟩ := orbita_di_galleria P hreg F G hgal
  refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
  have hface := congrArg (fun H : P.Flag => H.face ⟨0, hn⟩) hwFG
  rw [act_face, hF0, hG0] at hface
  have hsingle : ({(w : Isom n) v} : Set (E n)) = {u} := by
    simpa only [Set.image_singleton] using hface
  exact Set.singleton_injective hsingle

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertices_subset_simpleVertexOrbit_of_galleryConnected
statement:
theorem vertices_subset_simpleVertexOrbit_of_galleryConnected
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (hn : 0 < n)
    (F : P.Flag) {v : E n} (hF0 : F.face ⟨0, hn⟩ = {v})
    (hconn : ∀ G : P.Flag, GalleryConnected P F G) :
    (P.vertices : Set (E n)) ⊆ simpleVertexOrbit P hreg F v
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨G, hG0⟩ := bandiera_al_vertice_generica P hreg.1 hn hu
  exact vertex_mem_simpleVertexOrbit_of_gallery P hreg hn F G
    hF0 hG0 (hconn G)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertices_eq_simpleVertexOrbit_of_galleryConnected
statement:
theorem vertices_eq_simpleVertexOrbit_of_galleryConnected

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.mapFlag_refl
statement:

    mapFlag P (isSymmetry_refl P) F = F
proof:
:= by

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isRegular_of_wall_reflections
statement:
theorem isRegular_of_wall_reflections (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (Φ₀ : P.Flag) (r : Fin n → Isom n)
    (hsym : ∀ i, P.isSymmetry (r i))
    (hadj : ∀ i, FlagAdjacentAt P Φ₀ (mapFlag P (hsym i) Φ₀) i) :
    P.IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  
  have hreach : ∀ G : P.Flag, ∃ φ : Isom n, ∃ hφ : P.isSymmetry φ,
      mapFlag P hφ Φ₀ = G := by
    intro G
    have hgal : GalleryConnected P Φ₀ G :=
      galleryConnected_sempre P hfull Φ₀ G
    induction hgal with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, isSymmetry_refl P, mapFlag_refl P Φ₀⟩
    | tail hprev hstep ih =>
        obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσΦ⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨i, hadjstep⟩ := hstep
        refine ⟨(r i).trans σ, symmetry_transN (hsym i) hσ, ?_⟩
        rw [← mapFlag_trans P (hsym i) hσ]
        have h1 : mapFlag P (hsym i) Φ₀ = adjacentFlag P hfull Φ₀ i :=
          adjacentFlag_eq_of_isAdjacent P hfull i (hadj i)
        rw [h1, mapFlag_adjacentFlag P hfull hσ Φ₀ i, hσΦ]
        exact (adjacentFlag_eq_of_isAdjacent P hfull i hadjstep).symm
  
  refine ⟨hfull, ?_⟩
  intro F G
  obtain ⟨φF, hφF, hF⟩ := hreach F
  obtain ⟨φG, hφG, hG⟩ := hreach G
  refine ⟨φF.symm.trans φG,
    symmetry_transN (symmetry_symmN hφF) hφG, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have hstep1 : mapFlag P (symmetry_symmN hφF) F = Φ₀ := by
    rw [← hF, mapFlag_symm_mapFlag]
  have htrans := mapFlag_trans P (symmetry_symmN hφF) hφG F
  have hcomp : mapFlag P
      (symmetry_transN (symmetry_symmN hφF) hφG) F = G := by
    rw [← htrans, hstep1, hG]
  have hk := congrArg (fun X : P.Flag => X.face k) hcomp
  simpa [mapFlag_face] using hk

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.flag_ext
statement:
theorem flag_ext {P : ConvexPolytope n} {F G : P.Flag}
    (h : F.face = G.face) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  cases F with
  | mk f hf hd hm =>
    cases G with
    | mk g hg hd' hm' =>
      dsimp only at h
      subst h
      rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faccia_sopra
statement:
theorem faccia_sopra (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ B : Set (E n), P.IsFace B ∧ faceDim B = (i : ℕ) + 1 ∧
      F.face i ⊂ B ∧
      (∀ j : Fin n, i < j → B ⊆ F.face j) ∧
      (∀ D : Set (E n), P.IsFace D → faceDim D = (i : ℕ) →
        (∀ j : Fin n, i < j → D ⊂ F.face j) → D ⊂ B)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n
  · 
    refine ⟨F.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩, F.isFace _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact F.dim_eq _
    · refine F.strict_mono i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ ?_
      rw [Fin.lt_def]
      show (i : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) + 1
      omega
    · intro j hj
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge ((i : ℕ) + 1) (j : ℕ) with hlt | hge
      · refine (F.strict_mono ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ j ?_).subset
        rw [Fin.lt_def]
        show (i : ℕ) + 1 < (j : ℕ)
        exact hlt
      · have hje : j = ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ := by
          apply Fin.ext
          show (j : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1
          rw [Fin.lt_def] at hj
          omega
        subst hje
        exact subset_rfl
    · intro D _ _ hDj
      refine hDj ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ ?_
      rw [Fin.lt_def]
      show (i : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) + 1
      omega
  · 
    have hin : (i : ℕ) + 1 = n := by
      have := i.isLt
      omega
    have hPdim : faceDim P.toSet = n := hfull
    refine ⟨P.toSet, toSet_isFace P, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hPdim]
      omega
    · refine (face_subset_toSet P (F.isFace i)).ssubset_of_ne ?_
      intro heq
      have hdi := F.dim_eq i
      rw [heq, hPdim] at hdi
      have := i.isLt
      omega
    · intro j hj
      exfalso
      rw [Fin.lt_def] at hj
      have := j.isLt
      omega
    · intro D hD hdD _
      refine (face_subset_toSet P hD).ssubset_of_ne ?_
      intro heq
      rw [heq, hPdim] at hdD
      omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.existsUnique_flag_adjacent
statement:
theorem existsUnique_flag_adjacent (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃! G : P.Flag, FlagAdjacentAt P F G i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hdB, hFiB, hBsub, hDB⟩ := faccia_sopra P hfull F i
  
  have hQ : ∃! C : Set (E n),
      (P.IsFace C ∧ faceDim C = (i : ℕ) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin n, j < i → F.face j ⊂ C) ∧ C ⊂ B) ∧
      C ≠ F.face i := by
    by_cases hi0 : (i : ℕ) = 0
    · 
      have hdB1 : faceDim B = 1 := by rw [hdB, hi0]
      have hdV : faceDim (F.face i) = 0 := by
        rw [F.dim_eq]
        exact hi0
      have hVB : F.face i < B := hFiB
      obtain ⟨W, ⟨⟨hWface, hWdim, hWB⟩, hWne⟩, hWuniq⟩ :=
        due_vertici_per_spigolo P hB hdB1 (F.isFace i) hdV hVB
      refine ⟨W, ⟨⟨hWface, ?_, ?_, hWB⟩, hWne⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [hWdim, hi0]
      · intro j hj
        exfalso
        rw [Fin.lt_def, hi0] at hj
        omega
      · intro C hC
        refine hWuniq C ⟨⟨hC.1.1, ?_, hC.1.2.2.2⟩, hC.2⟩
        rw [hC.1.2.1, hi0]
    · 
      have hipos : 0 < (i : ℕ) := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi0
      obtain ⟨iv, hiv⟩ : ∃ iv : ℕ, (i : ℕ) = iv + 1 :=
        ⟨(i : ℕ) - 1, by omega⟩
      have hivn : iv < n := by
        have := i.isLt
        omega
      have him : ((⟨iv, hivn⟩ : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1 = (i : ℕ) := by
        show iv + 1 = (i : ℕ)
        omega
      have himlt : (⟨iv, hivn⟩ : Fin n) < i := by
        rw [Fin.lt_def]
        show iv < (i : ℕ)
        omega
      have hrank : faceDim B = faceDim (F.face ⟨iv, hivn⟩) + 2 := by
        rw [hdB, F.dim_eq]
        show (i : ℕ) + 1 = iv + 2
        omega
      have hAC : F.face ⟨iv, hivn⟩ < F.face i := F.strict_mono _ i himlt
      have hCB : F.face i < B := hFiB
      obtain ⟨C', ⟨⟨hC'face, hAC', hC'B⟩, hC'ne⟩, hC'uniq⟩ :=
        existsUnique_other_middle P (F.isFace ⟨iv, hivn⟩) hB hrank
          (F.isFace i) hAC hCB
      have hdC' : faceDim C' = (i : ℕ) := by
        have h1 := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P (F.isFace ⟨iv, hivn⟩) hC'face hAC'
        have h2 := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hC'face hB hC'B
        rw [F.dim_eq] at h1
        rw [hdB] at h2
        have h1' : iv < faceDim C' := h1
        omega
      refine ⟨C', ⟨⟨hC'face, hdC', ?_, hC'B⟩, hC'ne⟩, ?_⟩
      · exact catena_sotto P F him hAC'
      · intro C hC
        exact hC'uniq C ⟨⟨hC.1.1, hC.1.2.2.1 _ himlt, hC.1.2.2.2⟩, hC.2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨C, ⟨⟨hCface, hCdim, hCsotto, hCB⟩, hCne⟩, hCuniq⟩ := hQ
  have hCsopra : ∀ j : Fin n, i < j → C ⊂ F.face j := by
    intro j hj
    exact ssubset_of_ssubset_of_subset hCB (hBsub j hj)
  refine ⟨sostituisci P F i C hCface hCdim hCsotto hCsopra, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    exact sostituisci_face_ne P F i C hCface hCdim hCsotto hCsopra hj
  · rw [sostituisci_face_self]
    exact hCne
  · intro G' hG'
    obtain ⟨hG'eq, hG'ne⟩ := hG'
    have hQ' : (P.IsFace (G'.face i) ∧ faceDim (G'.face i) = (i : ℕ) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin n, j < i → F.face j ⊂ G'.face i) ∧ G'.face i ⊂ B) ∧
        G'.face i ≠ F.face i := by
      refine ⟨⟨G'.isFace i, G'.dim_eq i, ?_, ?_⟩, hG'ne⟩
      · intro j hj
        rw [← hG'eq j (ne_of_lt hj)]
        exact G'.strict_mono j i hj
      · refine hDB (G'.face i) (G'.isFace i) (G'.dim_eq i) ?_
        intro j hj
        rw [← hG'eq j (ne_of_gt hj)]
        exact G'.strict_mono i j hj
    have hCeq : G'.face i = C := hCuniq (G'.face i) hQ'
    apply flag_ext
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      rw [sostituisci_face_self]
      exact hCeq
    · rw [sostituisci_face_ne P F i C hCface hCdim hCsotto hCsopra hj]
      exact hG'eq j hj

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.sostituisci_face_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem sostituisci_face_self (P : ConvexPolytope n) (F : P.Flag)
    (i : Fin n) (C : Set (E n)) (hC hdim hsotto hsopra) :
    (sostituisci P F i C hC hdim hsotto hsopra).face i = C
proof:
:=
  Function.update_self ..

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.sostituisci_face_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem sostituisci_face_ne (P : ConvexPolytope n) (F : P.Flag)
    (i : Fin n) (C : Set (E n)) (hC hdim hsotto hsopra)
    {j : Fin n} (hj : j ≠ i) :
    (sostituisci P F i C hC hdim hsotto hsopra).face j = F.face j
proof:
:=
  Function.update_of_ne hj _ _

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.catena_sotto
statement:
theorem catena_sotto (P : ConvexPolytope n) (F : P.Flag) {i : Fin n}
    {C : Set (E n)} {im : Fin n} (him : (im : ℕ) + 1 = (i : ℕ))
    (hAC : F.face im ⊂ C) :
    ∀ j : Fin n, j < i → F.face j ⊂ C
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  by_cases hjim : j = im
  · rw [hjim]; exact hAC
  · have hjlt : j < im := by
      rw [Fin.lt_def] at hj ⊢
      have hne : (j : ℕ) ≠ (im : ℕ) := fun h => hjim (Fin.ext h)
      omega
    exact (F.strict_mono j im hjlt).trans hAC

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.catena_sopra
statement:
theorem catena_sopra (P : ConvexPolytope n) (F : P.Flag) {i : Fin n}
    {C : Set (E n)} {ip : Fin n} (hip : (i : ℕ) + 1 = (ip : ℕ))
    (hCB : C ⊂ F.face ip) :
    ∀ j : Fin n, i < j → C ⊂ F.face j
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  by_cases hjip : j = ip
  · rw [hjip]; exact hCB
  · have hjgt : ip < j := by
      rw [Fin.lt_def] at hj ⊢
      have hne : (j : ℕ) ≠ (ip : ℕ) := fun h => hjip (Fin.ext h)
      omega
    exact hCB.trans (F.strict_mono ip j hjgt)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faceDim_singleton
statement: theorem faceDim_singleton (v : E n) : faceDim ({v} : Set (E n)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ ({v} : Set (E n))) = 0
  rw [vectorSpan_singleton]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.exists_vertex_notMem_of_ne_toSet
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hall
  push_neg at hall
  have hconv : Convex ℝ f := hf.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have hsub : P.toSet ⊆ f := by
    show convexHull ℝ ((P.vertices : Set (E n))) ⊆ f
    apply convexHull_min ?_ hconv
    intro x hx
    exact hall x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
  exact hne (Set.Subset.antisymm (face_subset_toSet P hf) hsub)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.compagna_exists
statement:
theorem compagna_exists (P : ConvexPolytope 3) (F : P.Flag) :
    ∃ G : P.Flag, G.face 2 = F.face 2 ∧ G.face 1 ≠ F.face 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfacet : P.IsFace (F.face 2) := F.isFace 2
  have hQtoSet : (facePolytope P hfacet).toSet = F.face 2 :=
    facePolytope_toSet P hfacet
  have hQdim :
      Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (facePolytope P hfacet).toSet) = 2 := by
    rw [hQtoSet]
    exact F.dim_eq 2
  
  have hesub : F.face 1 ⊆ F.face 2 := (F.strict_mono 1 2 (by decide)).subset
  have he : (facePolytope P hfacet).IsFace (F.face 1) :=
    facePolytope_isFace_of P hfacet (F.isFace 1) hesub
  
  have hene : F.face 1 ≠ (facePolytope P hfacet).toSet := by
    intro h
    have h1 : faceDim (F.face 1) = 1 := F.dim_eq 1
    have h2 : faceDim (F.face 1) = 2 := by
      show Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (F.face 1)) = 2
      rw [h, hQdim]
    omega
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwV, hwe⟩ :=
    exists_vertex_notMem_of_ne_toSet (facePolytope P hfacet) he hene
  have hwF : (facePolytope P hfacet).IsFace ({w} : Set (E 3)) :=
    vertex_isFace (facePolytope P hfacet) hwV
  
  have hgap : faceDim ({w} : Set (E 3)) + 2 ≤
      Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (facePolytope P hfacet).toSet) := by
    rw [faceDim_singleton, hQdim]
  obtain ⟨f', hf', hwf', hf'ne⟩ := interpolazione (facePolytope P hfacet) hwF hgap
  have hf'sub : f' ⊆ F.face 2 := by
    have := face_subset_toSet (facePolytope P hfacet) hf'
    rwa [hQtoSet] at this
  have hdimf' : faceDim f' = 1 := by
    have h1 : 0 < faceDim f' := by
      have hlt := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset (facePolytope P hfacet) hwF hf' hwf'
      rw [faceDim_singleton] at hlt
      omega
    have hss : f' ⊂ (facePolytope P hfacet).toSet :=
      ⟨face_subset_toSet (facePolytope P hfacet) hf', fun hsup =>
        hf'ne (Set.Subset.antisymm
          (face_subset_toSet (facePolytope P hfacet) hf') hsup)⟩
    have h2 := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset (facePolytope P hfacet) hf'
      (toSet_isFace (facePolytope P hfacet)) hss
    have h3 : faceDim (facePolytope P hfacet).toSet = 2 := hQdim
    omega
  
  have h12 : f' ⊂ F.face 2 := by
    refine ⟨hf'sub, fun hsup => ?_⟩
    have : faceDim (F.face 2) ≤ faceDim f' :=
      le_of_eq (congrArg faceDim (Set.Subset.antisymm hsup hf'sub))
    have h4 : faceDim (F.face 2) = 2 := F.dim_eq 2
    omega
  have h02 : ({w} : Set (E 3)) ⊂ F.face 2 := hwf'.trans h12
  
  refine ⟨⟨fun k => if k.val = 0 then {w} else if k.val = 1 then f' else F.face 2,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    rcases k with ⟨kv, hk⟩
    interval_cases kv
    · exact isFace_of_facePolytope P hfacet hwF
    · exact isFace_of_facePolytope P hfacet hf'
    · exact F.isFace 2
  · intro k
    rcases k with ⟨kv, hk⟩
    interval_cases kv
    · exact faceDim_singleton w
    · exact hdimf'
    · exact F.dim_eq 2
  · intro i j hij
    rcases i with ⟨iv, hi⟩
    rcases j with ⟨jv, hj⟩
    have hij' : iv < jv := hij
    have hcasi : (iv = 0 ∧ jv = 1) ∨ (iv = 0 ∧ jv = 2) ∨ (iv = 1 ∧ jv = 2) := by
      omega
    rcases hcasi with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> subst h1 <;> subst h2
    · exact hwf'
    · exact h02
    · exact h12
  · rfl
  · show f' ≠ F.face 1
    intro h
    rw [h] at hwf'
    exact hwe (hwf'.subset rfl)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.rho_orbitale
statement:
theorem rho_orbitale (P : ConvexPolytope 3) (h : P.IsRegular)
    (F G : P.Flag) (hfacet : G.face 2 = F.face 2)
    (hedge : G.face 1 ≠ F.face 1) :
    ∃ ρ : Isom 3, P.isSymmetry ρ ∧
      ((ρ : E 3 → E 3)) '' (F.face 2) = F.face 2 ∧
      ((ρ : E 3 → E 3)) '' (F.face 1) ≠ F.face 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hface⟩ := h.2 F G
  refine ⟨ρ, hρ, (hface 2).trans hfacet, ?_⟩
  intro hfixed
  exact hedge ((hface 1).symm.trans hfixed)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.rho_orbitale_libero
statement:
theorem rho_orbitale_libero (P : ConvexPolytope 3) (h : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) :
    ∃ ρ : Isom 3, P.isSymmetry ρ ∧
      ((ρ : E 3 → E 3)) '' (F.face 2) = F.face 2 ∧
      ((ρ : E 3 → E 3)) '' (F.face 1) ≠ F.face 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hG2, hG1⟩ := compagna_exists P F
  exact rho_orbitale P h F G hG2 hG1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coniugazioneAffine_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coniugazioneAffine_apply (T : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n)
    (cP cQ x : E n) :
    coniugazioneAffine T cP cQ x = T (x - cP) + cQ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coniugazioneAffine_centro
statement:
@[simp] theorem coniugazioneAffine_centro (T : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n)
    (cP cQ : E n) : coniugazioneAffine T cP cQ cP = cQ
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coniugazioneAffine_parteLineare
statement:
@[simp] theorem coniugazioneAffine_parteLineare (T : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n)
    (cP cQ : E n) :
    (coniugazioneAffine T cP cQ).linearIsometryEquiv = T
proof:
:= by
  simp [coniugazioneAffine]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coniugazioneAffine_dist
statement:
theorem coniugazioneAffine_dist (T : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n)
    (cP cQ x y : E n) :
    dist (coniugazioneAffine T cP cQ x)
        (coniugazioneAffine T cP cQ y) = dist x y
proof:
:=
  (coniugazioneAffine T cP cQ).dist_map x y

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleReflection_fissa_centroGlobale
statement:
theorem simpleReflection_fissa_centroGlobale (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    simpleReflection P hreg F i (centroGlobale P) = centroGlobale P
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [centroGlobale] using
    centro_fisso P hreg (simpleReflection_isSymmetry P hreg F i)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.inner_normaleOrientato_centroGlobale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero
statement:
theorem inner_normaleOrientato_centroGlobale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i,
      centroGlobale P - puntoBase P hreg F i⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [normaleOrientato, real_inner_smul_left,
    inner_normale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero_of_fixed P hreg F i
      (centroGlobale P) (simpleReflection_fissa_centroGlobale P hreg F i),
    mul_zero]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.inner_coniugazioneAffine_sub_puntoBase
statement:
theorem inner_coniugazioneAffine_sub_puntoBase
    (T : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n) (cP cQ pP pQ αP αQ x : E n)
    (hT : T αP = αQ)
    (hP : ⟪αP, cP - pP⟫ = 0) (hQ : ⟪αQ, cQ - pQ⟫ = 0) :
    ⟪αQ, coniugazioneAffine T cP cQ x - pQ⟫ =
      ⟪αP, x - pP⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [coniugazioneAffine_apply]
  calc
    ⟪αQ, T (x - cP) + cQ - pQ⟫ =
        ⟪αQ, T (x - cP)⟫ + ⟪αQ, cQ - pQ⟫ := by
          rw [show T (x - cP) + cQ - pQ =
            T (x - cP) + (cQ - pQ) by abel, inner_add_right]
    _ = ⟪T αP, T (x - cP)⟫ + 0 := by rw [hT, hQ]
    _ = ⟪αP, x - cP⟫ := by rw [T.inner_map_map, add_zero]
    _ = ⟪αP, x - pP⟫ := by
      rw [show x - pP = (x - cP) + (cP - pP) by abel,
        inner_add_right, hP, add_zero]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleReflection_conj
statement:
theorem simpleReflection_conj
    (P Q : ConvexPolytope n) (hregP : P.IsRegular) (hregQ : Q.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (G : Q.Flag) (T : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n)
    (hT : ∀ i, T (normaleOrientato P hregP F i) =
      normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i) :
    ∀ i x,
      coniugazioneAffine T (centroGlobale P) (centroGlobale Q)
          (simpleReflection P hregP F i x) =
        simpleReflection Q hregQ G i
          (coniugazioneAffine T (centroGlobale P) (centroGlobale Q) x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i x
  have hinner := inner_coniugazioneAffine_sub_puntoBase T
    (centroGlobale P) (centroGlobale Q)
    (puntoBase P hregP F i) (puntoBase Q hregQ G i)
    (normaleOrientato P hregP F i) (normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i) x
    (hT i)
    (inner_normaleOrientato_centroGlobale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero P hregP F i)
    (inner_normaleOrientato_centroGlobale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero Q hregQ G i)
  rw [normaleOrientato_formula P hregP F i x,
    normaleOrientato_formula Q hregQ G i
      (coniugazioneAffine T (centroGlobale P) (centroGlobale Q) x),
    hinner]
  simp only [coniugazioneAffine_apply]
  rw [show x -
      (2 * ⟪normaleOrientato P hregP F i,
        x - puntoBase P hregP F i⟫ : ℝ) • normaleOrientato P hregP F i -
        centroGlobale P =
      (x - centroGlobale P) -
        (2 * ⟪normaleOrientato P hregP F i,
          x - puntoBase P hregP F i⟫ : ℝ) •
            normaleOrientato P hregP F i by abel,
    map_sub, map_smul, hT i]
  abel

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.esiste_coniugazioneAffine_da_gram
statement:
theorem esiste_coniugazioneAffine_da_gram
    (P Q : ConvexPolytope n) (hregP : P.IsRegular) (hregQ : Q.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (G : Q.Flag)
    (hspanP : Submodule.span ℝ
      (Set.range (normaleOrientato P hregP F)) = ⊤)
    (hspanQ : Submodule.span ℝ
      (Set.range (normaleOrientato Q hregQ G)) = ⊤)
    (hgram : ∀ i j,
      ⟪normaleOrientato P hregP F i, normaleOrientato P hregP F j⟫ =
        ⟪normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i, normaleOrientato Q hregQ G j⟫) :
    ∃ T : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n,
      (∀ i, T (normaleOrientato P hregP F i) =
        normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i) ∧
      ∀ i x,
        coniugazioneAffine T (centroGlobale P) (centroGlobale Q)
            (simpleReflection P hregP F i x) =
          simpleReflection Q hregQ G i
            (coniugazioneAffine T (centroGlobale P) (centroGlobale Q) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := isometria_da_gram_dim hspanP hspanQ hgram
  exact ⟨T, hT, simpleReflection_conj P Q hregP hregQ F G T hT⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertice_estremo_in_faccia
proof:
:= by
  have hex : w ∈ P.toSet.extremePoints ℝ := by
    have h1 : w ∈ (P.vertices : Set (E n)) := Finset.mem_coe.mpr hwV
    rw [P.vertices_eq_extremePoints] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨hwf, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy hseg
  exact hex.2 (face_subset_toSet P hf hx) (face_subset_toSet P hf hy) hseg

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.spigolo_segmento
statement:
theorem spigolo_segmento (P : ConvexPolytope n) {e : Set (E n)}
    (he : P.IsFace e) (hde : faceDim e = 1)
    {w : E n} (hwV : w ∈ P.vertices) (hwe : w ∈ e) :
    ∃ a : E n, a ∈ P.vertices ∧ a ∈ e ∧ a ≠ w ∧ e = segment ℝ w a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, hue, huw⟩ := faccia_ha_secondo_punto hde (v := w)
  set d : E n := u - w with hd
  have hdne : d ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr huw
  have hdd : (0:ℝ) < ⟪d, d⟫ := real_inner_self_pos.mpr hdne
  
  have hspan : vectorSpan ℝ e = Submodule.span ℝ {d} := by
    have hle : Submodule.span ℝ {d} ≤ vectorSpan ℝ e := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      intro z hz
      rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz with rfl
      exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hue hwe
    apply (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle ?_).symm
    rw [finrank_span_singleton hdne]
    have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ e) = 1 := hde
    omega
  
  have hcoord : ∀ z ∈ e, ∃ s : ℝ, z = w + s • d := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 : z - w ∈ vectorSpan ℝ e := vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hz hwe
    rw [hspan] at h1
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp h1
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q + w) hs
    simp at h2
    rw [← h2]
    abel
  have hval : ∀ z : E n, ∀ s : ℝ, z = w + s • d → ⟪d, z - w⟫ = s * ⟪d, d⟫ := by
    intro z s hs
    rw [hs]
    simp [inner_smul_right]
  
  set V : Finset (E n) := (facePolytope P he).vertices with hV
  have hVne : V.Nonempty := (facePolytope P he).vertices_nonempty
  have hVsube : (V : Set (E n)) ⊆ e := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : x ∈ (facePolytope P he).toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ hx
    rwa [facePolytope_toSet P he] at h1
  obtain ⟨a, haV, hamax⟩ := V.exists_max_image (fun z => ⟪d, z⟫) hVne
  have hae : a ∈ e := hVsube haV
  have hmax : ∀ z ∈ e, ⟪d, z⟫ ≤ ⟪d, a⟫ := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z ∈ convexHull ℝ (V : Set (E n)) := by
      have h1 := face_eq_hull_vertices P he
      rw [h1] at hz
      exact hz
    have hconv : Convex ℝ {y : E n | ⟪d, y⟫ ≤ ⟪d, a⟫} := by
      apply convex_halfSpace_le
      exact (innerSL ℝ d).toLinearMap.isLinear
    have hsub : (V : Set (E n)) ⊆ {y : E n | ⟪d, y⟫ ≤ ⟪d, a⟫} := by
      intro x hx
      exact hamax x (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx)
    exact convexHull_min hsub hconv hz'
  obtain ⟨sa, hsa⟩ := hcoord a hae
  have hsage : 1 ≤ sa := by
    have h1 : ⟪d, u⟫ ≤ ⟪d, a⟫ := hmax u hue
    have h2 : ⟪d, u - w⟫ ≤ ⟪d, a - w⟫ := by
      rw [inner_sub_right, inner_sub_right]
      linarith
    have h3 : ⟪d, u - w⟫ = ⟪d, d⟫ := by rw [hd]
    have h4 := hval a sa hsa
    nlinarith
  have hsapos : 0 < sa := by linarith
  
  have hwex : w ∈ e.extremePoints ℝ := vertice_estremo_in_faccia P he hwV hwe
  have hmin : ∀ z ∈ e, ∀ s : ℝ, z = w + s • d → 0 ≤ s := by
    intro z hz sz hsz
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have hτ : (0:ℝ) < sa - sz := by linarith
    have hne : sa - sz ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hτ
    have hcomb : w ∈ openSegment ℝ z a := by
      refine ⟨sa / (sa - sz), -sz / (sa - sz), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact div_pos hsapos hτ
      · exact div_pos (by linarith) hτ
      · have h5 : sa / (sa - sz) + -sz / (sa - sz) = (sa + -sz) / (sa - sz) :=
          (add_div sa (-sz) (sa - sz)).symm
        rw [h5]
        have h6 : sa + -sz = sa - sz := by ring
        rw [h6]
        exact div_self hne
      · rw [hsz, hsa]
        match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
    have hzw : z = w := hwex.2 hz hae hcomb
    rw [hzw] at hsz
    have h0 : sz • d = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun q => q - w) hsz
      simpa using this.symm
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
    · linarith
    · exact hdne h
  have haPV : a ∈ P.vertices := by
    have h1 := haV
    rw [hV] at h1
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp h1).1
  refine ⟨a, haPV, hae, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    rw [h] at hsa
    have h0 : sa • d = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun q => q - w) hsa
      simpa using this.symm
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h1 | h1
    · linarith
    · exact hdne h1
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hcoord z hz
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hmin z hz s hs
      have hssa : s ≤ sa := by
        have h1 : ⟪d, z⟫ ≤ ⟪d, a⟫ := hmax z hz
        have h2 : ⟪d, z - w⟫ ≤ ⟪d, a - w⟫ := by
          rw [inner_sub_right, inner_sub_right]
          linarith
        have h3 := hval z s hs
        have h4 := hval a sa hsa
        nlinarith
      refine ⟨1 - s / sa, s / sa, ?_, ?_, by ring, ?_⟩
      · have h1 : s / sa ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_one hsapos]
          exact hssa
        linarith
      · exact div_nonneg hs0 (le_of_lt hsapos)
      · rw [hs, hsa]
        match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
    · have hconv : Convex ℝ e := he.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
      exact hconv.segment_subset hwe hae

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.cono_al_vertice
statement:
theorem cono_al_vertice (Q : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) = 2)
    {w : E n} (hwV : w ∈ Q.vertices)
    {e₁ e₂ : Set (E n)} (he₁ : Q.IsFace e₁) (hde₁ : faceDim e₁ = 1)
    (he₂ : Q.IsFace e₂) (hde₂ : faceDim e₂ = 1) (hne : e₁ ≠ e₂)
    {a b : E n} (hae : a ∈ e₁) (haw : a ≠ w) (hseg₁ : e₁ = segment ℝ w a)
    (hbe : b ∈ e₂) (hbw : b ≠ w) (hseg₂ : e₂ = segment ℝ w b)
    (hwe₁ : w ∈ e₁) (hwe₂ : w ∈ e₂) :
    ∀ z ∈ Q.toSet, ∃ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ 0 ≤ t ∧
      z = w + s • (a - w) + t • (b - w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁⟩ := he₁.1 he₁.2
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂⟩ := he₂.1 he₂.2
  have hmax₁ : ∀ y ∈ Q.toSet, l₁ y ≤ l₁ w := by
    have h1 := hwe₁
    rw [hl₁] at h1
    exact h1.2
  have hmax₂ : ∀ y ∈ Q.toSet, l₂ y ≤ l₂ w := by
    have h1 := hwe₂
    rw [hl₂] at h1
    exact h1.2
  have hchar₁ : ∀ q ∈ Q.toSet, l₁ q = l₁ w → q ∈ e₁ := by
    intro q hq hlq
    rw [hl₁]
    exact ⟨hq, fun y hy => le_trans (hmax₁ y hy) (le_of_eq hlq.symm)⟩
  have hchar₂ : ∀ q ∈ Q.toSet, l₂ q = l₂ w → q ∈ e₂ := by
    intro q hq hlq
    rw [hl₂]
    exact ⟨hq, fun y hy => le_trans (hmax₂ y hy) (le_of_eq hlq.symm)⟩
  
  have hl₁a : l₁ a = l₁ w := by
    have h1 := hae
    rw [hl₁] at h1
    exact le_antisymm (hmax₁ a (face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hae))
      (h1.2 w (face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hwe₁))
  have hl₂b : l₂ b = l₂ w := by
    have h1 := hbe
    rw [hl₂] at h1
    exact le_antisymm (hmax₂ b (face_subset_toSet Q he₂ hbe))
      (h1.2 w (face_subset_toSet Q he₂ hwe₂))
  
  have hfuori : ∀ {p : E n}, p ∈ e₂ → p ≠ w → p ∉ e₁ := by
    intro p hpe₂ hpw hpe₁
    have hint : Q.IsFace (e₁ ∩ e₂) := ⟨he₁.1.inter he₂.1, ⟨w, hwe₁, hwe₂⟩⟩
    have hssub : e₁ ∩ e₂ ⊂ e₁ := by
      refine ⟨Set.inter_subset_left, fun hsup => ?_⟩
      have h12 : e₁ ⊆ e₂ := fun z hz => (hsup hz).2
      have hss : e₁ ⊂ e₂ := ⟨h12, fun h => hne (Set.Subset.antisymm h12 h)⟩
      have := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset Q he₁ he₂ hss
      omega
    have hlt := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset Q hint he₁ hssub
    have hge : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (e₁ ∩ e₂)) :=
      finrank_pos_di_due ⟨hwe₁, hwe₂⟩ ⟨hpe₁, hpe₂⟩ hpw
    have hlt' : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (e₁ ∩ e₂)) < 1 := by
      have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (e₁ ∩ e₂)) <
          Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ e₁) := hlt
      have h2 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ e₁) = 1 := hde₁
      omega
    omega
  have hfuori' : ∀ {p : E n}, p ∈ e₁ → p ≠ w → p ∉ e₂ := by
    intro p hpe₁ hpw hpe₂
    exact hfuori hpe₂ hpw hpe₁
  have hl₁b : l₁ b < l₁ w := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hmax₁ b (face_subset_toSet Q he₂ hbe)) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hchar₁ b (face_subset_toSet Q he₂ hbe) h) (hfuori hbe hbw)
  have hl₂a : l₂ a < l₂ w := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hmax₂ a (face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hae)) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hchar₂ a (face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hae) h) (hfuori' hae haw)
  
  have hLI : LinearIndependent ℝ ![a - w, b - w] := by
    rw [linearIndependent_fin2]
    constructor
    · show b - w ≠ 0
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hbw
    · intro c
      show c • (b - w) ≠ a - w
      intro heq
      
      have ha' : a = c • (b - w) + w := by
        have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q + w) heq
        simp at h2
        exact h2.symm
      have hval : l₂ a = c * (l₂ b - l₂ w) + l₂ w := by
        rw [ha']
        simp [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hl₂b] at hval
      simp at hval
      exact absurd (hchar₂ a (face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hae) hval)
        (hfuori' hae haw)
  have hspan2 : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![a - w, b - w]) =
      vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet := by
    have hle : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![a - w, b - w]) ≤
        vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
      rcases i with ⟨iv, hi⟩
      interval_cases iv
      · show (![a - w, b - w] : Fin 2 → E n) 0 ∈ vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet
        show a - w ∈ vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet
        exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ (face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hae)
          (face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hwe₁)
      · show (![a - w, b - w] : Fin 2 → E n) 1 ∈ vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet
        show b - w ∈ vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet
        exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ (face_subset_toSet Q he₂ hbe)
          (face_subset_toSet Q he₂ hwe₂)
    apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle
    rw [finrank_span_eq_card hLI]
    simp [hdim]
  
  intro z hz
  have hzmem : z - w ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![a - w, b - w]) := by
    rw [hspan2]
    exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hz (face_subset_toSet Q he₁ hwe₁)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun (R := ℝ)).mp hzmem
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hc
  have hc' : c 0 • (a - w) + c 1 • (b - w) = z - w := hc
  have hzval : z = w + c 0 • (a - w) + c 1 • (b - w) := by
    have := congrArg (fun q => q + w) hc'
    simp at this
    rw [← this]
    abel
  
  have hs1 : l₁ z = l₁ w + c 1 * (l₁ b - l₁ w) := by
    rw [hzval]
    simp [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul, hl₁a]
  have ht : 0 ≤ c 1 := by
    have h1 := hmax₁ z hz
    rw [hs1] at h1
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    nlinarith
  
  have hs2 : l₂ z = l₂ w + c 0 * (l₂ a - l₂ w) := by
    rw [hzval]
    simp [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul, hl₂b]
  have hs : 0 ≤ c 0 := by
    have h1 := hmax₂ z hz
    rw [hs2] at h1
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨c 0, c 1, hs, ht, hzval⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.locale_globale
statement:
theorem locale_globale (Q : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) = 2)
    {w : E n} (hwV : w ∈ Q.vertices)
    {e₁ e₂ : Set (E n)} (he₁ : Q.IsFace e₁) (hde₁ : faceDim e₁ = 1)
    (he₂ : Q.IsFace e₂) (hde₂ : faceDim e₂ = 1) (hne : e₁ ≠ e₂)
    {a b : E n} (hae : a ∈ e₁) (haw : a ≠ w) (hseg₁ : e₁ = segment ℝ w a)
    (hbe : b ∈ e₂) (hbw : b ≠ w) (hseg₂ : e₂ = segment ℝ w b)
    (hwe₁ : w ∈ e₁) (hwe₂ : w ∈ e₂)
    (h : E n →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hha : h a ≤ h w) (hhb : h b ≤ h w) :
    ∀ z ∈ Q.toSet, h z ≤ h w
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hzval⟩ := cono_al_vertice Q hdim hwV he₁ hde₁ he₂ hde₂
    hne hae haw hseg₁ hbe hbw hseg₂ hwe₁ hwe₂ z hz
  have hval : h z = h w + s * (h a - h w) + t * (h b - h w) := by
    rw [hzval]
    simp [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ h w - h a),
    mul_nonneg ht (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ h w - h b)]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.bandiera_del_residuo
statement:
theorem bandiera_del_residuo (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n)
    {C : Set (E n)} (hC : P.IsFace C) (hdC : faceDim C = (i : ℕ))
    (hsotto : ∀ k : Fin n, (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → F.face k ⊂ C)
    (hsopra : C ⊂ F.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩) :
    ∃ G : P.Flag,
      (∀ k : Fin n, k ≠ i → (k : ℕ) ≠ (i : ℕ) + 1 →
        G.face k = F.face k) ∧
      G.face i = C
proof:
:= by
  let ip : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
  have hsotto' : ∀ j : Fin n, j < i → F.face j ⊂ C := by
    intro j hj
    exact hsotto j hj
  have hsopra' : ∀ j : Fin n, i < j → C ⊂ F.face j :=
    catena_sopra P F (i := i) (ip := ip) (by rfl) hsopra
  let G := sostituisci P F i C hC hdC hsotto' hsopra'
  refine ⟨G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk_i _
    exact sostituisci_face_ne P F i C hC hdC hsotto' hsopra' hk_i
  · exact sostituisci_face_self P F i C hC hdC hsotto' hsopra'

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.bandiera_del_residuo_generale
statement:
theorem bandiera_del_residuo_generale (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hi2 : (i : ℕ) + 2 < n)
    {C : Set (E n)} (hC : P.IsFace C) (hdC : faceDim C = (i : ℕ))
    (hsotto : ∀ k : Fin n, (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → F.face k ⊂ C)
    (hsopra : C ⊂ F.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 2, hi2⟩) :
    ∃ G : P.Flag,
      (∀ k : Fin n, k ≠ i → (k : ℕ) ≠ (i : ℕ) + 1 →
        G.face k = F.face k) ∧
      G.face i = C
proof:
:= by
  let ip : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
  let ip2 : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 2, hi2⟩
  have hrank : faceDim (F.face ip2) = faceDim C + 2 := by
    rw [F.dim_eq ip2, hdC]
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hCD, hDtop, hdD0⟩ :=
    faccia_intermedia P hC (F.isFace ip2) hsopra hrank
  have hdD : faceDim D = (ip : ℕ) := by
    rw [hdD0, hdC]
  have hsotto' : ∀ j : Fin n, j < i → F.face j ⊂ C := by
    intro j hj
    exact hsotto j hj
  have hsopra' : ∀ j : Fin n, ip < j → D ⊂ F.face j :=
    catena_sopra P F (i := ip) (ip := ip2) (by rfl) hDtop
  let G := sostituisci_due P F i ip (by rfl) C D hC hD hdC hdD
    hsotto' hCD hsopra'
  have hi_ne_ip : i ≠ ip := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    omega
  refine ⟨G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk_i hk_ip_val
    have hk_ip : k ≠ ip := by
      intro h
      apply hk_ip_val
      rw [h]
    simp only [G, sostituisci_due, Function.update_of_ne hk_ip,
      Function.update_of_ne hk_i]
  · simp only [G, sostituisci_due, Function.update_of_ne hi_ne_ip,
      Function.update_self]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.bandiera_del_residuo_al_bordo
statement:
theorem bandiera_del_residuo_al_bordo (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hbordo : (i : ℕ) + 2 = n)
    {C : Set (E n)} (hC : P.IsFace C) (hdC : faceDim C = (i : ℕ))
    (hsotto : ∀ k : Fin n, (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → F.face k ⊂ C)
    (hsopra : C ⊂ P.toSet) :
    ∃ G : P.Flag,
      (∀ k : Fin n, k ≠ i → (k : ℕ) ≠ (i : ℕ) + 1 →
        G.face k = F.face k) ∧
      G.face i = C
proof:
:= by
  let ip : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
  have htopdim : faceDim P.toSet = n := hfull
  have hrank : faceDim P.toSet = faceDim C + 2 := by
    rw [htopdim, hdC]
    omega
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hCD, hDtop, hdD0⟩ :=
    faccia_intermedia P hC (toSet_isFace P) hsopra hrank
  have hdD : faceDim D = (ip : ℕ) := by
    rw [hdD0, hdC]
  have hsotto' : ∀ j : Fin n, j < i → F.face j ⊂ C := by
    intro j hj
    exact hsotto j hj
  have hsopra' : ∀ j : Fin n, ip < j → D ⊂ F.face j := by
    intro j hj
    exfalso
    rw [Fin.lt_def] at hj
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  let G := sostituisci_due P F i ip (by rfl) C D hC hD hdC hdD
    hsotto' hCD hsopra'
  have hi_ne_ip : i ≠ ip := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    omega
  refine ⟨G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk_i hk_ip_val
    have hk_ip : k ≠ ip := by
      intro h
      apply hk_ip_val
      rw [h]
    simp only [G, sostituisci_due, Function.update_of_ne hk_ip,
      Function.update_of_ne hk_i]
  · simp only [G, sostituisci_due, Function.update_of_ne hi_ne_ip,
      Function.update_self]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ridgeConnectedAboveOne_of_ridgeConnected
statement:
theorem ridgeConnectedAboveOne_of_ridgeConnected (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (h : RidgeConnected P) : RidgeConnectedAboveOne P
proof:
:= by
  intro B hB _hdB
  exact h B hB

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.chain_ending_at_face
statement:
theorem chain_ending_at_face (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    {A : Set (E n)} (hA : P.IsFace A) {d : ℕ} (hdA : faceDim A = d) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → Set (E n),
      c d = A ∧
      (∀ k, k ≤ d → P.IsFace (c k) ∧ faceDim (c k) = k) ∧
      (∀ j k, j < k → k ≤ d → c j ⊂ c k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q : ConvexPolytope n := facePolytope P hA
  have hQdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) = d := by
    dsimp only [Q]
    rw [facePolytope_toSet P hA]
    exact hdA
  obtain ⟨c', hc'1, hc'2⟩ := chain_exists Q d hQdim
  refine ⟨fun k => if k = d then A else c' k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (if d = d then A else c' d) = A
    rw [if_pos rfl]
  · intro k hk
    change P.IsFace (if k = d then A else c' k) ∧
      faceDim (if k = d then A else c' k) = k
    by_cases hkd : k = d
    · rw [if_pos hkd]
      exact ⟨hA, hdA.trans hkd.symm⟩
    · rw [if_neg hkd]
      have hklt : k < d := by omega
      obtain ⟨hkface, hkdim⟩ := hc'1 k hklt
      exact ⟨isFace_of_facePolytope P hA hkface, hkdim⟩
  · intro j k hjk hk
    change (if j = d then A else c' j) ⊂
      (if k = d then A else c' k)
    by_cases hkd : k = d
    · have hjd : j ≠ d := by omega
      rw [if_pos hkd, if_neg hjd]
      obtain ⟨hjface, hjdim⟩ := hc'1 j (by omega)
      have hjsub : c' j ⊆ A := by
        have := face_subset_toSet Q hjface
        simpa only [Q, facePolytope_toSet P hA] using this
      refine hjsub.ssubset_of_ne ?_
      intro heq
      have := congrArg faceDim heq
      rw [hjdim, hdA] at this
      omega
    · have hklt : k < d := by omega
      have hjd : j ≠ d := by omega
      rw [if_neg hkd, if_neg hjd]
      exact hc'2 j k hjk hklt

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.rechain_below_face
statement:
theorem rechain_below_face (P : ConvexPolytope n) (F : P.Flag)
    (i : Fin n) (hi : 0 < (i : ℕ))
    {R : Set (E n)} (hR : P.IsFace R)
    (hdR : faceDim R + 1 = (i : ℕ)) (hRi : R ⊂ F.face i) :
    ∃ H : P.Flag,
      AgreeAbove P F H (i : ℕ) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin n, j < i → H.face j ⊆ R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d : ℕ := (i : ℕ) - 1
  have hdR' : faceDim R = d := by
    dsimp only [d]
    omega
  obtain ⟨c, hcd, hcface, hcmono⟩ := chain_ending_at_face P hR hdR'
  let H : P.Flag :=
    { face := fun k => if k < i then c k else F.face k
      isFace := by
        intro k
        by_cases hki : k < i
        · rw [if_pos hki]
          exact (hcface k (by dsimp only [d]; omega)).1
        · rw [if_neg hki]
          exact F.isFace k
      dim_eq := by
        intro k
        by_cases hki : k < i
        · rw [if_pos hki]
          exact (hcface k (by dsimp only [d]; omega)).2
        · rw [if_neg hki]
          exact F.dim_eq k
      strict_mono := by
        intro a b hab
        by_cases hbi : b < i
        · have hai : a < i := lt_trans hab hbi
          rw [if_pos hai, if_pos hbi]
          exact hcmono a b hab (by dsimp only [d]; omega)
        · rw [if_neg hbi]
          by_cases hai : a < i
          · rw [if_pos hai]
            have hac : c a ⊆ R := by
              by_cases had : (a : ℕ) = d
              · rw [had, hcd]
              · rw [← hcd]
                exact (hcmono a d (by dsimp only [d]; omega) (le_refl d)).1
            have hib : F.face i ⊆ F.face b := by
              rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (show i ≤ b by omega) with hib | hib
              · rw [hib]
              · exact (F.strict_mono i b hib).1
            have hsub : c a ⊆ F.face b := hac.trans (hRi.1.trans hib)
            refine hsub.ssubset_of_ne ?_
            intro heq
            have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
            rw [(hcface a (by dsimp only [d]; omega)).2, F.dim_eq] at hdim
            omega
          · rw [if_neg hai]
            exact F.strict_mono a b hab }
  refine ⟨H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk
    change F.face k = (if k < i then c k else F.face k)
    rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  · intro j hji
    change (if j < i then c j else F.face j) ⊆ R
    rw [if_pos hji]
    by_cases hjd : (j : ℕ) = d
    · rw [hjd, hcd]
    · rw [← hcd]
      exact (hcmono j d (by dsimp only [d]; omega) (le_refl d)).1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.galleryConnected_of_agreeAbove_of_ridgeConnectedAboveOne
statement:
theorem galleryConnected_of_agreeAbove_of_ridgeConnectedAboveOne
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    (hridge : RidgeConnectedAboveOne P) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ n → ∀ F G : P.Flag,
      AgreeAbove P F G m → GalleryConnected P F G
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h m ih =>
      intro hmn F G hagree
      rcases m with _ | m
      · have hFG := agreeAbove_zero P hagree
        subst G
        exact galleryConnected_refl P F
      · by_cases hm0 : m = 0
        · subst m
          apply galleryConnected_of_agree_except P F G ⟨0, by omega⟩
          intro j hj
          exact hagree j (by
            have hjne : (j : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
              intro hjzero
              apply hj
              apply Fin.ext
              exact hjzero
            omega)
        · have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0
          let i : Fin n := ⟨m, by omega⟩
          have hidim : faceDim (F.face i) = m := F.dim_eq i
          obtain ⟨B, hB, hdB, hFiB, hGiB, hBupper⟩ :
              ∃ B : Set (E n), P.IsFace B ∧ faceDim B = m + 1 ∧
                F.face i ⊂ B ∧ G.face i ⊂ B ∧
                ∀ k : Fin n, i < k → B ⊆ F.face k := by
            by_cases htop : m + 1 = n
            · have htopdim : faceDim P.toSet = n := hfull
              refine ⟨P.toSet, toSet_isFace P, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
              · rw [htopdim, htop]
              · refine (face_subset_toSet P (F.isFace i)).ssubset_of_ne ?_
                intro heq
                have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
                rw [F.dim_eq, htopdim] at hdim
                dsimp only [i] at hdim
                omega
              · refine (face_subset_toSet P (G.isFace i)).ssubset_of_ne ?_
                intro heq
                have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
                rw [G.dim_eq, htopdim] at hdim
                dsimp only [i] at hdim
                omega
              · intro k hik
                exfalso
                have hik' := hik
                change m < (k : ℕ) at hik'
                have hklt := k.isLt
                omega
            · let ip : Fin n := ⟨m + 1, by omega⟩
              have hiip : i < ip := by
                change m < m + 1
                omega
              have hFGip : F.face ip = G.face ip :=
                hagree ip (by dsimp only [ip]; omega)
              refine ⟨F.face ip, F.isFace ip, F.dim_eq ip,
                F.strict_mono i ip hiip, ?_, ?_⟩
              · rw [hFGip]
                exact G.strict_mono i ip hiip
              · intro k hik
                have hik' := hik
                change m < (k : ℕ) at hik'
                have hipkle : ip ≤ k := by
                  change m + 1 ≤ (k : ℕ)
                  omega
                rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hipkle with hipk | hipk
                · rw [hipk]
                · exact (F.strict_mono ip k hipk).1
          have hfaces := hridge B hB (by rw [hdB]; omega)
            (F.face i) (G.face i)
            (F.isFace i) (G.isFace i) hFiB hGiB (by rw [F.dim_eq, hdB])
            (by rw [G.dim_eq, hdB])
          let FaceRel : Set (E n) → Set (E n) → Prop := fun X Y =>
            P.IsFace X ∧ P.IsFace Y ∧ X ⊂ B ∧ Y ⊂ B ∧
              faceDim X + 1 = faceDim B ∧
              faceDim Y + 1 = faceDim B ∧
              ∃ R : Set (E n), P.IsFace R ∧ R ⊂ X ∧ R ⊂ Y ∧
                faceDim R + 2 = faceDim B
          change Relation.ReflTransGen FaceRel (F.face i) (G.face i) at hfaces
          have transfer : ∀ {X : Set (E n)},
              Relation.ReflTransGen FaceRel (F.face i) X →
              ∃ K : P.Flag, GalleryConnected P F K ∧ K.face i = X ∧
                ∀ k : Fin n, i < k → K.face k = F.face k := by
            intro X hpath
            induction hpath with
            | refl =>
                exact ⟨F, galleryConnected_refl P F, rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
            | @tail X Y hprev hstep ihpath =>
                obtain ⟨K, hFK, hKi, hKup⟩ := ihpath
                obtain ⟨hX, hY, _hXB, hYB, _hdX, hdY,
                  R, hR, hRX, hRY, hdR⟩ := hstep
                have hRKi : R ⊂ K.face i := by simpa [hKi] using hRX
                have hdR' : faceDim R + 1 = (i : ℕ) := by
                  dsimp only [i]
                  rw [hdB] at hdR
                  omega
                obtain ⟨H, hKH, hHbelow⟩ :=
                  rechain_below_face P K i (by dsimp only [i]; omega)
                    hR hdR' hRKi
                have hKgalH : GalleryConnected P K H :=
                  ih m (Nat.lt_succ_self m) (by omega) K H hKH
                have hdYi : faceDim Y = (i : ℕ) := by
                  dsimp only [i]
                  rw [hdB] at hdY
                  omega
                have hsottoY : ∀ j : Fin n, j < i → H.face j ⊂ Y := by
                  intro j hji
                  have hsub : H.face j ⊆ Y := (hHbelow j hji).trans hRY.1
                  refine hsub.ssubset_of_ne ?_
                  intro heq
                  have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
                  rw [H.dim_eq, hdYi] at hdim
                  omega
                have hsopraY : ∀ j : Fin n, i < j → Y ⊂ H.face j := by
                  intro j hij
                  have hHF : H.face j = F.face j :=
                    (hKH j (by
                      have hij' := hij
                      change m < (j : ℕ) at hij'
                      omega)).symm.trans (hKup j hij)
                  rw [hHF]
                  have hsub : Y ⊆ F.face j := hYB.1.trans (hBupper j hij)
                  refine hsub.ssubset_of_ne ?_
                  intro heq
                  have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
                  rw [hdYi, F.dim_eq] at hdim
                  omega
                let L : P.Flag := sostituisci P H i Y hY hdYi hsottoY hsopraY
                have hHL : GalleryConnected P H L :=
                  galleryConnected_of_agree_except P H L i (by
                    intro j hji
                    exact (sostituisci_face_ne P H i Y hY hdYi
                      hsottoY hsopraY hji).symm)
                refine ⟨L, hFK.trans (hKgalH.trans hHL),
                  sostituisci_face_self P H i Y hY hdYi hsottoY hsopraY, ?_⟩
                intro k hik
                rw [sostituisci_face_ne P H i Y hY hdYi hsottoY hsopraY
                  (ne_of_gt hik)]
                exact (hKH k (by dsimp only [i]; omega)).symm.trans (hKup k hik)
          obtain ⟨K, hFK, hKi, hKup⟩ := transfer hfaces
          have hKGagree : AgreeAbove P K G m := by
            intro k hk
            by_cases hki : k = i
            · rw [hki, hKi]
            · have hik : i < k := by
                have hkne : (k : ℕ) ≠ m := by
                  intro hkm
                  apply hki
                  apply Fin.ext
                  simpa only [i] using hkm
                change m < (k : ℕ)
                omega
              rw [hKup k hik]
              exact hagree k (by
                have hik' := hik
                change m < (k : ℕ) at hik'
                omega)
          exact hFK.trans (ih m (Nat.lt_succ_self m) (by omega) K G hKGagree)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.galleryConnected_of_ridgeConnectedAboveOne
statement:
theorem galleryConnected_of_ridgeConnectedAboveOne
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    (hridge : RidgeConnectedAboveOne P) (F G : P.Flag) :
    GalleryConnected P F G
proof:
:= by
  apply galleryConnected_of_agreeAbove_of_ridgeConnectedAboveOne
    P hfull hridge n
    (le_refl n) F G
  exact agreeAbove_of_ge P F G (le_refl n)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.galleryConnected_of_ridgeConnected
statement:
theorem galleryConnected_of_ridgeConnected
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    (hridge : RidgeConnected P) (F G : P.Flag) :
    GalleryConnected P F G
proof:
:=
  galleryConnected_of_ridgeConnectedAboveOne P hfull
    (ridgeConnectedAboveOne_of_ridgeConnected P hridge) F G

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.not_ridgeConnected_of_flag_two_le
statement:
theorem not_ridgeConnected_of_flag_two_le
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (F : P.Flag) :
    ¬ RidgeConnected P
proof:
:= by
  intro hridge
  let i0 : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let i1 : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hi01 : i0 < i1 := by
    change 0 < 1
    omega
  have hVδ : F.face i0 ⊂ F.face i1 := F.strict_mono i0 i1 hi01
  obtain ⟨W, hW, _hWunique⟩ := due_vertici_per_spigolo P
    (F.isFace i1) (by simpa only [i1] using F.dim_eq i1)
    (F.isFace i0) (by simpa only [i0] using F.dim_eq i0) hVδ
  have hpath := hridge (F.face i1) (F.isFace i1)
    (F.face i0) W (F.isFace i0) hW.1.1 hVδ hW.1.2.2
    (by rw [F.dim_eq, F.dim_eq])
    (by rw [hW.1.2.1, F.dim_eq])
  have hstep_false : ∀ {X Y : Set (E n)},
      (P.IsFace X ∧ P.IsFace Y ∧ X ⊂ F.face i1 ∧ Y ⊂ F.face i1 ∧
        faceDim X + 1 = faceDim (F.face i1) ∧
        faceDim Y + 1 = faceDim (F.face i1) ∧
        ∃ R : Set (E n), P.IsFace R ∧ R ⊂ X ∧ R ⊂ Y ∧
          faceDim R + 2 = faceDim (F.face i1)) → False := by
    intro X Y h
    obtain ⟨_hX, _hY, _hXB, _hYB, _hdX, _hdY,
      R, _hR, _hRX, _hRY, hdR⟩ := h
    have hdEdge : faceDim (F.face i1) = 1 := by
      simpa only [i1] using F.dim_eq i1
    rw [hdEdge] at hdR
    omega
  have hEq : F.face i0 = W := by
    induction hpath with
    | refl => rfl
    | tail _ hstep _ => exact (hstep_false hstep).elim
  exact hW.2 hEq.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.classe_eq_of_similar_gen
statement:
theorem classe_eq_of_similar_gen {d : ℕ} {P Q : regularPolytopes d}
    (h : regularSimilar d P Q) : classe d P = classe d Q
proof:
:= by
  ext R
  constructor
  · intro hR
    exact similar_trans (similar_symm h) hR
  · intro hR
    exact similar_trans h hR

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_le_tre_di
statement:
theorem platonicCount_le_tre_di {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hrig : ∀ P : regularPolytopes d,
      ∃ i : Fin 3, regularSimilar d P (testimoneAlto d hd i)) :
    platonicCount d ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : {S : Set (regularPolytopes d) |
      ∃ P, S = {Q : regularPolytopes d | regularSimilar d P Q}} ⊆
      Set.range (fun i : Fin 3 => classe d (testimoneAlto d hd i)) := by
    rintro S ⟨P, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hrig P
    exact ⟨i, (classe_eq_of_similar_gen hi).symm⟩
  calc Set.encard {S : Set (regularPolytopes d) |
        ∃ P, S = {Q : regularPolytopes d | regularSimilar d P Q}}
      ≤ Set.encard
        (Set.range (fun i : Fin 3 => classe d (testimoneAlto d hd i))) :=
        Set.encard_le_encard hsub
    _ = Set.encard ((fun i : Fin 3 => classe d (testimoneAlto d hd i)) ''
        Set.univ) := by rw [Set.image_univ]
    _ ≤ Set.encard (Set.univ : Set (Fin 3)) := Set.encard_image_le _ _
    _ = 3 := by simp [Set.encard_univ]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_eq_tre_di
statement:
theorem platonicCount_eq_tre_di {d : ℕ} (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (hd : 5 ≤ d)
    (hrig : ∀ P : regularPolytopes d,
      ∃ i : Fin 3, regularSimilar d P (testimoneAlto d hd1 i)) :
    platonicCount d = 3
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (platonicCount_le_tre_di hd1 hrig) (three_le_platonicCount d hd)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.SpigoloPer.altro_spec
statement:
theorem altro_spec (hv : v ∈ P.vertices) (e : SpigoloPer P v) :
    altro P v hv e ∈ P.vertices ∧ altro P v hv e ∈ e.val ∧
      altro P v hv e ≠ v ∧
      e.val = segment ℝ v (altro P v hv e)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    (spigolo_segmento P e.property.1 e.property.2.1 hv e.property.2.2)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.SpigoloPer.taglio_fatti
statement:
theorem taglio_fatti (hv : v ∈ P.vertices) (l : E 3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : c < l v) (e : SpigoloPer P v)
    (ha : l (altro P v hv e) < c) :
    taglio P v hv l c e ∈ e.val ∧
      l (taglio P v hv l c e) = c ∧
      e.val ∩ {y | l y = c} = {taglio P v hv l c e}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : E 3 := altro P v hv e
  let θ : ℝ := (l v - c) / (l v - l a)
  have hden : 0 < l v - l a := by linarith
  have hnum : 0 < l v - c := by linarith
  have hθ0 : 0 < θ := by
    exact div_pos hnum hden
  have hθ1 : θ < 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one hden]
    linarith
  have hseg : e.val = segment ℝ v a := (altro_spec P v hv e).2.2.2
  have hxform : taglio P v hv l c e = v + θ • (a - v) := rfl
  have hxseg : taglio P v hv l c e ∈ e.val := by
    rw [hseg, hxform]
    refine ⟨1 - θ, θ, by linarith, le_of_lt hθ0, by ring, ?_⟩
    match_scalars <;> ring
  have hxlevel : l (taglio P v hv l c e) = c := by
    rw [hxform]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
    have hdenne : l v - l a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hden
    have hcancel : (l v - c) / (l v - l a) * (l v - l a) = l v - c :=
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ hdenne
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hxseg, hxlevel, Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    have hye : y ∈ segment ℝ v a := by simpa [hseg] using hy.1
    rcases hye with ⟨r, s, hr, hs, hrs, hyform⟩
    have hylevel : l y = c := hy.2
    have hsθ : s = θ := by
      rw [← hyform] at hylevel
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hylevel
      have hrform : r = 1 - s := by linarith
      rw [hrform] at hylevel
      have heq : s * (l v - l a) = l v - c := by linarith
      apply (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hden)).2
      linarith
    have hry : r = 1 - θ := by linarith
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    rw [hxform, ← hyform, hsθ, hry]
    match_scalars <;> ring
  · intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    exact ⟨hxseg, hxlevel⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.esiste_livello_separatore
statement:
theorem esiste_livello_separatore (P : ConvexPolytope 3) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    {v : E 3} (hv : v ∈ P.vertices) :
    ∃ l : E 3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ,
      c < l v ∧ ∀ u ∈ P.vertices, u ≠ v → l u < c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hvface : P.IsFace ({v} : Set (E 3)) := vertex_isFace P hv
  obtain ⟨l, hlmem, hlchar⟩ := espositore_di_faccia P hvface
  have hvT : v ∈ P.toSet := (hlmem v (Set.mem_singleton v)).1
  have hlmax : ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, l y ≤ l v :=
    (hlmem v (Set.mem_singleton v)).2
  have hlstrict : ∀ u ∈ P.vertices, u ≠ v → l u < l v := by
    intro u huV huv
    have huT : u ∈ P.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ huV
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hlmax u huT) with h | h
    · exact h
    · have huSing : u ∈ ({v} : Set (E 3)) :=
        hlchar u huT (fun z hz => le_trans (hlmax z hz) (le_of_eq h.symm))
      exact (huv (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp huSing)).elim
  have hsing_ne : ({v} : Set (E 3)) ≠ P.toSet := by
    intro heq
    have hPdim : faceDim P.toSet = 3 := hfull
    rw [← heq, faceDim_singleton] at hPdim
    omega
  obtain ⟨w, hwV, hwne⟩ := exists_vertex_notMem_of_ne_toSet P hvface hsing_ne
  have hwv : w ≠ v := by
    intro h
    subst w
    exact hwne (Set.mem_singleton v)
  let S : Finset (E 3) := P.vertices.erase v
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨w, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hwv, hwV⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hmS, hmmax⟩ := S.exists_max_image l hSne
  let c : ℝ := (l v + l m) / 2
  have hmlt : l m < l v := by
    exact hlstrict m (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hmS) (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hmS)
  refine ⟨l, c, by dsimp [c]; linarith, ?_⟩
  intro u huV huv
  have huS : u ∈ S := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨huv, huV⟩
  have hule : l u ≤ l m := hmmax u huS
  dsimp [c]
  linarith

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.unico_altro_spigolo_nella_faccetta
statement:
theorem unico_altro_spigolo_nella_faccetta (P : ConvexPolytope 3)
    {v : E 3} (hv : v ∈ P.vertices)
    {A : Set (E 3)} (hA : P.IsFace A) (hdA : faceDim A = 2) (hvA : v ∈ A)
    (e : SpigoloPer P v) (heA : e.val ⊆ A) :
    ∃ e' : SpigoloPer P v, e'.val ⊆ A ∧ e' ≠ e ∧
      ∀ d : SpigoloPer P v, d.val ⊆ A → d ≠ e → d = e'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q : ConvexPolytope 3 := facePolytope P hA
  have hQT : Q.toSet = A := facePolytope_toSet P hA
  have hQdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) = 2 := by
    rw [hQT]
    exact hdA
  have hvQ : v ∈ Q.vertices := by
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, hvA⟩
  have heQ : Q.IsFace e.val := facePolytope_isFace_of P hA e.property.1 heA
  obtain ⟨g, hgQ, hdg, hvg, hgne⟩ :=
    secondo_spigolo Q hQdim hvQ heQ e.property.2.1 e.property.2.2
  have hgP : P.IsFace g := isFace_of_facePolytope P hA hgQ
  have hgA : g ⊆ A := by
    have := face_subset_toSet Q hgQ
    rwa [hQT] at this
  let e' : SpigoloPer P v := ⟨g, hgP, hdg, hvg⟩
  have he'ne : e' ≠ e := by
    intro h
    apply hgne
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  refine ⟨e', hgA, he'ne, ?_⟩
  intro d hdA hde
  have hdQ : Q.IsFace d.val := facePolytope_isFace_of P hA d.property.1 hdA
  by_contra hde'
  have he_g : e.val ≠ g := fun h => hgne h.symm
  have he_d : e.val ≠ d.val := fun h => hde (Subtype.ext h.symm)
  have hg_d : g ≠ d.val := fun h => hde' (Subtype.ext h.symm)
  exact diamante_poligono Q hQdim heQ e.property.2.1 hgQ hdg hdQ d.property.2.1
    he_g he_d hg_d e.property.2.2 hvg d.property.2.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.sezione_faccetta_segmento
statement:
theorem sezione_faccetta_segmento (P : ConvexPolytope 3)
    {v : E 3} (hv : v ∈ P.vertices)
    (l : E 3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : c < l v)
    {A : Set (E 3)} (hA : P.IsFace A) (hdA : faceDim A = 2) (hvA : v ∈ A)
    (e₁ e₂ : SpigoloPer P v) (he₁A : e₁.val ⊆ A) (he₂A : e₂.val ⊆ A)
    (hne : e₁ ≠ e₂)
    (ha₁ : l (SpigoloPer.altro P v hv e₁) < c)
