    minoreGram c 4 = 1 - (c 0) ^ 2 - (c 1) ^ 2 - (c 2) ^ 2
      + (c 0) ^ 2 * (c 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 + 2 from rfl, minoreGram_succ_succ, minoreGram_tre,
    minoreGram_due]; ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coxeterCoeff_eq_cos
statement:
theorem coxeterCoeff_eq_cos (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 1 < n) :
    coxeterCoeff P hreg F j
      = Real.cos (Real.pi / (schlafliDi P hreg F ⟨j, by omega⟩ hj : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coxeterCoeff, dif_pos hj]
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli
statement:
theorem coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (j : ℕ) (hj0 : j < n) (hj : j + 1 < n) :
    coxeterCoeff P hreg F j
      = Real.cos (Real.pi / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨j, hj0⟩ : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coxeterCoeff_eq_cos P hreg F j hj, schlafli_apply P hreg F ⟨j, hj0⟩ hj]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.finestra_classificata
statement:
theorem finestra_classificata (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (s : ℕ) (hs4 : s + 4 ≤ n)
    (ha : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩)
    (hb : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩)
    (hc : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩) :
    (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 3) ∨
      (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 4 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 3) ∨
      (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 4) ∨
      (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 4 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 3) ∨
      (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 5 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 3) ∨
      (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 5)
proof:
:= by
  have hcos0 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F s
      = Real.cos (Real.pi / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F s (by omega) (by omega)
  have hcos1 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F (s + 1)
      = Real.cos (Real.pi / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F (s + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hcos2 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F (s + 2)
      = Real.cos (Real.pi / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F (s + 2) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hD3 := window_minori_positivi P hreg F hn s 3 (by omega)
  rw [minoreGram_tre] at hD3
  have hD4 := window_minori_positivi P hreg F hn s 4 (by omega)
  rw [minoreGram_quattro] at hD4
  simp only [Nat.add_zero, hcos0, hcos1, hcos2] at hD3 hD4
  exact classificazione_dim4 _ _ _ ha hb hc hD3 hD4

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.edge_inside_face_at_vertex
statement:
theorem edge_inside_face_at_vertex (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    {f : Set (E n)} (hf : P.IsFace f) {x : E n}
    (hxV : x ∈ P.vertices) (hxf : x ∈ f) (hdpos : 1 ≤ faceDim f) :
    ∃ e : Set (E n),
      P.IsFace e ∧ faceDim e = 1 ∧ x ∈ e ∧ e ⊆ f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q : ConvexPolytope n := facePolytope P hf
  have hQT : Q.toSet = f := facePolytope_toSet P hf
  have hxQ : x ∈ Q.vertices := by
    change x ∈ P.vertices.filter (· ∈ f)
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hxV, hxf⟩
  let d : ℕ := faceDim f
  have hQdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) = d := by
    change faceDim Q.toSet = d
    rw [hQT]
  have hdpos' : 1 ≤ d := by simpa only [d] using hdpos
  by_cases hd : d = 1
  · refine ⟨f, hf, ?_, hxf, Subset.rfl⟩
    simpa [d] using hd
  · have hd2 : 2 ≤ d := by
      omega
    obtain ⟨c, hc0, hcface, hcmono⟩ :=
      chain_exists_at_vertex Q d hQdim x hxQ
    have hc1 := hcface 1 (by omega)
    have hc01 := hcmono 0 1 (by omega) (by omega)
    have hxc1 : x ∈ c 1 := by
      apply hc01.1
      rw [hc0]
      exact Set.mem_singleton x
    have hc1sub : c 1 ⊆ f := by
      rw [← hQT]
      exact face_subset_toSet Q hc1.1
    exact ⟨c 1, isFace_of_facePolytope P hf hc1.1,
      hc1.2, hxc1, hc1sub⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.balinski_light_general
statement:
theorem balinski_light_general (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    {x₀ xs : E n} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ P.vertices) (hxs : xs ∈ P.vertices) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (GeneralVertexStep P) x₀ xs
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (vertex_isFace P hxs).1 (Set.singleton_nonempty xs)
  have hxsT : xs ∈ P.toSet := by
    have hmem : xs ∈ ({xs} : Set (E n)) := Set.mem_singleton xs
    rw [hl] at hmem
    exact hmem.1
  have hlmax : ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, l y ≤ l xs := by
    have hmem : xs ∈ ({xs} : Set (E n)) := Set.mem_singleton xs
    rw [hl] at hmem
    exact hmem.2
  have hlchar : ∀ q ∈ P.toSet, l q = l xs → q = xs := by
    intro q hq heq
    have hmem : q ∈ ({xs} : Set (E n)) := by
      rw [hl]
      exact ⟨hq, fun y hy => le_trans (hlmax y hy) (le_of_eq heq.symm)⟩
    exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hmem
  let EdgeAdj : E n → E n → Prop := fun p q =>
    p ≠ q ∧ ∃ e : Set (E n),
      P.IsFace e ∧ faceDim e = 1 ∧ p ∈ e ∧ q ∈ e
  have hlocal_global : ∀ x ∈ P.vertices,
      (∀ y ∈ P.vertices, EdgeAdj x y → l y ≤ l x) →
      ∀ z ∈ P.vertices, l z ≤ l x := by
    intro x hxV hlocal z hzV
    by_contra hnot
    have hlxz : l x < l z := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hxFace : P.IsFace ({x} : Set (E n)) := vertex_isFace P hxV
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hxFace.1 hxFace.2
    let w : E n := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (E n)).symm l
    have hwspec : ∀ y : E n, inner ℝ w y = l y := by
      intro y
      dsimp only [w]
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    have hwconst : ∀ y ∈ ({x} : Set (E n)),
        inner ℝ w y = inner ℝ w x := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy]
    have hwup : ∃ u ∈ P.vertices, inner ℝ w x < inner ℝ w u := by
      exact ⟨z, hzV, by simpa only [hwspec] using hlxz⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hxf, himprove⟩ :=
      perno_parametrico_crescente_monotono P hxFace g hg x
        (Set.mem_singleton x) w hwconst hwup
    have hfdimpos : 1 ≤ faceDim f := by
      have hlt := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hxFace hf hxf
      rw [faceDim_singleton] at hlt
      omega
    obtain ⟨e, he, hde, hxe, hef⟩ :=
      edge_inside_face_at_vertex P hf hxV (hxf.1 (Set.mem_singleton x)) hfdimpos
    obtain ⟨y, hyV, hye, hyne, _hseg⟩ :=
      spigolo_segmento P he hde hxV hxe
    have hynot : y ∉ ({x} : Set (E n)) := by
      simpa [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hyne
    have hxylt : l x < l y := by
      have hinc := himprove y (hef hye) hynot
      simpa only [hwspec] using hinc
    have hxyle : l y ≤ l x :=
      hlocal y hyV ⟨hyne.symm, e, he, hde, hxe, hye⟩
    linarith
  have hunique : ∀ z ∈ P.vertices, z ≠ xs → l z < l xs := by
    intro z hzV hzne
    have hzT : z ∈ P.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ hzV
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hlmax z hzT) with hlt | heq
    · exact hlt
    · exact (hzne (hlchar z hzT heq)).elim
  have hwalk := camminata_del_simplesso P.vertices EdgeAdj l
    hlocal_global hxs hunique hx₀
  exact hwalk.mono (by
    rintro p q ⟨hqV, hpq, e, he, hde, hpe, hqe⟩
    exact ⟨hqV, hpq, e, he, hde, hpe, hqe⟩)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.agreeAbove_zero
statement:
theorem agreeAbove_zero (P : ConvexPolytope n) {F G : P.Flag}
    (h : AgreeAbove P F G 0) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  apply flag_ext
  funext k
  exact h k (Nat.zero_le _)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.agreeAbove_mono
statement:
theorem agreeAbove_mono (P : ConvexPolytope n) {F G : P.Flag} {m m' : ℕ}
    (hmm : m ≤ m') (h : AgreeAbove P F G m) : AgreeAbove P F G m'
proof:
:=
  fun k hk => h k (le_trans hmm hk)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.agreeAbove_of_ge
statement:
theorem agreeAbove_of_ge (P : ConvexPolytope n) (F G : P.Flag) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : n ≤ m) : AgreeAbove P F G m
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  exfalso
  have := k.isLt
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.agreeAbove_of_adjacent
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  refine (h.1 k (fun hki => ?_)).symm
  rw [hki] at hk
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.galleryConnected_of_agree_except
statement:
theorem galleryConnected_of_agree_except (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (F G : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (h : ∀ j : Fin n, j ≠ i → F.face j = G.face j) :
    GalleryConnected P F G
proof:
:= by
  by_cases heq : G.face i = F.face i
  · have hFG : F = G := by
      apply flag_ext
      funext k
      by_cases hk : k = i
      · rw [hk, heq]
      · exact h k hk
    rw [hFG]
    exact galleryConnected_refl P G
  · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.single
      ⟨i, ⟨fun j hj => (h j hj).symm, heq⟩⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ridgeStep_symm
statement:
theorem ridgeStep_symm (P : ConvexPolytope n) (B X Y : Set (E n))
    (h : P.IsFace X ∧ P.IsFace Y ∧ X ⊂ B ∧ Y ⊂ B ∧
      faceDim X + 1 = faceDim B ∧ faceDim Y + 1 = faceDim B ∧
      ∃ R : Set (E n), P.IsFace R ∧ R ⊂ X ∧ R ⊂ Y ∧
        faceDim R + 2 = faceDim B) :
    P.IsFace Y ∧ P.IsFace X ∧ Y ⊂ B ∧ X ⊂ B ∧
      faceDim Y + 1 = faceDim B ∧ faceDim X + 1 = faceDim B ∧
      ∃ R : Set (E n), P.IsFace R ∧ R ⊂ Y ∧ R ⊂ X ∧
        faceDim R + 2 = faceDim B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hX, hY, hXB, hYB, hdX, hdY, R, hR, hRX, hRY, hdR⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hY, hX, hYB, hXB, hdY, hdX, R, hR, hRY, hRX, hdR⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.cos_sq_ge_of_six
statement: theorem cos_sq_ge_of_six {m : ℕ} (hm : 6 ≤ m) : (3 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ Real.cos (π / m) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := cos_sq_mono (m := 6) (m' := m) (by norm_num) hm
  have h6 : ((6 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 6 := by norm_num
  rw [h6, cos_pi_div_six_sq] at h
  exact h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.cos_sq_ge_of_three
statement: theorem cos_sq_ge_of_three {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) : (1 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ Real.cos (π / m) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := cos_sq_mono (m := 3) (m' := m) (by norm_num) hm
  have h3 : ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 3 := by norm_num
  rw [h3, cos_pi_div_three_sq] at h
  exact h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ordini_le_five_di_D3
statement:
theorem ordini_le_five_di_D3 {a b : ℕ} (ha : 3 ≤ a) (hb : 3 ≤ b)
    (hD3 : 0 < 1 - Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 - Real.cos (π / b) ^ 2) :
    a ≤ 5 ∧ b ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · by_contra h
    have ha6 : 6 ≤ a := by omega
    have h1 := cos_sq_ge_of_six ha6
    have h2 := cos_sq_ge_of_three hb
    linarith
  · by_contra h
    have hb6 : 6 ≤ b := by omega
    have h1 := cos_sq_ge_of_three ha
    have h2 := cos_sq_ge_of_six hb6
    linarith

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.cos_sq_val
statement:
theorem cos_sq_val {m : ℕ} (h3 : 3 ≤ m) (h5 : m ≤ 5) :
    Real.cos (π / m) ^ 2 = 1/4 ∨ Real.cos (π / m) ^ 2 = 1/2 ∨
      Real.cos (π / m) ^ 2 = (3 + Real.sqrt 5) / 8
proof:
:= by
  interval_cases m
  · left; rw [show ((3:ℕ):ℝ) = 3 by norm_num]; exact cos_pi_div_three_sq
  · right; left; rw [show ((4:ℕ):ℝ) = 4 by norm_num]; exact cos_pi_div_four_sq
  · right; right; rw [show ((5:ℕ):ℝ) = 5 by norm_num]; exact cos_pi_div_five_sq

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.classificazione_dim4
statement:
theorem classificazione_dim4 (a b c : ℕ) (ha : 3 ≤ a) (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hc : 3 ≤ c)
    (hD3 : 0 < 1 - Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 - Real.cos (π / b) ^ 2)
    (hD4 : 0 < 1 - Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 - Real.cos (π / b) ^ 2
      - Real.cos (π / c) ^ 2
      + Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 * Real.cos (π / c) ^ 2) :
    (a = 3 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3) ∨ (a = 4 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3) ∨
    (a = 3 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 4) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ b = 4 ∧ c = 3) ∨
    (a = 5 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 5)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨ha5, hb5⟩ := ordini_le_five_di_D3 ha hb hD3
  
  have hc5 : c ≤ 5 := by
    by_contra h
    have hc6 : 6 ≤ c := by omega
    have hcc := cos_sq_ge_of_six hc6
    have haa := cos_sq_ge_of_three ha
    have hbb := cos_sq_ge_of_three hb
    
    
    have hca1 : Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have := Real.neg_one_le_cos (π / a)
      have := Real.cos_le_one (π / a)
      nlinarith [Real.cos_le_one (π / a), Real.neg_one_le_cos (π / a)]
    nlinarith [hcc, haa, hbb, hca1, hD4, hD3]
  
  obtain ⟨lo, hi⟩ := sqrt_five_bounds
  interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;> interval_cases c <;>
    simp only [show ((3:ℕ):ℝ) = 3 by norm_num, show ((4:ℕ):ℝ) = 4 by norm_num,
      show ((5:ℕ):ℝ) = 5 by norm_num, cos_pi_div_three_sq, cos_pi_div_four_sq,
      cos_pi_div_five_sq] at hD3 hD4 ⊢ <;>
    first
      | tauto
      | (exfalso; nlinarith [lo, hi, hD3, hD4])

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.due_mul_lt_two_pow
statement: theorem due_mul_lt_two_pow : ∀ d : ℕ, 3 ≤ d → 2 * d < 2 ^ d
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  induction d with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n 3 with hn | hn
    · 
      interval_cases n <;> first | omega | norm_num
    · have hstep := ih (by omega)
      have hpow : 2 ≤ 2 ^ n := by
        calc (2 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
          _ ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      calc 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2 := by ring
        _ < 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by omega
        _ = 2 ^ (n + 1) := by ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.cardinalita_distinte
statement:
theorem cardinalita_distinte (d : ℕ) (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    d + 1 < 2 * d ∧ 2 * d < 2 ^ d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by omega, due_mul_lt_two_pow d (by omega)⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.card_tre_iniettiva
statement:
theorem card_tre_iniettiva (d : ℕ) (hd : 5 ≤ d) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin 3 => ![d + 1, 2 * d, 2 ^ d] i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := cardinalita_distinte d hd
  intro i j hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isSymmetry_congr
statement:
theorem isSymmetry_congr (P : ConvexPolytope n) {φ ψ : Isom n}
    (h : ∀ x, φ x = ψ x) (hφ : P.isSymmetry φ) : P.isSymmetry ψ
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry at *
  calc
    (⇑ψ) '' P.toSet = (⇑φ) '' P.toSet :=
      Set.image_congr (fun x _ => (h x).symm)
    _ = P.toSet := hφ

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.mem_symGroup
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_symGroup (P : ConvexPolytope n) {φ : Isom n} :
    φ ∈ symGroup P ↔ P.isSymmetry φ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleGen_sq
statement:
theorem simpleGen_sq (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    simpleGen P hreg F i * simpleGen P hreg F i = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply AffineIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro x
  exact simpleReflection_sq P hreg F i x

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleGen_ne_one
statement:
theorem simpleGen_ne_one (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) : simpleGen P hreg F i ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine simpleReflection_ne_id P hreg F i (fun x => ?_)
  have hv : ((simpleGen P hreg F i : symGroup P) : Isom n) x = x := by
    rw [h]
    simp
  exact hv

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleGen_orderOf
statement:
theorem simpleGen_orderOf (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) : orderOf (simpleGen P hreg F i) = 2
proof:
:= by
  refine orderOf_eq_prime ?_ (simpleGen_ne_one P hreg F i)
  rw [sq]
  exact simpleGen_sq P hreg F i

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleGen_far_sq
statement:
theorem simpleGen_far_sq (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n} (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ)) :
    (simpleGen P hreg F i * simpleGen P hreg F j) *
      (simpleGen P hreg F i * simpleGen P hreg F j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply AffineIsometryEquiv.ext
  intro x
  exact simpleReflection_far_rel P hreg F hij x

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleGen_far_comm
statement:
theorem simpleGen_far_comm (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n} (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ)) :
    simpleGen P hreg F i * simpleGen P hreg F j =
      simpleGen P hreg F j * simpleGen P hreg F i
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (simpleGen P hreg F i)⁻¹ = simpleGen P hreg F i := by
    rw [inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one]
    exact simpleGen_sq P hreg F i
  have hb : (simpleGen P hreg F j)⁻¹ = simpleGen P hreg F j := by
    rw [inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one]
    exact simpleGen_sq P hreg F j
  have h := mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv.mp (simpleGen_far_sq P hreg F hij)
  rwa [mul_inv_rev, ha, hb] at h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleGen_mul_isOfFinOrder
statement:
theorem simpleGen_mul_isOfFinOrder (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i j : Fin n) :
    IsOfFinOrder (simpleGen P hreg F i * simpleGen P hreg F j)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact P.IsFullDim := ⟨hreg.1⟩
  haveI := symGroup_finite P
  exact isOfFinOrder_of_finite _

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coxeterMatrix_diag
statement:
theorem coxeterMatrix_diag (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) : coxeterMatrix P hreg F i i = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold coxeterMatrix
  rw [simpleGen_sq P hreg F i]
  exact orderOf_one

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coxeterMatrix_off_diag_ge
statement:
theorem coxeterMatrix_off_diag_ge (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    2 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact P.IsFullDim := ⟨hreg.1⟩
  haveI := symGroup_finite P
  have hpos : 0 < coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j :=
    orderOf_pos_iff.mpr (simpleGen_mul_isOfFinOrder P hreg F i j)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j) 2 with hlt | hge
  · exfalso
    have h1 : coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j = 1 := by omega
    have hone : simpleGen P hreg F i * simpleGen P hreg F j = 1 :=
      orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp h1
    
    
    have hij' : simpleGen P hreg F i = simpleGen P hreg F j := by
      have hinv := mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv.mp hone
      rw [hinv, inv_eq_iff_mul_eq_one]
      exact simpleGen_sq P hreg F j
    have hflag : adjacentFlag P hreg.1 F i = adjacentFlag P hreg.1 F j := by
      rw [← simpleReflection_mapFlag P hreg F i,
        ← simpleReflection_mapFlag P hreg F j]
      apply flag_ext
      funext k
      show (⇑(simpleReflection P hreg F i)) '' F.face k =
        (⇑(simpleReflection P hreg F j)) '' F.face k
      have hfun : ∀ x, simpleReflection P hreg F i x =
          simpleReflection P hreg F j x := by
        intro x
        exact congrArg (fun g : symGroup P => (g : Isom n) x) hij'
      exact Set.image_congr (fun x _ => hfun x)
    
    have hAi := adjacentFlag_isAdjacent P hreg.1 F i
    have hAj := adjacentFlag_isAdjacent P hreg.1 F j
    rw [hflag] at hAi
    exact hAi.2 (hAj.1 i hij)
  · exact hge

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.funzionale_coniugato
statement:
theorem funzionale_coniugato (g : A ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] A) (l : A →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ (l' : A →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ), ∀ x : A, l (g.symm x) = l' x + c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨l.comp (g.symm.toAffineIsometry.linearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap),
    l (g.symm 0), ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hdec : g.symm x = g.symm.toAffineIsometry.linearIsometry x + g.symm 0 := by
    have hd := (g.symm.toAffineIsometry.toAffineMap).decomp
    have hx := congrFun hd x
    simpa using hx
  rw [hdec, map_add]
  rfl

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.isExposed_image
statement:
theorem isExposed_image (g : A ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] A) {s F : Set A}
    (hF : IsExposed ℝ s F) : IsExposed ℝ ((⇑g) '' s) ((⇑g) '' F)
proof:
:= by
  intro hne
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hF (hne.of_image)
  obtain ⟨l', c, hlc⟩ := funzionale_coniugato g l
  have chiave : ∀ u : A, l' (g u) = l u - c := by
    intro u
    have := hlc (g u)
    rw [g.symm_apply_apply] at this
    linarith
  refine ⟨l', ?_⟩
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, huF, rfl⟩
    have hu : u ∈ {x ∈ s | ∀ y ∈ s, l y ≤ l x} := hl ▸ huF
    refine ⟨⟨u, hu.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro y ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    rw [chiave, chiave]
    have := hu.2 w hw
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, hmax⟩
    refine ⟨u, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [hl]
    refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have h := hmax (g y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [chiave, chiave] at h
    linarith

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.immagine_coniugata
statement:
theorem immagine_coniugata (g σ : A ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] A) (X : Set A) :
    (⇑((g.symm.trans σ).trans g)) '' X
      = (⇑g) '' ((⇑σ) '' ((⇑g.symm) '' X))
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨σ (g.symm x), ⟨g.symm x, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp]
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨w, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    simp [AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp]

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.preserva_symm
statement:
theorem preserva_symm (g : A ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] A) {s : Set A} (hg : (⇑g) '' s = s) :
    (⇑g.symm) '' s = s
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hg]
  rw [Set.image_image]
  simp

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.finrank_vectorSpan_image_le
statement:
theorem finrank_vectorSpan_image_le (g : A ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] A) (F : Set A) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ ((⇑g) '' F))
      ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F)
proof:
:= by
  have himg : ((⇑g) '' F) -ᵥ ((⇑g) '' F)
      = ⇑g.toAffineIsometry.linearIsometry '' (F -ᵥ F) := by
    ext d
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, y, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨u -ᵥ v, ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      have h := g.toAffineIsometry.toAffineMap.linearMap_vsub u v
      simpa using h
    · rintro ⟨d', ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨g u, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, g v, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      have h := g.toAffineIsometry.toAffineMap.linearMap_vsub u v
      simpa using h.symm
  show Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (((⇑g) '' F) -ᵥ ((⇑g) '' F))) ≤ _
  rw [himg, ← LinearIsometry.coe_toLinearMap, Submodule.span_image]
  exact Submodule.finrank_map_le _ _

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.finrank_vectorSpan_image
statement:
theorem finrank_vectorSpan_image (g : A ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] A) (F : Set A) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ ((⇑g) '' F))
      = Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (finrank_vectorSpan_image_le g F) ?_
  have h2 := finrank_vectorSpan_image_le g.symm ((⇑g) '' F)
  have hgs : ⇑g.symm '' ((⇑g) '' F) = F := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    simp
  rwa [hgs] at h2

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.isFacet_image
statement:
theorem isFacet_image (P : FiniteConvexPolytope A) (g : A ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] A)
    (hg : (⇑g) '' P.toSet = P.toSet) {F : Set A} (hF : P.IsFacet F) :
    P.IsFacet ((⇑g) '' F)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, hF.1.2.image ⇑g⟩, ?_⟩
  · have h := isExposed_image g hF.1.1
    rwa [hg] at h
  · rw [finrank_vectorSpan_image]
    exact hF.2

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.iterato_coniugato
statement:
theorem iterato_coniugato (g ρ : A ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] A) (n : ℕ) (x : A) :
    (⇑((g.symm.trans ρ).trans g))^[n] (g x) = g ((⇑ρ)^[n] x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
    have hstep : ((g.symm.trans ρ).trans g) (g x) = g (ρ x) := by
      simp [AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp]
    rw [hstep, ih]

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.isRegularFacet_image
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfacet, hℓ, hp, ρ, x₀, hx₀, himg, hinj, hper, hhull, hdist⟩ := hF
  refine ⟨isFacet_image P g hg hfacet, hℓ, hp,
    (g.symm.trans ρ).trans g, g x₀, ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      have hstep : ((g.symm.trans ρ).trans g) (g u) = g (ρ u) := by
        simp [AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp]
      rw [hstep]
      exact ⟨ρ u, himg ▸ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      have hu' : u ∈ (⇑ρ) '' F := himg.symm ▸ hu
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hu'
      refine ⟨g w, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      simp [AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp]
  · intro i j hij
    simp only [iterato_coniugato] at hij
    exact hinj (g.injective hij)
  · rw [iterato_coniugato, hper]
  · have hg_hull : (⇑g) '' F = (⇑g) '' convexHull ℝ
        (Set.range fun i : Fin p => (⇑ρ)^[(i : ℕ)] x₀) := by rw [← hhull]
    have haff : (⇑g) '' convexHull ℝ (Set.range fun i : Fin p => (⇑ρ)^[(i : ℕ)] x₀)
        = convexHull ℝ ((⇑g) '' (Set.range fun i : Fin p => (⇑ρ)^[(i : ℕ)] x₀)) :=
      AffineMap.image_convexHull g.toAffineIsometry.toAffineMap _
    rw [hg_hull, haff]
    congr 1
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
      show (⇑((g.symm.trans ρ).trans g))^[(i : ℕ)] (g x₀)
        = g ((⇑ρ)^[(i : ℕ)] x₀)
      exact iterato_coniugato g ρ (i : ℕ) x₀
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(⇑ρ)^[(i : ℕ)] x₀, ⟨i, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      show g ((⇑ρ)^[(i : ℕ)] x₀)
        = (⇑((g.symm.trans ρ).trans g))^[(i : ℕ)] (g x₀)
      exact (iterato_coniugato g ρ (i : ℕ) x₀).symm
  · have hstep : ((g.symm.trans ρ).trans g) (g x₀) = g (ρ x₀) := by
      simp [AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp]
    rw [hstep, g.dist_map]
    exact hdist

name: FiniteConvexPolytope.isCyclicVertex_image
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := hv
  have hgsymm : (⇑g.symm) '' P.toSet = P.toSet := preserva_symm g hg
  refine ⟨⟨fun i => (⇑g) '' D.faccetta i,
    fun i => isFacet_image P g hg (D.isFacet i),
    fun i => ⟨v, D.mem_v i, rfl⟩,
    ?_, ?_,
    (g.symm.trans D.σ).trans g,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    intro i j hij
    exact D.distinte ((Set.image_injective.mpr g.injective) hij)
  · 
    intro F hF hgvF
    have hF' : P.IsFacet ((⇑g.symm) '' F) := isFacet_image P g.symm hgsymm hF
    have hvF' : v ∈ (⇑g.symm) '' F := ⟨g v, hgvF, g.symm_apply_apply v⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := D.complete _ hF' hvF'
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [← hi, Set.image_image]
    simp
  · 
    show ((g.symm.trans D.σ).trans g) (g v) = g v
    have h1 : ((g.symm.trans D.σ).trans g) (g v) = g (D.σ (g.symm (g v))) := by
      simp [AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp]
    rw [h1, g.symm_apply_apply, D.fissa_v]
  · 
    rw [immagine_coniugata, hgsymm, D.preserva, hg]
  · 
    intro i
    rw [immagine_coniugata]
    have hpre : (⇑g.symm) '' ((⇑g) '' D.faccetta i) = D.faccetta i := by
      rw [Set.image_image]; simp
    rw [hpre, D.ruota]
  · 
    intro i
    obtain ⟨x, hxv, hx⟩ := D.spigolo i
    refine ⟨g x, fun h => hxv (g.injective h), ?_⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx.1, rfl⟩, ⟨x, hx.2, rfl⟩⟩
  · 
    intro i j x hx hxv hxj
    obtain ⟨⟨u1, hu1, hu1e⟩, ⟨u2, hu2, hu2e⟩⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨u3, hu3, hu3e⟩ := hxj
    have h12 : u2 = u1 := g.injective (by rw [hu1e, hu2e])
    have h13 : u3 = u1 := g.injective (by rw [hu1e, hu3e])
    rw [h12] at hu2
    rw [h13] at hu3
    have hu1v : u1 ≠ v := fun h => hxv (by rw [← hu1e, h])
    exact D.spigolo_due i j u1 ⟨hu1, hu2⟩ hu1v hu3

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.esiste_famiglia_normali
statement:
theorem esiste_famiglia_normali (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) :
    ∃ α p : Fin n → E n, (∀ i : Fin n, ‖α i‖ = 1) ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin n) (x : E n), simpleReflection P hreg F i x =
        x - (2 * ⟪α i, x - p i⟫ : ℝ) • α i
proof:
:= by
  choose α p hnorm hform using
    fun i : Fin n => simpleReflection_formula P hreg F i
  exact ⟨α, p, hnorm, hform⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_diagonale
statement: theorem gram_diagonale {α : E n} (hα : ‖α‖ = 1) : ⟪α, α⟫ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hα]
  norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coxeterMatrix_far
statement:
theorem coxeterMatrix_far (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n} (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ)) :
    coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hne : i ≠ j := by
    intro he
    have : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val he
    omega
  have hge : 2 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j :=
    coxeterMatrix_off_diag_ge P hreg F hne
  have hle : coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j ≤ 2 := by
    unfold coxeterMatrix
    refine orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one (by norm_num) ?_
    rw [pow_two]
    exact simpleGen_far_sq P hreg F hij
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_parte_fondata
statement:
theorem gram_parte_fondata (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (α p : Fin n → E n) (hnorm : ∀ i : Fin n, ‖α i‖ = 1)
    (hform : ∀ (i : Fin n) (x : E n), simpleReflection P hreg F i x =
      x - (2 * ⟪α i, x - p i⟫ : ℝ) • α i) :
    (∀ i : Fin n, ⟪α i, α i⟫ = 1) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin n, (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ) → ⟪α i, α j⟫ = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin n, (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (i : ℕ) → ⟪α i, α j⟫ = 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => gram_diagonale (hnorm i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    exact normali_lontani_ortogonali P hreg F hij (hnorm i) (hform i)
      (hnorm j) (hform j)
  · intro i j hji
    have h := normali_lontani_ortogonali P hreg F hji (hnorm j) (hform j)
      (hnorm i) (hform i)
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    exact h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_coerente_con_coxeter
statement:
theorem gram_coerente_con_coxeter (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (α p : Fin n → E n)
    (hnorm : ∀ i : Fin n, ‖α i‖ = 1)
    (hform : ∀ (i : Fin n) (x : E n), simpleReflection P hreg F i x =
      x - (2 * ⟪α i, x - p i⟫ : ℝ) • α i)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ)) :
    ⟪α i, α j⟫ =
      -Real.cos (Real.pi / (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coxeterMatrix_far P hreg F hij]
  rw [normali_lontani_ortogonali P hreg F hij (hnorm i) (hform i)
    (hnorm j) (hform j)]
  norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.punto_di_faccia0_e_vertice
statement:
theorem punto_di_faccia0_e_vertice (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    {F : Set (E n)} (hF : P.IsFace F) (hdF : faceDim F = 0) :
    Exists fun v : E n =>
      And (F = ({v} : Set (E n))) (Membership.mem P.vertices v)
proof:
:= by
  choose v hFv using faccia_dim0_singoletto hF.2 hdF
  refine Exists.intro v (And.intro hFv ?_)
  have hexposed : IsExposed Real P.toSet ({v} : Set (E n)) := by
    simpa only [hFv] using hF.1
  have hvext : Membership.mem (P.toSet.extremePoints Real) v :=
    hexposed.isExtreme.mem_extremePoints
  have hvertices := P.vertices_eq_extremePoints
  rw [ConvexPolytope.toSet, hvertices.symm] at hvext
  exact hvext

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertice_in_segmento_estremo_generico
statement:
theorem vertice_in_segmento_estremo_generico (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    {delta : Set (E n)} (hdelta : P.IsFace delta) {x y z : E n}
    (hseg : delta = segment Real x y)
    (hz : Membership.mem P.vertices z) (hzdelta : Membership.mem delta z) :
    Or (z = x) (z = y)
proof:
:= by
  have hzext : Membership.mem (delta.extremePoints Real) z :=
    vertice_estremo_in_faccia P hdelta hz hzdelta
  have hxdelta : Membership.mem delta x := by
    rw [hseg]
    exact left_mem_segment Real x y
  have hydelta : Membership.mem delta y := by
    rw [hseg]
    exact right_mem_segment Real x y
  have hzseg : Membership.mem (segment Real x y) z := by
    simpa only [hseg] using hzdelta
  have hends : Or (x = z) (y = z) :=
    (mem_extremePoints_iff_forall_segment.mp hzext).2
      x hxdelta y hydelta hzseg
  exact hends.imp Eq.symm Eq.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.due_vertici_per_spigolo
statement:
theorem due_vertici_per_spigolo (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    {delta : Set (E n)} (hdelta : P.IsFace delta)
    (hddelta : faceDim delta = 1)
    {V : Set (E n)} (hV : P.IsFace V) (hdV : faceDim V = 0)
    (hVdelta : V < delta) :
    ExistsUnique fun W : Set (E n) =>
      And (And (P.IsFace W) (And (faceDim W = 0) (W < delta)))
        (Not (W = V))
proof:
:= by
  choose v hVeq hvP using punto_di_faccia0_e_vertice P hV hdV
  have hvV : Membership.mem V v := by
    rw [hVeq]
    exact Set.mem_singleton v
  have hvdelta : Membership.mem delta v := hVdelta.le hvV
  choose a haP hadelta hav hseg using
    spigolo_segmento P hdelta hddelta hvP hvdelta
  refine ExistsUnique.intro ({a} : Set (E n)) ?_ ?_
  next =>
    have haFace : P.IsFace ({a} : Set (E n)) := vertex_isFace P haP
    have hda : faceDim ({a} : Set (E n)) = 0 := faceDim_singleton a
    have hasub : ({a} : Set (E n)) <= delta :=
      Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hadelta
    have haneqdelta : Not (({a} : Set (E n)) = delta) := by
      intro haeqdelta
      have hdelta0 : faceDim delta = 0 := by
        rw [haeqdelta] at hda
        exact hda
      omega
    have hass : ({a} : Set (E n)) < delta :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hasub haneqdelta
    have haneV : Not (({a} : Set (E n)) = V) := by
      intro haeqV
      apply hav
      have hsingle : ({a} : Set (E n)) = {v} := haeqV.trans hVeq
      exact Set.singleton_injective hsingle
    exact And.intro (And.intro haFace (And.intro hda hass)) haneV
  next =>
    intro W hW
    have hWFace : P.IsFace W := hW.1.1
    have hdW : faceDim W = 0 := hW.1.2.1
    have hWdelta : W < delta := hW.1.2.2
    have hWneV : Not (W = V) := hW.2
    choose x hWeq hxP using punto_di_faccia0_e_vertice P hWFace hdW
    have hxW : Membership.mem W x := by
      rw [hWeq]
      exact Set.mem_singleton x
    have hxdelta : Membership.mem delta x := hWdelta.le hxW
    have hxend := vertice_in_segmento_estremo_generico P hdelta hseg hxP hxdelta
    cases hxend with
    | inl hxv =>
        have hWV : W = V := by
          calc
            W = {x} := hWeq
            _ = {v} := by rw [hxv]
            _ = V := hVeq.symm
        exact (hWneV hWV).elim
    | inr hxa =>
        calc
          W = {x} := hWeq
          _ = {a} := by rw [hxa]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_quattro_eq_sei_di
statement:
theorem platonicCount_quattro_eq_sei_di
    (C24 C600 C120 : ConvexPolytope 4)
    (h24 : C24.IsRegular) (h600 : C600.IsRegular) (h120 : C120.IsRegular)
    (hc24 : C24.vertices.card = 24) (hc600 : C600.vertices.card = 120)
    (hc120 : C120.vertices.card = 600) :
    platonicCount 4 = 6
proof:
:= by
  have hd1 : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by omega
  refine le_antisymm platonicCount_quattro_le_sei ?_
  refine sei_le_platonicCount_quattro_di
    (simplesso 4 hd1) (ortoplesse 4 hd1) (ipercubo 4 hd1) C24 C600 C120
    (simplesso_mem_regularPolytopes 4 hd1)
    (ortoplesse_mem_regularPolytopes 4 hd1)
    (ipercubo_mem_regularPolytopes 4 hd1)
    h24 h600 h120 ?_ ?_ ?_ hc24 hc600 hc120
  · rw [card_simplesso 4 hd1]
  · rw [card_ortoplesse 4 hd1]
  · rw [card_ipercubo 4 hd1]
    norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.adjacentFlag_comm
statement:
theorem adjacentFlag_comm (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n} (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ)) :
    adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F j) i =
      adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F i) j
proof:
:= by
  have hAdjA := adjacentFlag_isAdjacent P hfull F i
  have hAdjB := adjacentFlag_isAdjacent P hfull F j
  set A := adjacentFlag P hfull F i with hA_def
  set B := adjacentFlag P hfull F j with hB_def
  have hi1n : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n := by
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  have hj1n : (j : ℕ) - 1 < n := by
    have := j.isLt
    omega
  have hCface : P.IsFace (A.face i) := A.isFace i
  have hCdim : faceDim (A.face i) = (i : ℕ) := A.dim_eq i
  
  have hsotto : ∀ k : Fin n, k < i → B.face k ⊂ A.face i := by
    intro k hk
    have hkj : k ≠ j := fun he => by
      rw [Fin.lt_def] at hk
      have hv : (k : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val he
      omega
    have hki : k ≠ i := ne_of_lt hk
    rw [hAdjB.1 k hkj, ← hAdjA.1 k hki]
    exact A.strict_mono k i hk
  
  have hsopra : ∀ k : Fin n, i < k → A.face i ⊂ B.face k := by
    intro k hk
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · rw [hkj]
      have h1 : A.face i ⊂ A.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi1n⟩ := by
        refine A.strict_mono i _ ?_
        rw [Fin.lt_def]
        show (i : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) + 1
        omega
      have h1' : A.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi1n⟩ =
          F.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi1n⟩ := by
        refine hAdjA.1 _ (fun he => ?_)
        have hv : (i : ℕ) + 1 = (i : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val he
        omega
      have h2 : F.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi1n⟩ ⊆
          F.face ⟨(j : ℕ) - 1, hj1n⟩ := by
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) - 1) with hlt | hge
        · refine (F.strict_mono _ _ ?_).subset
          rw [Fin.lt_def]
          show (i : ℕ) + 1 < (j : ℕ) - 1
          exact hlt
        · have he : (⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi1n⟩ : Fin n) = ⟨(j : ℕ) - 1, hj1n⟩ := by
            apply Fin.ext
            show (i : ℕ) + 1 = (j : ℕ) - 1
            omega
          rw [he]
      have h3 : F.face ⟨(j : ℕ) - 1, hj1n⟩ = B.face ⟨(j : ℕ) - 1, hj1n⟩ := by
        refine (hAdjB.1 _ (fun he => ?_)).symm
        have hv : (j : ℕ) - 1 = (j : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val he
        omega
      have h4 : B.face ⟨(j : ℕ) - 1, hj1n⟩ ⊂ B.face j := by
        refine B.strict_mono _ j ?_
        rw [Fin.lt_def]
        show (j : ℕ) - 1 < (j : ℕ)
        omega
      have hstep : A.face i ⊂ F.face ⟨(j : ℕ) - 1, hj1n⟩ := by
        refine ssubset_of_ssubset_of_subset ?_ h2
        rw [← h1']
        exact h1
      rw [h3] at hstep
      exact hstep.trans h4
    · have hki : k ≠ i := (ne_of_lt hk).symm
      rw [hAdjB.1 k hkj, ← hAdjA.1 k hki]
      exact A.strict_mono i k hk
  
  have hHB : FlagAdjacentAt P B
      (sostituisci P B i (A.face i) hCface hCdim hsotto hsopra) i := by
    constructor
    · intro k hk
      exact sostituisci_face_ne P B i (A.face i) hCface hCdim hsotto hsopra hk
    · rw [sostituisci_face_self]
      have hBi : B.face i = F.face i := by
        refine hAdjB.1 i (fun he => ?_)
        have hv : (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val he
        omega
      rw [hBi]
      exact hAdjA.2
  
  have hHA : FlagAdjacentAt P A
      (sostituisci P B i (A.face i) hCface hCdim hsotto hsopra) j := by
    constructor
    · intro k hk
      by_cases hki : k = i
      · rw [hki, sostituisci_face_self]
      · rw [sostituisci_face_ne P B i (A.face i) hCface hCdim hsotto hsopra
          hki, hAdjB.1 k hk, hAdjA.1 k hki]
    · have hji : j ≠ i := fun he => by
        have hv : (j : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val he
        omega
      rw [sostituisci_face_ne P B i (A.face i) hCface hCdim hsotto hsopra hji]
      have hAj : A.face j = F.face j := hAdjA.1 j hji
      rw [hAj]
      exact hAdjB.2
  have e1 : sostituisci P B i (A.face i) hCface hCdim hsotto hsopra =
      adjacentFlag P hfull B i :=
    adjacentFlag_eq_of_isAdjacent P hfull i hHB
  have e2 : sostituisci P B i (A.face i) hCface hCdim hsotto hsopra =
      adjacentFlag P hfull A j :=
    adjacentFlag_eq_of_isAdjacent P hfull j hHA
  rw [← e1, ← e2]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.adjacentFlag_comm_far
statement:
theorem adjacentFlag_comm_far (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ) ∨ (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (i : ℕ)) :
    adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F j) i =
      adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F i) j
proof:
:= by
  rcases hij with h | h
  · exact adjacentFlag_comm P hfull F h
  · exact (adjacentFlag_comm P hfull F h).symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isExposed_image_isomN
statement:
theorem isExposed_image_isomN (φ : Isom n) {A B : Set (E n)}
    (h : IsExposed ℝ A B) : IsExposed ℝ ((⇑φ) '' A) ((⇑φ) '' B)
proof:
:= by
  intro hne
  obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨a, haB, hab⟩ := hbB
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h ⟨a, haB⟩
  let l' : E n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    l.comp φ.symm.linearIsometryEquiv.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hl' (x : E n) : l' (φ x) = l x - l (φ.symm 0) := by
    have hm := φ.symm.map_vsub (φ x) 0
    have hm' : φ.symm.linearIsometryEquiv (φ x) = x - φ.symm 0 := by
      simpa using hm
    simp only [l', ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    change l (φ.symm.linearIsometryEquiv (φ x)) = _
    rw [hm', map_sub]
  refine ⟨l', Set.ext ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    rw [hl] at hb
    refine ⟨⟨b, hb.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [hl' y, hl' b]
    exact sub_le_sub_right (hb.2 y hy) _
  · rintro ⟨hxA, hxmax⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hxA
    refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [hl]
    refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hle := hxmax (φ y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faceDim_image_isomN
statement:
theorem faceDim_image_isomN (φ : Isom n) (F : Set (E n)) :
    faceDim ((⇑φ) '' F) = faceDim F
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvexPolytope.faceDim
  have hmap := φ.toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.map_vectorSpan (s := F)
  change Submodule.map (φ.toAffineEquiv.linear : E n →ₗ[ℝ] E n)
    (vectorSpan ℝ F) = vectorSpan ℝ ((⇑φ) '' F) at hmap
  rw [← hmap]
  exact φ.toAffineEquiv.linear.finrank_map_eq (vectorSpan ℝ F)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isFace_image_isomN
statement:
theorem isFace_image_isomN {P : ConvexPolytope n} (φ : Isom n)
    (hφ : P.isSymmetry φ) {F : Set (E n)} (hF : P.IsFace F) :
    P.IsFace ((⇑φ) '' F)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, hF.2.image _⟩
  rw [← hφ]
  exact isExposed_image_isomN φ hF.1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.symmetry_transN
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry at *
  calc
    (⇑(φ.trans ψ)) '' P.toSet = (⇑ψ) '' ((⇑φ) '' P.toSet) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
      rfl
    _ = P.toSet := by rw [hφ, hψ]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.symmetry_symmN

theorem symmetry_symmN {P : ConvexPolytope n} {φ : Isom n}

proof:

    (⇑φ.symm) '' P.toSet = (⇑φ.symm) '' ((⇑φ) '' P.toSet) := by rw [hφ]

proof:

theorem mapFlag_adjacentFlag (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    {φ : Isom n} (hφ : P.isSymmetry φ) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    mapFlag P hφ (adjacentFlag P hfull F i) =
      adjacentFlag P hfull (mapFlag P hφ F) i
proof:
:=

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.flag_finite
statement: theorem flag_finite (P : ConvexPolytope n) : Finite P.Flag
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite {f : Set (E n) // P.IsFace f} :=
    Set.Finite.to_subtype (facce_finite P)
  refine Finite.of_injective
    (f := fun F : P.Flag =>
      (fun k : Fin n => (⟨F.face k, F.isFace k⟩ : {f : Set (E n) // P.IsFace f})))
    ?_
  intro F G h
  apply flag_ext
  funext k
  have hk := congrFun h k
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hk

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.symmetry_action_injective
statement:
theorem symmetry_action_injective (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) {φ ψ : Isom n}
    (hφ : P.isSymmetry φ) (hψ : P.isSymmetry ψ)
    (h : mapFlag P hφ F = mapFlag P hψ F) : ∀ x : E n, φ x = ψ x
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : P.isSymmetry (φ.trans ψ.symm) :=
    symmetry_transN hφ (symmetry_symmN hψ)
  have hfix : ∀ k : Fin n, (⇑(φ.trans ψ.symm)) '' F.face k = F.face k := by
    intro k
    have hk := congrArg (fun G : P.Flag => G.face k) h
    simp only [mapFlag_face] at hk
    calc
      (⇑(φ.trans ψ.symm)) '' F.face k
          = (⇑ψ.symm) '' ((⇑φ) '' F.face k) := by
            rw [Set.image_image]
            rfl
      _ = (⇑ψ.symm) '' ((⇑ψ) '' F.face k) := by rw [hk]
      _ = F.face k := ψ.toEquiv.symm_image_image _
  have hid := bandiera_fissata_id P hfull hcomp F hfix
  intro x
  have hx := hid x
  have hx' : ψ.symm (φ x) = x := by simpa using hx
  calc
    φ x = ψ (ψ.symm (φ x)) := (ψ.apply_symm_apply _).symm
    _ = ψ x := by rw [hx']

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.symmetries_finite
statement:
theorem symmetries_finite (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim) :
    Finite {φ : Isom n // P.isSymmetry φ}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := flag_exists P hfull
  haveI := flag_finite P
  refine Finite.of_injective
    (f := fun φ : {φ : Isom n // P.isSymmetry φ} => mapFlag P φ.2 F) ?_
  intro φ ψ h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact AffineIsometryEquiv.ext
    (symmetry_action_injective P hfull F φ.2 ψ.2 h)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.prodotto_riflessioni_traccia
statement:
theorem prodotto_riflessioni_traccia {α β : E n} (hα : ‖α‖ = 1)
    (hβ : ‖β‖ = 1) (s : E n → E n)
    (hs : ∀ x, s x = (x - (2 * ⟪β, x⟫ : ℝ) • β) -
      (2 * ⟪α, x - (2 * ⟪β, x⟫ : ℝ) • β⟫ : ℝ) • α) :
    s α = ((4 * ⟪α, β⟫ ^ 2 - 1 : ℝ)) • α -
        ((2 * ⟪α, β⟫ : ℝ)) • β ∧
      s β = ((2 * ⟪α, β⟫ : ℝ)) • α - β
proof:
:= by
  have hαα : (⟪α, α⟫ : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hα]
    norm_num
  have hββ : (⟪β, β⟫ : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hβ]
    norm_num
  have hβα : (⟪β, α⟫ : ℝ) = ⟪α, β⟫ := (real_inner_comm β α).symm
  constructor
  · rw [hs α]
    simp only [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hαα, hβα]
    match_scalars <;> ring
  · rw [hs β]
    simp only [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hββ]
    match_scalars <;> ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coseno_di_ordine
statement:
theorem coseno_di_ordine {α β : E n} (hα : ‖α‖ = 1) (hβ : ‖β‖ = 1)
    (hind : ∀ t : ℝ, β ≠ t • α) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (s : E n → E n)
    (hs : ∀ x, s x = (x - (2 * ⟪β, x⟫ : ℝ) • β) -
      (2 * ⟪α, x - (2 * ⟪β, x⟫ : ℝ) • β⟫ : ℝ) • α)
    (hord : ∀ x : E n, s^[m] x = x) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, k < m ∧
      ((⟪α, β⟫ : ℝ) = Real.cos (k * Real.pi / m) ∨
       (⟪α, β⟫ : ℝ) = -Real.cos (k * Real.pi / m))
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℝ := ⟪α, β⟫
  have hαα : (⟪α, α⟫ : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hα]
    norm_num
  have hββ : (⟪β, β⟫ : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hβ]
    norm_num
  have hβα : (⟪β, α⟫ : ℝ) = c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    exact (real_inner_comm β α).symm
  have hαβ : (⟪α, β⟫ : ℝ) = c := rfl
  have hα_ne : α ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, norm_zero] at hα
    norm_num at hα
  have hlin : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      s (a • α + b • β) =
        (((4 * c ^ 2 - 1) * a + 2 * c * b) : ℝ) • α +
        ((-2 * c * a - b : ℝ)) • β := by
    intro a b
    rw [hs (a • α + b • β)]
    simp only [inner_sub_right, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right,
      hαα, hββ, hβα, hαβ]
    match_scalars <;> ring
  let T : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun p =>
    (((4 * c ^ 2 - 1) * p.1 + 2 * c * p.2),
      (-2 * c * p.1 - p.2))
  let v : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ := fun q => T^[q] (1, 0)
  have hv_zero : v 0 = (1, 0) := by simp [v]
  have hv_succ (q : ℕ) : v (q + 1) = T (v q) := by
    simp only [v, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
  have hs_iter : ∀ q : ℕ,
      s^[q] α = (v q).1 • α + (v q).2 • β := by
    intro q
    induction q with
    | zero => simp [hv_zero]
    | succ q ih =>
        calc
          s^[q + 1] α = s (s^[q] α) := by
            rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
          _ = s ((v q).1 • α + (v q).2 • β) := congrArg s ih
          _ = (((4 * c ^ 2 - 1) * (v q).1 + 2 * c * (v q).2) : ℝ) • α +
              ((-2 * c * (v q).1 - (v q).2 : ℝ)) • β :=
            hlin (v q).1 (v q).2
          _ = (v (q + 1)).1 • α + (v (q + 1)).2 • β := by
            rw [hv_succ]
  have hvm_vec : (v m).1 • α + (v m).2 • β = α := by
    exact (hs_iter m).symm.trans (hord α)
  have hvm_snd : (v m).2 = 0 := by
    by_contra hb
    apply hind (((v m).2)⁻¹ * (1 - (v m).1))
    have hrel : (v m).2 • β = (1 - (v m).1) • α := by
      calc
        (v m).2 • β = α - (v m).1 • α := by
          exact (eq_sub_iff_add_eq).mpr (by simpa [add_comm] using hvm_vec)
        _ = (1 - (v m).1) • α := by
          match_scalars
          ring
    have hscaled := congrArg (fun x : E n => ((v m).2)⁻¹ • x) hrel
    simpa [smul_smul, hb] using hscaled
  have hvm_fst : (v m).1 = 1 := by
    have heq : (v m).1 • α = α := by simpa [hvm_snd] using hvm_vec
    have hz : ((v m).1 - 1) • α = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul, heq, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((smul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hα_ne)
  have hvm : v m = (1, 0) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hvm_fst
    · exact hvm_snd
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · have hsα_iter : ∀ q : ℕ, s^[q] α = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ q) • α := by
      intro q
      induction q with
      | zero => simp
      | succ q ih =>
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, hs]
          simp only [inner_smul_right, hβα, hc, mul_zero, zero_smul,
            sub_zero, hαα]
          match_scalars
          ring
    have hpow : (-1 : ℝ) ^ m = 1 := by
      have heq : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ m) • α = (1 : ℝ) • α := by
        simpa [hsα_iter m] using hord α
      exact (smul_left_injective ℝ hα_ne) heq
    have heven : Even m :=
      (neg_one_pow_eq_one_iff_even (R := ℝ) (by norm_num)).mp hpow
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := heven
    have hqpos : 0 < q := by omega
    refine ⟨q, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩
    change c = Real.cos ((q : ℝ) * Real.pi / (m : ℝ))
    rw [hc]
    have hang : (q : ℝ) * Real.pi / (m : ℝ) = Real.pi / 2 := by
      rw [hq]
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hang, Real.cos_pi_div_two]
  · have habs : |c| ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp only [c]
      simpa [hα, hβ] using abs_real_inner_le_norm α β
    have hrad : 0 ≤ 1 - c ^ 2 := by
      have := (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one c).mpr habs
      linarith
    let d : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1 - c ^ 2)
    have hd_sq : d ^ 2 = 1 - c ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [d]
      exact Real.sq_sqrt hrad
    let lam : ℂ := ((2 * c ^ 2 - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) +
      ((2 * c * d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hchar : lam ^ 2 - (((4 * c ^ 2 - 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * lam) + 1 = 0 := by
      dsimp only [lam]
      have hd_sq' : (d : ℂ) ^ 2 = 1 - (c : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
        exact_mod_cast hd_sq
      push_cast
      ring_nf
      rw [Complex.I_sq, hd_sq']
      ring
    have htrace_cast : (((4 * c ^ 2 - 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        4 * (c : ℂ) ^ 2 - 2 := by
      push_cast
      ring
    have hchar' : lam ^ 2 - (4 * (c : ℂ) ^ 2 - 2) * lam + 1 = 0 := by
      rw [← htrace_cast]
      exact hchar
    let z : ℕ → ℂ := fun q =>
      (lam + 1) * ((v q).1 : ℂ) + ((2 * c : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((v q).2 : ℂ)
    have hz_succ (q : ℕ) : z (q + 1) = lam * z q := by
      rw [show z (q + 1) =
          (lam + 1) * ((v (q + 1)).1 : ℂ) +
            ((2 * c : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((v (q + 1)).2 : ℂ) from rfl,
        hv_succ]
      change (lam + 1) *
          (((4 * c ^ 2 - 1) * (v q).1 + 2 * c * (v q).2 : ℝ) : ℂ) +
          ((2 * c : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            (((-2 * c * (v q).1 - (v q).2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) = lam * z q
      dsimp only [z]
      push_cast
      linear_combination (norm := ring) (-((v q).1 : ℂ)) * hchar'
    have hz_pow : ∀ q : ℕ, z q = lam ^ q * (lam + 1) := by
      intro q
      induction q with
      | zero => simp [z, hv_zero]
      | succ q ih =>
          rw [hz_succ, ih, pow_succ]
          ring
    have hlam_add : lam + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have hre := congrArg Complex.re hzero
      simp [lam, pow_two, Complex.mul_re] at hre
      exact hc hre
    have hlampow : lam ^ m = 1 := by
      have hz_m : z m = lam + 1 := by simp [z, hvm]
      have heq : lam ^ m * (lam + 1) = 1 * (lam + 1) := by
        rw [← hz_pow m, hz_m, one_mul]
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ hlam_add heq
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by omega
    letI : NeZero m := ⟨hm0⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hkm, hklam⟩ :=
      (Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp m hm0).eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hlampow
    have hklam' :
        Complex.exp (((k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / (m : ℂ)))) = lam := by
      rw [Complex.exp_nat_mul]
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hklam
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re hklam'
    have hrelam : lam.re = 2 * c ^ 2 - 1 := by
      simp [lam, pow_two, Complex.mul_re]
    have hexp_re :
        (Complex.exp (((k : ℂ) *
          (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / (m : ℂ))))).re =
          Real.cos (2 * ((k : ℝ) * Real.pi / (m : ℝ))) := by
      rw [Complex.exp_re]
      simp
      congr 1
      field_simp
    rw [hexp_re, hrelam, Real.cos_two_mul] at hre
    have hsq : c ^ 2 = Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * Real.pi / (m : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
      linarith
    rcases (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp hsq) with hpos | hneg
    · exact ⟨k, hkm, Or.inl (by simpa [c] using hpos)⟩
    · exact ⟨k, hkm, Or.inr (by simpa [c] using hneg)⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coseno_di_ordine_generale
statement:
theorem coseno_di_ordine_generale {α β : E n} (hα : ‖α‖ = 1)
    (hβ : ‖β‖ = 1) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (s : E n → E n)
    (hs : ∀ x, s x = (x - (2 * ⟪β, x⟫ : ℝ) • β) -
      (2 * ⟪α, x - (2 * ⟪β, x⟫ : ℝ) • β⟫ : ℝ) • α)
    (hord : ∀ x : E n, s^[m] x = x) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, k < m ∧
      ((⟪α, β⟫ : ℝ) = Real.cos (k * Real.pi / m) ∨
       (⟪α, β⟫ : ℝ) = -Real.cos (k * Real.pi / m))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hind : ∀ t : ℝ, β ≠ t • α
  · exact coseno_di_ordine hα hβ hind m hm s hs hord
  · push Not at hind
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hind
    have habst : |t| = 1 := by
      have hn := congrArg norm ht
      rw [hβ, norm_smul, hα, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hn
      exact hn.symm
    have ht_sq : t ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) habst
      simpa using this
    have hinner : (⟪α, β⟫ : ℝ) = t := by
      rw [ht, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hα]
      norm_num
    rcases (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp ht_sq) with ht1 | htm1
    · refine ⟨0, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩
      simp [hinner, ht1]
    · refine ⟨0, by omega, Or.inr ?_⟩
      simp [hinner, htm1]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coseno_di_coxeter_assoluto
statement:
theorem coseno_di_coxeter_assoluto (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    {αi pi αj pj : E n} (hαi : ‖αi‖ = 1) (hαj : ‖αj‖ = 1)
    (hri : ∀ x : E n, simpleReflection P hreg F i x =
      x - (2 * ⟪αi, x - pi⟫ : ℝ) • αi)
    (hrj : ∀ x : E n, simpleReflection P hreg F j x =
      x - (2 * ⟪αj, x - pj⟫ : ℝ) • αj) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, k < coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j ∧
      |(⟪αi, αj⟫ : ℝ)| =
        |Real.cos (k * Real.pi / (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j : ℝ))|
proof:
:= by
  let ri : E n → E n := simpleReflection P hreg F i
  let rj : E n → E n := simpleReflection P hreg F j
  let g : E n → E n := fun x => ri (rj x)
  let s : E n → E n := fun x =>
    (x - (2 * ⟪αj, x⟫ : ℝ) • αj) -
      (2 * ⟪αi, x - (2 * ⟪αj, x⟫ : ℝ) • αj⟫ : ℝ) • αi
  have hs : ∀ x : E n, s x =
      (x - (2 * ⟪αj, x⟫ : ℝ) • αj) -
        (2 * ⟪αi, x - (2 * ⟪αj, x⟫ : ℝ) • αj⟫ : ℝ) • αi :=
    fun _ => rfl
  have hdiff : ∀ x v : E n, g (x + v) - g x = s v := by
    intro x v
    dsimp only [g, ri, rj]
    rw [hrj (x + v), hri, hrj x, hri]
    dsimp only [s]
    simp only [inner_sub_right, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    match_scalars <;> ring
  let a : symGroup P := simpleGen P hreg F i * simpleGen P hreg F j
  let m : ℕ := coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j
  have ha_iter : ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ x : E n,
      (((a ^ q : symGroup P) : Isom n) x) = g^[q] x := by
    intro q
    induction q with
    | zero => intro x; simp
    | succ q ih =>
        intro x
        rw [pow_succ, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        change (((a ^ q : symGroup P) : Isom n)
          (((a : symGroup P) : Isom n) x)) = g^[q] (g x)
        rw [ih]
        rfl
  have ha_pow : a ^ m = 1 := by
    dsimp only [a, m, coxeterMatrix]
    exact pow_orderOf_eq_one _
  have hg_period : ∀ x : E n, g^[m] x = x := by
    intro x
    have heval := congrArg (fun u : symGroup P => ((u : Isom n) x)) ha_pow
    rw [ha_iter] at heval
    simpa using heval
  have hdiff_iter : ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ x v : E n,
      g^[q] (x + v) - g^[q] x = s^[q] v := by
    intro q
    induction q with
    | zero =>
        intro x v
        simp
    | succ q ih =>
        intro x v
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        have hq := ih x v
        have harg : g^[q] (x + v) = g^[q] x + s^[q] v := by
          exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hq |>.trans (add_comm _ _)
        rw [harg, hdiff]
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
  have hs_period : ∀ v : E n, s^[m] v = v := by
    intro v
    have h := hdiff_iter m 0 v
    rw [zero_add, hg_period, hg_period] at h
    simpa using h.symm
  have hm : 2 ≤ m := by
    dsimp only [m]
    exact coxeterMatrix_off_diag_ge P hreg F hij
  obtain ⟨k, hkm, hk⟩ :=
    coseno_di_ordine_generale hαi hαj m hm s hs hs_period
  refine ⟨k, by simpa [m] using hkm, ?_⟩
  rcases hk with hk | hk
  · simpa [m] using congrArg abs hk
  · simpa [m] using congrArg abs hk

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ripiega_coseno
statement:
theorem ripiega_coseno {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hk : k < m) :
    ∃ l : ℕ, l < m ∧
      |Real.cos (k * Real.pi / (m : ℝ))| =
        Real.cos (l * Real.pi / (m : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  by_cases hhalf : 2 * k ≤ m
  · refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    apply abs_of_nonneg
    apply Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * Real.pi / (m : ℝ) := by positivity
    refine ⟨le_trans (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) hx0, ?_⟩
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hmR]
    have hhalfR : (2 : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hhalf
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  · have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
    have hkmle : k ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt hk
    have hlm : m - k < m := by omega
    have hhalf' : 2 * (m - k) ≤ m := by omega
    let l : ℕ := m - k
    have hl_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.cos (l * Real.pi / (m : ℝ)) := by
      apply Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc
      have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (l : ℝ) * Real.pi / (m : ℝ) := by positivity
      refine ⟨le_trans (by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]) hy0, ?_⟩
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hmR]
      have hhalfR : (2 : ℝ) * (l : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
        dsimp only [l]
        exact_mod_cast hhalf'
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hang : (l : ℝ) * Real.pi / (m : ℝ) =
        Real.pi - (k : ℝ) * Real.pi / (m : ℝ) := by
      dsimp only [l]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hkmle]
      field_simp
    have hcos : Real.cos (l * Real.pi / (m : ℝ)) =
        -Real.cos (k * Real.pi / (m : ℝ)) := by
      rw [hang, Real.cos_pi_sub]
    have hk_nonpos : Real.cos (k * Real.pi / (m : ℝ)) ≤ 0 := by
      linarith
    refine ⟨l, by simpa [l] using hlm, ?_⟩
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hk_nonpos]
    exact hcos.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coseno_di_coxeter
statement:
theorem coseno_di_coxeter (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j)
    {αi pi αj pj : E n} (hαi : ‖αi‖ = 1) (hαj : ‖αj‖ = 1)
    (hri : ∀ x : E n, simpleReflection P hreg F i x =
      x - (2 * ⟪αi, x - pi⟫ : ℝ) • αi)
    (hrj : ∀ x : E n, simpleReflection P hreg F j x =
      x - (2 * ⟪αj, x - pj⟫ : ℝ) • αj) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, |(⟪αi, αj⟫ : ℝ)| =
      Real.cos (k * Real.pi / (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hkm, hk⟩ :=
    coseno_di_coxeter_assoluto P hreg F hij hαi hαj hri hrj
  have hmpos : 0 < coxeterMatrix P hreg F i j := by
    have := coxeterMatrix_off_diag_ge P hreg F hij
    omega
  obtain ⟨l, _hlm, hl⟩ := ripiega_coseno hmpos hkm
  refine ⟨l, hk.trans ?_⟩
  exact hl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gramMatrix_isHermitian
statement:
theorem gramMatrix_isHermitian (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) : (gramMatrix P hreg F).IsHermitian
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [gramMatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, real_inner_comm]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gramMatrix_posDef
statement:
theorem gramMatrix_posDef (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : (gramMatrix P hreg F).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos (gramMatrix_isHermitian P hreg F)
  intro x hx
  have hform := gram_canonica_forma_positiva P hreg F hn x hx
  have heq : star x ⬝ᵥ (gramMatrix P hreg F).mulVec x
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, x i * x j *
          ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F i, normaleOrientato P hreg F j⟫ := by
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, gramMatrix, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    ring
  rw [heq]; exact hform

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_leading_posDef
statement:
theorem gram_leading_posDef (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    ((gramMatrix P hreg F).submatrix (Fin.castLE hk) (Fin.castLE hk)).PosDef
proof:
:=
  (gramMatrix_posDef P hreg F hn).submatrix (Fin.castLE_injective hk)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_leading_det_pos
statement:
theorem gram_leading_det_pos (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    0 < ((gramMatrix P hreg F).submatrix (Fin.castLE hk) (Fin.castLE hk)).det
proof:
:=
  (gram_leading_posDef P hreg F hn k hk).det_pos

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_leading_eq_tridiag
statement:
theorem gram_leading_eq_tridiag (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (gramMatrix P hreg F).submatrix (Fin.castLE hk) (Fin.castLE hk)
      = tridiag (coxeterCoeff P hreg F) k
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply, tridiag_apply]
  show ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F (Fin.castLE hk a),
        normaleOrientato P hreg F (Fin.castLE hk b)⟫ = _
  have hava : ((Fin.castLE hk a : Fin n) : ℕ) = (a : ℕ) := rfl
  have havb : ((Fin.castLE hk b : Fin n) : ℕ) = (b : ℕ) := rfl
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst hab; rw [gram_diag_orientata, if_pos rfl]
  · have habv : (a : ℕ) ≠ (b : ℕ) := fun h => hab (Fin.ext h)
    rw [if_neg hab]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (a : ℕ) (b : ℕ) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · by_cases hadj : (a : ℕ) + 1 = (b : ℕ)
      · rw [if_pos hadj]
        have hi : ((Fin.castLE hk a : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1 < n := by rw [hava]; omega
        have hjn : (a : ℕ) + 1 < n := by omega
        have hbeq : Fin.castLE hk b = ⟨((Fin.castLE hk a : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ := by
          apply Fin.ext; change (b : ℕ) = (a : ℕ) + 1; omega
        have hcm : coxeterMatrix P hreg F (Fin.castLE hk a)
              ⟨((Fin.castLE hk a : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
            = coxeterMatrix P hreg F ⟨(a : ℕ), by omega⟩ ⟨(a : ℕ) + 1, hjn⟩ := by
          congr 1
        rw [hbeq, gram_adiacente_orientata P hreg F (Fin.castLE hk a) hi hn,
            coxeterCoeff, dif_pos hjn, hcm]
      · rw [if_neg hadj, if_neg (by omega)]
        exact gram_lontane_orientata P hreg F (by rw [hava, havb]; omega)
    · exact absurd heq habv
    · rw [real_inner_comm]
      by_cases hadj : (b : ℕ) + 1 = (a : ℕ)
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos hadj]
        have hi : ((Fin.castLE hk b : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1 < n := by rw [havb]; omega
        have hjn : (b : ℕ) + 1 < n := by omega
        have haeq : Fin.castLE hk a = ⟨((Fin.castLE hk b : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ := by
          apply Fin.ext; change (a : ℕ) = (b : ℕ) + 1; omega
        have hcm : coxeterMatrix P hreg F (Fin.castLE hk b)
              ⟨((Fin.castLE hk b : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
            = coxeterMatrix P hreg F ⟨(b : ℕ), by omega⟩ ⟨(b : ℕ) + 1, hjn⟩ := by
          congr 1
        rw [haeq, gram_adiacente_orientata P hreg F (Fin.castLE hk b) hi hn,
            coxeterCoeff, dif_pos hjn, hcm]
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg hadj]
        exact gram_lontane_orientata P hreg F (by rw [hava, havb]; omega)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.canonicalGram_positive_minori
statement:
theorem canonicalGram_positive_minori (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    0 < minoreGram (coxeterCoeff P hreg F) k
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := gram_leading_det_pos P hreg F hn k hk
  rw [gram_leading_eq_tridiag P hreg F hn k hk, det_tridiagonale] at h3
  exact h3

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ridgeConnected_in_faceDim_two
statement:
theorem ridgeConnected_in_faceDim_two (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (B : Set (E n)) (hB : P.IsFace B) (hdB : faceDim B = 2) :
    ∀ (A A' : Set (E n)), P.IsFace A → P.IsFace A' →
      A ⊂ B → A' ⊂ B →
      faceDim A + 1 = faceDim B → faceDim A' + 1 = faceDim B →
      Relation.ReflTransGen
        (fun X Y : Set (E n) =>
          P.IsFace X ∧ P.IsFace Y ∧ X ⊂ B ∧ Y ⊂ B ∧
            faceDim X + 1 = faceDim B ∧ faceDim Y + 1 = faceDim B ∧
            ∃ R : Set (E n), P.IsFace R ∧ R ⊂ X ∧ R ⊂ Y ∧
              faceDim R + 2 = faceDim B)
        A A'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro A A' hA hA' hAB hA'B hdA hdA'
  let Q : ConvexPolytope n := facePolytope P hB
  have hQT : Q.toSet = B := facePolytope_toSet P hB
  have hAQ : Q.IsFace A := facePolytope_isFace_of P hB hA hAB.1
  have hA'Q : Q.IsFace A' := facePolytope_isFace_of P hB hA' hA'B.1
  have hdAone : faceDim A = 1 := by omega
  have hdA'one : faceDim A' = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (facePolytope Q hAQ).vertices_nonempty
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := (facePolytope Q hA'Q).vertices_nonempty
  have hxQ : x ∈ Q.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1
  have hxA : x ∈ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
  have hx'Q : x' ∈ Q.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx').1
  have hx'A' : x' ∈ A' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx').2
  have hQdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) = 2 := by
    rw [hQT]
    exact hdB
  let VertRel : E n → E n → Prop := fun p q =>
    q ∈ Q.vertices ∧ p ≠ q ∧
      ∃ e : Set (E n), Q.IsFace e ∧ faceDim e = 1 ∧ p ∈ e ∧ q ∈ e
  let RidgeRel : Set (E n) → Set (E n) → Prop := fun X Y =>
    P.IsFace X ∧ P.IsFace Y ∧ X ⊂ B ∧ Y ⊂ B ∧
      faceDim X + 1 = faceDim B ∧ faceDim Y + 1 = faceDim B ∧
      ∃ R : Set (E n), P.IsFace R ∧ R ⊂ X ∧ R ⊂ Y ∧
        faceDim R + 2 = faceDim B
  have edge_in_B : ∀ {e : Set (E n)}, Q.IsFace e → faceDim e = 1 →
      P.IsFace e ∧ e ⊂ B := by
    intro e he hde
    have heP : P.IsFace e := isFace_of_facePolytope P hB he
    have heBsub : e ⊆ B := by
      rw [← hQT]
      exact face_subset_toSet Q he
    refine ⟨heP, heBsub.ssubset_of_ne ?_⟩
    intro heq
    have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
    rw [hde, hdB] at hdim
    omega
  have ridge_step_at_vertex : ∀ {p : E n} {X Y : Set (E n)},
      p ∈ Q.vertices → P.IsFace X → faceDim X = 1 → X ⊂ B → p ∈ X →
      P.IsFace Y → faceDim Y = 1 → Y ⊂ B → p ∈ Y → RidgeRel X Y := by
    intro p X Y hpQ hX hdX hXB hpX hY hdY hYB hpY
    have hpFaceQ : Q.IsFace ({p} : Set (E n)) := vertex_isFace Q hpQ
    have hpFaceP : P.IsFace ({p} : Set (E n)) :=
      isFace_of_facePolytope P hB hpFaceQ
    have hpXstrict : ({p} : Set (E n)) ⊂ X := by
      refine (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hpX).ssubset_of_ne ?_
      intro heq
      have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
      rw [faceDim_singleton, hdX] at hdim
      omega
    have hpYstrict : ({p} : Set (E n)) ⊂ Y := by
      refine (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hpY).ssubset_of_ne ?_
      intro heq
      have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
      rw [faceDim_singleton, hdY] at hdim
      omega
    exact ⟨hX, hY, hXB, hYB, by omega, by omega,
      {p}, hpFaceP, hpXstrict, hpYstrict, by
        rw [faceDim_singleton, hdB]⟩
  have hverts : Relation.ReflTransGen VertRel x x' := by
    exact poligono_connesso Q hQdim hxQ hx'Q
  have transfer : ∀ {q : E n}, Relation.ReflTransGen VertRel x q →
      ∃ X : Set (E n),
        Relation.ReflTransGen RidgeRel A X ∧
        P.IsFace X ∧ faceDim X = 1 ∧ X ⊂ B ∧ q ∈ Q.vertices ∧ q ∈ X := by
    intro q hpath
    induction hpath with
    | refl =>
        exact ⟨A, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, hA, hdAone, hAB, hxQ, hxA⟩
    | @tail p q hprev hstep ih =>
        obtain ⟨X, hAX, hX, hdX, hXB, hpQ, hpX⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨hqQ, _hpq, e, heQ, hde, hpe, hqe⟩ := hstep
        obtain ⟨heP, heB⟩ := edge_in_B heQ hde
        have hstep' : RidgeRel X e :=
          ridge_step_at_vertex hpQ hX hdX hXB hpX heP hde heB hpe
        exact ⟨e, hAX.tail hstep', heP, hde, heB, hqQ, hqe⟩
  obtain ⟨X, hAX, hX, hdX, hXB, hx'Q', hx'X⟩ := transfer hverts
  have hlast : RidgeRel X A' :=
    ridge_step_at_vertex hx'Q' hX hdX hXB hx'X hA' hdA'one hA'B hx'A'
  exact hAX.tail hlast

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ridgeConnectedAboveOne_dim_two
statement:
theorem ridgeConnectedAboveOne_dim_two (P : ConvexPolytope n) :
    ∀ (B : Set (E n)), P.IsFace B → faceDim B = 2 →
      ∀ (A A' : Set (E n)), P.IsFace A → P.IsFace A' →
        A ⊂ B → A' ⊂ B →
        faceDim A + 1 = faceDim B → faceDim A' + 1 = faceDim B →
        Relation.ReflTransGen
          (fun X Y : Set (E n) =>
            P.IsFace X ∧ P.IsFace Y ∧ X ⊂ B ∧ Y ⊂ B ∧
              faceDim X + 1 = faceDim B ∧ faceDim Y + 1 = faceDim B ∧
              ∃ R : Set (E n), P.IsFace R ∧ R ⊂ X ∧ R ⊂ Y ∧
                faceDim R + 2 = faceDim B)
          A A'
proof:
:= by
  intro B hB hdB
  exact ridgeConnected_in_faceDim_two P B hB hdB

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.triplaSchlafli_mem_seiTriple
statement:
theorem triplaSchlafli_mem_seiTriple (P : ConvexPolytope 4)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) :
    triplaSchlafli P hreg F ∈ seiTriple
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (3 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by omega
  have h0 : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨0, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨0, by omega⟩
      (show (0 : ℕ) + 1 < 4 by omega)
  have h1 : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨0 + 1, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨0 + 1, by omega⟩
      (show (0 : ℕ) + 1 + 1 < 4 by omega)
  have h2 : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨0 + 2, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨0 + 2, by omega⟩
      (show (0 : ℕ) + 2 + 1 < 4 by omega)
  rcases finestra_classificata P hreg F hn 0 (by omega) h0 h1 h2 with
    ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ | ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ | ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ | ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ |
    ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ | ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ <;>
    simp only [triplaSchlafli, seiTriple, Set.mem_insert_iff,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff, Prod.mk.injEq, ha, hb, hc] <;>
    tauto

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_quattro_le_sei
statement: theorem platonicCount_quattro_le_sei : platonicCount 4 ≤ 6
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hflag : ∀ P : regularPolytopes 4,
      Nonempty (P : ConvexPolytope 4).Flag :=
    fun P => exists_flag (P : ConvexPolytope 4) P.2 (by omega)
  set fl : ∀ P : regularPolytopes 4, (P : ConvexPolytope 4).Flag :=
    fun P => (hflag P).some with hfl
  set tr : regularPolytopes 4 → ℕ × ℕ × ℕ := fun P =>
    triplaSchlafli (P : ConvexPolytope 4) P.2 (fl P) with htr
  
  have hinj : ∀ P₁ P₂ : regularPolytopes 4, tr P₁ = tr P₂ →
      classe 4 P₁ = classe 4 P₂ := by
    intro P₁ P₂ ht
    apply classe_eq_of_similar_gen
    show Similar (P₁ : ConvexPolytope 4) (P₂ : ConvexPolytope 4)
    apply similar_of_schlafli_eq (by omega) _ _ P₁.2 P₂.2 (fl P₁) (fl P₂)
    apply schlafli_eq_of_fun_agree
    intro k hk
    simp only [htr, triplaSchlafli, Prod.mk.injEq] at ht
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := ht
    have hk3 : k < 3 := by omega
    interval_cases k
    · rw [schlafliFun_eq _ P₁.2 _ 0 (by omega),
        schlafliFun_eq _ P₂.2 _ 0 (by omega)]
      exact h0
    · rw [schlafliFun_eq _ P₁.2 _ 1 (by omega),
        schlafliFun_eq _ P₂.2 _ 1 (by omega)]
      exact h1
    · rw [schlafliFun_eq _ P₁.2 _ 2 (by omega),
        schlafliFun_eq _ P₂.2 _ 2 (by omega)]
      exact h2
  
  set g : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → Set (regularPolytopes 4) := fun t =>
    if h : ∃ P : regularPolytopes 4, tr P = t
      then classe 4 h.choose else ∅ with hg
  have hsub : {S : Set (regularPolytopes 4) |
      ∃ P, S = {Q : regularPolytopes 4 | regularSimilar 4 P Q}} ⊆
      g '' seiTriple := by
    rintro S ⟨P, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨tr P, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [htr]
      exact triplaSchlafli_mem_seiTriple (P : ConvexPolytope 4) P.2 (fl P)
    · simp only [hg]
      have hex : ∃ P' : regularPolytopes 4, tr P' = tr P := ⟨P, rfl⟩
      rw [dif_pos hex]
      exact hinj hex.choose P hex.choose_spec
  
  have h6 : seiTriple.encard ≤ 6 := by
    rw [seiTriple]
    calc ({(3, 3, 3), (4, 3, 3), (3, 3, 4), (3, 4, 3), (5, 3, 3),
          (3, 3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ)).encard
        ≤ ({(4, 3, 3), (3, 3, 4), (3, 4, 3), (5, 3, 3),
          (3, 3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ)).encard + 1 :=
          Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ ≤ (({(3, 3, 4), (3, 4, 3), (5, 3, 3),
          (3, 3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ)).encard + 1) + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ ≤ ((({(3, 4, 3), (5, 3, 3),
          (3, 3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ)).encard + 1) + 1) + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ ≤ (((({(5, 3, 3),
          (3, 3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ)).encard + 1) + 1) + 1) + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ ≤ ((((({(3, 3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ)).encard
          + 1) + 1) + 1) + 1) + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ = 6 := by
          rw [Set.encard_singleton]
          rfl
  calc platonicCount 4
      = Set.encard {S : Set (regularPolytopes 4) |
          ∃ P, S = {Q : regularPolytopes 4 | regularSimilar 4 P Q}} := rfl
    _ ≤ (g '' seiTriple).encard := Set.encard_le_encard hsub
    _ ≤ seiTriple.encard := Set.encard_image_le _ _
    _ ≤ 6 := h6
