:=
  (gramMatrix_posDef P hreg F hn).submatrix (embedWindow_injective s k hsk)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.window_eq_tridiag
statement:
theorem window_eq_tridiag (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag)
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (s k : ℕ) (hsk : s + k ≤ n) :
    (gramMatrix P hreg F).submatrix (embedWindow s k hsk) (embedWindow s k hsk)
      = tridiag (fun j => coxeterCoeff P hreg F (s + j)) k
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply, tridiag_apply]
  show ⟪normaleOrientato P hreg F (embedWindow s k hsk a),
        normaleOrientato P hreg F (embedWindow s k hsk b)⟫ = _
  have hava : ((embedWindow s k hsk a : Fin n) : ℕ) = s + (a : ℕ) := rfl
  have havb : ((embedWindow s k hsk b : Fin n) : ℕ) = s + (b : ℕ) := rfl
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst hab; rw [gram_diag_orientata, if_pos rfl]
  · have habv : (a : ℕ) ≠ (b : ℕ) := fun h => hab (Fin.ext h)
    rw [if_neg hab]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (a : ℕ) (b : ℕ) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · by_cases hadj : (a : ℕ) + 1 = (b : ℕ)
      · rw [if_pos hadj]
        have hi : ((embedWindow s k hsk a : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1 < n := by rw [hava]; omega
        have hjn : s + (a : ℕ) + 1 < n := by omega
        have hbeq : embedWindow s k hsk b
            = ⟨((embedWindow s k hsk a : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ := by
          apply Fin.ext; change s + (b : ℕ) = s + (a : ℕ) + 1; omega
        have hcm : coxeterMatrix P hreg F (embedWindow s k hsk a)
              ⟨((embedWindow s k hsk a : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
            = coxeterMatrix P hreg F ⟨s + (a : ℕ), by omega⟩ ⟨s + (a : ℕ) + 1, hjn⟩ := by
          congr 1
        rw [hbeq, gram_adiacente_orientata P hreg F (embedWindow s k hsk a) hi hn,
            coxeterCoeff, dif_pos (by omega : s + (a : ℕ) + 1 < n), hcm]
      · rw [if_neg hadj, if_neg (by omega)]
        exact gram_lontane_orientata P hreg F (by rw [hava, havb]; omega)
    · exact absurd heq habv
    · rw [real_inner_comm]
      by_cases hadj : (b : ℕ) + 1 = (a : ℕ)
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos hadj]
        have hi : ((embedWindow s k hsk b : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1 < n := by rw [havb]; omega
        have hjn : s + (b : ℕ) + 1 < n := by omega
        have haeq : embedWindow s k hsk a
            = ⟨((embedWindow s k hsk b : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ := by
          apply Fin.ext; change s + (a : ℕ) = s + (b : ℕ) + 1; omega
        have hcm : coxeterMatrix P hreg F (embedWindow s k hsk b)
              ⟨((embedWindow s k hsk b : Fin n) : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
            = coxeterMatrix P hreg F ⟨s + (b : ℕ), by omega⟩ ⟨s + (b : ℕ) + 1, hjn⟩ := by
          congr 1
        rw [haeq, gram_adiacente_orientata P hreg F (embedWindow s k hsk b) hi hn,
            coxeterCoeff, dif_pos (by omega : s + (b : ℕ) + 1 < n), hcm]
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg hadj]
        exact gram_lontane_orientata P hreg F (by rw [hava, havb]; omega)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.window_minori_positivi
statement:
theorem window_minori_positivi (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (s k : ℕ) (hsk : s + k ≤ n) :
    0 < minoreGram (fun j => coxeterCoeff P hreg F (s + j)) k
proof:
:= by
  have hdet := (window_posDef P hreg F hn s k hsk).det_pos
  rw [window_eq_tridiag P hreg F hn s k hsk, det_tridiagonale] at hdet
  exact hdet

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.seconda_faccetta
statement:
theorem seconda_faccetta (P : ConvexPolytope 3) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    {δ : Set (E 3)} (hδ : P.IsFace δ) (hdδ : faceDim δ = 1)
    {A : Set (E 3)} (hA : P.IsFace A) (hdA : faceDim A = 2) (hδA : δ ⊆ A) :
    ∃ A' : Set (E 3), P.IsFace A' ∧ faceDim A' = 2 ∧ δ ⊆ A' ∧ A' ≠ A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hδ.1 hδ.2
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀δ⟩ := hδ.2
  have hp₀T : p₀ ∈ P.toSet := by
    have := hp₀δ
    rw [hl] at this
    exact this.1
  have hlmax : ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, l y ≤ l p₀ := by
    have := hp₀δ
    rw [hl] at this
    exact this.2
  have hlchar : ∀ q ∈ P.toSet, l q = l p₀ → q ∈ δ := by
    intro q hq hlq
    rw [hl]
    exact ⟨hq, fun y hy => le_trans (hlmax y hy) (le_of_eq hlq.symm)⟩
  have hlconst : ∀ z ∈ δ, l z = l p₀ := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' := hz
    rw [hl] at hz'
    exact le_antisymm (hlmax z hz'.1) (hz'.2 p₀ hp₀T)
  
  have ha₁ : ∃ a₁ ∈ A, a₁ ∉ δ := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    have hsub : A ⊆ δ := hall
    have hle := vectorSpan_mono ℝ hsub
    have h1 := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
    have h2 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ A) = 2 := hdA
    have h3 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ δ) = 1 := hdδ
    omega
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁A, ha₁δ⟩ := ha₁
  have ha₁T : a₁ ∈ P.toSet := face_subset_toSet P hA ha₁A
  have ha₁lt : l a₁ < l p₀ := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hlmax a₁ ha₁T) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hlchar a₁ ha₁T h) ha₁δ
  
  have hwex : ∃ w : E 3, w ∈ (vectorSpan ℝ A)ᗮ ∧ w ≠ 0 := by
    have hsum := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
      (K := vectorSpan ℝ A)
    have hdA' : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ A) = 2 := hdA
    have hE : Module.finrank ℝ (E 3) = 3 := by
      rw [finrank_euclideanSpace]
      simp
    have hperp : 1 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ A)ᗮ := by omega
    have hne : (vectorSpan ℝ A)ᗮ ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hperp
      simp [finrank_bot] at hperp
    obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwne⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
    exact ⟨w, hwmem, hwne⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hwperp, hwne⟩ := hwex
  
  have hwconstA : ∀ z ∈ A, ∀ z' ∈ A, ⟪w, z⟫ = ⟪w, z'⟫ := by
    intro z hz z' hz'
    have hmem : z - z' ∈ vectorSpan ℝ A := vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hz hz'
    have h1 : ⟪z - z', w⟫ = 0 := by
      have := (Submodule.mem_orthogonal (vectorSpan ℝ A) w).mp hwperp
      exact this (z - z') hmem
    rw [real_inner_comm] at h1
    rw [inner_sub_right] at h1
    linarith
  
  have hwW : w ∈ vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet := by
    have htop : vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet = ⊤ := by
      apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
      have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) = 3 := hfull
      rw [h1, finrank_euclideanSpace]
      simp
    rw [htop]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀V, hu₀ne⟩ := exists_vertex_inner_ne P hp₀T hwW hwne
  
  have costruzione : ∀ w' : E 3, (∀ z ∈ A, ∀ z' ∈ A, ⟪w', z⟫ = ⟪w', z'⟫) →
      (∃ u ∈ P.vertices, ⟪w', p₀⟫ < ⟪w', u⟫) →
      ∃ A' : Set (E 3), P.IsFace A' ∧ faceDim A' = 2 ∧ δ ⊆ A' ∧ A' ≠ A := by
    intro w' hw'A hup
    obtain ⟨ux, huxV, huxgt⟩ := hup
    set S : Finset (E 3) := P.vertices.filter (fun u => ⟪w', p₀⟫ < ⟪w', u⟫)
      with hS
    have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨ux, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huxV, huxgt⟩⟩
    set r : E 3 → ℝ := fun u => (l p₀ - l u) / (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) with hr
    obtain ⟨us, husS, husmin⟩ := S.exists_min_image r hSne
    have husV : us ∈ P.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp husS).1
    have husgt : ⟪w', p₀⟫ < ⟪w', us⟫ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp husS).2
    have husT : us ∈ P.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ husV
    have husδ : us ∉ δ := by
      intro h
      have h1 := hw'A us (hδA h) p₀ (hδA hp₀δ)
      rw [h1] at husgt
      exact lt_irrefl _ husgt
    have huslt : l us < l p₀ := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hlmax us husT) with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd (hlchar us husT h) husδ
    set t : ℝ := r us with ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := by
      rw [ht, hr]
      apply div_pos
      · linarith
      · linarith
    set ψ : E 3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := l + t • innerSL ℝ w' with hψ
    have hψval : ∀ y : E 3, ψ y = l y + t * ⟪w', y⟫ := by
      intro y
      rw [hψ]
      simp
    have hvert : ∀ u ∈ P.vertices, ψ u ≤ ψ p₀ := by
      intro u huV
      rw [hψval, hψval]
      by_cases hside : ⟪w', p₀⟫ < ⟪w', u⟫
      · have huS : u ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨huV, hside⟩
        have hrle : t ≤ r u := husmin u huS
        have hgap : (0:ℝ) < ⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫ := by linarith
        have h1 : t * (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) ≤ r u * (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrle (le_of_lt hgap)
        have h2 : r u * (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) = l p₀ - l u := by
          show (l p₀ - l u) / (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) * (⟪w', u⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) =
            l p₀ - l u
          exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hgap)
        nlinarith
      · push_neg at hside
        have h1 : l u ≤ l p₀ := hlmax u (subset_convexHull ℝ _ huV)
        have h2 : t * ⟪w', u⟫ ≤ t * ⟪w', p₀⟫ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hside (le_of_lt htpos)
        linarith
    have hbody : ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, ψ y ≤ ψ p₀ := by
      intro y hy
      have hconv : Convex ℝ {z : E 3 | ψ z ≤ ψ p₀} := by
        apply convex_halfSpace_le
        exact ψ.toLinearMap.isLinear
      have hsub : (P.vertices : Set (E 3)) ⊆ {z : E 3 | ψ z ≤ ψ p₀} := by
        intro u hu
        exact hvert u (Finset.mem_coe.mp hu)
      exact convexHull_min hsub hconv hy
    
    have hψδ : ∀ z ∈ δ, ψ z = ψ p₀ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hψval, hψval, hlconst z hz, hw'A z (hδA hz) p₀ (hδA hp₀δ)]
    set F : Set (E 3) := {x ∈ P.toSet | ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, ψ y ≤ ψ x} with hF
    have hδF : δ ⊆ F := by
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨face_subset_toSet P hδ hz, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      rw [hψδ z hz]
      exact hbody y hy
    have hp₀F : p₀ ∈ F := hδF hp₀δ
    have hFface : P.IsFace F := ⟨fun _ => ⟨ψ, rfl⟩, ⟨p₀, hp₀F⟩⟩
    
    have htie : ψ us = ψ p₀ := by
      rw [hψval, hψval]
      have hgap : (0:ℝ) < ⟪w', us⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫ := by linarith
      have h2 : t * (⟪w', us⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) = l p₀ - l us := by
        show (l p₀ - l us) / (⟪w', us⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) * (⟪w', us⟫ - ⟪w', p₀⟫) =
          l p₀ - l us
        exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hgap)
      nlinarith [h2]
    have husF : us ∈ F := by
      refine ⟨husT, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      rw [htie]
      exact hbody y hy
    
    have ha₁F : a₁ ∉ F := by
      intro hmem
      have h1 : ψ a₁ = ψ p₀ :=
        le_antisymm (hbody a₁ ha₁T) (hmem.2 p₀ hp₀T)
      rw [hψval, hψval] at h1
      have h2 : ⟪w', a₁⟫ = ⟪w', p₀⟫ := hw'A a₁ ha₁A p₀ (hδA hp₀δ)
      have h4 : l a₁ = l p₀ := by
        rw [h2] at h1
        linarith
      exact ha₁δ (hlchar a₁ ha₁T h4)
    have hFneT : F ≠ P.toSet := by
      intro h
      exact ha₁F (h ▸ ha₁T)
    have hFneA : F ≠ A := by
      intro h
      exact ha₁F (h ▸ ha₁A)
    
    have hconstspan : ∀ y ∈ affineSpan ℝ δ, l y = l p₀ := by
      intro y hy
      have heqon : Set.EqOn (⇑l.toLinearMap.toAffineMap)
          (⇑(AffineMap.const ℝ (E 3) (l p₀))) δ := by
        intro z hz
        simp [hlconst z hz]
      have h2 := AffineMap.eqOn_affineSpan (k := ℝ) heqon
      have := h2 hy
      simpa using this
    
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁δ, hz₁p₀⟩ := faccia_ha_secondo_punto hdδ (v := p₀)
    have hLI : LinearIndependent ℝ ![us - p₀, z₁ - p₀] := by
      rw [linearIndependent_fin2]
      constructor
      · show z₁ - p₀ ≠ 0
        exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hz₁p₀
      · intro a
        show a • (z₁ - p₀) ≠ us - p₀
        intro heq
        have hmem : us ∈ affineSpan ℝ δ := by
          have h1 : a • (z₁ -ᵥ p₀) +ᵥ p₀ ∈ affineSpan ℝ δ :=
            AffineSubspace.smul_vsub_vadd_mem _ a
              (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ hz₁δ)
              (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ hp₀δ)
              (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ hp₀δ)
          have h2 : a • (z₁ -ᵥ p₀) +ᵥ p₀ = us := by
            have h3 : us - p₀ = a • (z₁ - p₀) := heq.symm
            have h4 : us = a • (z₁ - p₀) + p₀ := by
              have := congrArg (fun q => q + p₀) h3
              simpa using this
            rw [h4]
            rfl
          rw [h2] at h1
          exact h1
        have h5 : l us = l p₀ := hconstspan us hmem
        exact husδ (hlchar us husT h5)
    
    have hsl : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![us - p₀, z₁ - p₀]) ≤
        vectorSpan ℝ F := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
      rcases i with ⟨iv, hi⟩
      interval_cases iv
      · show (![us - p₀, z₁ - p₀] : Fin 2 → E 3) 0 ∈ vectorSpan ℝ F
        show us - p₀ ∈ vectorSpan ℝ F
        exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ husF hp₀F
      · show (![us - p₀, z₁ - p₀] : Fin 2 → E 3) 1 ∈ vectorSpan ℝ F
        show z₁ - p₀ ∈ vectorSpan ℝ F
        exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ (hδF hz₁δ) hp₀F
    have hd2le : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F) := by
      have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ
          (Set.range ![us - p₀, z₁ - p₀])) = 2 := by
        rw [finrank_span_eq_card hLI]
        simp
      have h2 := Submodule.finrank_mono hsl
      omega
    have hdlt : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F) < 3 := by
      have hss : F ⊂ P.toSet :=
        ⟨fun x hx => hx.1, fun hsup => hFneT
          (Set.Subset.antisymm (fun x hx => hx.1) hsup)⟩
      have h1 := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hFface (toSet_isFace P) hss
      have h2 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) = 3 := hfull
      have h3 : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F) <
          Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ P.toSet) := h1
      omega
    refine ⟨F, hFface, ?_, hδF, hFneA⟩
    show Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ F) = 2
    omega
  
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hu₀ne with hlt | hgt
  · apply costruzione (-w)
    · intro z hz z' hz'
      rw [inner_neg_left, inner_neg_left, hwconstA z hz z' hz']
    · refine ⟨u₀, hu₀V, ?_⟩
      rw [inner_neg_left, inner_neg_left]
      linarith
  · exact costruzione w hwconstA ⟨u₀, hu₀V, hgt⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.adjacentFlag_isAdjacent
statement:
theorem adjacentFlag_isAdjacent (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    FlagAdjacentAt P F (adjacentFlag P hfull F i) i
proof:
:=
  (existsUnique_flag_adjacent P hfull F i).choose_spec.1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.adjacentFlag_eq_of_isAdjacent
statement:
theorem adjacentFlag_eq_of_isAdjacent (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) {F G : P.Flag} (i : Fin n)
    (h : FlagAdjacentAt P F G i) : G = adjacentFlag P hfull F i
proof:
:=
  (existsUnique_flag_adjacent P hfull F i).choose_spec.2 G h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.flagAdjacentAt_symm
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun j hj => (h.1 j hj).symm, (h.2).symm⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.adjacentFlag_involutive
statement:
theorem adjacentFlag_involutive (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F i) i = F
proof:
:=
  (adjacentFlag_eq_of_isAdjacent P hfull i
    (flagAdjacentAt_symm P (adjacentFlag_isAdjacent P hfull F i))).symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.adjacentFlag_ne
statement:
theorem adjacentFlag_ne (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    adjacentFlag P hfull F i ≠ F
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have h := (adjacentFlag_isAdjacent P hfull F i).2
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP2_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertP2_apply (i : Fin 4) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertP2 i s j = (if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
      (if j = i then Real.sqrt 5 else 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertP2]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP3_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertP3_apply (i : Fin 4) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertP3 i s j = (if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
      (if j = i then 2 - aureo else aureo)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertP3]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP4_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertP4_apply (i : Fin 4) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertP4 i s j = (if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
      (if j = i then aureo + 1 else aureo - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertP4]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoZeroTesta_sq
statement:
theorem segnoZeroTesta_sq (s : Fin 3 → Bool) (k : Fin 4) :
    segnoZeroTesta s k ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k <;> simp [segnoZeroTesta] <;> split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoPieno_sq
statement:
theorem segnoPieno_sq (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (k : Fin 4) :
    segnoPieno s k ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k <;> simp [segnoPieno] <;> split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP5_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertP5_apply (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (s : Fin 3 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertP5 σ s j = segnoZeroTesta s ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
      base5 ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertP5]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP6_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertP6_apply (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (s : Fin 3 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertP6 σ s j = segnoZeroTesta s ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
      base6 ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertP6]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP7_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertP7_apply (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertP7 σ s j = segnoPieno s ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
      base7 ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertP7]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_vertP1
statement: theorem norm_sq_vertP1 (c : CodiceVentiquattro) : ‖vertP1 c‖ ^ 2 = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertP1, norm_smul, norm_vertVentiquattro]
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [mul_pow, sq_abs, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_vertP2
statement:
theorem norm_sq_vertP2 (i : Fin 4) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    ‖vertP2 i s‖ ^ 2 = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [vertP2_apply]
  have hterm : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      ‖(if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
        (if j = i then Real.sqrt 5 else 1)‖ ^ 2
      = (if j = i then 5 else 1) := by
    intro j
    rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs]
    have h1 : (if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    rw [h1, one_mul]
    split_ifs
    · exact Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    · norm_num
  simp_rw [hterm]
  fin_cases i <;> rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] <;> simp <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_vertP3
statement:
theorem norm_sq_vertP3 (i : Fin 4) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    ‖vertP3 i s‖ ^ 2 = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [vertP3_apply]
  have hterm : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      ‖(if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
        (if j = i then 2 - aureo else aureo)‖ ^ 2
      = (if j = i then (2 - aureo) ^ 2 else aureo ^ 2) := by
    intro j
    rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs]
    have h1 : (if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    rw [h1, one_mul]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  simp_rw [hterm]
  fin_cases i <;> rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] <;> simp <;> nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_vertP4
statement:
theorem norm_sq_vertP4 (i : Fin 4) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    ‖vertP4 i s‖ ^ 2 = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [vertP4_apply]
  have hterm : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      ‖(if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
        (if j = i then aureo + 1 else aureo - 1)‖ ^ 2
      = (if j = i then (aureo + 1) ^ 2 else (aureo - 1) ^ 2) := by
    intro j
    rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs]
    have h1 : (if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    rw [h1, one_mul]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  simp_rw [hterm]
  fin_cases i <;> rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] <;> simp <;> nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_perm_block
statement:
theorem norm_sq_perm_block {sg : Fin 4 → ℝ} {bs : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (hsg : ∀ k, sg k ^ 2 = 1)
    (htot : bs 0 ^ 2 + bs 1 ^ 2 + bs 2 ^ 2 + bs 3 ^ 2 = 8) :
    ∑ j : Fin 4, ‖sg ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
      bs ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)‖ ^ 2 = 8
proof:
:= by
  have hre : ∑ j : Fin 4, ‖sg ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
        bs ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ k : Fin 4, ‖sg k * bs k‖ ^ 2 :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm _ _ (fun j => rfl)
  rw [hre]
  have hterm : ∀ k : Fin 4, ‖sg k * bs k‖ ^ 2 = bs k ^ 2 := by
    intro k
    rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs, hsg, one_mul]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  exact htot

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_vertP5
statement:
theorem norm_sq_vertP5 (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (s : Fin 3 → Bool) : ‖vertP5 σ s‖ ^ 2 = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [vertP5_apply]
  apply norm_sq_perm_block σ (segnoZeroTesta_sq s)
  have h0 : base5 0 = 0 := rfl
  have h1 : base5 1 = 2 - aureo := rfl
  have h2 : base5 2 = 1 := rfl
  have h3 : base5 3 = aureo + 1 := rfl
  rw [h0, h1, h2, h3]
  nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_vertP6
statement:
theorem norm_sq_vertP6 (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (s : Fin 3 → Bool) : ‖vertP6 σ s‖ ^ 2 = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [vertP6_apply]
  apply norm_sq_perm_block σ (segnoZeroTesta_sq s)
  have h0 : base6 0 = 0 := rfl
  have h1 : base6 1 = aureo - 1 := rfl
  have h2 : base6 2 = aureo := rfl
  have h3 : base6 3 = Real.sqrt 5 := rfl
  rw [h0, h1, h2, h3, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 5)]
  nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_sq_vertP7
statement:
theorem norm_sq_vertP7 (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (s : Fin 4 → Bool) : ‖vertP7 σ s‖ ^ 2 = 8
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [vertP7_apply]
  apply norm_sq_perm_block σ (segnoPieno_sq s)
  have h0 : base7 0 = aureo - 1 := rfl
  have h1 : base7 1 = 1 := rfl
  have h2 : base7 2 = aureo := rfl
  have h3 : base7 3 = 2 := rfl
  rw [h0, h1, h2, h3]
  nlinarith [aureo_sq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.inj_posizionale
statement:
theorem inj_posizionale {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool) =>
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 4) ℝ).symm
        (fun j => (if p.2 j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) *
          (if j = p.1 then a else b)) : E 4))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i, s⟩ ⟨i', s'⟩ h
  simp only at h
  have happ : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      (if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (if j = i then a else b)
      = (if s' j then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * (if j = i' then a else b) := by
    intro j
    simpa using congrArg (fun v : E 4 => v j) h
  have hii : i = i' := by
    by_contra hne
    have h1 := happ i
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg hne] at h1
    have habs := congrArg abs h1
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul] at habs
    have hs1 : |if s i then (1 : ℝ) else -1| = 1 := by
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hs2 : |if s' i then (1 : ℝ) else -1| = 1 := by
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    rw [hs1, hs2, one_mul, one_mul, abs_of_pos ha, abs_of_pos hb] at habs
    exact hab habs
  subst hii
  have hss : s = s' := by
    funext j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · have h1 := happ j
      rw [if_pos hji] at h1
      have h2 := mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt ha) h1
      cases hs : s j <;> cases hs' : s' j <;> rw [hs, hs'] at h2 <;>
        first | rfl | (exfalso; norm_num at h2)
    · have h1 := happ j
      rw [if_neg hji] at h1
      have h2 := mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hb) h1
      cases hs : s j <;> cases hs' : s' j <;> rw [hs, hs'] at h2 <;>
        first | rfl | (exfalso; norm_num at h2)
  rw [hss]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.inj_permutativo
statement:
theorem inj_permutativo {S : Type*} (bs : Fin 4 → ℝ) (sg : S → Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hbs_nn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ bs k)
    (hbs_inj : ∀ k k' : Fin 4, bs k = bs k' → k = k')
    (hsg : ∀ s k, |sg s k| = 1)
    (hrec : ∀ s s' : S, (∀ k, bs k ≠ 0 → sg s k = sg s' k) → s = s') :
    Function.Injective (fun p : alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × S =>
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 4) ℝ).symm
        (fun j => sg p.2 ((p.1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
          bs ((p.1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)) : E 4))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨σ, s⟩ ⟨σ', s'⟩ h
  simp only at h
  have happ : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      sg s ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
        bs ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j)
      = sg s' ((σ' : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) *
        bs ((σ' : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm j) := by
    intro j
    simpa using congrArg (fun v : E 4 => v j) h
  have hσσ : ∀ k : Fin 4, (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k =
      (σ' : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k := by
    intro k
    have h1 := happ ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k)
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h1
    have habs := congrArg abs h1
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, hsg, hsg, one_mul, one_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (hbs_nn _), abs_of_nonneg (hbs_nn _)] at habs
    have hk := hbs_inj _ _ habs
    have h2 := congrArg (σ' : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) hk
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  have hσ : σ = σ' := Subtype.ext (Equiv.ext hσσ)
  subst hσ
  have hs : s = s' := by
    apply hrec
    intro k hbk
    have h1 := happ ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k)
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h1
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hbk h1
  rw [hs]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.rec_segnoZeroTesta
statement:
theorem rec_segnoZeroTesta {bs : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (h1 : bs 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : bs 2 ≠ 0) (h3 : bs 3 ≠ 0) :
    ∀ s s' : Fin 3 → Bool,
      (∀ k, bs k ≠ 0 → segnoZeroTesta s k = segnoZeroTesta s' k) →
      s = s'
proof:
:= by
  intro s s' hk
  funext m
  fin_cases m
  · show s 0 = s' 0
    have h := hk 1 h1
    have h0 : (if s 0 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
        = (if s' 0 then 1 else -1) := h
    cases hs : s 0 <;> cases hs' : s' 0 <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | (exfalso; rw [hs, hs'] at h0; norm_num at h0)
  · show s 1 = s' 1
    have h := hk 2 h2
    have h0 : (if s 1 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
        = (if s' 1 then 1 else -1) := h
    cases hs : s 1 <;> cases hs' : s' 1 <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | (exfalso; rw [hs, hs'] at h0; norm_num at h0)
  · show s 2 = s' 2
    have h := hk 3 h3
    have h0 : (if s 2 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
        = (if s' 2 then 1 else -1) := h
    cases hs : s 2 <;> cases hs' : s' 2 <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | (exfalso; rw [hs, hs'] at h0; norm_num at h0)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.rec_segnoPieno
statement:
theorem rec_segnoPieno {bs : Fin 4 → ℝ} (hbs : ∀ k, bs k ≠ 0) :
    ∀ s s' : Fin 4 → Bool,
      (∀ k, bs k ≠ 0 → segnoPieno s k = segnoPieno s' k) → s = s'
proof:
:= by
  intro s s' hk
  funext m
  fin_cases m
  · show s 0 = s' 0
    have h := hk 0 (hbs 0)
    have h0 : (if s 0 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
        = (if s' 0 then 1 else -1) := h
    cases hs : s 0 <;> cases hs' : s' 0 <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | (exfalso; rw [hs, hs'] at h0; norm_num at h0)
  · show s 1 = s' 1
    have h := hk 1 (hbs 1)
    have h0 : (if s 1 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
        = (if s' 1 then 1 else -1) := h
    cases hs : s 1 <;> cases hs' : s' 1 <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | (exfalso; rw [hs, hs'] at h0; norm_num at h0)
  · show s 2 = s' 2
    have h := hk 2 (hbs 2)
    have h0 : (if s 2 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
        = (if s' 2 then 1 else -1) := h
    cases hs : s 2 <;> cases hs' : s' 2 <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | (exfalso; rw [hs, hs'] at h0; norm_num at h0)
  · show s 3 = s' 3
    have h := hk 3 (hbs 3)
    have h0 : (if s 3 then (1 : ℝ) else -1)
        = (if s' 3 then 1 else -1) := h
    cases hs : s 3 <;> cases hs' : s' 3 <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | (exfalso; rw [hs, hs'] at h0; norm_num at h0)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.segnoZeroTesta_abs
statement:
theorem segnoZeroTesta_abs (s : Fin 3 → Bool) (k : Fin 4) :

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.base5_nonneg
statement: theorem base5_nonneg (k : Fin 4) : 0 ≤ base5 k
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds
  fin_cases k
  · exact le_rfl
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 - aureo
    linarith [hb.2]
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1
    norm_num
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ aureo + 1
    linarith [hb.1]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.base6_nonneg
statement: theorem base6_nonneg (k : Fin 4) : 0 ≤ base6 k
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds

  · exact le_rfl
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ aureo - 1
    linarith [hb.1]
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ aureo
    linarith [hb.1]
  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt 5
    exact Real.sqrt_nonneg 5

  · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ aureo

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.base5_inj
statement: theorem base5_inj : ∀ k k' : Fin 4, base5 k = base5 k' → k = k'
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds
  intro k k' h
  fin_cases k <;> fin_cases k' <;>
    first
      | rfl
      | (exfalso; simp [base5] at h; done)
      | (exfalso; simp [base5] at h; nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2])

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.base6_inj
statement: theorem base6_inj : ∀ k k' : Fin 4, base6 k = base6 k' → k = k'
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds
  obtain ⟨lo, hi⟩ := sqrt_five_bounds
  intro k k' h
  fin_cases k <;> fin_cases k' <;>
    first
      | rfl
      | (exfalso; simp [base6] at h; done)
      | (exfalso; simp [base6] at h; nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2, lo, hi])

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP1_injective
statement: theorem vertP1_injective : Function.Injective vertP1
proof:
:= by
  intro c c' h
  apply vertVentiquattro_injective
  exact smul_right_injective (E 4) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP2_injective
statement:
theorem vertP2_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool) =>
      vertP2 p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h5 : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 5 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨lo, hi⟩ := sqrt_five_bounds
  exact inj_posizionale h5 one_pos (by intro h; linarith)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP3_injective
statement:
theorem vertP3_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool) =>
      vertP3 p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds
  exact inj_posizionale (by linarith [hb.2]) aureo_pos
    (by intro h; linarith [hb.1, hb.2])

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP4_injective
statement:
theorem vertP4_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool) =>
      vertP4 p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds

    (by intro h; linarith [hb.1])

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP5_injective
statement:
theorem vertP5_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p :
      alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 3 → Bool) => vertP5 p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds
  exact inj_permutativo base5 segnoZeroTesta base5_nonneg base5_inj
    segnoZeroTesta_abs
    (rec_segnoZeroTesta
      (by show (2 : ℝ) - aureo ≠ 0; intro h; linarith [hb.2])
      (by show (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0; norm_num)
      (by show aureo + 1 ≠ 0; intro h; linarith [hb.1]))

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP6_injective
statement:
theorem vertP6_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p :
      alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 3 → Bool) => vertP6 p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds
  obtain ⟨lo, hi⟩ := sqrt_five_bounds
  exact inj_permutativo base6 segnoZeroTesta base6_nonneg base6_inj
    segnoZeroTesta_abs
    (rec_segnoZeroTesta
      (by show aureo - 1 ≠ 0; intro h; linarith [hb.1])
      (by show aureo ≠ 0; intro h; linarith [hb.1])
      (by show Real.sqrt 5 ≠ 0; intro h; linarith))

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP7_injective
statement:
theorem vertP7_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p :
      alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 4 → Bool) => vertP7 p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := aureo_bounds
  refine inj_permutativo base7 segnoPieno base7_nonneg base7_inj
    segnoPieno_abs (rec_segnoPieno ?_)
  intro k
  fin_cases k
  · show aureo - 1 ≠ 0
    intro h
    linarith [hb.1]
  · show (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0
    norm_num
  · show aureo ≠ 0
    intro h
    linarith [hb.1]
  · show (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0
    norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.abs_segnoVentiquattro
statement: theorem abs_segnoVentiquattro (b : Bool) : |segnoVentiquattro b| = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp [segnoVentiquattro] <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP1_coord
statement:
theorem vertP1_coord (c : CodiceVentiquattro) (j : Fin 4) :
    vertP1 c j = 2 * vertVentiquattro c j
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertP1, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP1_range
statement:
theorem vertP1_range (c : CodiceVentiquattro) (j : Fin 4) :
    |vertP1 c j| = 0 ∨ |vertP1 c j| = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertP1_coord, abs_mul, vertVentiquattro_apply]
  by_cases h1 : j = indicePrimoVentiquattro c
  · rw [if_pos h1, if_neg (by rw [h1]; exact indicePrimo_ne_indiceSecondo c),
      add_zero, abs_segnoVentiquattro]
    right
    norm_num
  · by_cases h2 : j = indiceSecondoVentiquattro c
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2, zero_add, abs_segnoVentiquattro]
      right
      norm_num
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]
      left
      norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP1_testimone
statement:
theorem vertP1_testimone (c : CodiceVentiquattro) :
    |vertP1 c (indicePrimoVentiquattro c)| = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertP1_coord, vertVentiquattro_apply_primo, abs_mul,
    abs_segnoVentiquattro]
  norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP1_testimone_zero
statement:
theorem vertP1_testimone_zero (c : CodiceVentiquattro) :
    ∃ j, |vertP1 c j| = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : ({indicePrimoVentiquattro c,
      indiceSecondoVentiquattro c}ᶜ : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos, Finset.card_compl]
    have hle : ({indicePrimoVentiquattro c,
        indiceSecondoVentiquattro c} : Finset (Fin 4)).card ≤ 2 :=
      (Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp)
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin 4) = 4 := by simp
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hne
  rw [Finset.mem_compl, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hj
  push Not at hj
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  rw [vertP1_coord, abs_mul, vertVentiquattro_apply,
    if_neg hj.1, if_neg hj.2, add_zero]
  norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP2_range
statement:
theorem vertP2_range (i : Fin 4) (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (j : Fin 4) :
    |vertP2 i s j| = 1 ∨ |vertP2 i s j| = Real.sqrt 5
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertP2_apply, abs_mul]
  have hsg : |if s j then (1 : ℝ) else -1| = 1 := by
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  rw [hsg, one_mul]
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · right
    rw [if_pos hji]
    exact abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 5)
  · left
    rw [if_neg hji]
    norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP2_testimone
statement:

  have hsg : |if s i then (1 : ℝ) else -1| = 1 := by
    split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP2_testimone_uno

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.perm_at_abs
statement:
theorem perm_at_abs {sg : Fin 4 → ℝ} {bs : Fin 4 → ℝ}
    (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4))
    (hsg : ∀ k, |sg k| = 1) (hnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ bs k) (k : Fin 4) :
    |sg ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k)) *
      bs ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)).symm ((σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) k))|
      = bs k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, abs_mul, hsg, one_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (hnn k)]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertP5_range
statement:
theorem vertP5_range (σ : alternatingGroup (Fin 4)) (s : Fin 3 → Bool)
    (j : Fin 4) :
    |vertP5 σ s j| = 0 ∨ |vertP5 σ s j| = 2 - aureo ∨
      |vertP5 σ s j| = 1 ∨ |vertP5 σ s j| = aureo + 1

statement: theorem card_centoventiVertici : centoventiVertici.card = 600
proof:
:= by

  have d12 : Disjoint
      ((Finset.univ : Finset CodiceVentiquattro).image vertP1)
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image
        (fun p => vertP2 p.1 p.2)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    rintro x hx hy

    obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨p, _, hp⟩ := hy

      (((Finset.univ : Finset CodiceVentiquattro).image vertP1) ∪

    · obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact vertP1_ne_vertP3 c q.1 q.2 hq.symm
    · obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact vertP2_ne_vertP3 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
  have d4 : Disjoint
      ((((Finset.univ : Finset CodiceVentiquattro).image vertP1) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP2 p.1 p.2))) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image

        exact vertP2_ne_vertP4 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
    · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
      obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx

      (((((Finset.univ : Finset CodiceVentiquattro).image vertP1) ∪

          (fun p => vertP3 p.1 p.2))) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image

      ((Finset.univ :
          Finset (alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 3 → Bool))).image
        (fun p => vertP5 p.1 p.2)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    rintro x hx hy
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hy
    obtain ⟨q, _, hq⟩ := hy
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
        rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
        · obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := hx

        · obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx

      ((((((Finset.univ : Finset CodiceVentiquattro).image vertP1) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP2 p.1 p.2))) ∪

          (fun p => vertP3 p.1 p.2))) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP4 p.1 p.2))) ∪
        ((Finset.univ :
            Finset (alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 3 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP5 p.1 p.2)))
      ((Finset.univ :

    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
          rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
          · obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := hx
            exact vertP1_ne_vertP6 c q.1 q.2 hq.symm
          · obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
            exact vertP2_ne_vertP6 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
        · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
          obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
          exact vertP3_ne_vertP6 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
      · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
        obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
        exact vertP4_ne_vertP6 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
    · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
      obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact vertP5_ne_vertP6 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
  have d7 : Disjoint
      (((((((Finset.univ : Finset CodiceVentiquattro).image vertP1) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP2 p.1 p.2))) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP3 p.1 p.2))) ∪
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4 × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP4 p.1 p.2))) ∪
        ((Finset.univ :
            Finset (alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 3 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP5 p.1 p.2))) ∪
        ((Finset.univ :
            Finset (alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 3 → Bool))).image
          (fun p => vertP6 p.1 p.2)))
      ((Finset.univ :
          Finset (alternatingGroup (Fin 4) × (Fin 4 → Bool))).image
        (fun p => vertP7 p.1 p.2)) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    rintro x hx hy
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hy
    obtain ⟨q, _, hq⟩ := hy
    rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
          rcases hx with hx | hx
          · rw [Finset.mem_union] at hx
            rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
            · obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := hx
              exact vertP1_ne_vertP7 c q.1 q.2 hq.symm
            · obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
              exact vertP2_ne_vertP7 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
          · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
            obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
            exact vertP3_ne_vertP7 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
        · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
          obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
          exact vertP4_ne_vertP7 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
      · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
        obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
        exact vertP5_ne_vertP7 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
    · rw [Finset.mem_image] at hx
      obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact vertP6_ne_vertP7 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 hq.symm
  rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d7,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d6,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d5,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d4,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d3,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d12,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertP1_injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertP2_injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertP3_injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertP4_injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertP5_injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertP6_injective,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ vertP7_injective]
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool, card_codiceVentiquattro,
    card_coppiaVentiquattro, card_alternatingGroup]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.centoventiVertici_eq_extremePoints
statement:
theorem centoventiVertici_eq_extremePoints :
    ((centoventiVertici : Finset (E 4)) : Set (E 4)) =
      Set.extremePoints ℝ
        (convexHull ℝ
          ((centoventiVertici : Finset (E 4)) : Set (E 4)))
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 := vertP1 (codiceVentiquattro 0 1 (by norm_num) true true)
  have hne : (0 : E 4) ≠
      vertP1 (codiceVentiquattro 0 1 (by norm_num) true true) := by
    intro h
    have hnorm := norm_sq_vertP1 (codiceVentiquattro 0 1
      (by norm_num) true true)
    rw [← h] at hnorm
    simp at hnorm
  haveI : Nontrivial (E 4) :=
    ⟨⟨0, vertP1 (codiceVentiquattro 0 1 (by norm_num) true true), hne⟩⟩
  symm
  apply cosferico_extremePoints 0 (Real.sqrt 8)
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
  have hv' : v ∈ centoventiVertici := by exact_mod_cast hv
  have hsq := norm_sq_mem_centoventiVertici hv'
  rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg v), hsq]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.centoventi_isFullDim
statement: theorem centoventi_isFullDim : centoventi.IsFullDim
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W : Submodule ℝ (E 4) := vectorSpan ℝ centoventi.toSet
  have hbasis : ∀ k : Fin 4,
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 4) ℝ) k ∈ W := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨i, hik⟩ := exists_ne k
    have hdiff : vertP2 i (fun _ => true) -
        vertP2 i (fun j => if j = k then false else true) ∈ W :=
      vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ
        (vertP2_mem_centoventi_toSet i (fun _ => true))
        (vertP2_mem_centoventi_toSet i (fun j => if j = k then false
          else true))
    have hcalc : vertP2 i (fun _ => true) -
        vertP2 i (fun j => if j = k then false else true)
        = (2 : ℝ) • (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 4) ℝ) k := by
      ext j
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, vertP2_apply, vertP2_apply,
        EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      by_cases hjk : j = k
      · rw [if_pos hjk]
        have hjik : ¬ j = i := by
          rw [hjk]
          exact fun h => hik h.symm
        rw [if_neg hjik]
        simp [hjk, hjik]
        norm_num
      · rw [if_neg hjk]
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · rw [if_pos hji]
          simp [hjk, hji]
          exact hik
        · rw [if_neg hji]
          simp [hjk, hji]
    rw [hcalc] at hdiff
    exact (W.smul_mem_iff (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)).mp hdiff
  have hW : W = ⊤ := by
    rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
    intro x
    rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 4) ℝ).sum_repr x]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem W fun i _ => W.smul_mem _ (hbasis i)
  rw [ConvexPolytope.IsFullDim, ConvexPolytope.dim]
  change Module.finrank ℝ W = 4
  rw [hW, finrank_top, finrank_euclideanSpace]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.classificazione_dim3
statement:
theorem classificazione_dim3 (a b : ℕ) (ha : 3 ≤ a) (hb : 3 ≤ b)
    (hD3 : 0 < 1 - Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 - Real.cos (π / b) ^ 2) :
    (a = 3 ∧ b = 3) ∨ (a = 4 ∧ b = 3) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ b = 4) ∨
    (a = 5 ∧ b = 3) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ b = 5)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha5, hb5⟩ := ordini_le_five_di_D3 ha hb hD3
  obtain ⟨lo, hi⟩ := sqrt_five_bounds
  interval_cases a <;> interval_cases b <;>
    simp only [show ((3:ℕ):ℝ) = 3 by norm_num,
      show ((4:ℕ):ℝ) = 4 by norm_num, show ((5:ℕ):ℝ) = 5 by norm_num,
      cos_pi_div_three_sq, cos_pi_div_four_sq, cos_pi_div_five_sq]
      at hD3 ⊢ <;>
    first
      | tauto
      | (exfalso; nlinarith [lo, hi, hD3])

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coppiaSchlafli_mem_cinqueCoppie
statement:
theorem coppiaSchlafli_mem_cinqueCoppie (P : ConvexPolytope 3)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) :
    coppiaSchlafli P hreg F ∈ cinqueCoppie
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (3 : ℕ) ≤ 3 := le_refl 3
  have h0 : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨0, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨0, by omega⟩
      (show (0 : ℕ) + 1 < 3 by omega)
  have h1 : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨1, by omega⟩ :=
    schlafli_ge_tre_all P hreg F hn ⟨1, by omega⟩
      (show (1 : ℕ) + 1 < 3 by omega)
  have hD := canonicalGram_positive_minori P hreg F hn 3 (le_refl 3)
  rw [minoreGram_tre] at hD
  have hc0 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F 0
      = Real.cos (π / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨0, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F 0 (by omega) (by omega)
  have hc1 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F 1
      = Real.cos (π / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨1, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F 1 (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [hc0, hc1] at hD
  rcases classificazione_dim3 _ _ h0 h1 hD with
    ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩ <;>
    simp only [coppiaSchlafli, cinqueCoppie, Set.mem_insert_iff,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff, Prod.mk.injEq, ha, hb] <;>
    tauto

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_tre_le_cinque
statement: theorem platonicCount_tre_le_cinque : platonicCount 3 ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hflag : ∀ P : regularPolytopes 3,
      Nonempty (P : ConvexPolytope 3).Flag :=
    fun P => exists_flag (P : ConvexPolytope 3) P.2 (by omega)
  set fl : ∀ P : regularPolytopes 3, (P : ConvexPolytope 3).Flag :=
    fun P => (hflag P).some with hfl
  set cp : regularPolytopes 3 → ℕ × ℕ := fun P =>
    coppiaSchlafli (P : ConvexPolytope 3) P.2 (fl P) with hcp
  have hinj : ∀ P₁ P₂ : regularPolytopes 3, cp P₁ = cp P₂ →
      classe 3 P₁ = classe 3 P₂ := by
    intro P₁ P₂ ht
    apply classe_eq_of_similar_gen
    show Similar (P₁ : ConvexPolytope 3) (P₂ : ConvexPolytope 3)
    apply similar_of_schlafli_eq (by omega) _ _ P₁.2 P₂.2 (fl P₁) (fl P₂)
    apply schlafli_eq_of_fun_agree
    intro k hk
    simp only [hcp, coppiaSchlafli, Prod.mk.injEq] at ht
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := ht
    have hk2 : k < 2 := by omega
    interval_cases k
    · rw [schlafliFun_eq _ P₁.2 _ 0 (by omega),
        schlafliFun_eq _ P₂.2 _ 0 (by omega)]
      exact h0
    · rw [schlafliFun_eq _ P₁.2 _ 1 (by omega),
        schlafliFun_eq _ P₂.2 _ 1 (by omega)]
      exact h1
  set g : ℕ × ℕ → Set (regularPolytopes 3) := fun t =>
    if h : ∃ P : regularPolytopes 3, cp P = t
      then classe 3 h.choose else ∅ with hg
  have hsub : {S : Set (regularPolytopes 3) |
      ∃ P, S = {Q : regularPolytopes 3 | regularSimilar 3 P Q}} ⊆
      g '' cinqueCoppie := by
    rintro S ⟨P, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨cp P, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [hcp]
      exact coppiaSchlafli_mem_cinqueCoppie (P : ConvexPolytope 3) P.2 (fl P)
    · simp only [hg]
      have hex : ∃ P' : regularPolytopes 3, cp P' = cp P := ⟨P, rfl⟩
      rw [dif_pos hex]
      exact hinj hex.choose P hex.choose_spec
  have h5 : cinqueCoppie.encard ≤ 5 := by
    rw [cinqueCoppie]
    calc ({(3, 3), (4, 3), (3, 4), (5, 3), (3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ)).encard
        ≤ ({(4, 3), (3, 4), (5, 3), (3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ)).encard + 1 :=
          Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ ≤ (({(3, 4), (5, 3), (3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ)).encard + 1) + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ ≤ ((({(5, 3), (3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ)).encard + 1) + 1) + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ ≤ (((({(3, 5)} : Set (ℕ × ℕ)).encard + 1) + 1) + 1) + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact Set.encard_insert_le _ _
      _ = 5 := by
          rw [Set.encard_singleton]
          rfl
  calc platonicCount 3
      = Set.encard {S : Set (regularPolytopes 3) |
          ∃ P, S = {Q : regularPolytopes 3 | regularSimilar 3 P Q}} := rfl
    _ ≤ (g '' cinqueCoppie).encard := Set.encard_le_encard hsub
    _ ≤ cinqueCoppie.encard := Set.encard_image_le _ _
    _ ≤ 5 := h5

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_tre
statement: theorem platonicCount_tre : platonicCount 3 = 5
proof:
:=

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.face_eq_hull_vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset (E n) := P.vertices.filter (· ∈ f)
  have hPcompact : IsCompact P.toSet :=
    (P.vertices.finite_toSet.isCompact_convexHull ℝ)
  have hFcompact : IsCompact f := hf.1.isCompact hPcompact
  have hFconvex : Convex ℝ f := hf.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have hKM := closure_convexHull_extremePoints hFcompact hFconvex
  have hext : f.extremePoints ℝ = (S : Set (E n)) := by
    rw [hf.1.isExtreme.extremePoints_eq]
    ext x
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    change (x ∈ f ∧ x ∈ P.toSet.extremePoints ℝ) ↔
      x ∈ P.vertices ∧ x ∈ f
    rw [ConvexPolytope.toSet, ← P.vertices_eq_extremePoints]
    tauto
  calc
    f = closure (convexHull ℝ (f.extremePoints ℝ)) := hKM.symm
    _ = closure (convexHull ℝ (S : Set (E n))) := by rw [hext]
    _ = convexHull ℝ (S : Set (E n)) :=
      (S.finite_toSet.isClosed_convexHull ℝ).closure_eq
    _ = convexHull ℝ
        ((P.vertices.filter (· ∈ f) : Finset (E n)) : Set (E n)) := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.isFace_of_isExposed_isFace
statement:
theorem isFace_of_isExposed_isFace (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    {f e : Set (E n)} (hf : P.IsFace f) (he : IsExposed ℝ f e)
    (hene : e.Nonempty) : P.IsFace e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hf.1 hf.2
  obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := he hene
  have hene' := hene
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hene'
  have hx₀f : x₀ ∈ f := by rw [hl'] at hx₀; exact hx₀.1
  have hx₀T : x₀ ∈ P.toSet := by rw [hl] at hx₀f; exact hx₀f.1
  
  set M : ℝ := l x₀ with hM
  have hlf : ∀ z ∈ f, l z = M := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hl] at hz hx₀f
    exact le_antisymm (hx₀f.2 z hz.1) (hz.2 x₀ hx₀f.1)
  have hlmax : ∀ y ∈ P.toSet, l y ≤ M := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hl] at hx₀f
    exact hx₀f.2 y hy
  
  by_cases hA : ∀ v ∈ P.vertices, v ∈ f
  · have hTf : P.toSet ⊆ f := by
      have hsub : (P.vertices : Set (E n)) ⊆ f := fun v hv =>
        hA v (by exact_mod_cast hv)
      have hconv : Convex ℝ f := hf.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
      exact convexHull_min hsub hconv
    have hfT : f = P.toSet := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ hTf
      rw [hl]; exact fun z hz => hz.1
    refine ⟨?_, hene⟩
    intro _
    refine ⟨l', ?_⟩
    rw [hl', hfT]
  
  · push_neg at hA
    obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀V, hv₀f⟩ := hA
    set Vout : Finset (E n) := P.vertices.filter (· ∉ f) with hVout
    have hVoutne : Vout.Nonempty := ⟨v₀, by simp [hVout, hv₀V, hv₀f]⟩
    
    set mout : ℝ := (Vout.image (fun v => l v)).max'
      (hVoutne.image _) with hmout
    have hmout_lt : mout < M := by
      have : ∀ b ∈ Vout.image (fun v => l v), b < M := by
        intro b hb
        obtain ⟨v, hvin, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
        have hvV : v ∈ P.vertices := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvin).1
        have hvnf : v ∉ f := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hvin).2
        have hle : l v ≤ M := hlmax v (subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hvV))
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          apply hvnf
          rw [hl]
          exact ⟨subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hvV),
            fun y hy => h ▸ hlmax y hy⟩
      rw [hmout]
      exact (Finset.max'_lt_iff _ (hVoutne.image _)).mpr this
    set δ : ℝ := M - mout with hδ
    have hδpos : 0 < δ := by simp [hδ]; linarith
    
    have hVne : P.vertices.Nonempty := P.vertices_nonempty
    set C : ℝ := (P.vertices.image (fun v => |l' v|)).max'
      (hVne.image _) with hC
    have hCnneg : 0 ≤ C := by
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hVne
      have : |l' v| ∈ P.vertices.image (fun v => |l' v|) :=
        Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hv
      rw [hC]
      exact le_trans (abs_nonneg (l' v))
        (Finset.le_max' (P.vertices.image (fun w => |l' w|)) (|l' v|) this)
    have hl'le : ∀ x ∈ P.toSet, l' x ≤ C := by
      apply le_su_toSet
      intro v hv
      have hvV : v ∈ P.vertices := by exact_mod_cast hv
      have hCb : |l' v| ≤ C := by
        rw [hC]
        exact Finset.le_max' (P.vertices.image (fun w => |l' w|)) (|l' v|)
          (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun w => |l' w|) hvV)
      linarith [le_abs_self (l' v)]
    have hl'ge : ∀ x ∈ P.toSet, -C ≤ l' x := by
      have h2 : ∀ x ∈ P.toSet, (-l') x ≤ C := by
        apply le_su_toSet
        intro v hv
        have hvV : v ∈ P.vertices := by exact_mod_cast hv
        have h2a : |l' v| ≤ C := by
          rw [hC]
          exact Finset.le_max' (P.vertices.image (fun w => |l' w|)) (|l' v|)
            (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun w => |l' w|) hvV)
        have h2b := neg_abs_le (l' v)
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply]
        linarith
      intro x hx
      have := h2 x hx
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply] at this
      linarith
    
    set ε : ℝ := δ / (2 * C + 1) with hε
    have hεpos : 0 < ε := div_pos hδpos (by linarith)
    have h2C1 : (0:ℝ) < 2 * C + 1 := by linarith
    have hεδ : ε * (2 * C + 1) = δ := by
      rw [hε]
      field_simp
    have hεC : 2 * ε * C < δ := by nlinarith
    
    set L : E n →L[ℝ] ℝ := l + ε • l' with hLdef
    have hLapp : ∀ x, L x = l x + ε * l' x := by
      intro x
      simp [hLdef, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    refine ⟨?_, hene⟩
    intro _
    refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hxf : x ∈ f := by rw [hl'] at hx; exact hx.1
      have hxT : x ∈ P.toSet := by rw [hl] at hxf; exact hxf.1
      refine ⟨hxT, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      have hvert : ∀ v ∈ (P.vertices : Set (E n)), L v ≤ L x := by
        intro v hvS
        have hvV : v ∈ P.vertices := by exact_mod_cast hvS
        have hvT : v ∈ P.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ hvS
        by_cases hvf : v ∈ f
        · have h1 : l v = M := hlf v hvf
          have h2 : l' v ≤ l' x := by
            rw [hl'] at hx
            exact hx.2 v hvf
          rw [hLapp, hLapp, h1, hlf x hxf]
          nlinarith
        · have h1 : l v ≤ mout := by
            rw [hmout]
            exact Finset.le_max' (Vout.image (fun w => l w)) (l v)
              (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun w => l w) (by simp [hVout, hvV, hvf]))
          have h2 : l' v ≤ C := by
            have hb : |l' v| ≤ C := by
              rw [hC]
              exact Finset.le_max' (P.vertices.image (fun w => |l' w|)) (|l' v|)
                (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun w => |l' w|) hvV)
            linarith [le_abs_self (l' v)]
          have h3 : -C ≤ l' x := hl'ge x hxT
          rw [hLapp, hLapp, hlf x hxf]
          have hmoutδ : mout = M - δ := by rw [hδ]; ring
          nlinarith
      exact le_su_toSet P L hvert y hy
    · rintro ⟨hxT, hxmax⟩
      have hxhull := PlatoniciL3.faccia_argmax P.vertices L
        (y := x) hxT (fun w hw => hxmax w hw)
      have hVL : {z ∈ (P.vertices : Set (E n)) | L z = L x} ⊆ e := by
        rintro v ⟨hvS, hvL⟩
        have hvV : v ∈ P.vertices := by exact_mod_cast hvS
        have hvT : v ∈ P.toSet := subset_convexHull ℝ _ hvS
        have hcomp : L x₀ ≤ L x := hxmax x₀ hx₀T
        have hLx₀ : L x₀ = M + ε * l' x₀ := by
          rw [hLapp, hM]
        have hvf : v ∈ f := by
          by_contra hvnf
          have h1 : l v ≤ mout := by
            rw [hmout]
            exact Finset.le_max' (Vout.image (fun w => l w)) (l v)
              (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun w => l w) (by simp [hVout, hvV, hvnf]))
          have h2 : l' v ≤ C := by
            have hb : |l' v| ≤ C := by
              rw [hC]
              exact Finset.le_max' (P.vertices.image (fun w => |l' w|)) (|l' v|)
                (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (fun w => |l' w|) hvV)
            linarith [le_abs_self (l' v)]
          have h3 : -C ≤ l' x₀ := hl'ge x₀ hx₀T
          have h5 : L v = l v + ε * l' v := hLapp v
          have hmoutδ : mout = M - δ := by rw [hδ]; ring
          rw [hvL] at h5
          nlinarith
        have hlv : l v = M := hlf v hvf
        have h7 : L x₀ ≤ L v := by rw [hvL]; exact hcomp
        rw [hLapp, hLapp, hlv, hM] at h7
        have h8 : l' x₀ ≤ l' v := by
          have h6 : ε * l' x₀ ≤ ε * l' v := by linarith
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h6 hεpos
        rw [hl']
        refine ⟨hvf, ?_⟩
        intro y hyf
        have h9 : l' y ≤ l' x₀ := by
          rw [hl'] at hx₀
          exact hx₀.2 y hyf
        linarith
      have hecvx : Convex ℝ e := he.convex (hf.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _))
      have hsub : convexHull ℝ {z ∈ (P.vertices : Set (E n)) | L z = L x} ⊆ e :=
        convexHull_min hVL hecvx
      exact hsub hxhull

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.cosferico_extremePoints
statement:
theorem cosferico_extremePoints {A : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup A]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ A] [Nontrivial A]
    (x : A) (r : ℝ) (V : Set A) (hV : V ⊆ sphere x r) :
    (convexHull ℝ V).extremePoints ℝ = V
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm extremePoints_convexHull_subset ?_
  have hball : convexHull ℝ V ⊆ closedBall x r :=
    convexHull_min (hV.trans sphere_subset_closedBall) (convex_closedBall x r)
  intro v hv
  have hsfera : v ∈ (closedBall x r).extremePoints ℝ := by
    rw [StrictConvexSpace.extremePoints_closedBall_eq_sphere]
    exact hV hv
  exact inter_extremePoints_subset_extremePoints_of_subset hball
    ⟨subset_convexHull ℝ V hv, hsfera⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.norm_vertici
statement: theorem norm_vertici : ∀ v ∈ verticiTetra, ‖v‖ = Real.sqrt 3
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hcasi : v = w0 ∨ v = w1 ∨ v = w2 ∨ v = w3 := by
    simpa [verticiTetra] using hv
  rcases hcasi with h | h | h | h
  · subst h
    show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(1 : ℝ), 1, 1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]
    norm_num
  · subst h
    show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(1 : ℝ), -1, -1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]
    norm_num
  · subst h
    show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(-1 : ℝ), 1, -1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]
    norm_num
  · subst h
    show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(-1 : ℝ), -1, 1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]
    norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.w_apply_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem w_apply_zero : w 0 = w0
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.w_apply_one
statement: @[simp] theorem w_apply_one : w 1 = w1
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.w_apply_two
statement: @[simp] theorem w_apply_two : w 2 = w2
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.w_apply_three
statement: @[simp] theorem w_apply_three : w 3 = w3
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.w_affineIndependent
statement: theorem w_affineIndependent : AffineIndependent ℝ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIndependent_iff_eq_of_fintype_affineCombination_eq]
  intro a b ha hb hab
  funext i
  have hcoord (j : Fin 3) := congrArg (fun x : E3 => x j) hab
  rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ (by simpa using ha),
    Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ (by simpa using hb)] at hcoord
  simp [w, w0, w1, w2, w3, Fin.sum_univ_four] at hcoord
  have h0 := hcoord 0
  have h1 := hcoord 1
  have h2 := hcoord 2
  change a 0 * 1 + a 1 * 1 + a 2 * (-1) + a 3 * (-1) =
    b 0 * 1 + b 1 * 1 + b 2 * (-1) + b 3 * (-1) at h0
  change a 0 * 1 + a 1 * (-1) + a 2 * 1 + a 3 * (-1) =
    b 0 * 1 + b 1 * (-1) + b 2 * 1 + b 3 * (-1) at h1
  change a 0 * 1 + a 1 * (-1) + a 2 * (-1) + a 3 * 1 =
    b 0 * 1 + b 1 * (-1) + b 2 * (-1) + b 3 * 1 at h2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at ha hb
  have e0 : a 0 = b 0 := by linarith
  have e1 : a 1 = b 1 := by linarith
  have e2 : a 2 = b 2 := by linarith
  have e3 : a 3 = b 3 := by linarith
  fin_cases i
  · exact e0
  · exact e1
  · simpa using e2
  · simpa using e3

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.w_injective
statement: theorem w_injective : Function.Injective w
proof: := w_affineIndependent.injective

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.verticiTetra_eq_map
statement: theorem verticiTetra_eq_map : verticiTetra = Finset.univ.map wEmb
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [verticiTetra, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
    Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨3, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i <;> simp [wEmb, w]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.range_w_eq_vertices
statement: theorem range_w_eq_vertices : Set.range w = (tetraedroB.vertices : Set E3)
proof:
:= by
  change Set.range w = (verticiTetra : Set E3)
  rw [verticiTetra_eq_map]
  ext x
  simp [wEmb]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraedroB_finrank
statement:
theorem tetraedroB_finrank :
    Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (tetraedroB.vertices : Set E3)) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← range_w_eq_vertices]
  exact w_affineIndependent.finrank_vectorSpan (by simp)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.exposedFace_eq_convexHull_vertices
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset E3 := tetraedroB.vertices.filter (· ∈ F)
  have hPcompact : IsCompact tetraedroB.toSet :=
    tetraedroB.vertices.finite_toSet.isCompact_convexHull ℝ
  have hFcompact : IsCompact F := hF.1.isCompact hPcompact
  have hFconvex : Convex ℝ F := hF.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have hKM := closure_convexHull_extremePoints hFcompact hFconvex
  have hext : F.extremePoints ℝ = (S : Set E3) := by
    rw [hF.1.isExtreme.extremePoints_eq]
    ext x
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, mem_inter_iff]
    change (x ∈ F ∧ x ∈ tetraedroB.toSet.extremePoints ℝ) ↔
      x ∈ tetraedroB.vertices ∧ x ∈ F
    rw [ConvexPolytope.toSet, ← tetraedroB.vertices_eq_extremePoints]
    tauto
  calc
    F = closure (convexHull ℝ (F.extremePoints ℝ)) := hKM.symm
    _ = closure (convexHull ℝ (S : Set E3)) := by rw [hext]
    _ = convexHull ℝ (S : Set E3) :=
      (S.finite_toSet.isClosed_convexHull ℝ).closure_eq
    _ = convexHull ℝ
        ((tetraedroB.vertices.filter (· ∈ F) : Finset E3) : Set E3) := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.affineIndependent_vertices
statement:
theorem affineIndependent_vertices :
    AffineIndependent ℝ
      ((↑) : {x // x ∈ (tetraedroB.vertices : Set E3)} → E3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← range_w_eq_vertices]
  exact w_affineIndependent.range

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.filtered_vertices_eq_map
statement:
theorem filtered_vertices_eq_map (F : Set E3) :
    tetraedroB.vertices.filter (· ∈ F) = (faceIndices F).map wEmb
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show tetraedroB.vertices = verticiTetra by rfl, verticiTetra_eq_map]
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨hxv, hxF⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
    obtain ⟨i, _hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hxv
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr
      ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hxF⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hx
    have hiF := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩, hiF⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.face_eq_hull_indices
statement:
theorem face_eq_hull_indices {F : Set E3} (hF : tetraedroB.IsFace F) :
    F = convexHull ℝ (((faceIndices F).map wEmb : Finset E3) : Set E3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← filtered_vertices_eq_map]
  exact exposedFace_eq_convexHull_vertices hF

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.faceIndices_card
statement:
theorem faceIndices_card {F : Set E3} (hF : tetraedroB.IsFace F) :
    (faceIndices F).card = ConvexPolytope.faceDim F + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset E3 := tetraedroB.vertices.filter (· ∈ F)
  have hFS : F = convexHull ℝ (S : Set E3) := exposedFace_eq_convexHull_vertices hF
  have hSsub : S ⊆ tetraedroB.vertices := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
    have hne := hF.2
    rw [hFS, h] at hne
    simp at hne
  have hSind : AffineIndependent ℝ
      ((↑) : {x // x ∈ (S : Set E3)} → E3) :=
    affineIndependent_vertices.mono (by
      intro x hx
      exact_mod_cast hSsub hx)
  letI : Nonempty {x // x ∈ (S : Set E3)} :=
    ⟨⟨hSne.choose, hSne.choose_spec⟩⟩
  have hdim := hSind.finrank_vectorSpan_add_one
  have hrange : Set.range ((↑) : {x // x ∈ (S : Set E3)} → E3) = (S : Set E3) :=
    Subtype.range_coe_subtype
  rw [hrange] at hdim
  have hdim' : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (S : Set E3)) =
      ConvexPolytope.faceDim F := by
    symm
    unfold ConvexPolytope.faceDim
    rw [hFS, ← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull, direction_affineSpan]
  rw [hdim'] at hdim
  rw [← Finset.card_map wEmb, ← filtered_vertices_eq_map F]
  change S.card = ConvexPolytope.faceDim F + 1
  simpa using hdim.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.faceIndices_mono
statement:
theorem faceIndices_mono {F G : Set E3} (h : F ⊆ G) :
    faceIndices F ⊆ faceIndices G
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  simpa [faceIndices] using h (by simpa [faceIndices] using hi)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.flag_has_triple
statement: theorem flag_has_triple (F : tetraedroB.Flag) : Nonempty (FlagTriple F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S0 := faceIndices (F.face 0)
  let S1 := faceIndices (F.face 1)
  let S2 := faceIndices (F.face 2)
  have hc0 : S0.card = 1 := by
    simpa [S0, F.dim_eq] using faceIndices_card (F.isFace 0)
  have hc1 : S1.card = 2 := by
    simpa [S1, F.dim_eq] using faceIndices_card (F.isFace 1)
  have hc2 : S2.card = 3 := by
    simpa [S2, F.dim_eq] using faceIndices_card (F.isFace 2)
  have h01 : S0 ⊆ S1 :=
    faceIndices_mono (F.strict_mono 0 1 (by decide)).1
  have h12 : S1 ⊆ S2 :=
    faceIndices_mono (F.strict_mono 1 2 (by decide)).1
  obtain ⟨a, hS0⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc0
  obtain ⟨b, hb0, hbEq⟩ := Finset.exists_eq_insert_iff.mpr
    ⟨h01, by omega⟩
  have hS1 : S1 = {a, b} := by
    rw [← hbEq, hS0]
    ext x
    simp [or_comm]
  obtain ⟨c, hc1not, hcEq⟩ := Finset.exists_eq_insert_iff.mpr
    ⟨h12, by omega⟩
  have hS2 : S2 = {a, b, c} := by
    rw [← hcEq, hS1]
    ext x
    simp [or_left_comm, or_comm]
  let p : Fin 3 → Fin 4 := ![a, b, c]
  have hp : Function.Injective p := by
    intro i j hij
    have hba : b ≠ a := by
      intro h
      apply hb0
      simp [hS0, h]
    have hca : c ≠ a := by
      intro h
      apply hc1not
      simp [hS1, h]
    have hcb : c ≠ b := by
      intro h
      apply hc1not
      simp [hS1, h]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [p]
  refine ⟨{
    idx := p
    injective := hp
    face_zero := ?_
    face_one := ?_
    face_two := ?_ }⟩
  · rw [face_eq_hull_indices (F.isFace 0)]
    rw [show faceIndices (F.face 0) = S0 by rfl, hS0]
    congr 2
    ext x
    simp [p, wEmb]
  · rw [face_eq_hull_indices (F.isFace 1)]
    rw [show faceIndices (F.face 1) = S1 by rfl, hS1]
    congr 2
    ext x
    simp [p, wEmb]
  · rw [face_eq_hull_indices (F.isFace 2)]
    rw [show faceIndices (F.face 2) = S2 by rfl, hS2]
    congr 2
    ext x
    simp [p, wEmb]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.inner_toLp
statement:
theorem inner_toLp (a b c d e f : ℝ) :
    inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 ![a, b, c] : E3)
      (WithLp.toLp 2 ![d, e, f] : E3) = a * d + b * e + c * f
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  norm_num [show (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 0 = a from rfl,
    show (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 = b from rfl,
    show (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 2 = c from rfl,
    show (![d, e, f] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 0 = d from rfl,
    show (![d, e, f] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 = e from rfl,
    show (![d, e, f] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 2 = f from rfl]
  ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.inner_w
statement:
theorem inner_w (i j : Fin 4) :
    inner ℝ (w i) (w j) = if i = j then 3 else -1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [if_pos rfl, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    have hi : w i ∈ verticiTetra := by
      rw [verticiTetra_eq_map]
      exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    rw [norm_vertici (w i) hi, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
  · rw [if_neg hij]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp_all [w, w0, w1, w2, w3, inner_toLp]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.axis_orthonormal
statement: theorem axis_orthonormal (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) : Orthonormal ℝ (axis σ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    have h0 : σ 0 ≠ σ i.succ := σ.injective.ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm
    simp only [axis, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_left,
      inner_add_right, inner_w]
    simp [h0]
    norm_num
  · have h0i : σ 0 ≠ σ i.succ := σ.injective.ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm
    have h0j : σ 0 ≠ σ j.succ := σ.injective.ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm
    have hij' : σ i.succ ≠ σ j.succ :=
      σ.injective.ne (fun h => hij (Fin.succ_injective 3 h))
    rw [if_neg hij]
    simp only [axis, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_left,
      inner_add_right, inner_w]
    simp [h0j, hij']
    norm_num

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.axisBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem axisBasis_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (j : Fin 3) :
    axisBasis σ j = axis σ j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [axisBasis]
  rw [OrthonormalBasis.coe_mk]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.sum_w
statement: theorem sum_w : ∑ i : Fin 4, w i = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [w, w0, w1, w2, w3, Fin.sum_univ_four]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.sum_w_tail
statement:
theorem sum_w_tail (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    ∑ j : Fin 3, w (σ j.succ) = -w (σ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∑ i : Fin 4, w (σ i) = 0 := by
    rw [Equiv.sum_comp σ w]
    exact sum_w
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hall
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hall

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.sum_axis
statement:
theorem sum_axis (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    ∑ j : Fin 3, axis σ j = w (σ 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (∑ j : Fin 3, axis σ j) =
      (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ j : Fin 3, (w (σ 0) + w (σ j.succ)) by
    simp [axis, Finset.smul_sum]]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sum_w_tail]
  simp
  module

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraLinear_axis
statement:
theorem tetraLinear_axis (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (j : Fin 3) :
    tetraLinear σ (axis (Equiv.refl (Fin 4)) j) = axis σ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← axisBasis_apply (Equiv.refl (Fin 4)) j, ← axisBasis_apply σ j]
  simpa [tetraLinear] using
    (axisBasis (Equiv.refl (Fin 4))).equiv_apply_basis
      (axisBasis σ) (Equiv.refl (Fin 3)) j

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraLinear_vertex_zero
statement:
theorem tetraLinear_vertex_zero (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    tetraLinear σ (w 0) = w (σ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ∑ j : Fin 3, axis (Equiv.refl (Fin 4)) j = w 0 := by
    simpa using sum_axis (Equiv.refl (Fin 4))
  rw [← hbase, map_sum]
  simp_rw [tetraLinear_axis]
  exact sum_axis σ

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraLinear_vertex
statement:
theorem tetraLinear_vertex (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (i : Fin 4) :
    tetraLinear σ (w i) = w (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · exact tetraLinear_vertex_zero σ
  · have hsource : w j.succ = (2 : ℝ) • axis (Equiv.refl (Fin 4)) j - w 0 := by
      simp [axis]
    have htarget : w (σ j.succ) = (2 : ℝ) • axis σ j - w (σ 0) := by
      simp [axis]
    rw [hsource, map_sub, map_smul, tetraLinear_axis]
    rw [tetraLinear_vertex_zero]
    exact htarget.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraIsom_vertex
statement:
theorem tetraIsom_vertex (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (i : Fin 4) :
    tetraIsom σ (w i) = w (σ i)
proof: := tetraLinear_vertex σ i

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraIsom_image_vertices
statement:
theorem tetraIsom_image_vertices (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    (⇑(tetraIsom σ)) '' (tetraedroB.vertices : Set E3) =
      (tetraedroB.vertices : Set E3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← range_w_eq_vertices]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [tetraIsom_vertex]
    exact Set.mem_range_self (σ i)
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨w (σ.symm i), Set.mem_range_self _, ?_⟩
    rw [tetraIsom_vertex, σ.apply_symm_apply]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraIsom_image_hull
statement:
theorem tetraIsom_image_hull (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (S : Set E3) :
    (⇑(tetraIsom σ)) '' convexHull ℝ S =
      convexHull ℝ ((⇑(tetraIsom σ)) '' S)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [AffineEquiv.coe_toAffineMap, AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_toAffineEquiv] using
    (tetraIsom σ).toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.image_convexHull S

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraIsom_symmetry
statement:
theorem tetraIsom_symmetry (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    tetraedroB.isSymmetry (tetraIsom σ)
proof:
:= by
  change (⇑(tetraIsom σ)) '' convexHull ℝ (tetraedroB.vertices : Set E3) =
    convexHull ℝ (tetraedroB.vertices : Set E3)
  rw [tetraIsom_image_hull, tetraIsom_image_vertices]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.image_vertex_set_one
statement:
theorem image_vertex_set_one (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (a : Fin 4) :
    (⇑(tetraIsom σ)) '' ({w a} : Set E3) = {w (σ a)}
proof:
:= by
  ext x

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.image_vertex_set_two
statement:
theorem image_vertex_set_two (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (a b : Fin 4) :
    (⇑(tetraIsom σ)) '' ({w a, w b} : Set E3) = {w (σ a), w (σ b)}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [tetraIsom_vertex, eq_comm]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.image_vertex_set_three
proof:
:= by
  ext x

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F10.tetraedroB_isRegular
statement: theorem tetraedroB_isRegular : tetraedroB.IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ConvexPolytope.IsFullDim, ConvexPolytope.dim,
      ConvexPolytope.toSet, ← direction_affineSpan,
      affineSpan_convexHull, direction_affineSpan]
    exact tetraedroB_finrank
  · intro F G
    let f := (flag_has_triple F).some
    let g := (flag_has_triple G).some
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair
      f.idx g.idx f.injective g.injective
    refine ⟨tetraIsom σ, tetraIsom_symmetry σ, ?_⟩
    intro k
    by_cases hk0 : k = 0
    · subst k
      rw [f.face_zero, g.face_zero, tetraIsom_image_hull,
        image_vertex_set_one, hσ]
    by_cases hk1 : k = 1
    · subst k
      rw [f.face_one, g.face_one, tetraIsom_image_hull,
        image_vertex_set_two]
      simp_rw [hσ]
    · have hk2 : k = 2 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        omega
      subst k
      rw [f.face_two, g.face_two, tetraIsom_image_hull,
        image_vertex_set_three]
      simp_rw [hσ]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F11.isExposed_image_isom
statement:
theorem isExposed_image_isom (φ : ConvexPolytope.Isom 3) {A B : Set E3}
    (h : IsExposed ℝ A B) : IsExposed ℝ ((⇑φ) '' A) ((⇑φ) '' B)
proof:
:= by
  intro hne
  obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨a, haB, hab⟩ := hbB
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := h ⟨a, haB⟩
  let l' : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    l.comp φ.symm.linearIsometryEquiv.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hl' (x : E3) : l' (φ x) = l x - l (φ.symm 0) := by
    have hm := φ.symm.map_vsub (φ x) 0
    have hm' : φ.symm.linearIsometryEquiv (φ x) = x - φ.symm 0 := by
      simpa using hm
    simp only [l', ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    change l (φ.symm.linearIsometryEquiv (φ x)) = _
    rw [hm', map_sub]
  refine ⟨l', Set.ext ?_⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    rw [hl] at hb
    refine ⟨⟨b, hb.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [hl' y, hl' b]
    exact sub_le_sub_right (hb.2 y hy) _
  · rintro ⟨hxA, hxmax⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hxA
    refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [hl]
    refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hle := hxmax (φ y) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [hl' y, hl' a] at hle
    linarith

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F11.faceDim_image_isom
statement:
theorem faceDim_image_isom (φ : ConvexPolytope.Isom 3) (F : Set E3) :
    ConvexPolytope.faceDim ((⇑φ) '' F) = ConvexPolytope.faceDim F
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvexPolytope.faceDim
  have hmap := φ.toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.map_vectorSpan (s := F)
  change Submodule.map (φ.toAffineEquiv.linear : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) (vectorSpan ℝ F) =
    vectorSpan ℝ ((⇑φ) '' F) at hmap
  rw [← hmap]
  exact φ.toAffineEquiv.linear.finrank_map_eq (vectorSpan ℝ F)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F11.isFace_image_isom
statement:
theorem isFace_image_isom {P : ConvexPolytope 3} (φ : ConvexPolytope.Isom 3)
    (hφ : P.isSymmetry φ) {F : Set E3} (hF : P.IsFace F) :
    P.IsFace ((⇑φ) '' F)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, hF.2.image _⟩
  rw [← hφ]
  exact isExposed_image_isom φ hF.1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F11.symmetry_refl
statement:
theorem symmetry_refl (P : ConvexPolytope 3) :
    P.isSymmetry (AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ E3)
proof:
:= by
  exact Set.image_id _

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F11.symmetry_trans
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry at *
  calc
    (⇑(φ.trans ψ)) '' P.toSet = (⇑ψ) '' ((⇑φ) '' P.toSet) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
      rfl
    _ = P.toSet := by rw [hφ, hψ]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F11.symmetry_symm
statement:
theorem symmetry_symm {P : ConvexPolytope 3} {φ : ConvexPolytope.Isom 3}
    (hφ : P.isSymmetry φ) : P.isSymmetry φ.symm
proof:
:= by
  unfold ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry at *
  calc
    (⇑φ.symm) '' P.toSet = (⇑φ.symm) '' ((⇑φ) '' P.toSet) := by rw [hφ]
    _ = P.toSet := φ.toEquiv.symm_image_image P.toSet

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.F11.zeroFace_is_vertex
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hF.2
  have hspan : vectorSpan ℝ F = ⊥ := by
    apply Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp
    exact hd
  have hsingle : F = {v} := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      have hxv := vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hx hv
      rw [hspan] at hxv
      have : x - v = 0 := by simpa using hxv
      simpa using sub_eq_zero.mp this
    · exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hv
  refine ⟨v, hsingle, ?_⟩
  have hexposed : IsExposed ℝ P.toSet ({v} : Set E3) := by
    rw [← hsingle]
    exact hF.1
  have hvext : v ∈ P.toSet.extremePoints ℝ :=
    hexposed.isExtreme.mem_extremePoints
  rw [ConvexPolytope.toSet, ← P.vertices_eq_extremePoints] at hvext
  exact hvext
