      ≠ D.faccetta (finRotate q (finRotate q i)) := by
    intro h
    exact finRotate_ne_self (by omega) (finRotate q i) (D.distinte h).symm
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc⟩ := intersezione_spigolo_semiretta P
    (D.isFacet (finRotate q i)) (D.isFacet (finRotate q (finRotate q i)))
    hFG (D.mem_v _) (D.mem_v _) hvex htr.1 hnext.2 htr.2.1 hnext.1
  
  have hlin : D.σ.linearIsometryEquiv (punto P v D i - v)
      = D.σ (punto P v D i) - v := by
    have h := D.σ.map_vsub (punto P v D i) v
    rw [D.fissa_v] at h
    simpa using h
  have hnorm : ‖punto P v D (finRotate q i) - v‖ = c * ‖punto P v D i - v‖ := by
    rw [hc, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc0, htr.2.2]
  have hnormi : ‖punto P v D i - v‖ ≠ 0 :=
    norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hi.1)
  rw [dir, dir, map_smul, hlin, hnorm, hc, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc0
  have hni : ‖punto P v D i - v‖ ≠ 0 :=
    norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hi.1)
  rw [mul_inv]
  field_simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexOne_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem simplexOne_apply (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    simplexOne d i = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [simplexOne]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexOne_ne_zero
statement: theorem simplexOne_ne_zero (d : ℕ) : simplexOne d ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrArg (fun x : E (d + 1) => x 0) h
  norm_num at h0

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexCoordPerm_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem simplexCoordPerm_single (d : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1))) (i : Fin (d + 1)) (a : ℝ) :
    simplexCoordPerm d σ (EuclideanSpace.single i a) =
      EuclideanSpace.single (σ i) a
proof:
:= by
  simp [simplexCoordPerm]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexCoordPerm_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem simplexCoordPerm_one (d : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1))) :
    simplexCoordPerm d σ (simplexOne d) = simplexOne d
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  change simplexOne d (σ.symm i) = simplexOne d i
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexRawVert_injective
statement:
theorem simplexRawVert_injective (d : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (simplexRawVert d)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' := congrArg Subtype.val hij
  change EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) -
      ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • simplexOne d =
    EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) -
      ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • simplexOne d at hij'
  have hs : EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) =
      EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) := sub_left_inj.mp hij'
  have hi := congrArg (fun x : E (d + 1) => x i) hs
  by_contra hne
  simp [hne] at hi

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertSimplesso_injective
statement:
theorem vertSimplesso_injective (d : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (vertSimplesso d)
proof:
:=
  (simplexHyperplaneEquiv d).injective.comp (simplexRawVert_injective d)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.mem_verticiSimplesso
statement:
theorem mem_verticiSimplesso {d : ℕ} {x : E d} :
    x ∈ verticiSimplesso d ↔ ∃ k : Fin (d + 1), vertSimplesso d k = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [verticiSimplesso]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.card_verticiSimplesso
statement: theorem card_verticiSimplesso (d : ℕ) : (verticiSimplesso d).card = d + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticiSimplesso,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (vertSimplesso_injective d)]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexRawVert_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem simplexRawVert_affineIndependent (d : ℕ) :
    AffineIndependent ℝ (simplexRawVert d)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : LinearIndependent ℝ
      (fun k : Fin (d + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) := by
    have heq : (fun k : Fin (d + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) =
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).toBasis := by
      funext k
      exact (EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ k).symm
    rw [heq]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (d + 1)) ℝ).toBasis.linearIndependent
  have ha : AffineIndependent ℝ
      (fun k : Fin (d + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) :=
    hb.affineIndependent
  have hat : AffineIndependent ℝ (fun k : Fin (d + 1) =>
      EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ) -
        ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • simplexOne d) := by
    have hv := (affineIndependent_vadd (k := ℝ)
      (p := fun k : Fin (d + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))
      (v := -(((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • simplexOne d))).2 ha
    have heq : (fun k : Fin (d + 1) =>
        EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ) -
          ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • simplexOne d) =
        (-(((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ • simplexOne d) +ᵥ
          fun k : Fin (d + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) := by
      funext k
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
    rw [heq]
    exact hv
  apply AffineIndependent.of_comp (simplexHyperplane d).subtype.toAffineMap
  simpa [Function.comp_def, simplexRawVert] using hat

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertSimplesso_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem vertSimplesso_affineIndependent (d : ℕ) :
    AffineIndependent ℝ (vertSimplesso d)
proof:
:= by
  exact (simplexHyperplaneEquiv d).toLinearEquiv.toAffineEquiv.affineIndependent_iff.mpr
    (simplexRawVert_affineIndependent d)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.verticiSimplesso_coe_eq_range
statement:
theorem verticiSimplesso_coe_eq_range (d : ℕ) :
    ((verticiSimplesso d : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)) =
      Set.range (vertSimplesso d)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [verticiSimplesso]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norm_simplexRawVert_eq
statement:
theorem norm_simplexRawVert_eq (d : ℕ) (i j : Fin (d + 1)) :
    ‖simplexRawVert d i‖ = ‖simplexRawVert d j‖
proof:
:= by
  let σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1)) := Equiv.swap i j
  let L := simplexCoordPerm d σ
  change ‖(simplexRawVert d i : E (d + 1))‖ =
    ‖(simplexRawVert d j : E (d + 1))‖
  calc
    ‖(simplexRawVert d i : E (d + 1))‖ =
        ‖L (simplexRawVert d i : E (d + 1))‖ := (L.norm_map _).symm
    _ = ‖(simplexRawVert d j : E (d + 1))‖ := by
      congr 1
      simp [L, σ, simplexRawVert]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertSimplesso_cospherical
statement:
theorem vertSimplesso_cospherical (d : ℕ) :
    (Set.range (vertSimplesso d)) ⊆ sphere 0 ‖vertSimplesso d 0‖
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
  simp only [vertSimplesso, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  exact norm_simplexRawVert_eq d k 0

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.verticiSimplesso_eq_extremePoints
statement:
theorem verticiSimplesso_eq_extremePoints (d : ℕ) :
    ((verticiSimplesso d : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)) =
      Set.extremePoints ℝ
        (convexHull ℝ ((verticiSimplesso d : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · subst d
    have hsingle : ((verticiSimplesso 0 : Finset (E 0)) : Set (E 0)) = {0} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact Subsingleton.elim x 0
      · rintro rfl
        rw [verticiSimplesso_coe_eq_range]
        exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
    rw [hsingle]
    simp
  · have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd
    haveI : Nontrivial (E d) := by
      refine ⟨⟨0, EuclideanSpace.single ⟨0, hdpos⟩ 1, ?_⟩⟩
      intro h
      have h0 := congrArg (fun x : E d => x ⟨0, hdpos⟩) h
      norm_num [PiLp.single_apply] at h0
    rw [verticiSimplesso_coe_eq_range]
    symm
    exact cosferico_extremePoints 0 ‖vertSimplesso d 0‖ _
      (vertSimplesso_cospherical d)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.card_simplesso
statement:
theorem card_simplesso (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    (simplesso d hd).vertices.card = d + 1
proof:
:=
  card_verticiSimplesso d

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplesso_isFullDim
statement:
theorem simplesso_isFullDim (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    (simplesso d hd).IsFullDim
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : vectorSpan ℝ (Set.range (vertSimplesso d)) = ⊤ :=
    (vertSimplesso_affineIndependent d).vectorSpan_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank_add_one
      (by simp [finrank_euclideanSpace])
  rw [ConvexPolytope.IsFullDim, ConvexPolytope.dim]
  change Module.finrank ℝ
    (vectorSpan ℝ (convexHull ℝ
      ((verticiSimplesso d : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)))) = d
  rw [← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull, direction_affineSpan,
    verticiSimplesso_coe_eq_range, hspan, finrank_top, finrank_euclideanSpace]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.verticiSimplesso_affineIndependent_set
statement:
theorem verticiSimplesso_affineIndependent_set (d : ℕ) :
    AffineIndependent ℝ
      ((↑) : {x // x ∈
        (((verticiSimplesso d : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)))} → E d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticiSimplesso_coe_eq_range]
  exact (vertSimplesso_affineIndependent d).range

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplesso_face_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem simplesso_face_affineIndependent (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    {f : Set (E d)} :
    AffineIndependent ℝ
      ((↑) : {x // x ∈
        ((((simplesso d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f) : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)))} →
        E d)
proof:
:= by
  apply (verticiSimplesso_affineIndependent_set d).mono
  intro x hx
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp (by exact_mod_cast hx)).1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplesso_face_card
statement:
theorem simplesso_face_card (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    {f : Set (E d)} (hf : (simplesso d hd).IsFace f) :
    ((simplesso d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f)).card = faceDim f + 1
proof:
:= by
  let S : Finset (E d) := (simplesso d hd).vertices.filter (· ∈ f)
  have hFS : f = convexHull ℝ (S : Set (E d)) := face_eq_hull_vertices _ hf
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
    have hne := hf.2
    rw [hFS, h] at hne
    simp at hne
  have hSind : AffineIndependent ℝ
      ((↑) : {x // x ∈ (S : Set (E d))} → E d) := by
    simpa only [S] using simplesso_face_affineIndependent d hd (f := f)
  letI : Nonempty {x // x ∈ (S : Set (E d))} :=
    ⟨⟨hSne.choose, hSne.choose_spec⟩⟩
  have hdim := hSind.finrank_vectorSpan_add_one
  have hrange : Set.range ((↑) : {x // x ∈ (S : Set (E d))} → E d) =
      (S : Set (E d)) := Subtype.range_coe_subtype
  rw [hrange] at hdim
  have hdim' : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (S : Set (E d))) = faceDim f := by
    symm
    unfold faceDim
    rw [hFS, ← direction_affineSpan, affineSpan_convexHull, direction_affineSpan]
  rw [hdim'] at hdim
  change S.card = faceDim f + 1
  simpa using hdim.symm

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexCoordPerm_mem_hyperplane
statement:
theorem simplexCoordPerm_mem_hyperplane (d : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1))) {x : E (d + 1)}
    (hx : x ∈ simplexHyperplane d) :
    simplexCoordPerm d σ x ∈ simplexHyperplane d
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_left] at hx ⊢
  rw [← simplexCoordPerm_one d σ,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map]
  exact hx

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexHyperplanePerm_raw
statement:
@[simp] theorem simplexHyperplanePerm_raw (d : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1))) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    simplexHyperplanePerm d σ (simplexRawVert d k) =
      simplexRawVert d (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [simplexHyperplanePerm, simplexRawVert]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexLinearPerm_vert
statement:
@[simp] theorem simplexLinearPerm_vert (d : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1))) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    simplexLinearPerm d σ (vertSimplesso d k) = vertSimplesso d (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [simplexLinearPerm, vertSimplesso]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexPerm_vert
statement:
@[simp] theorem simplexPerm_vert (d : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1))) (k : Fin (d + 1)) :
    simplexPerm d σ (vertSimplesso d k) = vertSimplesso d (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  exact simplexLinearPerm_vert d σ k

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexPerm_image_vertici
statement:
theorem simplexPerm_image_vertici (d : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1))) :
    (simplexPerm d σ : E d → E d) '' (verticiSimplesso d : Set (E d)) =
      (verticiSimplesso d : Set (E d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [verticiSimplesso_coe_eq_range]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨k, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨σ k, (simplexPerm_vert d σ k).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨vertSimplesso d (σ.symm k), ⟨σ.symm k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplexPerm_isSymmetry
statement:
theorem simplexPerm_isSymmetry (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1))) :
    (simplesso d hd).isSymmetry (simplexPerm d σ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConvexPolytope.isSymmetry, ConvexPolytope.toSet]
  calc
    (simplexPerm d σ : E d → E d) ''
        convexHull ℝ ((simplesso d hd).vertices : Set (E d)) =
      convexHull ℝ ((simplexPerm d σ : E d → E d) ''
        ((simplesso d hd).vertices : Set (E d))) := by
          exact (simplexPerm d σ).toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.image_convexHull _
    _ = convexHull ℝ ((simplesso d hd).vertices : Set (E d)) := by
      rw [show ((simplesso d hd).vertices : Set (E d)) =
          (verticiSimplesso d : Set (E d)) by rfl,
        simplexPerm_image_vertici]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagVertices_card
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagVertices_card (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    (simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k).card = k.val + 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [simplessoFlagVertices, F.dim_eq] using
    simplesso_face_card d hd (F.isFace k)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagVertices_mono
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagVertices_mono (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) {i j : Fin d} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    simplessoFlagVertices d hd F i ⊆ simplessoFlagVertices d hd F j
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [simplessoFlagVertices, Finset.mem_filter] at hv ⊢
  refine ⟨hv.1, ?_⟩
  rcases hij.eq_or_lt with rfl | hij
  · exact hv.2
  · exact (F.strict_mono i j hij).1 hv.2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagStep_nonempty
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagStep_nonempty (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    (simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k \ simplessoFlagPrev d hd F k).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k.val = 0
  · have hc := simplessoFlagVertices_card d hd F k
    simpa [simplessoFlagPrev, hk] using
      (Finset.card_pos.mp
        (by omega : 0 < (simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k).card))
  · let p : Fin d := finPredSame k hk
    have hpk : p < k := by
      apply Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr
      simp
      omega
    have hsub : simplessoFlagVertices d hd F p ⊆
        simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k :=
      simplessoFlagVertices_mono d hd F hpk.le
    have hcp := simplessoFlagVertices_card d hd F p
    have hck := simplessoFlagVertices_card d hd F k
    have hcdiff :
        (simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k \
          simplessoFlagVertices d hd F p).card = 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hsub, hcp, hck]
      simp [p]
      omega
    have hne : (simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k \
        simplessoFlagVertices d hd F p).Nonempty :=
      Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
    simpa [simplessoFlagPrev, hk, p] using hne

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagNew_mem
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagNew_mem (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    simplessoFlagNew d hd F k ∈ simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp
    (simplessoFlagStep_nonempty d hd F k).choose_spec).1

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagNew_not_prev
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagNew_not_prev (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    simplessoFlagNew d hd F k ∉ simplessoFlagPrev d hd F k
proof:
:=
  (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp
    (simplessoFlagStep_nonempty d hd F k).choose_spec).2

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagNew_injective
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagNew_injective (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) :
    Function.Injective (simplessoFlagNew d hd F)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hijlt | hjilt
  · have hj0 : j.val ≠ 0 := by omega
    let p : Fin d := finPredSame j hj0
    have hip : i ≤ p := by
      apply Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr
      omega
    have himem : simplessoFlagNew d hd F i ∈
        simplessoFlagVertices d hd F p :=
      simplessoFlagVertices_mono d hd F hip
        (simplessoFlagNew_mem d hd F i)
    have hjnot : simplessoFlagNew d hd F j ∉
        simplessoFlagVertices d hd F p := by
      simpa [simplessoFlagPrev, hj0, p] using
        simplessoFlagNew_not_prev d hd F j
    exact hjnot (hij ▸ himem)
  · have hi0 : i.val ≠ 0 := by omega
    let p : Fin d := finPredSame i hi0
    have hjp : j ≤ p := by
      apply Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr
      omega
    have hjmem : simplessoFlagNew d hd F j ∈
        simplessoFlagVertices d hd F p :=
      simplessoFlagVertices_mono d hd F hjp
        (simplessoFlagNew_mem d hd F j)
    have hinot : simplessoFlagNew d hd F i ∉
        simplessoFlagVertices d hd F p := by
      simpa [simplessoFlagPrev, hi0, p] using
        simplessoFlagNew_not_prev d hd F i
    exact hinot (hij.symm ▸ hjmem)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagVertices_eq_image_Iic
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagVertices_eq_image_Iic (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k =
      (Finset.Iic k).image (simplessoFlagNew d hd F)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
  · intro v hv
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hv
    obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact simplessoFlagVertices_mono d hd F (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hj)
      (simplessoFlagNew_mem d hd F j)
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (simplessoFlagNew_injective d hd F),
      simplessoFlagVertices_card d hd F k]
    simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagCode_spec
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagCode_spec (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    vertSimplesso d (simplessoFlagCode d hd F k) =
      simplessoFlagNew d hd F k
proof:
:=
  (mem_verticiSimplesso.mp
    (show simplessoFlagNew d hd F k ∈ verticiSimplesso d from
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp (simplessoFlagNew_mem d hd F k)).1)).choose_spec

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagCode_injective
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagCode_injective (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F : (simplesso d hd).Flag) :
    Function.Injective (simplessoFlagCode d hd F)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply simplessoFlagNew_injective d hd F
  rw [← simplessoFlagCode_spec d hd F i,
    ← simplessoFlagCode_spec d hd F j, hij]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagPerm_spec
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagPerm_spec (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F G : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    simplessoFlagPerm d hd F G (simplessoFlagCode d hd F k) =
      simplessoFlagCode d hd G k
proof:
:=
  (Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair
    (simplessoFlagCode d hd F) (simplessoFlagCode d hd G)
    (simplessoFlagCode_injective d hd F)
    (simplessoFlagCode_injective d hd G)).choose_spec k

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagIsom_new
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagIsom_new (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F G : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    simplexPerm d (simplessoFlagPerm d hd F G)
        (simplessoFlagNew d hd F k) =
      simplessoFlagNew d hd G k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← simplessoFlagCode_spec d hd F k,
    ← simplessoFlagCode_spec d hd G k,
    simplexPerm_vert, simplessoFlagPerm_spec]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagIsom_image_vertices
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagIsom_image_vertices (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F G : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    Finset.image (simplexPerm d (simplessoFlagPerm d hd F G))
        (simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k) =
      simplessoFlagVertices d hd G k
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplessoFlagVertices_eq_image_Iic d hd F k,
    simplessoFlagVertices_eq_image_Iic d hd G k]
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_Iic]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨j, hj, (simplessoFlagIsom_new d hd F G j).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨simplessoFlagNew d hd F j, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩,
      simplessoFlagIsom_new d hd F G j⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplessoFlagIsom_image_face
statement:
theorem simplessoFlagIsom_image_face (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (F G : (simplesso d hd).Flag) (k : Fin d) :
    (simplexPerm d (simplessoFlagPerm d hd F G) : E d → E d) '' F.face k =
      G.face k
proof:
:= by
  let φ := simplexPerm d (simplessoFlagPerm d hd F G)
  calc
    (φ : E d → E d) '' F.face k =
        (φ : E d → E d) '' convexHull ℝ
          ((simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)) := by
      rw [face_eq_hull_vertices (simplesso d hd) (F.isFace k)]
      rfl
    _ = convexHull ℝ ((φ : E d → E d) ''
          ((simplessoFlagVertices d hd F k : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d))) := by
      exact φ.toAffineEquiv.toAffineMap.image_convexHull _
    _ = convexHull ℝ
          ((simplessoFlagVertices d hd G k : Finset (E d)) : Set (E d)) := by
      rw [← Finset.coe_image, simplessoFlagIsom_image_vertices d hd F G k]
    _ = G.face k := by
      rw [face_eq_hull_vertices (simplesso d hd) (G.isFace k)]
      rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplesso_isRegular
statement:
theorem simplesso_isRegular (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    (simplesso d hd).IsRegular
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨simplesso_isFullDim d hd, ?_⟩
  intro F G
  refine ⟨simplexPerm d (simplessoFlagPerm d hd F G),
    simplexPerm_isSymmetry d hd _, ?_⟩
  exact simplessoFlagIsom_image_face d hd F G

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simplesso_mem_regularPolytopes
statement:
theorem simplesso_mem_regularPolytopes (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    simplesso d hd ∈ regularPolytopes d
proof:
:=
  simplesso_isRegular d hd

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.span_normaleOrientato_top
statement:
theorem span_normaleOrientato_top (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (normaleOrientato P hreg F)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
  apply (normali_orientati_linearIndependent P hreg F hn).span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, finrank_euclideanSpace]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.gram_eq_of_schlafli_eq
statement:
theorem gram_eq_of_schlafli_eq (P Q : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hregP : P.IsRegular) (hregQ : Q.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (G : Q.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hs : schlafli P hregP F = schlafli Q hregQ G) :
    ∀ i j, ⟪normaleOrientato P hregP F i, normaleOrientato P hregP F j⟫ =
      ⟪normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i, normaleOrientato Q hregQ G j⟫
proof:
:= by
  
  have aux : ∀ i j : Fin n, (i : ℕ) ≤ (j : ℕ) →
      ⟪normaleOrientato P hregP F i, normaleOrientato P hregP F j⟫ =
        ⟪normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i, normaleOrientato Q hregQ G j⟫ := by
    intro i j hij
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hij with heq | hlt
    · 
      have hij' : i = j := Fin.ext heq
      subst hij'
      rw [gram_diag_orientata P hregP F i, gram_diag_orientata Q hregQ G i]
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i : ℕ) ((j : ℕ) - 1) with hfar | hadj
      · 
        have h2 : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ) := by omega
        rw [gram_lontane_orientata P hregP F h2,
          gram_lontane_orientata Q hregQ G h2]
      · 
        have hi1 : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n := by
          have := j.isLt
          omega
        have hjeq : j = ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi1⟩ := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
          omega
        subst hjeq
        have hcox : coxeterMatrix P hregP F i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi1⟩ =
            coxeterMatrix Q hregQ G i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi1⟩ := by
          have h1 := schlafli_apply P hregP F i hi1
          have h2 := schlafli_apply Q hregQ G i hi1
          have hfi := congrFun hs i
          rw [h1, h2] at hfi
          exact hfi
        rw [gram_adiacente_orientata P hregP F i hi1 hn,
          gram_adiacente_orientata Q hregQ G i hi1 hn, hcox]
  intro i j
  rcases le_or_gt (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) with h | h
  · exact aux i j h
  · calc ⟪normaleOrientato P hregP F i, normaleOrientato P hregP F j⟫
        = ⟪normaleOrientato P hregP F j, normaleOrientato P hregP F i⟫ :=
          real_inner_comm _ _
      _ = ⟪normaleOrientato Q hregQ G j, normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i⟫ :=
          aux j i (le_of_lt h)
      _ = ⟪normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i, normaleOrientato Q hregQ G j⟫ :=
          real_inner_comm _ _

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.esiste_coniugazione_da_schlafli
statement:
theorem esiste_coniugazione_da_schlafli (P Q : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hregP : P.IsRegular) (hregQ : Q.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (G : Q.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hs : schlafli P hregP F = schlafli Q hregQ G) :
    ∃ T : E n ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E n,
      (∀ i, T (normaleOrientato P hregP F i) =
        normaleOrientato Q hregQ G i) ∧
      ∀ i x,
        coniugazioneAffine T (centroGlobale P) (centroGlobale Q)
            (simpleReflection P hregP F i x) =
          simpleReflection Q hregQ G i
            (coniugazioneAffine T (centroGlobale P) (centroGlobale Q) x)
proof:
:=
  esiste_coniugazioneAffine_da_gram P Q hregP hregQ F G
    (span_normaleOrientato_top P hregP F (by omega))
    (span_normaleOrientato_top Q hregQ G (by omega))
    (gram_eq_of_schlafli_eq P Q hregP hregQ F G hn hs)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertice_seme_fissato
statement:
theorem vertice_seme_fissato (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag)
    (hn : 0 < n) (v : E n) (hF0 : F.face ⟨0, hn⟩ = {v})
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i ≠ ⟨0, hn⟩) :
    simpleReflection P hreg F i v = v
proof:
:= by
  have h := simpleReflection_fissa_facce P hreg F i (k := ⟨0, hn⟩) (Ne.symm hi)
  rw [hF0] at h
  have hmem : simpleReflection P hreg F i v ∈ ({v} : Set (E n)) := by
    rw [← h]; exact ⟨v, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact hmem

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.inner_normale_vertice_seme
statement:
theorem inner_normale_vertice_seme (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag)
    (hn : 0 < n) (v : E n) (hF0 : F.face ⟨0, hn⟩ = {v})
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i ≠ ⟨0, hn⟩) :
    ⟪normale P hreg F i, v - puntoBase P hreg F i⟫ = 0
proof:
:=
  inner_normale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero_of_fixed P hreg F i v
    (vertice_seme_fissato P hreg F hn v hF0 i hi)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.inner_normale_vertice_centroGlobale
statement:
theorem inner_normale_vertice_centroGlobale (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 0 < n) (v : E n) (hF0 : F.face ⟨0, hn⟩ = {v})
    (i : Fin n) (hi : i ≠ ⟨0, hn⟩) :
    ⟪normale P hreg F i, v - centroGlobale P⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := inner_normale_vertice_seme P hreg F hn v hF0 i hi
  have h2 := inner_normale_sub_puntoBase_eq_zero_of_fixed P hreg F i (centroGlobale P)
    (simpleReflection_fissa_centroGlobale P hreg F i)
  have heq : v - centroGlobale P
      = (v - puntoBase P hreg F i) - (centroGlobale P - puntoBase P hreg F i) := by abel
  rw [heq, inner_sub_right, h1, h2, sub_zero]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faccia_intermedia
statement:
theorem faccia_intermedia (P : ConvexPolytope n) {A B : Set (E n)}
    (hA : P.IsFace A) (hB : P.IsFace B) (hAB : A ⊂ B)
    (hrank : faceDim B = faceDim A + 2) :
    ∃ C : Set (E n), P.IsFace C ∧ A ⊂ C ∧ C ⊂ B ∧
      faceDim C = faceDim A + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set Q : ConvexPolytope n := facePolytope P hB with hQ
  have hQtoSet : Q.toSet = B := facePolytope_toSet P hB
  have hAQ : Q.IsFace A := facePolytope_isFace_of P hB hA hAB.subset
  
  have hgap : faceDim A + 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ Q.toSet) := by
    rw [hQtoSet]
    have hBdim : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ B) = faceDim A + 2 := hrank
    omega
  
  obtain ⟨C, hCQ, hACss, hCne⟩ := interpolazione Q hAQ hgap
  
  have hCP : P.IsFace C := isFace_of_facePolytope P hB hCQ
  have hCB : C ⊆ B := by
    have h1 := face_subset_toSet Q hCQ
    rwa [hQtoSet] at h1
  have hCssB : C ⊂ B := by
    refine hCB.ssubset_of_ne ?_
    intro hEq
    apply hCne
    rw [hEq, hQtoSet]
  
  have hlo0 := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hA hCP hACss
  have hhi0 := faceDim_lt_of_ssubset P hCP hB hCssB
  have hlo : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ A) <
      Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ C) := hlo0
  have hhi : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ C) <
      Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ B) := hhi0
  have hBd : Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ B) =
      Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ A) + 2 := hrank
  refine ⟨C, hCP, hACss, hCssB, ?_⟩
  show Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ C) =
    Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ A) + 1
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faccia_intermedia_di_bandiera
statement:
theorem faccia_intermedia_di_bandiera (P : ConvexPolytope n) (F : P.Flag)
    {i j : Fin n} (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 = (j : ℕ)) :
    ∃ C : Set (E n), P.IsFace C ∧ F.face i ⊂ C ∧ C ⊂ F.face j ∧
      faceDim C = faceDim (F.face i) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : i < j := by
    rw [Fin.lt_def]
    omega
  refine faccia_intermedia P (F.isFace i) (F.isFace j)
    (F.strict_mono i j hlt) ?_
  rw [F.dim_eq i, F.dim_eq j]
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.extremePoints_image_affineEquiv
statement:
theorem extremePoints_image_affineEquiv (T : E n ≃ᵃ[ℝ] E n) (s : Set (E n)) :
    Set.extremePoints ℝ ((⇑T) '' s) = (⇑T) '' Set.extremePoints ℝ s
proof:
:= by
  have hseg : ∀ u v : E n,
      (⇑T) '' openSegment ℝ u v = openSegment ℝ (T u) (T v) := fun u v =>
    image_openSegment _ T.toAffineMap u v
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy, hstr⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    intro u hu v hv hxseg
    have himg : T x ∈ openSegment ℝ (T u) (T v) := by
      rw [← hseg]
      exact ⟨x, hxseg, rfl⟩
    have hmu : T u ∈ (⇑T) '' s := ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hmv : T v ∈ (⇑T) '' s := ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact T.injective (hstr hmu hmv himg)
  · rintro ⟨x, hxm, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hx, hstr⟩ := hxm
    refine ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro u hu v hv hy
    obtain ⟨u', hu', hue⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨v', hv', hve⟩ := hv
    have hpre : x ∈ openSegment ℝ u' v' := by
      rw [← hue, ← hve, ← hseg] at hy
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩ := hy
      rwa [← T.injective hwx]
    have h1 : u' = x := hstr hu' hv' hpre
    rw [← hue, h1]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.similMap_apply
statement:
theorem similMap_apply (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (φ : Isom n) (x : E n) :
    similMap a ha φ x = a • (φ x)
proof: := rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.vertices_card_of_similar
statement:
theorem vertices_card_of_similar {P Q : ConvexPolytope n}
    (h : Similar P Q) : Q.vertices.card = P.vertices.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha, φ, hQ⟩ := h
  have hT : Q.toSet = (⇑(similMap a ha φ)) '' P.toSet := by
    rw [hQ, ← Set.image_comp]
    rfl
  have hQv : (Q.vertices : Set (E n))
      = (⇑(similMap a ha φ)) '' (P.vertices : Set (E n)) := by
    have h1 : (Q.vertices : Set (E n)) = Set.extremePoints ℝ Q.toSet :=
      Q.vertices_eq_extremePoints
    have h2 : (P.vertices : Set (E n)) = Set.extremePoints ℝ P.toSet :=
      P.vertices_eq_extremePoints
    rw [h1, h2, hT, extremePoints_image_affineEquiv]
  have hfin : Q.vertices = P.vertices.image (⇑(similMap a ha φ)) := by
    apply Finset.coe_injective
    rw [Finset.coe_image, hQv]
  rw [hfin]
  exact Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (similMap a ha φ).injective

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.similar_refl
statement: theorem similar_refl (P : ConvexPolytope n) : Similar P P
proof:
:= by

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleSubgroup_conj_exists
statement:
private theorem simpleSubgroup_conj_exists
    (P Q : ConvexPolytope n) (hregP : P.IsRegular) (hregQ : Q.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (G : Q.Flag) (Φ : E n ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] E n)
    (hconj : ∀ i x,
      Φ (simpleReflection P hregP F i x) =
        simpleReflection Q hregQ G i (Φ x))
    {w : symGroup P} (hw : w ∈ simpleSubgroup P hregP F) :
    ∃ w' : symGroup Q,
      w' ∈ simpleSubgroup Q hregQ G ∧
        ∀ x, (w' : Isom n) (Φ x) = Φ ((w : Isom n) x)
proof:
:= by
  change w ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (simpleGen P hregP F)) at hw
  induction hw using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem g hg =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hg
      refine ⟨simpleGen Q hregQ G i, simpleGen_mem Q hregQ G i, ?_⟩
      intro x
      change simpleReflection Q hregQ G i (Φ x) =
        Φ (simpleReflection P hregP F i x)
      exact (hconj i x).symm
  | one =>
      refine ⟨1, one_mem _, ?_⟩
      intro x
      simp
  | mul a b ha hb iha ihb =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha'mem, ha'⟩ := iha
      obtain ⟨b', hb'mem, hb'⟩ := ihb
      refine ⟨a' * b', mul_mem ha'mem hb'mem, ?_⟩
      intro x
      change (a' : Isom n) ((b' : Isom n) (Φ x)) =
        Φ ((a : Isom n) ((b : Isom n) x))
      rw [hb' x, ha' ((b : Isom n) x)]
  | inv a ha iha =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha'mem, ha'⟩ := iha
      refine ⟨a'⁻¹, inv_mem ha'mem, ?_⟩
      intro x
      apply (a' : Isom n).injective
      rw [ha' (((a⁻¹ : symGroup P) : Isom n) x)]
      simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleVertexOrbit_conj
statement:
theorem simpleVertexOrbit_conj
    (P Q : ConvexPolytope n) (hregP : P.IsRegular) (hregQ : Q.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (G : Q.Flag) (Φ : E n ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] E n)
    (hconj : ∀ i x,
      Φ (simpleReflection P hregP F i x) =
        simpleReflection Q hregQ G i (Φ x)) (v : E n) :
    (⇑Φ) '' simpleVertexOrbit P hregP F v =
      simpleVertexOrbit Q hregQ G (Φ v)
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w', hw'mem, hw'⟩ :=
      simpleSubgroup_conj_exists P Q hregP hregQ F G Φ hconj hw
    refine ⟨w', hw'mem, ?_⟩
    rw [← hwz]
    exact hw' v
  · intro hu
    obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwu⟩ := hu
    have hconj_symm : ∀ i y,
        Φ.symm (simpleReflection Q hregQ G i y) =
          simpleReflection P hregP F i (Φ.symm y) := by
      intro i y
      apply Φ.injective
      simpa using (hconj i (Φ.symm y)).symm
    obtain ⟨w', hw'mem, hw'⟩ :=
      simpleSubgroup_conj_exists Q P hregQ hregP G F Φ.symm
        hconj_symm hwmem
    refine ⟨(w' : Isom n) v, ⟨w', hw'mem, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      Φ ((w' : Isom n) v) =
          Φ (Φ.symm ((w : Isom n) (Φ v))) := by
            apply congrArg Φ
            simpa using hw' (Φ v)
      _ = (w : Isom n) (Φ v) := Φ.apply_symm_apply _
      _ = u := hwu

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleVertexOrbit_eq_singleton_of_fixed
statement:
theorem simpleVertexOrbit_eq_singleton_of_fixed
    (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (v : E n)
    (hfix : ∀ i, simpleReflection P hreg F i v = v) :
    simpleVertexOrbit P hreg F v = {v}
proof:
:= by
  have all_fix : ∀ (w : symGroup P),
      w ∈ simpleSubgroup P hreg F → (w : Isom n) v = v := by
    intro w hw
    change w ∈ Subgroup.closure (Set.range (simpleGen P hreg F)) at hw
    induction hw using Subgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem g hg =>
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hg
        change simpleReflection P hreg F i v = v
        exact hfix i
    | one => simp
    | mul a b ha hb iha ihb =>
        change (a : Isom n) ((b : Isom n) v) = v
        rw [ihb, iha]
    | inv a ha iha =>
        apply (a : Isom n).injective
        simp [iha]
  ext u
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    simpa using all_fix w hw
  · intro hu
    have huv : u = v := by simpa using hu
    subst u
    exact ⟨1, one_mem _, by simp⟩

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.famigliaPoligoni_card
statement:
@[simp] theorem famigliaPoligoni_card (n : ℕ) :
    (famigliaPoligoni n : ConvexPolytope 2).vertices.card = n + 3

:=
  poligono_card (n + 3) (by omega)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.platonicCount_two
statement: theorem platonicCount_two : platonicCount 2 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine platonicCount_eq_top 2 famigliaPoligoni ?_
  intro m n hmn
  have h : m + 3 = n + 3 := by
    simpa [famigliaPoligoni_card] using hmn
  omega

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faceDim_lt_of_ssubset
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hfQ : (facePolytope P hg).IsFace f :=
    facePolytope_isFace_of P hg hf hsub.1
  
  have hgconv : Convex ℝ g := hg.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have hout : ∃ w ∈ (facePolytope P hg).vertices, w ∉ f := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    have hsubg : g ⊆ f := by
      have h1 : g = (facePolytope P hg).toSet := (facePolytope_toSet P hg).symm
      rw [h1]
      have hsubv : ((facePolytope P hg).vertices : Set (E n)) ⊆ f := fun w hw =>
        hall w (by exact_mod_cast hw)
      have hfconv : Convex ℝ f := hf.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
      exact convexHull_min hsubv hfconv
    exact hsub.2 hsubg
  obtain ⟨w, hwV, hwf⟩ := hout
  have hwg : w ∈ g := by
    have h1 : w ∈ (facePolytope P hg).toSet :=
      subset_convexHull ℝ _ (by exact_mod_cast hwV)
    rwa [facePolytope_toSet P hg] at h1
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hfQ.1 hf.2
  rw [facePolytope_toSet P hg] at hl
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hf.2
  have hx₀' := hx₀
  rw [hl] at hx₀'
  set M : ℝ := l x₀ with hM
  have hlf : ∀ z ∈ f, l z = M := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' := hz
    rw [hl] at hz'
    exact le_antisymm (hx₀'.2 z hz'.1) (hz'.2 x₀ hx₀'.1)
  have hlw : l w < M := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hx₀'.2 w hwg) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      apply hwf
      rw [hl]
      exact ⟨hwg, fun y hy => h ▸ hx₀'.2 y hy⟩
  
  have hmono : vectorSpan ℝ f ≤ vectorSpan ℝ g :=
    vectorSpan_mono ℝ hsub.1
  have hle : faceDim f ≤ faceDim g := Submodule.finrank_mono hmono
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt | heq
  · exact hlt
  · exfalso
    have hspan_eq : vectorSpan ℝ f = vectorSpan ℝ g := by
      apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hmono
      show faceDim g ≤ faceDim f
      exact le_of_eq heq.symm
    have haff_le : affineSpan ℝ f ≤ affineSpan ℝ g := affineSpan_mono ℝ hsub.1
    have haff_eq : affineSpan ℝ f = affineSpan ℝ g := by
      have hx₀m : x₀ ∈ affineSpan ℝ f := subset_affineSpan ℝ _ hx₀
      apply le_antisymm haff_le
      intro y hy
      have hdir : (affineSpan ℝ f).direction = (affineSpan ℝ g).direction := by
        rw [direction_affineSpan, direction_affineSpan, hspan_eq]
      have h1 : y -ᵥ x₀ ∈ (affineSpan ℝ g).direction :=
        AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hy (haff_le hx₀m)
      rw [← hdir] at h1
      have := AffineSubspace.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction h1 hx₀m
      simpa using this
    
    have hconst : ∀ y ∈ affineSpan ℝ f, l y = M := by
      intro y hy
      have heqon : Set.EqOn (⇑l.toLinearMap.toAffineMap)
          (⇑(AffineMap.const ℝ (E n) M)) f := by
        intro z hz
        simp [hlf z hz]
      have h2 := AffineMap.eqOn_affineSpan (k := ℝ) heqon  
      have := h2 hy
      simpa using this
    have hw_aff : w ∈ affineSpan ℝ f := by
      rw [haff_eq]
      exact subset_affineSpan ℝ _ hwg
    have := hconst w hw_aff
    linarith

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coda_pattern
statement:
theorem coda_pattern (c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℕ) (hc0 : (c 0) ^ 2 = 1 / 2)
    (hci : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ L - 2 → (c i) ^ 2 = 1 / 4) :
    ∀ k, k + 1 ≤ L → minoreGram c (k + 1) = (1 / 2) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => intro _; simp [minoreGram]
  | one => intro _; rw [minoreGram_due, hc0]; norm_num
  | more j ih1 ih2 =>
    intro hjL
    rw [show j + 2 + 1 = (j + 1) + 2 from by ring, minoreGram_succ_succ,
      ih2 (by omega), ih1 (by omega), hci (j + 1) (by omega) (by omega),
      pow_succ, pow_succ]
    ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.doppio_quattro_D_zero
statement:
theorem doppio_quattro_D_zero (c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℕ) (hL : 2 ≤ L)
    (hc0 : (c 0) ^ 2 = 1 / 2) (hci : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ L - 2 → (c i) ^ 2 = 1 / 4)
    (hcL : (c (L - 1)) ^ 2 = 1 / 2) :
    minoreGram c (L + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcoda := coda_pattern c L hc0 hci
  have hDL : minoreGram c L = (1 / 2) ^ (L - 1) := by
    have := hcoda (L - 1) (by omega); rwa [show (L - 1) + 1 = L from by omega] at this
  have hDLm1 : minoreGram c (L - 1) = (1 / 2) ^ (L - 2) := by
    have := hcoda (L - 2) (by omega); rwa [show (L - 2) + 1 = L - 1 from by omega] at this
  rw [show L + 1 = (L - 1) + 2 from by omega, minoreGram_succ_succ, hcL,
    show (L - 1) + 1 = L from by omega, hDL, hDLm1,
    show L - 1 = (L - 2) + 1 from by omega, pow_succ]
  ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.doppio_quattro_impossibile
statement:
theorem doppio_quattro_impossibile (c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℕ) (hL : 2 ≤ L)
    (hc0 : (c 0) ^ 2 = 1 / 2) (hci : ∀ i, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ L - 2 → (c i) ^ 2 = 1 / 4)
    (hcL : (c (L - 1)) ^ 2 = 1 / 2)
    (hmin : 0 < minoreGram c (L + 1)) : False
proof:
:= by
  rw [doppio_quattro_D_zero c L hL hc0 hci hcL] at hmin
  exact lt_irrefl 0 hmin

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.image_trans_isom
statement:
theorem image_trans_isom (φ ψ : Isom n) (S : Set (E n)) :
    (⇑(φ.trans ψ)) '' S = (⇑ψ) '' ((⇑φ) '' S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.image_image]
  rfl

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.eq_id_of_mapFlag_eq
statement:
theorem eq_id_of_mapFlag_eq (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hfull : P.IsFullDim)
    {φ : Isom n} (hφ : P.isSymmetry φ) (F : P.Flag)
    (h : mapFlag P hφ F = F) : ∀ x : E n, φ x = x
proof:
:= by
  refine bandiera_fissata_id P hfull hφ F (fun k => ?_)
  have hk := congrArg (fun G : P.Flag => G.face k) h
  simpa only [mapFlag_face] using hk

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleReflection_sq
statement:
theorem simpleReflection_sq (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) (x : E n) :
    simpleReflection P hreg F i (simpleReflection P hreg F i x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hi : P.isSymmetry (simpleReflection P hreg F i) :=
    simpleReflection_isSymmetry P hreg F i
  have hcomp : P.isSymmetry
      ((simpleReflection P hreg F i).trans (simpleReflection P hreg F i)) :=
    symmetry_transN hi hi
  have hflag : mapFlag P hcomp F = F := by
    rw [← mapFlag_trans P hi hi F]
    exact simpleReflection_sq_fixes P hreg F i
  have h := eq_id_of_mapFlag_eq P hreg.1 hcomp F hflag x
  simpa using h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleReflection_far_rel
statement:
theorem simpleReflection_far_rel (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ (j : ℕ)) (x : E n) :
    simpleReflection P hreg F i (simpleReflection P hreg F j
      (simpleReflection P hreg F i
        (simpleReflection P hreg F j x))) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hi : P.isSymmetry (simpleReflection P hreg F i) :=
    simpleReflection_isSymmetry P hreg F i
  have hj : P.isSymmetry (simpleReflection P hreg F j) :=
    simpleReflection_isSymmetry P hreg F j
  have hs : P.isSymmetry
      ((simpleReflection P hreg F j).trans (simpleReflection P hreg F i)) :=
    symmetry_transN hj hi
  have hss : P.isSymmetry
      (((simpleReflection P hreg F j).trans
        (simpleReflection P hreg F i)).trans
        ((simpleReflection P hreg F j).trans
          (simpleReflection P hreg F i))) :=
    symmetry_transN hs hs
  have hflag : mapFlag P hss F = F := by
    rw [← mapFlag_trans P hs hs F, ← mapFlag_trans P hj hi F,
      ← mapFlag_trans P hj hi (mapFlag P hi (mapFlag P hj F))]
    exact simpleReflection_far_comm_fixes P hreg F hij
  have h := eq_id_of_mapFlag_eq P hreg.1 hss F hflag x
  simpa using h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.simpleReflection_ne_id
statement:
theorem simpleReflection_ne_id (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n) :
    ¬ (∀ x : E n, simpleReflection P hreg F i x = x)
proof:
:= by
  intro hid
  have hflag : mapFlag P (simpleReflection_isSymmetry P hreg F i) F = F := by
    apply flag_ext
    funext k
    show (⇑(simpleReflection P hreg F i)) '' F.face k = F.face k
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      rwa [hid z]
    · intro hy
      exact ⟨y, hy, hid y⟩
  have hne := adjacentFlag_ne P hreg.1 F i
  rw [← simpleReflection_mapFlag P hreg F i] at hne
  exact hne hflag

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faccia_intermedia_e_una_delle_due_al_bordo
statement:
theorem faccia_intermedia_e_una_delle_due_al_bordo (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hbordo : (i : ℕ) + 2 = n)
    (hcomm : adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F i)
        ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ =
      adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩) i)
    {C : Set (E n)} (hC : P.IsFace C) (hdC : faceDim C = (i : ℕ))
    (hsotto : ∀ k : Fin n, (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → F.face k ⊂ C)
    (hsopra : C ⊂ P.toSet) :
    C = F.face i ∨ C = (adjacentFlag P hfull F i).face i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hGout, hGi⟩ :=
    bandiera_del_residuo_al_bordo P hfull F i hi hbordo
      hC hdC hsotto hsopra
  have hgal := residuo_rango_tre_connesso P hfull F G i hi
    (fun k hk hk2 => (hGout k hk hk2).symm)
  have h := facce_del_residuo_chiuso P hfull F i hi hcomm hgal
  rw [hGi] at h
  exact h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ordine_tre_bordo_alto
statement:
theorem ordine_tre_bordo_alto (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hbordo : (i : ℕ) + 2 = n)
    (hipos : 0 < (i : ℕ)) :
    3 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set ip : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ with hip
  have hne : i ≠ ip := by
    intro he
    have : (i : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := congrArg Fin.val he
    omega
  have hge2 : 2 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip :=
    coxeterMatrix_off_diag_ge P hreg F hne
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip) 3 with hlt | hge
  · exfalso
    have h2 : coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip = 2 := by omega
    have hcomm := mosse_commutano_di_ordine_due P hreg F hne h2
    obtain ⟨im, him⟩ : ∃ im : ℕ, (i : ℕ) = im + 1 :=
      ⟨(i : ℕ) - 1, by omega⟩
    have himn : im < n := by omega
    let A : Fin n := ⟨im, himn⟩
    have hAval : (A : ℕ) = im := rfl
    have hAtop : F.face A ⊆ P.toSet :=
      face_subset_toSet P (F.isFace A)
    have hAB : F.face A ⊂ P.toSet := by
      refine ⟨hAtop, ?_⟩
      intro htopA
      have heq : F.face A = P.toSet :=
        Set.Subset.antisymm hAtop htopA
      have hdim := congrArg faceDim heq
      have htopdim : faceDim P.toSet = n := hreg.1
      rw [F.dim_eq A, hAval, htopdim] at hdim
      omega
    have hrank : faceDim P.toSet = faceDim (F.face A) + 3 := by
      have htopdim : faceDim P.toSet = n := hreg.1
      rw [htopdim, F.dim_eq A, hAval]
      omega
    obtain ⟨C₁, C₂, C₃, hC₁, hC₂, hC₃, h12, h13, h23⟩ :=
      tre_intermedie_di_rango_tre P (F.isFace A) (toSet_isFace P) hAB hrank
    have hdim : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, faceDim C = faceDim (F.face A) + 1 →
        faceDim C = (i : ℕ) := by
      intro C hC
      rw [hC, F.dim_eq A, hAval]
      omega
    have hsotto : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, F.face A ⊂ C →
        ∀ k : Fin n, (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → F.face k ⊂ C := by
      intro C hAC k hk
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (k : ℕ) im with hklt | hkge
      · refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ hAC.le
        refine F.strict_mono k A ?_
        rw [Fin.lt_def, hAval]
        exact hklt
      · have hkA : k = A := by
          apply Fin.ext
          show (k : ℕ) = im
          omega
        rw [hkA]
        exact hAC
    have hone : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, P.IsFace C → F.face A ⊂ C →
        C ⊂ P.toSet → faceDim C = faceDim (F.face A) + 1 →
        C = F.face i ∨ C = (adjacentFlag P hreg.1 F i).face i := by
      intro C hCface hAC hCTop hCdim
      exact faccia_intermedia_e_una_delle_due_al_bordo P hreg.1 F i hi
        hbordo hcomm hCface (hdim hCdim) (hsotto hAC) hCTop
    have r₁ := hone hC₁.1 hC₁.2.1 hC₁.2.2.1 hC₁.2.2.2
    have r₂ := hone hC₂.1 hC₂.2.1 hC₂.2.2.1 hC₂.2.2.2
    have r₃ := hone hC₃.1 hC₃.2.1 hC₃.2.2.1 hC₃.2.2.2
    rcases r₁ with e₁ | e₁ <;> rcases r₂ with e₂ | e₂ <;>
      rcases r₃ with e₃ | e₃
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h13 (e₁.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h23 (e₂.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h23 (e₂.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h13 (e₁.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
  · exact hge

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.faccia_zero_e_una_delle_due
statement:
theorem faccia_zero_e_una_delle_due (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hfull : P.IsFullDim) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hi2 : (i : ℕ) + 2 < n)
    (hi0 : (i : ℕ) = 0)
    (hcomm : adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F i)
        ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ =
      adjacentFlag P hfull (adjacentFlag P hfull F ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩) i)
    {C : Set (E n)} (hC : P.IsFace C) (hdC : faceDim C = 0)
    (hsopra : C ⊂ F.face ⟨(i : ℕ) + 2, hi2⟩) :
    C = F.face i ∨ C = (adjacentFlag P hfull F i).face i
proof:
:= by
  have hsotto : ∀ k : Fin n, (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) → F.face k ⊂ C := by
    intro k hk
    omega
  obtain ⟨G, hGout, hGi⟩ :=
    bandiera_del_residuo_generale P hfull F i hi hi2 hC
      (by simpa [hi0] using hdC) hsotto hsopra
  have hgal := residuo_rango_tre_connesso P hfull F G i hi
    (fun k hk hk2 => (hGout k hk hk2).symm)
  have h := facce_del_residuo_chiuso P hfull F i hi hcomm hgal
  rw [hGi] at h
  exact h

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.ordine_tre_bordo_zero
statement:
theorem ordine_tre_bordo_zero (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hi2 : (i : ℕ) + 2 < n)
    (hi0 : (i : ℕ) = 0) :
    3 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set ip : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩ with hip
  have hne : i ≠ ip := by
    intro he
    have : (i : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := congrArg Fin.val he
    omega
  have hge2 : 2 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip :=
    coxeterMatrix_off_diag_ge P hreg F hne
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip) 3 with hlt | hge
  · exfalso
    have h2 : coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ip = 2 := by omega
    have hcomm := mosse_commutano_di_ordine_due P hreg F hne h2
    let i2 : Fin n := ⟨(i : ℕ) + 2, hi2⟩
    let Q := facePolytope P (F.isFace i2)
    have hQdim : faceDim Q.toSet = 2 := by
      change faceDim (facePolytope P (F.isFace i2)).toSet = 2
      rw [facePolytope_toSet P (F.isFace i2), F.dim_eq i2]
      change (i : ℕ) + 2 = 2
      omega
    obtain ⟨C₁, C₂, C₃, hC₁, hC₂, hC₃, h12, h13, h23⟩ :=
      tre_vertici_di_poligono Q hQdim
    have hlift : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, Q.IsFace C → P.IsFace C := by
      intro C hCQ
      exact isFace_of_facePolytope P (F.isFace i2) hCQ
    have hstrict : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, Q.IsFace C → faceDim C = 0 →
        C ⊂ F.face i2 := by
      intro C hCQ hCdim
      have hsubQ := face_subset_toSet Q hCQ
      have hsub : C ⊆ F.face i2 := by
        change C ⊆ (facePolytope P (F.isFace i2)).toSet at hsubQ
        rwa [facePolytope_toSet P (F.isFace i2)] at hsubQ
      refine ⟨hsub, ?_⟩
      intro hback
      have heq : C = F.face i2 := Set.Subset.antisymm hsub hback
      have hdimEq := congrArg faceDim heq
      rw [hCdim, F.dim_eq i2] at hdimEq
      change 0 = (i : ℕ) + 2 at hdimEq
      omega
    have hone : ∀ {C : Set (E n)}, Q.IsFace C → faceDim C = 0 →
        C = F.face i ∨ C = (adjacentFlag P hreg.1 F i).face i := by
      intro C hCQ hCdim
      exact faccia_zero_e_una_delle_due P hreg.1 F i hi hi2 hi0 hcomm
        (hlift hCQ) hCdim (hstrict hCQ hCdim)
    have r₁ := hone hC₁.1 hC₁.2
    have r₂ := hone hC₂.1 hC₂.2
    have r₃ := hone hC₃.1 hC₃.2
    rcases r₁ with e₁ | e₁ <;> rcases r₂ with e₂ | e₂ <;>
      rcases r₃ with e₃ | e₃
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h13 (e₁.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h23 (e₂.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h23 (e₂.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h13 (e₁.trans e₃.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
    · exact h12 (e₁.trans e₂.symm)
  · exact hge

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.coxeterMatrix_adiacente_ge_tre_ovunque
statement:
theorem coxeterMatrix_adiacente_ge_tre_ovunque (P : ConvexPolytope n)
    (hreg : P.IsRegular) (F : P.Flag) (i : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    3 ≤ coxeterMatrix P hreg F i ⟨(i : ℕ) + 1, hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (i : ℕ) with hi0 | hipos
  · have hi2 : (i : ℕ) + 2 < n := by omega
    exact ordine_tre_bordo_zero P hreg F i hi hi2 hi0
  · have hi2le : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ n := by omega
    rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hi2le with hi2 | hbordo
    · exact coxeterMatrix_adiacente_ge_tre P hreg F i hi hi2 hipos
    · exact ordine_tre_bordo_alto P hreg F i hi hbordo hipos

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.norma_poligonoVertice
statement:
theorem norma_poligonoVertice (n : Nat) (k : Fin n) :
    norm (poligonoVertice n k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [poligonoVertice, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    sq_abs, Matrix.cons_val_one]
  have htrig := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (poligonoAngolo n k)
  rw [show Real.cos (poligonoAngolo n k) ^ 2 +
    Real.sin (poligonoAngolo n k) ^ 2 = 1 by nlinarith]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.poligonoAngolo_nonneg
statement:
theorem poligonoAngolo_nonneg {n : Nat} (k : Fin n) :
    0 <= poligonoAngolo n k
proof:
:= by
  unfold poligonoAngolo
  positivity

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.poligonoAngolo_lt_two_pi
statement:
theorem poligonoAngolo_lt_two_pi {n : Nat} (hn : Not (n = 0)) (k : Fin n) :
    poligonoAngolo n k < 2 * Real.pi
proof:
:= by
  have hnR : (0 : Real) < (n : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
  have hkR : (k : Real) < (n : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast k.isLt
  unfold poligonoAngolo
  calc
    2 * Real.pi * (k : Real) / (n : Real) <
        (2 * Real.pi * (n : Real)) / (n : Real) :=
      (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hnR).2 (by
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos])
    _ = 2 * Real.pi := by field_simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.poligonoVertice_injective
statement:
theorem poligonoVertice_injective {n : Nat} (hn : Not (n = 0)) :
    Function.Injective (poligonoVertice n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hcos : Real.cos (poligonoAngolo n i) =
      Real.cos (poligonoAngolo n j) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun x : E2 => (WithLp.ofLp x) 0) hij
    simpa [poligonoVertice] using h
  have hsin : Real.sin (poligonoAngolo n i) =
      Real.sin (poligonoAngolo n j) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun x : E2 => (WithLp.ofLp x) 1) hij
    simpa [poligonoVertice] using h
  have hcosSub : Real.cos
      (poligonoAngolo n i - poligonoAngolo n j) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub]
    rw [hcos, hsin]
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (poligonoAngolo n j)]
  have hlower : -(2 * Real.pi) <
      poligonoAngolo n i - poligonoAngolo n j := by
    have hi0 := poligonoAngolo_nonneg i
    have hjlt := poligonoAngolo_lt_two_pi hn j
    linarith
  have hupper : poligonoAngolo n i - poligonoAngolo n j <
      2 * Real.pi := by
    have hj0 := poligonoAngolo_nonneg j
    have hilt := poligonoAngolo_lt_two_pi hn i
    linarith
  have hangle : poligonoAngolo n i = poligonoAngolo n j := by
    have hz := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff_of_lt_of_lt hlower hupper).1 hcosSub
    linarith
  apply Fin.ext
  have hnR : (0 : Real) < (n : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
  unfold poligonoAngolo at hangle
  have hcast : (i : Real) = (j : Real) := by
    have hnum : 2 * Real.pi * (i : Real) =
        2 * Real.pi * (j : Real) :=
      (div_left_inj' (ne_of_gt hnR)).mp hangle
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  exact_mod_cast hcast

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.verticiPoligono_nonempty
statement: theorem verticiPoligono_nonempty (n : Nat) : (verticiPoligono n).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  case pos =>
    simp [verticiPoligono, hn]
  case neg =>
    have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    let k : Fin n := Fin.mk 0 hnpos
    refine Exists.intro (poligonoVertice n k) ?_
    simp [verticiPoligono, hn]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.verticiPoligono_cosferici
statement:
theorem verticiPoligono_cosferici (n : Nat) :
    (verticiPoligono n : Set E2) <= sphere 0 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  case pos =>
    subst n
    have hx0 : x = poligonoBase := by
      simpa [verticiPoligono] using hx
    subst x
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    exact norma_poligonoVertice 1 0
  case neg =>
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    simp [verticiPoligono, hn] at hx
    cases hx with
    | intro k hk =>
      subst x
      exact norma_poligonoVertice n k

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.poligono_card
statement:
theorem poligono_card (n : Nat) (hn : 3 <= n) :
    (poligono n).vertices.card = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn0 : Not (n = 0) := by omega
  simp only [poligono, verticiPoligono, if_neg hn0]
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective Finset.univ
    (poligonoVertice_injective hn0)]
  simp

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.primiTreVertici_injective
statement:
theorem primiTreVertici_injective (n : Nat) (hn : 3 <= n) :
    Function.Injective (primiTreVertici n hn)
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : Not (n = 0) := by omega
  exact (poligonoVertice_injective hn0).comp (Fin.castLE_injective hn)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.primiTreVertici_affineIndependent
statement:
theorem primiTreVertici_affineIndependent (n : Nat) (hn : 3 <= n) :
    AffineIndependent Real (primiTreVertici n hn)
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical
      (Set.range (primiTreVertici n hn)) := by
    refine Exists.intro 0 (Exists.intro 1 ?_)
    intro x hx
    cases hx with
    | intro k hk =>
      subst x
      simpa [primiTreVertici, dist_zero_right] using
        norma_poligonoVertice n (Fin.castLE hn k)
  exact hcos.affineIndependent Set.Subset.rfl
    (primiTreVertici_injective n hn)

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.affineSpan_verticiPoligono_eq_top
statement:
theorem affineSpan_verticiPoligono_eq_top (n : Nat) (hn : 3 <= n) :
    affineSpan Real (verticiPoligono n : Set E2) =
      affineSpan Real (Set.univ : Set E2)
proof:
:= by
  have hai := primiTreVertici_affineIndependent n hn
  have hspan :=
      (hai.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_card_eq_finrank_add_one).2 (by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin, finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin]
    )
  have hn0 : Not (n = 0) := by omega
  have hrange : Set.range (primiTreVertici n hn) <=
      (verticiPoligono n : Set E2) := by
    intro x hx
    cases hx with
    | intro k hk =>
      subst x
      simp [primiTreVertici, verticiPoligono, hn0]
  have hle := affineSpan_mono Real hrange
  rw [hspan] at hle
  simpa only [AffineSubspace.span_univ] using top_unique hle

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.poligono_isFullDim
statement:
theorem poligono_isFullDim (n : Nat) (hn : 3 <= n) :
    (poligono n).IsFullDim
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank Real (vectorSpan Real
    (convexHull Real (verticiPoligono n : Set E2))) = 2
  rw [(direction_affineSpan Real
      (convexHull Real (verticiPoligono n : Set E2))).symm,
    affineSpan_convexHull, affineSpan_verticiPoligono_eq_top n hn,
    AffineSubspace.span_univ, AffineSubspace.direction_top, finrank_top,
    finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin]

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.finestra_quadrupla
statement:
theorem finestra_quadrupla (P : ConvexPolytope n) (hreg : P.IsRegular)
    (F : P.Flag) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (s : ℕ) (hs5 : s + 5 ≤ n)
    (ha : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩)
    (hb : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩)
    (hc : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩)
    (hd : 3 ≤ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 3, by omega⟩) :
    (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 3, by omega⟩ = 3) ∨
      (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 4 ∧ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 3, by omega⟩ = 3) ∨
      (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧
        schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ = 3 ∧ schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 3, by omega⟩ = 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := finestra_classificata P hreg F hn s (by omega) ha hb hc
  have hright := finestra_classificata P hreg F hn (s + 1) (by omega) hb hc hd
  simp only [show s + 1 + 1 = s + 2 from rfl, show s + 1 + 2 = s + 3 from rfl] at hright
  have h0 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F s
      = Real.cos (π / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F s (by omega) (by omega)
  have h1 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F (s + 1)
      = Real.cos (π / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 1, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F (s + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have h2 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F (s + 2)
      = Real.cos (π / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 2, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F (s + 2) (by omega) (by omega)
  have h3 : coxeterCoeff P hreg F (s + 3)
      = Real.cos (π / (schlafli P hreg F ⟨s + 3, by omega⟩ : ℝ)) :=
    coxeterCoeff_eq_cos_schlafli P hreg F (s + 3) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hD5 := window_minori_positivi P hreg F hn s 5 (by omega)
  rw [minoreGram_cinque] at hD5
  simp only [Nat.add_zero, h0, h1, h2, h3] at hD5
  exact quadrupla_classificata _ _ _ _ hleft hright hD5

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.minoreGram_cinque
statement:
theorem minoreGram_cinque (c : ℕ → ℝ) :
    minoreGram c 5 = 1 - (c 0) ^ 2 - (c 1) ^ 2 - (c 2) ^ 2 - (c 3) ^ 2
      + (c 0) ^ 2 * (c 2) ^ 2 + (c 0) ^ 2 * (c 3) ^ 2 + (c 1) ^ 2 * (c 3) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (5 : ℕ) = 3 + 2 from rfl, minoreGram_succ_succ, minoreGram_quattro,
    minoreGram_tre]; ring

name: LeanEval.Geometry.PlatonicClassification.quadrupla_classificata
statement:
theorem quadrupla_classificata (a b c d : ℕ)
    (hleft : (a = 3 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3) ∨ (a = 4 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3) ∨
        (a = 3 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 4) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ b = 4 ∧ c = 3) ∨
        (a = 5 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3) ∨ (a = 3 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 5))
    (hright : (b = 3 ∧ c = 3 ∧ d = 3) ∨ (b = 4 ∧ c = 3 ∧ d = 3) ∨
        (b = 3 ∧ c = 3 ∧ d = 4) ∨ (b = 3 ∧ c = 4 ∧ d = 3) ∨
        (b = 5 ∧ c = 3 ∧ d = 3) ∨ (b = 3 ∧ c = 3 ∧ d = 5))
    (hD5 : 0 < 1 - Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 - Real.cos (π / b) ^ 2
        - Real.cos (π / c) ^ 2 - Real.cos (π / d) ^ 2
        + Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 * Real.cos (π / c) ^ 2
        + Real.cos (π / a) ^ 2 * Real.cos (π / d) ^ 2
        + Real.cos (π / b) ^ 2 * Real.cos (π / d) ^ 2) :
    (a = 3 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3 ∧ d = 3) ∨ (a = 4 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3 ∧ d = 3) ∨
      (a = 3 ∧ b = 3 ∧ c = 3 ∧ d = 4)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lo, hi⟩ := sqrt_five_bounds
  rcases hleft with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ |
      ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
    rcases hright with ⟨hb, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨hb, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨hb, hc, rfl⟩ |
        ⟨hb, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨hb, hc, rfl⟩ | ⟨hb, hc, rfl⟩ <;>
    first
      | omega
      | (exfalso
         simp only [show ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 3 by norm_num,
           show ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 4 by norm_num, show ((5 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 5 by norm_num,
           cos_pi_div_three_sq, cos_pi_div_four_sq, cos_pi_div_five_sq] at hD5
         nlinarith [lo, hi, hD5])

name: mem_verticiCubo_iff
statement:
theorem mem_verticiCubo_iff {v : E3} : v ∈ verticiCubo ↔
    v = c0 ∨ v = c1 ∨ v = c2 ∨ v = c3 ∨ v = c4 ∨ v = c5 ∨ v = c6 ∨ v = c7
proof:
:= by
  simp [verticiCubo]

name: norm_vertici_cubo
statement: theorem norm_vertici_cubo : ∀ v ∈ verticiCubo, ‖v‖ = Real.sqrt 3
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rcases mem_verticiCubo_iff.mp hv with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;> subst h
  · show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(1:ℝ), 1, 1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]; norm_num
  · show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(1:ℝ), 1, -1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]; norm_num
  · show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(1:ℝ), -1, 1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]; norm_num
  · show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(1:ℝ), -1, -1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]; norm_num
  · show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(-1:ℝ), 1, 1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]; norm_num
  · show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(-1:ℝ), 1, -1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]; norm_num
  · show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(-1:ℝ), -1, 1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]; norm_num
  · show ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ![(-1:ℝ), -1, -1] : E3)‖ = _
    rw [norma_toLp]; norm_num

name: rotX_c0
statement: theorem rotX_c0 : rotFacciaX c0 = c2
proof:
:= by
  ext j <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [rotFacciaX, scambioYZ, segnoY, c0, c2, Equiv.swap_apply_def,
      LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft, LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrRight]

statement: theorem rotX_c2 : rotFacciaX c2 = c3
proof:
:= by

    simp [rotFacciaX, scambioYZ, segnoY, c2, c3, Equiv.swap_apply_def,

name: rotX_c3
statement: theorem rotX_c3 : rotFacciaX c3 = c1
proof:
:= by

name: rotX_c1
statement: theorem rotX_c1 : rotFacciaX c1 = c0
proof:
:= by
  ext j <;> fin_cases j <;>

name: rotAffX_apply
statement: theorem rotAffX_apply (z : E3) : rotAffX z = rotFacciaX z
proof: := rfl

name: c0_ne_c2
statement: theorem c0_ne_c2 : c0 ≠ c2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => (WithLp.ofLp v) 1) h
  simp [c0, c2] at this
  norm_num at this

name: c0_ne_c3
statement: theorem c0_ne_c3 : c0 ≠ c3
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => (WithLp.ofLp v) 1) h
  simp [c0, c3] at this
  norm_num at this

name: c0_ne_c1
statement: theorem c0_ne_c1 : c0 ≠ c1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => (WithLp.ofLp v) 2) h
  simp [c0, c1] at this
  norm_num at this

name: c2_ne_c3
statement: theorem c2_ne_c3 : c2 ≠ c3
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => (WithLp.ofLp v) 2) h

statement: theorem c2_ne_c1 : c2 ≠ c1
proof:
:= by

statement: theorem c3_ne_c1 : c3 ≠ c1

name: orbita_rotX
statement:
theorem orbita_rotX : ∀ i : Fin 4, (⇑rotAffX)^[(i : ℕ)] c0
    = ![c0, c2, c3, c1] i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · rfl
  · show rotAffX c0 = c2
    rw [rotAffX_apply, rotX_c0]
  · show rotAffX (rotAffX c0) = c3
    rw [rotAffX_apply, rotAffX_apply, rotX_c0, rotX_c2]
  · show rotAffX (rotAffX (rotAffX c0)) = c1
    rw [rotAffX_apply, rotAffX_apply, rotAffX_apply, rotX_c0, rotX_c2, rotX_c3]

name: ciclo_chiuso
statement: theorem ciclo_chiuso : (⇑rotAffX)^[4] c0 = c0
proof:
:= by
  show rotAffX ((⇑rotAffX)^[3] c0) = c0
  have h3 := orbita_rotX 3
  simp only [show ((3 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 3 from rfl] at h3
  rw [h3]
  show rotAffX c1 = c0
  rw [rotAffX_apply, rotX_c1]

name: ciclo_iniettivo
statement:
theorem ciclo_iniettivo : Function.Injective
    (fun i : Fin 4 => (⇑rotAffX)^[(i : ℕ)] c0)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' : (⇑rotAffX)^[(i : ℕ)] c0 = (⇑rotAffX)^[(j : ℕ)] c0 := hij
  rw [orbita_rotX i, orbita_rotX j] at hij'
  clear hij
  rename' hij' => hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first
    | rfl
    | (exfalso; revert hij; simp only []
       first
         | exact fun h => c0_ne_c2 h
         | exact fun h => c0_ne_c3 h
         | exact fun h => c0_ne_c1 h
         | exact fun h => c2_ne_c3 h
         | exact fun h => c2_ne_c1 h
         | exact fun h => c3_ne_c1 h
         | exact fun h => c0_ne_c2 h.symm
         | exact fun h => c0_ne_c3 h.symm
         | exact fun h => c0_ne_c1 h.symm
         | exact fun h => c2_ne_c3 h.symm
         | exact fun h => c2_ne_c1 h.symm
         | exact fun h => c3_ne_c1 h.symm)

name: range_orbita
statement:
theorem range_orbita : Set.range (fun i : Fin 4 => (⇑rotAffX)^[(i : ℕ)] c0)
    = (facciaX1 : Set E3)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    show (⇑rotAffX)^[(i : ℕ)] c0 ∈ (facciaX1 : Set E3)
    rw [orbita_rotX i]
    fin_cases i <;> simp [facciaX1]
  · intro hz
    have hcasi : z = c0 ∨ z = c2 ∨ z = c3 ∨ z = c1 := by
      simpa [facciaX1] using hz
    rcases hcasi with h | h | h | h <;> subst h
    · exact ⟨0, by
        show (⇑rotAffX)^[((0 : Fin 4) : ℕ)] c0 = c0
        rw [orbita_rotX 0]
        rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by
        show (⇑rotAffX)^[((1 : Fin 4) : ℕ)] c0 = c2
        rw [orbita_rotX 1]
        rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨2, by
        show (⇑rotAffX)^[((2 : Fin 4) : ℕ)] c0 = c3
        rw [orbita_rotX 2]
        rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨3, by
        show (⇑rotAffX)^[((3 : Fin 4) : ℕ)] c0 = c1
        rw [orbita_rotX 3]
        rfl⟩

name: lato_cubo
statement: theorem lato_cubo : dist c0 (rotAffX c0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotAffX_apply, rotX_c0]
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  have hsub : c0 - c2 = WithLp.toLp 2 ![0, 2, 0] := by
    ext j <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [c0, c2] <;> norm_num
  rw [hsub, norma_toLp]
  rw [show (0:ℝ)^2 + 2^2 + 0^2 = 4 by norm_num]
  rw [show (4:ℝ) = 2^2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]

name: lX_toLp
statement: theorem lX_toLp (a b c : ℝ) : lX (WithLp.toLp 2 ![a, b, c]) = a
proof: := rfl

name: lX_vertici
statement:
theorem lX_vertici : lX c0 = 1 ∧ lX c1 = 1 ∧ lX c2 = 1 ∧ lX c3 = 1 ∧
    lX c4 = -1 ∧ lX c5 = -1 ∧ lX c6 = -1 ∧ lX c7 = -1
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: argmax_verticiX
statement:
theorem argmax_verticiX : {x ∈ (verticiCubo : Set E3) | lX x = 1}
    = (facciaX1 : Set E3)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, hlz⟩
    rcases mem_verticiCubo_iff.mp (by exact_mod_cast hz) with
      h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;> subst h
    · simp [facciaX1]
    · simp [facciaX1]
    · simp [facciaX1]
    · simp [facciaX1]
    · exfalso; rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.2.1] at hlz; norm_num at hlz
    · exfalso; rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.2.2.1] at hlz; norm_num at hlz
    · exfalso; rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.2.2.2.1] at hlz; norm_num at hlz
    · exfalso; rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.2.2.2.2] at hlz; norm_num at hlz
  · intro hz
    have hcasi : z = c0 ∨ z = c2 ∨ z = c3 ∨ z = c1 := by
      simpa [facciaX1] using hz
    rcases hcasi with h | h | h | h <;> subst h
    · exact ⟨by simp [verticiCubo], lX_vertici.1⟩
    · exact ⟨by simp [verticiCubo], lX_vertici.2.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨by simp [verticiCubo], lX_vertici.2.2.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨by simp [verticiCubo], lX_vertici.2.1⟩

name: toSet_le_uno
statement: theorem toSet_le_uno : ∀ z ∈ cubo.toSet, lX z ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hsub : (verticiCubo : Set E3) ⊆ {w : E3 | lX w ≤ 1} := by
    intro w hw
    rcases mem_verticiCubo_iff.mp (by exact_mod_cast hw) with
      h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;> subst h <;>
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] <;>
      first
        | (rw [lX_vertici.1])
        | (rw [lX_vertici.2.1])
        | (rw [lX_vertici.2.2.1])
        | (rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.1])
        | (rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.2.1]; norm_num)
        | (rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.2.2.1]; norm_num)
        | (rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.2.2.2.1]; norm_num)
        | (rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.2.2.2.2]; norm_num)
  have hcx : Convex ℝ {w : E3 | lX w ≤ 1} :=
    convex_halfSpace_le (LinearMap.isLinear lX.toLinearMap) 1
  exact convexHull_min hsub hcx hz

name: F₀_ge_uno
statement: theorem F₀_ge_uno : ∀ z ∈ F₀, 1 ≤ lX z
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hsub : (facciaX1 : Set E3) ⊆ {w : E3 | 1 ≤ lX w} := by
    intro w hw
    have hcasi : w = c0 ∨ w = c2 ∨ w = c3 ∨ w = c1 := by
      simpa [facciaX1] using hw
    rcases hcasi with h | h | h | h <;> subst h <;>
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    · rw [lX_vertici.1]
    · rw [lX_vertici.2.2.1]
    · rw [lX_vertici.2.2.2.1]
    · rw [lX_vertici.2.1]
  have hcx : Convex ℝ {w : E3 | 1 ≤ lX w} :=
    convex_halfSpace_ge (LinearMap.isLinear lX.toLinearMap) 1
  exact convexHull_min hsub hcx hz

name: F₀_sub_toSet
statement: theorem F₀_sub_toSet : F₀ ⊆ cubo.toSet
proof:
:= by
  apply convexHull_mono
  intro z hz
  have hcasi : z = c0 ∨ z = c2 ∨ z = c3 ∨ z = c1 := by
    simpa [facciaX1] using hz
  rcases hcasi with h | h | h | h <;> subst h <;> simp [cubo, verticiCubo]

name: facciaX1_esposta
statement: theorem facciaX1_esposta : IsExposed ℝ cubo.toSet F₀
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  refine ⟨lX, ?_⟩
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hz1 : lX z = 1 := le_antisymm
      (toSet_le_uno z (F₀_sub_toSet hz)) (F₀_ge_uno z hz)
    refine ⟨F₀_sub_toSet hz, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    rw [hz1]
    exact toSet_le_uno y hy
  · rintro ⟨hzS, hzmax⟩
    have hc0S : c0 ∈ cubo.toSet := by
      apply subset_convexHull
      simp [cubo, verticiCubo]
    have hz1 : lX z = 1 := by
      have h1 : lX c0 ≤ lX z := hzmax c0 hc0S
      rw [lX_vertici.1] at h1
      exact le_antisymm (toSet_le_uno z hzS) h1
    have hL3 := faccia_argmax verticiCubo lX hzS
      (fun w hw => hzmax w hw)
    have hset : {x ∈ (verticiCubo : Set E3) | lX x = lX z}
        = (facciaX1 : Set E3) := by
      rw [hz1]
      exact argmax_verticiX
    rw [hset] at hL3
    exact hL3

name: rotAffX_preserva_F₀
statement: theorem rotAffX_preserva_F₀ : (⇑rotAffX) '' F₀ = F₀
proof:
:= by
  show (⇑rotAffX) '' (convexHull ℝ (facciaX1 : Set E3)) = _
  have haff : (⇑rotAffX) '' (convexHull ℝ (facciaX1 : Set E3))
      = convexHull ℝ ((⇑rotAffX) '' (facciaX1 : Set E3)) :=
    AffineMap.image_convexHull rotAffX.toAffineIsometry.toAffineMap _
  rw [haff]
  congr 1
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hcasi : y = c0 ∨ y = c2 ∨ y = c3 ∨ y = c1 := by
      simpa [facciaX1] using hy
    rcases hcasi with h | h | h | h <;> subst h <;>
      rw [rotAffX_apply] <;>
      first
        | (rw [rotX_c0]; simp [facciaX1])
        | (rw [rotX_c2]; simp [facciaX1])
        | (rw [rotX_c3]; simp [facciaX1])
        | (rw [rotX_c1]; simp [facciaX1])
  · intro hz
    have hcasi : z = c0 ∨ z = c2 ∨ z = c3 ∨ z = c1 := by
      simpa [facciaX1] using hz
    rcases hcasi with h | h | h | h <;> subst h
    · exact ⟨c1, by simp [facciaX1], by rw [rotAffX_apply, rotX_c1]⟩
    · exact ⟨c0, by simp [facciaX1], by rw [rotAffX_apply, rotX_c0]⟩
    · exact ⟨c2, by simp [facciaX1], by rw [rotAffX_apply, rotX_c2]⟩
    · exact ⟨c3, by simp [facciaX1], by rw [rotAffX_apply, rotX_c3]⟩

name: lX_su_faccia
statement: theorem lX_su_faccia : ∀ u ∈ (facciaX1 : Set E3), lX u = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  rw [← argmax_verticiX] at hu
  exact hu.2

name: span_le_ker
statement:
theorem span_le_ker : vectorSpan ℝ (facciaX1 : Set E3)
    ≤ LinearMap.ker lX.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.span ℝ ((facciaX1 : Set E3) -ᵥ (facciaX1 : Set E3)) ≤ _
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro d ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  show lX (u -ᵥ v) = 0
  rw [vsub_eq_sub, map_sub, lX_su_faccia u hu, lX_su_faccia v hv, sub_self]

name: finrank_ker_lX
statement:
theorem finrank_ker_lX :
    Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker lX.toLinearMap) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective lX.toLinearMap := by
    intro t
    refine ⟨t • c0, ?_⟩
    rw [map_smul]
    show t • lX c0 = t
    rw [lX_vertici.1, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker lX.toLinearMap
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj, finrank_top] at hrn
  have hE3 : Module.finrank ℝ E3 = 3 := by
    simp [E3, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
  rw [hE3] at hrn
  have hR : Module.finrank ℝ ℝ = 1 := Module.finrank_self ℝ
  omega

name: indep_d
statement: theorem indep_d : LinearIndependent ℝ ![d1, d2]
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_fin2]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => (WithLp.ofLp v) 2) h
    simp [d2, c0, c1] at this
  · intro a h
    have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => (WithLp.ofLp v) 1) h
    simp [d1, d2, c0, c1, c2] at this
    norm_num at this

name: finrank_span_faccia
statement:
theorem finrank_span_faccia :
    Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (facciaX1 : Set E3)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · calc Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (facciaX1 : Set E3))
        ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker lX.toLinearMap) :=
          Submodule.finrank_mono span_le_ker
      _ = 2 := finrank_ker_lX
  · have hsub : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![d1, d2])
        ≤ vectorSpan ℝ (facciaX1 : Set E3) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i
      · have hm := vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ
          (show c0 ∈ (facciaX1 : Set E3) by simp [facciaX1])
          (show c2 ∈ (facciaX1 : Set E3) by simp [facciaX1])
        simpa [d1, vsub_eq_sub] using hm
      · have hm := vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ
          (show c0 ∈ (facciaX1 : Set E3) by simp [facciaX1])
          (show c1 ∈ (facciaX1 : Set E3) by simp [facciaX1])
        simpa [d2, vsub_eq_sub] using hm
    have h2 : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![d1, d2])) = 2 := by

name: cubo_finrank
statement:
theorem cubo_finrank :
    Module.finrank ℝ (vectorSpan ℝ (cubo.vertices : Set E3)) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : c0 ∈ (cubo.vertices : Set E3) := by simp [cubo, verticiCubo]
  have hc1 : c1 ∈ (cubo.vertices : Set E3) := by simp [cubo, verticiCubo]
  have hc2 : c2 ∈ (cubo.vertices : Set E3) := by simp [cubo, verticiCubo]
  have hc4 : c4 ∈ (cubo.vertices : Set E3) := by simp [cubo, verticiCubo]
  have htop : vectorSpan ℝ (cubo.vertices : Set E3) = ⊤ := by
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.span_eq, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    all_goals simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply,
      SetLike.mem_coe]
    · show EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)
        ∈ vectorSpan ℝ (cubo.vertices : Set E3)
      have hd : (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
          = (2⁻¹ : ℝ) • (c0 -ᵥ c4) := by
        ext j <;> fin_cases j <;>
          simp [c0, c4, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> norm_num
      rw [hd]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hc0 hc4)
    · show EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)
        ∈ vectorSpan ℝ (cubo.vertices : Set E3)
      have hd : (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
          = (2⁻¹ : ℝ) • (c0 -ᵥ c2) := by
        ext j <;> fin_cases j <;>
          simp [c0, c2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> norm_num
      rw [hd]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hc0 hc2)
    · show EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)
        ∈ vectorSpan ℝ (cubo.vertices : Set E3)
      have hd : (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))
          = (2⁻¹ : ℝ) • (c0 -ᵥ c1) := by
        ext j <;> fin_cases j <;>
          simp [c0, c1, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> norm_num
      rw [hd]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (vsub_mem_vectorSpan ℝ hc0 hc1)
  rw [htop, finrank_top]
  simp [E3]

name: exposedFace_eq_convexHull_vertices_cubo
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset E3 := cubo.vertices.filter (· ∈ F)
  have hPcompact : IsCompact cubo.toSet :=
    (cubo.vertices.finite_toSet.isCompact_convexHull ℝ)
  have hFcompact : IsCompact F := hF.1.isCompact hPcompact
  have hFconvex : Convex ℝ F := hF.1.convex (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
  have hKM := closure_convexHull_extremePoints hFcompact hFconvex
  have hext : F.extremePoints ℝ = (S : Set E3) := by
    rw [hF.1.isExtreme.extremePoints_eq]
    ext x
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, mem_inter_iff]
    change (x ∈ F ∧ x ∈ cubo.toSet.extremePoints ℝ) ↔
      x ∈ cubo.vertices ∧ x ∈ F
    rw [FiniteConvexPolytope.toSet, ← cubo.vertices_eq_extremePoints]
    tauto
  calc
    F = closure (convexHull ℝ (F.extremePoints ℝ)) := hKM.symm
    _ = closure (convexHull ℝ (S : Set E3)) := by rw [hext]
    _ = convexHull ℝ (S : Set E3) :=
      (S.finite_toSet.isClosed_convexHull ℝ).closure_eq
    _ = convexHull ℝ
        ((cubo.vertices.filter (· ∈ F) : Finset E3) : Set E3) := rfl

            rw [← argmax_verticiX]; exact ⟨hu, hx1⟩

            simpa [facciaX1] using hux

          · rw [lY_vertici.2.2.1] at hy1; norm_num at hy1
          · rw [lY_vertici.2.2.2.1] at hy1; norm_num at hy1
          · simp
        have := span_coppia_le hsub
        omega)
